scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1206_0.de: * Ich bin der DP-Meister. Frag mich über DP./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1206_0.en:
* I'm TP Master.
* Ask me about TP's./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1206_0.es:
* Soy el Maestro del PT.
* Pregúntame sobre los PT./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1206_0.ja:
＊ ボクは　TPマスター。
＊ TPのことなら　なんでも聞いて。/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1206_0.ko:
* 나는 TP 마스터.
* TP에 관한 거라면 뭐든 물어봐./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1206_0.pl:
* Nauczam o PA.
* Pytaj mnie o PA./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1206_0.pt-BR:
* Eu sou o Mestre PA.
* Me pergunte sobre PAs./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1206_0.zh:
* 我是TP大师。
* 问我关于TP的事。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1214_0.de: * DP? Was ist DP? Die lassen dich MAGIE wirken, OK!?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1214_0.en:
* TP? What's TP?
* That's what lets you cast SPELLS, see!?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1214_0.es: * ¿PT? ¿Qué es PT? Es lo que alimenta tus HECHIZOS, ¿¡no lo ves!?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1214_0.ja:
＊ TP？　ってなぁにィ？
＊ 必要なんだよ
　 「まほう」使うのにィ！/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1214_0.ko:
* TP? TP가 뭐냐?
* 마법을 쓸 때 필요한 숫자야!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1214_0.pl:
* PA? Czym jest PA?
* Pozwala ci rzucać CZARY waluta ta!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1214_0.pt-BR:
* PA? O que é PA?
* É o que te deixa usar MAGIAS, tá?!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1214_0.ru:
* ПН что такое, узнать вы хотите?
* С ним ЗАКЛИНАНИЕ в жизнь воплотите!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1214_0.zh:
* TP？什么是TP？
* 那是用来让你施展【法术】的东西！/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1215_0.de: * Wenn der Balken orange wird, wirke MAGIE wenn sie sich füllt./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1215_0.en:
* When you see that orange bar,
* Cast some SPELLS when it's filled up far./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1215_0.es: * Cuando veas esa barra NARANJA, lanza HECHIZOS si se alarga la FRANJA./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1215_0.ja:
＊ 見えるだろ　オレンジのメータァー。
＊ 「まほう」使えよ
　 上まで　たまったらァ。/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1215_0.ko:
* 주황색 막대를 봐.
* 꽉 차 있으면 마법을 써 봐./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1215_0.pl:
* Gdy ujrzysz pomarańczowy pasek,
* Wiedz, że wypełniony pozwoli ci zaklęć rzucić masę./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1215_0.pt-BR:
* Quando a barra laranja
você avistar, use MAGIAS
quando ela acumular./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1215_0.ru: * Как только полоска заполнится слева — использовать МАГИЮ можете смело./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1215_0.zh:
* 盯着那根橙色光柱，
* 快满了就赶紧用些法术。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1216_0.de: * DP...! Ist nicht verkehrt! DP! Steht für... ... Dickes Pferd!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1216_0.en:
* TP...! It's quite a caper!
* TP! Stands for...
* ... Toilet Paper!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1216_0.ja:
＊ TP！　ってなぁにィ？
＊ TP！　
　 「トイレットペーパー」って意味ィ！/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1216_0.ko:
* TP...! 정말 대단하지!
* TP! 이것은 바로...
* ... 토핑의 약자지!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1216_0.pl:
* PA...! To jest ciekawa sprawa!
* Rozwinięcie PA to...
* Pełna Autonaprawa!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1216_0.pt-BR:
* PA...! É um belo esquema!
* PA! significa...
* ... Pino de Antena!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1216_0.ru:
* ПН! Не подумать о нём без тоски.
* А значит ПН... Порванные носки!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1216_0.zh:
* TP...！它可了不起！
* TP！它表示...
* ...调皮！/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1218_0.en: * ... no, it stands for Tension Points./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1218_0.ja:
＊ …じゃなくて
　 「テンションポイント」の
　 略です。/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1218_0.pl: * Nieprawda, rozwinięcie skrótu PA to Punkty Adrenaliny./

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1220_0.ja: 1＊ えええぇ！　そうなの！？/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1224_0.de: * DP hält nur für einen Kampf. Gewinnst du, sind sie verdampft./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1224_0.en:
* TP only lasts, inside a fight.
* Once you win, it's out of sight./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1224_0.es: * Los PT solo duran durante la BATALLA. Una vez ganes, se irán a la PLAYA./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1224_0.ja:
＊ TP！　バトル終わると
　 もどるよ　ゼロ！
＊ バトル勝ったら　消えるよ　ドロン！/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1224_0.ko:
* TP는 전투가 끝나면 사라져.
* 네가 이기면 쓸데없어져./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1224_0.pl:
* PA tylko w walce się znajduje.
* Zanim wygracie, zużyjcie je, bo się zmarnuje./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1224_0.pt-BR:
* PA só dura, durante uma luta.
* Depois que vencer, ele não continua./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1224_0.ru:
* ПН существует в СРАЖЕНИИ лишь.
* Исчезнет оно, хоть и ты победишь./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1224_0.zh:
* TP只会持续，一整场战斗。
* 一旦取得胜利，它就会溜走。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1225_0.de: * Zuviele zu haben, unerträglich. Brauchst nicht zu sparen, das ist unsäglich./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1225_0.en:
* Having extra, feels unbearable.
* No point in saving, it's straight-up terrible./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1225_0.es:
* Cuando te sobran, es INSOPOR-
TABLE. No los guardes, malgastarlos es DESPRECIABLE./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1225_0.ja:
＊ 余分に　あっても「だからなにィ？」
＊ 使わずためても　意味ないしィ。/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1225_0.ko:
* 안 쓰고 남겨봤자 신경만 거슬리지.
* 아끼고 모아봤자 뭣도 안 되지./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1225_0.pl:
* W oszczędzaniu go sensu brak.
* Po walce i tak znika, sam nie wiem jak./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1225_0.pt-BR:
* Ter PA extra, parece incabível.
* Não há razão pra poupar, é claramente terrível./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1225_0.ru:
* Копить выше меры его толку нет.
* Хранить невозможно, исчезнет в момент./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1225_0.zh:
* 拥有多余点数，令人难以忍受。
* 点数存不下来，情况简直糟透。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1227_0.de: Doch werden überflüssige DP am Ende zu zusätzlichem Geld.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1227_0.en: * But leftover TP turns into extra money at the end of battle.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1227_0.es: * Pero los PT que sobren se convierten en dinero extra tras la batalla.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1227_0.ja:
＊ でも　TPが残っている状態で
　 バトルを終えると　おカネを
　 多くもらえますよ…？/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1227_0.ko:
* 쓰고 남은 TP는 
  전투가 끝나면 돈이 돼요.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1227_0.pl: * Przecież resztki PA zmieniają się pod koniec walki w walutę.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1227_0.pt-BR: * Mas o PA restante se torna dinheiro extra no fim de uma batalha.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1227_0.ru: * Но в конце сражения оставшиеся ПН конвертируются в деньги.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1227_0.zh:
* 但多出来的TP会在战斗结束后
变成额外的钱.../

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1229_0.de: 1* Meinst du ich hätt nur ein Quadrat benutzen sollen!?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1229_0.en: 1* You mean I only should have been using one square!?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1229_0.es: 1* ... he vivido engañado toda mi vida.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1229_0.ja:
1＊ ええぇ！　だったら
　 １回に使うのは　10センチまでに
　 しとけば　よかったよーーー！！/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1229_0.ko:
1* 뭐?!
  다 쓰지 말 걸 그랬다!!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1229_0.pl: 1* Czyli w ten sposób mogłem zdobyć więcej funduszy, by poprawić życia mego smak!?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1229_0.pt-BR: 1* Quer dizer que eu só deveria estar usando um pino?!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1229_0.zh:
1* 照你这么说我其实只用
一点点就好了！？/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1233_0.de: * DP erhältst du beim BLOCKEN. Schütze dich, und wirke dann MAGIE./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1233_0.en:
* You get TP when you DEFEND.
* Protect yourself, then cast SPELLs, friend./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1233_0.es: * Para conseguir PT, solo tienes que DEFENDER. Protégete y lanza HECHIZOS por DOQUIER./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1233_0.ja:
＊ 「ぼうぎょ」をすると　TPたまるゥ。
＊ まず身を守れば「まほう」使えるゥ。/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1233_0.ko:
* 방어를 하면 TP를 얻을 수 있어.
* 방어를 하고, 마법을 쓰라구,
  친구./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1233_0.pl:
* Aby PA zdobyć, jest OBRONA.
* Chroń się, zaklęcia rzucaj, a dołączysz do zwycięzców grona./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1233_0.pt-BR:
* PA se ganha quando se DEFENDE.
* Proteja-se e use MAGIAS sabiamente./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1233_0.ru:
* Вы получаете ПН, себя ЗАЩИЩАЯ.
* Затем победите, врага ЗАКЛИНАЯ./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1233_0.zh:
* 当你【防御】时会获得TP点数。
* 保护自己，然后用点【法术】。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1234_0.de: * Du bekommst auch DP wenn du Kugeln nahe kommst./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1234_0.en: * You also get TP by getting close to bullets./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1234_0.es: * También puedes conseguir PT al acercarte a las BALAS./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1234_0.ja:
＊ 敵弾　ギリで　かわしても
　 TPたまるゥ。/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1234_0.ko:
* 적탄에 스칠 때도
  TP를 얻을 수 있지./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1234_0.pt-BR: * PA também se ganha ficando próximo das balas./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1234_0.zh: * 如果身旁擦过子弹，就能增加TP。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1235_0.de: * Achte auf dem Umriss um dein Herz wenn du Kugeln nahe kommst./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1235_0.en: * Look for the heart outline when you get close to bullets./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1235_0.es: * Fíjate en la silueta del corazón cuando te acerques a las BALAS./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1235_0.ja:
＊ 敵弾　近づき　ハートの外側
　 枠が見えたら　TPたまるゥ。/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1235_0.ko:
* 적탄에 스칠 때는
  하트의 윤곽에 스쳐야 하지./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1235_0.pl: * Obserwuj obwódkę serca, kiedy zbliżasz się do pocisków./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1235_0.pt-BR: * Olhe o contorno no coração ao ficar próximo das balas./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1235_0.ru: * Контур сердца ищите, приближаясь к снарядам./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1235_0.zh: * 出现心形线框，表示获得TP。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1237_0.de: Du hast "nahe kommst" mit "nahe kommst" gereimt./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1237_0.ja:
＊ 「TPたまる」って
　 ２回言ったな。
　 ショボいリリックだぜ。/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1237_0.ko:
* 스친다는 말을
  몇 번을 하는 거야./

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1239_0.ja:
1＊ だ…大事なことだから
　 ２回言ったんだよぅ！/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1244_0.de: Du hast "nahe kommst" mit "nahe kommst" gereimt...?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1244_0.ja:
＊ 「TPたまる」って
　 ２回言いましたね…
　 イマイチなリリックです…/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1255_0.de: * Ich bin der Ralsei-Meister. Frag mich über RALSEI./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1255_0.en:
* I'm Ralsei Master.
* Ask me about RALSEI's./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1255_0.es:
* Soy el Maestro de Ralsei.
* Pregúntame sobre RALSEI./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1255_0.ja:
＊ ボクは　ラルセイ・マスター。
＊ ラルセイのことなら
　 なんでも聞いて。/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1255_0.ko:
* 나는 랄세이 마스터.
* 랄세이에 관한 거라면
  뭐든 물어봐./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1255_0.pl:
* Nauczam o Ralseiu.
* Pytaj mnie o RALSEIA./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1255_0.pt-BR:
* Eu sou o Mestre Ralsei.
* Me pergunte sobre RALSEIs./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1255_0.zh:
* 我是Ralsei大师。
* 问我RALSEI的事。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1263_0.de: * BERUHIGEN heisst Ralseis Zauber. Nutze ihn bei BABIES, dann werden sie SAUBER./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1263_0.en:
* Ralsei's spell's called PACIFY.
* Use it on BABIES, before they CRY./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1263_0.es: * Ralsei tiene un hechizo llamado APACIGUAR. Úsalo en BEBÉS y dejarán de LLORAR./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1263_0.ja:
＊ 「スリープ」。
　 それは　ラルセイの「まほう」ゥ！
　 電源おとさず　パソコン消せるゥ！/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1263_0.ko:
* 랄세이는 진정 마법을 쓸 수 있어.
* 우는 아기를 달랠 때
  쓸 수 있어./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1263_0.pl:
* Ralseia to jest zaklęcie.
* Ucisza ono DZIECIAKI, lecz niewdzięczne to zajęcie./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1263_0.pt-BR:
* A magia do Ralsei
é PACIFICAR. Use em BEBÊS
antes que possam CHORAR./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1263_0.ru:
* Ральзей УСМИРЕНИЯ магию знает.
* Используй на ДЕТЯХ, когда те РЫДАЮТ./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1263_0.zh:
* Ralsei有个法术叫【安抚】。
* 在婴儿哭之前，用它把嘴堵。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1265_0.de: Was? Er entfernt einen "MÜDEN" Gegner sicher aus dem Kampf./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1265_0.en: * What? It safely removes a "TIRED" enemy from combat./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1265_0.es: * ¿Qué? Lo que hace es retirar a los enemigos "FATIGADOS" del combate./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1265_0.ja:
＊ 違います…
　 「くたびれ」状態の敵を
　 倒さずに　逃がすんです。/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1265_0.ko:
* 아니에요!
  진정 마법은 '지친' 적을
  안전하게 보낼 때 쓰는 거예요./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1265_0.pl: * Co? Ono bezpiecznie usuwa „SENNEGO” wroga z WALKI./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1265_0.pt-BR: * Quê? Ela simplesmente tira um inimigo "CANSADO" do combate./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1265_0.ru: * Что? Оно безопасно выводит «УСТАВШЕГО» врага из битвы./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1265_0.zh:
* 不对！它是用来将一个“疲惫”
的敌人安全移出战斗的。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1267_0.de: 1* Und was wenn wir gegen BABIES kämpfen!?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1267_0.en: 1* What if you're fighting a BABY!?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1267_0.ja:
1＊ で…でも！
　 パソコンと戦うことが
　 あるかもしれないでしょ！？/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1267_0.pl: 1* A co jeśli walczysz z DZIECKIEM!?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1267_0.pt-BR: 1* E se você estiver lutando contra um BEBÊ?!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1267_0.ru: 1* А что, если вы сражаетесь с ДЕТЬМИ?!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1267_0.zh: 1* 万一你就是在和一个婴儿战斗呢！？/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1272_0.de: * Ralsei hat 'nen Zauber der dich HEILT, Alter./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1272_0.en: * Ralsei has a spell that HEALS, dude./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1272_0.es: * Tu compañero Ralsei tiene un hechizo que CURA./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1272_0.ja: ＊ ラルセイ使える　回復まほうゥ。/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1272_0.ko:
* 랄세이는 회복 마법을
  쓸 수 있지../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1272_0.pl: * Gostku, Ralsei ma zaklęcie zapewniające LECZENIE./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1272_0.pt-BR: * Ralsei tem uma magia que CURA Pontos de Vida./

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1273_0.de: * Doch warum das, wenn du hast FUTTER?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1273_0.en: * Why use that, when you can eat FOOD?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1273_0.es: * ¿Por qué usar eso, cuando puedes comer comida BASURA?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1273_0.ja:
＊ よくわからない…
　 食べ物と　なにが違うゥ？/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1273_0.pl: * Lecz po co go używać, skoro masz JEDZENIE?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1273_0.pt-BR: * Mas por que usar isso, quando já se tem COMIDA?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1273_0.ru: * Но нужно ль оно, коль есть много ВЕЩЕЙ?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1273_0.zh: * 为什么要用它，而不是直接吃东西？/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1275_0.de: Weil du dann kein ITEM nutzen bräuchtest?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1275_0.en: * Because you won't have to use up an ITEM?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1275_0.es: * ¿Porque así no tendría que gastar un OBJETO?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1275_0.ja:
＊ アイテムを使い果たさずに
　 すみますよ…？/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1275_0.pl: * Bo wtedy nie trzeba marnować przedmiotów?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1275_0.pt-BR: * Para não precisar desperdiçar um ITEM?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1275_0.ru: * Но ведь так можно не тратить ВЕЩИ на исцеление?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1275_0.zh: * 因为这样你不必消耗物品？/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1277_0.de: 1* Wie, ich hätte mir all die leeren Kalorien sparen können!?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1277_0.en: 1* I could have avoided all those empty calories!?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1277_0.ja:
1＊ じゃ…じゃあ…　今まで
　 ジャンクフード食べつづけてた
　 ボクは　なんだったの！？/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1277_0.pt-BR: 1* Eu poderia ter evitado todas aquelas calorias?!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1277_0.ru: 1* Я мог обойтись без всех этих лишних калорий?!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1277_0.zh: 1* 原来我本不用摄入过量的卡路里！？/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1281_0.de: * Ralsei liebt es, gibst du uns GELD./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1281_0.en: * Ralsei loves when you give us MONEY./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1281_0.es: * A Ralsei le encanta cuando nos das tu DINERO./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1281_0.ja:
＊ ラルセイよろこぶ　どんなときィ？
　 キミが　ボクらに
　 おカネくれるときィ！/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1281_0.ko:
* 네가 우리에게 돈을 주면
  랄세이가 기뻐할 거야./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1281_0.pl: * Ralsei uwielbia, jak dajesz nam KASĘ./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1281_0.pt-BR: * Ralsei adora quando nos dá DINHEIRINHO./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1281_0.ru: * Того, кто ДЕНЬЖАТ нам немного приплатит./

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1282_0.de: * Er wird dich kuscheln, und nennt dich HELD./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1282_0.en: * He will hug you, and call you HONEY./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1282_0.es: * Si lo haces te abrazará, con amor y ESMERO./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1282_0.ja:
＊ そしたらラルセイ　キミをハグゥ！
　 そして「ボクのダーリン♪」
　 と呼ぶゥ！/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1282_0.ko:
* 자기야- 하면서,
  널 꼭 껴안아 줄 거야./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1282_0.pl: * Przytuli cię, a potem zrobi ciastek MASĘ./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1282_0.pt-BR: * Ele te abraçará e te chamará de DOCINHO./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1282_0.zh: * 他会抱住你，喊你小甜甜。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1285_0.en: 8* You don't need money to get me to do that!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1285_0.es: 8* ¡No necesitas gastar dinero para que lo haga!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1285_0.ja:
8＊ そんなこと　おカネを
　 払わなくたって　よろこんで
　 やってあげます！/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1285_0.ko:
8* 돈 같은 거 안 줘도
  다 해줄 거야!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1285_0.pl: 8* Nie potrzebuję pieniedzy, by to zrobić!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1285_0.pt-BR:
8* Não é preciso dinheiro
para eu fazer isso!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1285_0.ru: 8* Я могу сделать всё это и забесплатно!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1285_0.zh:
8* 你想让我做这种事的话
根本不必花钱！/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1294_0.de: * Ich bin der Susie-Meister. Frag mich über SUSIE./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1294_0.en:
* I'm Susie Master.
* Ask me about SUSIE's./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1294_0.es:
* Soy el Maestro de Susie.
* Pregúntame sobre SUSIE./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1294_0.ja:
＊ ボクは　スージィ・マスター。
＊ スージィのことなら
　 なんでも聞いて。/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1294_0.ko:
* 나는 수지 마스터.
* 수지에 관한 거라면
  뭐든 물어봐./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1294_0.pl:
* Nauczam o Susie.
* Pytaj mnie o SUSIE./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1294_0.pt-BR:
* Eu sou o Mestre Susie.
* Me pergunte sobre SUSIEs./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1294_0.zh:
* 我是Susie大师。
* 问我关于SUSIE的事。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1302_0.de: * Wenn KRIS WARNUNG nutzt, kann SUSIE nichts rei€en. Also geh hinter einen Baum -/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1302_0.en:
* When KRIS uses WARNING, SUSIE can't hit.
* So make sure to -/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1302_0.es:
* Cuando KRIS usa ADVERTIR, SUSIE FALLARÁ.
* Así que asegúrate de -/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1302_0.ja:
＊ クリスが　「けいこく」すると
　 スージィのこうげき　当たらないィ。
＊ だから…/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1302_0.ko:
* 크리스가 경고하면
  수지의 공격이 빗나가.
* 그러니 확실하게../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1302_0.pl:
* Kiedy KRIS wroga OSTRZEŻE, SUSIE go nie trafi.
* Upewnij się, że.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1302_0.pt-BR:
* Quando KRIS usa AVISAR, Susie não mais acertará.
* Então tenha certe -/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1302_0.ru:
* Если Крис предупреждает, Сьюзи бить не сможет.
* Так всегда держи в уме.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1302_0.zh:
* 一旦KRIS用【警告】，
SUSIE就打不中。
* 所以只要确保-/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1304_0.en: * So there's no reason to use it./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1304_0.es: * Así que no hay motivo para usarlo./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1304_0.ja:
＊ …「けいこく」なんて
　 するイミねーってことだな。/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1304_0.pt-BR: * Então não tem motivo pra usar./

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1306_0.de: 1* Au€er... Au€er wir wollen die Gegner nicht -/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1306_0.en:
1* Unless...
* Unless you wanted not to hurt -/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1306_0.es:
1* A no ser...
* A no ser que no quieras hacer daño -/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1306_0.ja:
1＊ でも…
＊ 敵を　こうげきしたくないときは…/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1306_0.pl:
1* Chyba że...
* Chyba że nie chcesz komuś zrobić krzywdy.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1306_0.pt-BR:
1* A menos...
* A não ser que não queira machucar -/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1306_0.zh:
1* 除非... 
* 除非你不想伤害-/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1308_0.ja:
＊ だから
　 「けいこく」なんて
　 するイミねーよな！/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1308_0.pl: * CZYLI NIE MA SENSU TEGO UŻYWAĆ./

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1312_0.de: * Susie ist fort, ich sehe, ihr seht./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1312_0.en: * Susie's gone, I'm afraid, I'm afreet./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1312_0.es: * Susie ya no está en el GRUPO./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1312_0.ja: ＊ スージィ消えたァ。ケタタタタァ。/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1312_0.pl: * Susie odeszła z drużyny, kamień z serca./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1312_0.pt-BR: * Susie sumiu, eu receio, eu receito./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1312_0.ru: * Сьюзи ушла, вас стерпеть не смогла./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1312_0.zh: * Susie已经离去，我又恢复生气！/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1313_0.de: * Es scheint WARNUNG ist nun obsolet./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1313_0.es: * De ADVERTIR ya no me PREOCUPO./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1313_0.ja:
＊ 「けいこく」はもう
　 いらなくなったァ。/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1313_0.pl: * OSTRZEGANIE wrogów już najpewniej nie wraca./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1313_0.zh: * 看起来【警告】已经可以废弃。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1317_0.de: * Die Tage des WARNENS, sind lang vorbei./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1317_0.en: * The days of WARNing, have long since past./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1317_0.es: * Los días de ADVERTIR quedaron en el PASADO./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1317_0.ja:
＊ 「けいこく」の日々は
　 過去のモノォ。/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1317_0.pt-BR: * Os dias de AVISO, há tempos passaram./

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1318_0.en: * The circumstances, changed pretty fast./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1318_0.es: * Me temo que las circunstancias han CAMBIADO./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1318_0.ja: ＊ 状況変わるよ　どんどんとォ。/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1318_0.ko:
* 세상 변하는 것도
  참 빠른 것 같네./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1318_0.pl: * Okoliczności te z serc naszych kamień zdjęły./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1318_0.zh: * 快到看不清，环境在更替。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1325_0.de: * Susie attackiert, den Gegner ganz oben./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1325_0.en: * Susie always attacks, the foe on top./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1325_0.es: * Susie siempre ataca al enemigo de ARRIBA./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1325_0.ja:
＊ スージィは　いつも必ずゥ
　 いちばん上の敵　こうげきするゥ。/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1325_0.ko: * 수지는 항상 맨 위에 있는 적을 공격해./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1325_0.pt-BR: * Susie sempre ataca, o inimigo mais pra cima./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1325_0.zh: * Susie总是攻击，最上方那一位。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1326_0.de: * Sie haut sie klein, das muss man loben./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1326_0.en: * She'll smash them, with a crushing chop./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1326_0.es: * Ella lo aplastará, no hay otra ALTERNATIVA./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1326_0.ja: ＊ ブッつぶすゥ。ブッたぎるゥ。/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1326_0.pl: * Gdy ktoś ją zdenerwuje, zemsta będzie sroga./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1326_0.pt-BR: * Ela vai esmagá-lo, com um corte que elimina./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1326_0.ru: * За пару ударов все сгинут они./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1326_0.zh: * 她会猛砸一斧，将那敌人粉碎。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1327_0.de: * Sie schlägt immer, das Erste was sie sieht.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1327_0.en: * She always strikes, at the first thing she sees.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1327_0.es: * Ella siempre golpea a lo primero que se mueva.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1327_0.ja:
＊ スージィは　いつも必ずゥ
　 最初に　目に入ったもの
　 こうげきするゥ…/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1327_0.pl: * Zawsze celuje w tego, kto się pierwszy napatoczy.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1327_0.pt-BR: * O primeiro que ela olhar, ela vai atingir.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1327_0.ru: * Ко всем, кого видит, жестока она.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1327_0.zh:
* 她第一眼看到的东西，
都会挨上一记重击.../

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1331_0.de: 1* Oh nein, oh nein! Sie sieht MICH an!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1331_0.en:
1* Oh no, oh no!
* She's looking at ME!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1331_0.es:
1* Oh, no, ¡oh, no!
* ¡Me está mirando a MÍ!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1331_0.ja:
1＊ あわ…あわわわわ！
＊ スージィが　こっち見てるゥゥ！/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1331_0.pl:
1* O nie, o nie!
* Czy ja spojrzałem jej prosto w oczy?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1331_0.pt-BR:
1* Ah não, ah não!
* Ela tá olhando pra MIM!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1331_0.ru:
1* О нет, о нет!
* Она глядит на МЕНЯ!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1331_0.zh:
1* 噢！不好！
* 她在瞪着我这里！/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1335_0.de: * Susie ist fort, also kein Angriff./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1335_0.en: * Susie's gone, so no attack./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1335_0.es: * Susie se ha ido, se acabó el ATAQUE./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1335_0.ja:
＊ スージィいないよ。
　 こうげきしないィ。/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1335_0.pl: * Susie z wami nie ma, więc o ataku cicho./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1335_0.ru: * Сьюзи тут нет, нас никто не побьёт./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1335_0.zh: * Susie已经离去，再也没有攻击。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1336_0.de: * Bekommt ihr zwei das noch in den Griff?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1336_0.en: * Will you two pick up the slack?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1336_0.es: * ¿Pondréis vosotros dos a los enemigos en JAQUE?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1336_0.ja:
＊ キミたち２人が
　 すりゃいんじゃないィ？/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1336_0.pl: * Mamy szczerą nadzieję, że ją weźmie licho./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1336_0.pt-BR: * Será que vocês vão fazer essa parte?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1336_0.ru: * Кто-то из вас ей в замену придёт?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1336_0.zh: * 你们俩还能否收拾这场残局？/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1341_0.de: * Susies BUSTER, so FRECH er auch ist.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1341_0.en: * Susie's BUSTER, RUDE as may be.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1341_0.es: * La DESCARGA de SUSIE, por BRUTAL que PAREZCA.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1341_0.ja:
＊ 「ルードバスター」
　 スージィの技ァ…/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1341_0.pt-BR: * O FOGO da Susie, por mais BRUTAL que possa ser.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1341_0.ru: * ВЗМАХ ЯРЫЙ у Сьюзи, насилье цветёт.../

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1342_0.de: * Macht mehr Schaden, wenn du ~1 drückst!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1342_0.en: * Will deal more damage, if you just press ~1!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1342_0.es: * Con solo pulsar el botón ~1, hará que la pena MEREZCA./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1342_0.ja: ＊ 大ダメージ与える 　 ~1を押せばァ！/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1342_0.ko: * [~1]를 눌러서 사용하면 더 강한 피해를 줄 거야!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1342_0.pl: * Zada więcej obrażeń, jeśli wciśniesz ~1!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1342_0.pt-BR: * Vai causar mais dano, se você apertar ~1!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1342_0.ru: * Усилит урон, кто на ~1 часто жмёт!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1342_0.zh: * 想要造成更多伤害，只需要按~1！ /

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1348_0.de: * Susie liebt, wenn du uns GELD gibst. Sie wird -/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1348_0.en:
* Susie loves, when you give us MONEY.
* She will -/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1348_0.es: * A Susie le encanta cuando nos das tu DINERO. Si lo haces te -/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1348_0.ja:
＊ スージィよろこぶ　どんなときィ？
　 キミが　ボクらに　おカn…/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1348_0.ko:
* 수지는 네가 우리에게
  돈을 주면 아주 기뻐../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1348_0.pl:
* Susie uwiebia, jak dajesz nam KASĘ.
* Ona wtedy.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1348_0.pt-BR:
* Susie adora quando nos dá DINHEIRINHO.
* Ela vai -/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1348_0.ru:
* Сьюзи любит, когда вы даёте нам ДЕНЬГИ.
* Она будет.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1348_0.zh:
* Susie喜欢你给我们钱。
* 她会-/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1350_0.ja:
＊ ベツに。
　 どーでもいいな。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1352_0.ja:
1＊ ボク　なんか
　 ヘンなこと言った！？/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1352_0.zh: 1* 我说了什么好笑的话吗！？/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1355_0.de: * Susie ist fort, also keine Fakten./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1355_0.en: * Susie's gone, so no facts./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1355_0.es: * Susie no está, así que nada de datos./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1355_0.ja:
＊ スージィいないよ。
　 マメ知識も　ないよォ。/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1355_0.pl: * Susie z wami nie ma, więc i faktów brak./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1355_0.ru: * Сьюзи исчезла, значит фактам не место./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1355_0.zh: * Susie已经离去，小知识没意义。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1356_0.de: * Kriegt ihr zwei das noch in die Akten?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1356_0.en: * Will you two pick up the slackts?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1356_0.ja:
＊ キミたち２人が
　 すりゃいんじゃないォ？/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1356_0.pl: * I tak wiecie o niej wszystko, czyż nie jest tak?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1356_0.pt-BR: * Será que vocês vão fazer essa partos?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1356_0.ru: * Может, кто-то из вас займёт её место?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1356_0.zh: * 你们俩还能否收拾这场残局？/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1360_0.de: * SUSIE hat sich verändert, wenn auch nur um ein Haar./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1360_0.en: * SUSIE seems to have changed, just a hair./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1360_0.es: * Parece que SUSIE se hizo un cambio de IMAGEN./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1360_0.ja: ＊ スージィ変わった　毛ほどの変化ァ。/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1360_0.pl: * Poprawa zachowania SUSIE, to niezła zagadka./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1360_0.pt-BR: * SUSIE parece ter mudado, mas só um bocado./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1360_0.ru: * Сьюзи ныне другая, перемен лишь настрой./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1360_0.zh: * 看来SUSIE总算有了，一丝丝改变。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1361_0.en: * That kind of growth is actually rare./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1361_0.es: * Aunque solo sea un pelo, ahora es radical y ELEGANTE./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1361_0.ja: ＊ そんな成長　かなりレアァ！/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1361_0.pl: * Taka zmiana charakteru jest dziś bardzo rzadka./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1361_0.pt-BR: * Esse tipo de crescimento na verdade é bem raro./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1361_0.ru: * Как мало всех тех, кто растёт над собой./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1361_0.zh: * 这样的成长还是挺罕见。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1377_0.de: * Ich bin der Kris-Meister. Frag mich über KRIS./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1377_0.en:
* I'm Kris Master.
* Ask me about KRIS's./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1377_0.es:
* Soy el Maestro de Kris.
* Pregúntame sobre KRIS./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1377_0.ja:
＊ ボクは　クリス・マスター。
＊ クリスのことなら　なんでも聞いて。/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1377_0.ko:
* 나는 크리스 마스터.
* 크리스에 관한 거라면
  뭐든 물어 봐./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1377_0.pl:
* Nauczam o Kris.
* Pytaj mnie o KRIS./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1377_0.pt-BR:
* Eu sou o mestre Kris.
* Me pergunte sobre KRISes./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1377_0.zh:
* 我是Kris大师。
* 问我关于KRIS的事。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1385_0.de: * Wird HP negativ, fallen deine Freunde um/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1385_0.en: * When HP goes negative, your friends fall down/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1385_0.es: * Cuando los PV bajan de 0, tus amigos CAERÁN./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1385_0.ja:
＊ HPゼロより下がると
　 仲間は気絶ゥ。/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1385_0.pl: * Kiedy PZ zabraknie, padną na glebę twoi przyjaciele./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1385_0.pt-BR: * Se o PV ficar negativo, os seus amigos cairão/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1385_0.ru: * Как ОЗ упадут, так ваш друг вслед за ним./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1385_0.zh: * HP变成负数时，你的朋友会倒下。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1386_0.de: * Doch sie hoch zu bringen, geht im Handherum/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1386_0.en: * But bringing them back, is easy-town/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1386_0.es: * Pero traerlos de vuelta es tan fácil como comprar PAN./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1386_0.ja: ＊ でもだいじょうぶゥ。すぐに復活ゥ。/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1386_0.pl: * Ale wyleczenie ich, nie kosztuje wiele./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1386_0.pt-BR: * Mas trazê-los de volta, é açúcar no mamão/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1386_0.ru: * Но верни его в строй, знай секрет лишь один./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1386_0.zh: * 要让他们站起来，方法简单又廉价。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1387_0.de: * Schlichtes Essen und Zauber, die wirken gescheit -/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1387_0.en: * Plain foods and spells, work like a charm -/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1387_0.es: * Comidas o hechizos, son la receta SUPREMA -/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1387_0.ja:
＊ 普通の食べ物…　回復まほうゥ…
　 どちらも　バッチリ効果アリィ！/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1387_0.ko:
* 그냥 음식과 마법만 있으면
  요술같이 해결돼./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1387_0.pl: * Zwykłe jedzenie i czary, działają jak marzenie.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1387_0.pt-BR: * Simples comidas e magias, funcionam como um encanto -/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1387_0.zh: * 简单的食物和法术，效果响当当-/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1388_0.de: * Und mit einer MINZE, heilst du jedes LEID./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1388_0.en: * And with a MINT, you can cure all HARM./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1388_0.es: * Y con una MENTA, curarás todo PROBLEMA./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1388_0.ja:
＊ 「ミント」を使えば　一気に復活ゥ！
　 HPだってMAXにィ！/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1388_0.ko:
* 근데 부활 민트가 있으면
  완전하게 해결돼./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1388_0.pl: * A dzięki MIĘTCE, członek drużyny przejdzie pełne leczenie./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1388_0.pt-BR: * E usando uma MENTA, você cura todo o DANO./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1388_0.ru: * А ЛЕДЕНЦОМ ты можешь с нуля воскресить./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1388_0.zh: * 要是用上了薄荷糖，治疗所有伤。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1390_0.de: Auch normales Essen und Zauber können Leute wiederbeleben, wie?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1390_0.en: * Even normal items and spells can revive people, huh?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1390_0.es:
* Conque tanto los objetos como los hechizos pue-
den revivir, ¿eh?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1390_0.ja:
＊ つまり　普通の回復アイテムや
　 まほうでも　気絶した仲間を
　 復活させられるってこと？/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1390_0.ko:
* 그러니까 평범한 음식이랑
  마법으로도 동료들을
  살릴 수 있단 말이죠?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1390_0.pl: * Wiesz, że nawet normalne jedzenie i czary są w stanie odrodzić?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1390_0.pt-BR: * Até itens normais e magias podem fazer as pessoas renascerem, hã?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1390_0.ru: * То есть можно исцелять даже обычными вещами, да?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1390_0.zh:
* 就连一般的物品和法术
也能使人复活，对吧？/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1392_0.en: * Yeah, that's what I'm saying!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1392_0.es: * ¡Veo que lo PILLAS, veo que lo CAPTAS!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1392_0.pl: * Tak, dokładnie to miałem na myśli!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1392_0.pt-BR: * Sim, é isso que estou falando!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1392_0.ru: * Да, о чём я и говорю!/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1397_0.de: * Zeigst du nur TATen, denk nach nochmal -/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1397_0.en: * If you only ACT, you might start to think -/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1397_0.es: * Si vas solo ACTUANDO, podrías llegar a PENSAR -/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1397_0.ja:
＊ キミはきっと　こう思うゥ。
　 「自分ばっかり『こうどう』」ゥ…/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1397_0.ko:
* 행동만 할 때는
  고민할 수 있지./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1397_0.pl: * Jeśli tylko ty możesz CZYNIĆ, to pewnie ci wpadło do głowy.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1397_0.pt-BR: * Se você só quer AGIR, você pode se perguntar -/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1397_0.ru: * Коль ДЕЙСТВУЕШЬ, то держи при уме.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1397_0.zh: * 当你采取【行动】时，可以想想看-/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1398_0.de: * Was ist mit dem Typen mit dem pinken Schal?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1398_0.en: * What about the guy with the scarf in pink?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1398_0.es: * ¿Y qué hay del tipo verde? ¿Sin hacer nada se va a QUEDAR?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1398_0.ja:
＊ 「ピンクのマフラーのヤツは
　 なにする」ゥ？/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1398_0.ko:
* 스카프 두른 애는
  뭘 시켜야 하지?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1398_0.pl: * Po co w drużynie ten w szaliku gość młody?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1398_0.pt-BR: * E o cara do cachecol rosa, o que ele fará?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1398_0.ru: * Что ты не один ведёшь бой в этой тьме./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1398_0.zh: * 让那个戴粉色围巾的怎么干？/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1400_0.de: Wenn du schon weisst, dass deine TATen den Gegner besänftigen werden -/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1400_0.en: * If you know ACTing will make the enemy friendly -/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1400_0.es: * Si sabes que tras ACTUAR el enemigo quedará satisfecho -/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1400_0.ja:
＊ クリスの「こうどう」で
　 敵と仲よくなれると
　 わかっているときは…/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1400_0.ko:
* 네 행동으로 상대가
  얌전해질 것 같으면.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1400_0.pl: * Jeśli wiesz, że twój CZYN uszczęśliwi wroga,/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1400_0.pt-BR: * Se você sabe que AGIR deixará o inimigo amigável -/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1400_0.ru: * Если ты знаешь, что твоё ДЕЙСТВИЕ расположит врага к нам.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1400_0.zh:
* 如果你预判这次的【行动】
会让敌人变得友好-/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1401_0.de: Dann kannst du mich im GLEICHEN ZUG fragen, den Gegner zu VERSCHONEN./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1401_0.en: * Then you can ask me to SPARE on the SAME TURN./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1401_0.es: * Entonces puedes pedirme que le muestre PIEDAD en el MISMO TURNO./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1401_0.ja:
＊ ボクには　敵を「にがす」
　 ように指示してくれれば
　 ターンを節約できるよ。/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1401_0.ko:
* 같은 턴에 나한테
  보내주라고 지시하면 돼./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1401_0.pl: * To możesz mnie poprosić, bym go OSZCZĘDZIŁ w TEJ SAMEJ TURZE./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1401_0.pt-BR: * Então você pode me pedir para POUPAR no MESMO TURNO./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1401_0.ru: * То ты можешь попросить меня ПОЩАДИТЬ его в тот же ход./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1401_0.zh:
* 那么你就可以让我
在同一回合里使用【饶恕】。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1402_0.de: Oder du wirkst BESÄNFTIGEN wenn du weisst, dass die MÜDE werden./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1402_0.en: * Or, cast PACIFY if you know they'll get TIRED./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1402_0.es: * O que conjure APACIGUAR si sabes que se sentirá FATIGADO./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1402_0.ja:
＊ 敵が「くたびれ」ると
　 わかっているときは
　 「スリープ」を使えばいい。/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1402_0.ko:
* 적이 지칠 것 같으면
  진정 마법을 쓰면 돼./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1402_0.pl: * Albo mogę rzucić zaklęcie SENNIK, gdy wiesz, że będzie SENNY./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1402_0.pt-BR: * Ou usar PACIFICAR, se souber que ficarão CANSADOS./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1402_0.ru: * Или использовать УСМИРЕНИЕ, если знаешь, что он УСТАНЕТ./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1402_0.zh:
* 或者，在你知道他们将要
【疲惫】的时候施展【安抚】。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1403_0.de: Wenn du voraus denkst, kann eine Menge in EINEM ZUG passieren!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1403_0.en: * If you plan ahead, a lot can happen in ONE TURN!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1403_0.es: * Si usas la cabeza, ¡muchas cosas pueden ocurrir en UN TURNO!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1403_0.ja:
＊ うまく先を読んで動けば
　 1ターンのあいだに
　 いろんなことができるよ！/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1403_0.ko:
* 계획만 잘 세우면,
  한 턴에 많은 걸
  할 수 있어!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1403_0.pl: * Jeśli zaplanujesz swoje ruchy, to możesz wiele osiągnąć w JEDNEJ TURZE!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1403_0.pt-BR: * Se planejar com antecedência, muito pode acontecer em UM TURNO!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1403_0.ru: * Если планировать всё наперёд, многое можно сделать ЗА ХОД!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1403_0.zh:
* 只要你提前规划好，
就可以在一回合里解决很多事！/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1405_0.de: 1* Hey, wer ist der MEISTER hier, ich oder du!?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1405_0.en: 1* Hey, who's the MASTER here, me or you!?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1405_0.es: 1* ¡Oye! ¿¡Quién es el MAESTRO aquí, tú o yo!?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1405_0.ja:
1＊ ちょっと！　マスターはボクだ！
　 キミじゃない！/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1405_0.pl: 1* Ej, kto tu jest NAUCZYCIELEM, ty, czy ja!?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1405_0.pt-BR: 1* Ei, quem é o MESTRE aqui, eu ou você?!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1405_0.ru: 1* Эй, кто здесь МАСТЕР, я или ты?!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1405_0.zh:
1* 嘿，这儿谁才是大师，
是你还是我！？/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1409_0.de: * Es wäre sehr schlau, gibst du uns TACKEN./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1409_0.en: * It's a good idea, to give us BUCKs./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1409_0.ja: ＊ どんどんしよう　ボクらに寄付ゥ。/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1409_0.ko:
* 너희 돈을 내게 주면,
  좋은 일 벌어지지./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1409_0.pl: * Dobrym planem jest dać nam SZMAL./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1409_0.pt-BR: * É uma boa ideia, que algum DINHEIRO nos mande./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1409_0.zh: * 若给我们钱，是个好主意。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1410_0.de: * Ihr wäret dann glücklich, lächelt mit den BACKEN./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1410_0.en: * It'll make you happy, and fill you with LUCKs./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1410_0.es: * Así todos contentos, nos beneficia a AMBOS./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1410_0.ja: ＊ 幸運授かり　ハッピーになるゥ。/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1410_0.pl: * Dzięki temu nie będzie cię trapił ŻAL./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1410_0.pt-BR: * Vai fazer você feliz e lhe dar uma SORTE grande./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1410_0.zh: * 带给你开心，还有好运气。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1411_0.en: * Over there, is our DONATION HOLE./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1411_0.es: * Por allí se encuentra nuestro AGUJERO DE DONACIÓN./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1411_0.ja: ＊ あそこにあるよ　「募金ホール」ゥ。/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1411_0.pl: * Oto nasza dziura DOTACJI, jakbyście nie zgadli./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1411_0.pt-BR: * Logo ali está, o nosso BURACO DE DOAÇÃO./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1411_0.ru: * ЯМУ для денег мы здесь откопали./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1411_0.zh: * 我们的募捐洞，就在那头。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1412_0.de: * Wir hatten ne KASSE, nur klauten sie sie DOCH./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1412_0.en: * We had a BOX, but it got STOLE./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1412_0.es: * Antes era una caja, pero fue robada por un BRIBÓN./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1412_0.ja:
＊ 盗まれちゃったよ
　 「募金ボックス」ゥ。/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1412_0.pl: * Mieliśmy PUDEŁKO, ale nam je ukradli./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1412_0.pt-BR: * Nós tinhamos uma CAIXA, mas foi levada por um LADRÃO./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1412_0.zh: * 我们曾有个箱子，但它早已被偷。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1422_0.de: * (Falls euch unsere Tutorials gefallen, wirf bitte dein Geld in das Loch.)/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1422_0.en: * (If you like our tutorials, please throw your money into a hole.)/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1422_0.es: * (Si te gustan nuestros tutoriales, por favor, lanza un poco de tu dinero al hoyo.)/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1422_0.ja:
＊ (私たちの　チュートリアルに
　 ご満足いただけたなら
　 穴に　おカネを入れてください)/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1422_0.ko:
* (우리 튜토리얼이 마음에 드시면,
  돈을 구멍에 넣어 주세요.)/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1422_0.pl: * (Proszę, jeśli lubisz nasze samouczki, wrzuć do dziury pieniążki.)/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1422_0.pt-BR: * (Se você gosta de nossos tutoriais, por favor, jogue seu dinheiro em um buraco.)/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1422_0.ru: * (Если вам понравились наши обучения, бросьте немного денег в нору.)/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1422_0.zh:
* （如果你喜欢我们的教程，
请把你的钱扔进洞里。）/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1426_0.en: * (The hole is filled to the brim with cash.)/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1426_0.es: * (El agujero está lleno hasta el tope de dinero.)/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1426_0.ja:
＊ (穴には　現金が
　 ギッシリ詰まっている)/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1426_0.pt-BR: * (O buraco está com dinheiro até o talo.)/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1426_0.zh: * （这个洞被现金装的快满出来了。）/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1433_0.en: * (You put a dollar in the "Hole.")/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1441_0.de: * (Geld in ein Loch zu werfen passte nicht in dein Budget...)/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1441_0.en: * (You failed to budget enough money to throw into a hole...)/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1441_0.es: * (Tu plan de ahorros fallido te impide dejar dinero...)/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1441_0.ja:
＊ (穴に　おカネを投げ入れる予算を
　 確保できなかった…)/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1441_0.ko:
* (당신은 구멍에 던져넣을 만한
  돈을 저축하지 못했다...)/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1441_0.pl: * (Nie udało ci się zaoszczędzić jednego dolara?)/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1441_0.pt-BR: * (Você falhou em orçar dinheiro suficiente para jogar num buraco...)/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1441_0.ru: * (Ваш бюджет не позволяет бросить доллар в нору...)/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1441_0.zh: * （你没有留够投入这个洞的预算...）/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1446_0.de: * (Du hebst deinen Dollar für ein anderes Loch auf.)/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1446_0.en: * (You decided to save the dollar for a different hole.)/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1446_0.es: * (Decides guardar el dólar para gastarlo en otro agujero.)/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1446_0.ja:
＊ (おカネは　別の穴のために
　 取っておくことにした)/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1446_0.pl: * (Wolisz wrzucić tego dolara do innej dziury.)/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1446_0.pt-BR: * (Você decidiu guardar o dólar para um buraco diferente.)/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1446_0.ru: * (Вы решили оставить доллар до другой норы.)/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1446_0.zh: * （你决定为了另一个洞而省下这$1。）/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1451_0.ja:
ラルセイが
食べてみて

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1455_0.de: Wie gehen die fiesen Planungen voran?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1455_0.en: * How's the evil scheming going?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1455_0.ja: ＊ 邪悪な計画は　順調？/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1455_0.pt-BR: * Como o esquema maligno está indo?/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1457_0.ja: ＊ は？　ああ　それな。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1458_0.de: 2Uns, äh, wurde langweilig. Also essen wir kurz was./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1458_0.en:
2* We, uh, got bored.
* So we're having a snack./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1458_0.es:
2* Nos, eh, hemos aburrido.
* Así que estamos tomándonos un aperitivo./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1458_0.ja:
2＊ そろそろ　あきてきたから
　 いまは　おやつの時間だ。/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1458_0.ko:
2* 그게, 음, 좀 재미없어져서.
* 간식 먹고 있어./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1458_0.pl:
2* Ten... znudziło nam się.
* Więc zrobiliśmy sobie przerwę na jedzonko./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1458_0.pt-BR:
2* Hã, a gente ficou entediado.
* Tamo lanchando./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1458_0.ru:
2* Нам, эм, наскучило.
* Так что мы ушли на перекус./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1458_0.zh:
2* 我们，呃，觉得有点无聊。
* 所以在吃点心。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1462_0.de: Komm schon! Alles was ich zum Frühstück hatte war Kreide!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1462_0.en: * C'mon! All I ate for breakfast was chalk!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1462_0.es: * ¡No me mires así! ¡Lo único que he comido para desayunar ha sido tiza!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1462_0.ja:
＊ しょーがねーだろ！
　 朝から　チョークしか
　 食ってねーんだから！/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1462_0.ko:
* 아침으로 분필 하나밖에
  안 먹었단 말이야!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1462_0.pl: * Gościu! Na śniadanie zjadłam tylko trochę kredy!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1462_0.pt-BR: * Qualé! Tudo que eu comi no café foi giz!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1462_0.ru: * Да ну тебя! У меня на завтрак был лишь мел!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1462_0.zh: * 拜托！我早饭就吃了点粉笔！/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1464_0.en: * And I didn't eat anything!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1464_0.ja:
＊ ボクさまなんて　なーんにも
　 食べてないぞ！/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1464_0.pl: * A ja nic dziś nie jadłem!/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1466_0.de: Verzeihung. Und was esst ihr beiden da, genau...?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1466_0.en: * Sorry. What are you two having, exactly...?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1466_0.es: * Lo siento. ¿Y qué estáis comiendo, exactamente?.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1466_0.ja:
＊ そうだったんだね…
　 えっと…　今日のおやつは
　 なあに？/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1466_0.ko:
* 그런데 너희 둘. 정확히
  뭘 먹고 있는 거야...?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1466_0.pt-BR: * Desculpem. E o que estão comendo, exatamente...?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1466_0.ru: * Извините. Так чем именно хотите перекусить?../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1466_0.zh:
* 不好意思。你们两个到底，
在吃什么...？/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1468_0.de: Nur eine kleine Köstlichkeit aus diesem Baumstumpf hier./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1468_0.en: * Just a daily treasure I hid in this stump's orifice./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1468_0.es: * Un tesoro que escondo a diario en el orificio de este tocón./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1468_0.ja:
＊ ボクさまが　この切り株の
　 体内に隠しておいた
　 「普段づかいのお宝」だ。/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1468_0.ko:
* 나무 둥치에 숨겨 둔
  하루 치 보물이지./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1468_0.pl: * Pewien smakołyk, który ukryłem dziś w tym pieńku./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1468_0.pt-BR: * Uma belezinha que escondi aqui nesse toquinho./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1468_0.ru: * Всего лишь ежедневным сокровищем, спрятанным мною в этом пне./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1468_0.zh:
* 在吃我藏在这个树桩洞里的
日常宝藏。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1470_0.ja:
＊ えーっと　それは…
　 つまり…？/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1472_0.de: Zieh es dir selbst rein, Genosse./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1472_0.en: * Feast for yourself, my main man./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1472_0.ja:
＊ 自分の舌で　よーく確認して
　 くれていいぞ。おまえと
　 ボクさまの仲だからな。/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1472_0.zh: * 敞开肚子吃吧，我的死党。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1474_0.de: Kris, willst du es, ähm, probieren?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1474_0.en: * Kris, do you want to, um, try it?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1474_0.ja:
＊ う…うん…
　 クリス　どうする？/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1488_0.de: 6Oh, es ist ein... Honigtopf? Da drin?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1488_0.ja:
6＊ わ…わあ…
＊ 中に…ツボがある…？
　 これは…ハチミツかな？/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1488_0.ko:
6* 아, 그거...
* 안에 든 건 꿀단지야?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1488_0.pl:
6* Och, w środku...
* Jest dzban? Po miodzie?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1488_0.pt-BR:
6* Ah, tem um...
* Pote de mel? Dentro?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1488_0.ru:
6* Ох, здесь...
* Банка для мёда? А внутри?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1488_0.zh:
6* 噢，有个... 
* 蜂蜜罐？在里面？/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1489_0.ja:
1＊ …ちがった。
　 サルサが　たっぷり
　 入ってる。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1491_0.ja:
3＊ ピンポンだ　この
　 おりこうさんめ！/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1491_0.ru: 3* Бинго, моя ты сладкая, маленькая тыковка!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1491_0.zh: 3* 答对了，你们两个乖宝宝！/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1492_0.de: 1Es ist mein Geheimvorrat. Ein kleines Leckerli von mir für di.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1492_0.en:
1* It's my secret stash.
* A little snackeroo from me to you.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1492_0.es: 1* Este es mi escondrijo secreto. Un pequeño aperitivo de mi parte./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1492_0.ja:
1＊ それは　ボクさまの
　 ヘソクリ。おまえに贈る
　 おもてなしおやつだ…/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1790_0.en: * ... I can even fix you! Well, well, what will it be?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1790_0.es: * ... ¡Hasta os puedo arreglar a vosotros! Bueno, bueno, ¿qué va a ser?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1790_0.ja:
＊ …おぬしの体であろうとな！
　 さて　今日は　なにをお望みか？/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1790_0.ko:
* ... 그대의 몸도 말일세!
  그래..
  뭘 고치겠소?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1790_0.pl: * ...nawet WAS! Dobrze, już dobrze, w czym mogę pomóc?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1790_0.pt-BR: * ... Posso até consertar vocês! Pois, pois, o que vai ser?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1790_0.ru: * ...И даже вас самих! Так, так, чего вы хотите?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1790_0.zh:
* ...连你也能修理！
哎呀，哎呀，有何贵干？/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1795_0.en: * Hm? What is it now?/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1812_0.de: * Nun gut, nun gut. Ihr habt nichts zu reparieren./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1812_0.en: * Well, well. You have nothing to fix./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1812_0.es: * Bueno, bueno. No tienes nada que pueda reparar./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1812_0.ja:
＊ はて…
　 直すべき物を
　 持っておられぬようだが。/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1812_0.pl: * No dobrze, dobrze. Nie macie już niczego do naprawienia./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1812_0.pt-BR: * Pois, pois. Não há mais nada a consertar./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1812_0.ru: * Так, так. У вас нечего чинить./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1812_0.zh:
* 哎呀，哎呀。
你们没有可以修理的东西。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1813_0.de: * Doch wenn ihr etwas KAPUTTES findet, kommt gerne wieder./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1813_0.en: * But if you find anything BROKEN, return here./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1813_0.es: * Pero si encuentras algo ROTO, vuelve aquí./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1813_0.ja:
＊ 「こわれた」物を見つけたならば
　 再び私を訪ねてきなさい。/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1813_0.ko:
* 뭔가 망가진 걸 찾으면,
  나에게 가져와주시오./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1813_0.pl: * Ale jak znajdziecie coś ZEPSUTEGO, to zapraszam./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1813_0.pt-BR: * Mas se você achar algo QUEBRADO, retorne aqui./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1813_0.ru: * Но если вы найдёте что-то СЛОМАННОЕ, возвращайтесь./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1813_0.zh:
* 但如果你们找到什么坏掉的东西，
就来这吧。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1814_0.en: * After all, I can fix anything.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1814_0.es: * Después de todo, puedo arreglar lo que sea.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1814_0.ja: ＊ 私に直せぬものはない…/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1814_0.pt-BR: * Afinal, eu posso consertar qualquer coisa.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1814_0.ru: * В конце концов, я могу починить всё.../

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1815_0.en: * ... except for a BROKEN HEART./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1815_0.ja:
＊ …ただひとつ
　 「こわれた心」を　のぞいてはな。/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1815_0.zh: * ... 除非那是一颗“破碎的心”。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1820_0.de: * Was---! Diese TORTE strahlt nur vor Energie! Ihr müsst sie mich reparieren lassen!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1820_0.en: * Huh---! That CAKE is seething with energy! You must let me fix it!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1820_0.ja:
＊ なんと…！　そのケーキからは
　 すさまじい気が　感じられる！
　 よろこんで直させていただこう！/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1820_0.ko:
* 헛! 그 케이크에서 기운이
  끓어오르고 있군!
  내가 꼭 고쳐야겠소!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1820_0.pl: * Coo...! To CIASTO wypełnia energia! Pozwólcie mi je naprawić!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1820_0.pt-BR: * Huh---! Esse BOLO está cheio de energia! Você tem que me deixar consertá-lo!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1820_0.ru: * А!.. Этот ТОРТ просто кипит энергией! Вы должны дать мне починить его!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1820_0.zh:
* 嗬--！那块蛋糕里翻腾着能量！
务必让我修好它！/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1821_0.de: * Hu-ha! Lasst uns meine Technik spüren!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1821_0.en: * Huh-hah! Let's feel my technique!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1821_0.ja:
＊ フッ！　ハッ！
　 わが究極の技　とくと見よ！/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1821_0.pl: * Hih-hah! Pokażę wam, na co mnie stać!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1821_0.zh: * 嗬-哈！来感受我的技术吧！/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1827_0.de: * Was---! Diese TORTE strahlt nur vor Energie! Ihr müsst sie mich reparieren lassen!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1827_0.en: * Huh---! That CAKE is seething with energy! You must let me fix it!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1827_0.ja:
＊ なんと…！　そのケーキからは
　 すさまじい気が　感じられる！
　 よろこんで直させていただこう！/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1827_0.ko:
* 헛! 그 케이크에서 기운이
  끓어오르고 있군!
  내가 꼭 고쳐야겠소!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1827_0.pl: * Coo...! To CIASTO wypełnia energia! Pozwólcie mi je naprawić!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1827_0.pt-BR: * Huh---! Esse BOLO está cheio de energia! Você tem que me deixar consertá-lo!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1827_0.ru: * А!.. Этот ТОРТ просто кипит энергией! Вы должны дать мне починить его!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1827_0.zh:
* 嗬--！那块蛋糕里翻腾着能量！
务必让我修好它！/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1828_0.de: * ... allerdings, müsst ihr erst Platz in euren ITEMs machen./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1828_0.en: * ... actually, you will need a free space in your ITEMs first./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1828_0.es: * ... aunque primero deberías hacer hueco en tus OBJETOS./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1828_0.ja:
＊ …が　まずは「アイテム」の
　 空きスペースを作るのだ。よいな？/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1828_0.pl: * Nie naprawię tego, jeśli nie macie miejsca w kieszeniach./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1828_0.pt-BR: * ... na verdade, você precisa de um espaço livre nos seus ITENS primeiro./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1828_0.ru: * ...но для начала, вам бы освободить место в ВЕЩАХ./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1828_0.zh:
* ... 但是，你的【物品】
也得有空位才行。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1833_0.de: * Was-! Dieser SCHLÜSSEL strahlt nur vor Energie! Ihr müsst ihn mich reparieren lassen!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1833_0.en: * Huh---! That KEY is seething with energy! You must let me fix it!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1833_0.ja:
＊ なんと…！　そのカギからは
　 すさまじい気が　感じられる！
　 よろこんで直させていただこう！/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1833_0.ko:
* 헛! 그 열쇠에서 에너지가
  끓어오르고 있군!
  내가 꼭 고쳐야겠소!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1833_0.pl: * Coo...! Ten KLUCZ wypełnia energia! Pozwólcie mi go naprawić!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1833_0.pt-BR: * Huh---! Essa CHAVE está cheia de energia! Você tem que me deixar consertá-la!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1833_0.ru: * А!.. Этот КЛЮЧ просто кипит энергией! Вы должны дать мне починить его!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1833_0.zh:
* 嗬--！那把钥匙里翻腾着能量！
务必让我修好它！/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1834_0.de: * Hu-ha! Lasst uns meine Technik spüren!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1834_0.en: * Huh-hah! Let's feel my technique!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1834_0.ja:
＊ フッ！　ハッ！
　 わが究極の技　とくと見よ！/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1834_0.pl: * Hih-hah! Pokażę wam, na co mnie stać!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1834_0.zh: * 嗬-哈！来感受我的技术吧！/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1841_0.de: * Nun gut, nun gut. Gute Reise, meine Freunde./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1841_0.en: * Well, well. Good journey, my friends./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1841_0.es: * Bueno, bueno. Tened buen viaje, amigos míos./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1841_0.ja:
＊ さようか。
　 では　よき旅を。/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1841_0.ko:
* 그래...
  즐거운 여행 되게나, 나의 친구들./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1841_0.pt-BR: * Pois, pois. Boa viagem, meus amigos./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1841_0.zh: * 哎呀，哎呀。一路顺风，我的友人。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1845_0.de: * Dein Körper ist auch eine Waffe. Ihr müsst sie hin und wieder schärfen./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1845_0.en: * Your body is a weapon, too. You must take care of it from time to time./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1845_0.es: * Vuestro cuerpo también es un arma. Debéis cuidarlo un poco de vez en cuando./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1845_0.ja:
＊ おぬしの体もまた　武器である。
　 こまめに手入れを　せねばならぬぞ。/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1845_0.ko:
* 그대의 몸 또한 무기.
  시간이 날 때마다
  몸을 정갈히 다듬으시게./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1845_0.pl: * Wasze ciała to też broń. Trzeba o nie zadbać od czasu do czasu./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1845_0.pt-BR: * Seu corpo é uma arma, também. Você tem que tomar conta dele de tempos em tempos./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1845_0.ru: * Ваше тело — тоже оружие. Время от времени ему тоже нужен уход./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1845_0.zh:
* 你的身体，也是武器。
你们必须要时刻注意维护好它。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1846_0.de: * Hu-ha! Lasst uns meine Technik spüren./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1846_0.en: * Huh-hah! Let's feel my technique./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1846_0.ja:
＊ フッ！　ハッ！
　 わが究極の技　とくと見よ！/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1846_0.pl: * Hih-hah! Pokażę wam, na co mnie stać./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1846_0.zh: * 嗬-哈！来感受我的技术吧。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1857_0.en: * Interested in a Choco Diamond? /
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1857_0.ja: ＊ チョコダイヤ　いかがですか？/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1857_0.pt-BR: * Interessados em um Chocolate de Ouro? /
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1857_0.zh: * 想来一块方钻巧克力吗？/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1858_0.de: * Alle Einnahmen gehen an den Karodin Erholungs-Fond, oder so. Nur $40!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1858_0.en:
* All proceeds go to Rudinn Relief Funds, I guess.
* It's only $40!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1858_0.es: * El dinero se invertirá en los Fondos de ayuda a Ofidiamantes, supongo. ¡Solo por 40$!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1858_0.ja:
＊ 売上は全額　モンディ救済基金に
　 寄付される…のかな。
＊ $40です。お買い得です。/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1858_0.ko:
* 모든 금액은 루딘 구제 기금으로
  환원됩니다, 아마도요.
* 단돈 40G!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1858_0.pl:
* Wszystkie środki idą (chyba) na Fundusz Ochrony Rudina.
* Tylko 40 $!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1858_0.pt-BR:
* Nossos ganhos vão para o Fundo de Auxílio Rudourado, eu acho.
* Apenas 40T$!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1858_0.ru:
* Вся выручка идёт в Фонд помощи бубиннам, полагаю.
* Всего 40$!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1858_0.zh:
* 所有收入都将用于Rudinn救济基金，
大概吧。
* 只卖$40！/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1863_0.en: * Choco Diamonds, only $40, I guess./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1863_0.ja:
＊ チョコダイヤ　$40…
　 お買い得…かな。/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1863_0.pt-BR: * Chocolate de Ouro, apenas 40 pratas, eu acho./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1863_0.zh: * 方钻巧克力，只卖$40，大概吧。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1877_0.de: * Danke, oder so. (Das SchokoKaro wurde zu deinen ITEMS gelegt.)/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1877_0.en:
* Thanks, I guess.
* (The Choco Diamond was added to your ITEMS.)/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1877_0.es:
* Gracias, supongo.
* (El Choco Diamante ha sido añadido a tus OBJETOS.)/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1877_0.ja:
＊ まいどあり…かな。
＊ (チョコダイヤが
　 「アイテム」に加わった)/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1877_0.pt-BR:
* Obrigado, eu acho.
* (O Chocolate de Ouro foi adicionado aos seus ITENS.)/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1877_0.ru:
* Спасибо, полагаю.
* (Шокобубна была добавлена в ваши ВЕЩИ.)/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1877_0.zh:
* 谢啦，大概吧。
* （方钻巧克力被放进了
你的【物品】中。）/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1881_0.de: * ... Da hast du zu viele ITEMS für, oder so./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1881_0.en: * ... You have too many ITEMS for this, I guess./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1881_0.ja:
＊ …これ以上　アイテムを
　 持てない…のかな。/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1881_0.ko:
* ... 아이템을 너무 많이
  들고 계시네요, 아마도요./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1881_0.pt-BR: * ... Você tem muitos ITENS para isso, eu acho./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1881_0.zh: * ... 你的物品太多了，大概吧。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1886_0.de: * Du hast nicht genug Geld, oder so./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1886_0.en: * You don't have enough money, I guess./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1886_0.ja: ＊ おカネが足りない…のかな。/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1886_0.pt-BR: * Você não tem dinheiro o suficiente, eu acho./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1886_0.ru: * У вас не хватает денег, полагаю./

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1904_0.de: * (Herta bietet ein Herz-Donut an.) (Einnahmen gehen an die Hertaklinik. Es kostet $40.)/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1904_0.en:
* (Hathy offers a Hearts Donut.)
* (Proceeds go to Hathy's Health. It costs $40.)/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1904_0.es: * (Curazón te ofrece un Dónut Corazón por 40$. El dinero irá a la Sanidad para Curazones.)/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1904_0.ja:
＊ (ハートドーナツを　すすめられた)
＊ (売上は　ハーティの健康維持に
　 役立てられる。値段は　$40だ)/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1904_0.ko:
* (하티는 하트 도넛을 판다.)
* (수익금은 하티 보건기금으로 환원된다.
  가격은 40G다.)/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1904_0.pl:
* (Sercka oferuje KierPączek.)
* (Kosztuje 40 $. Zebrane datki idą na zdrowie Sercki.)/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1904_0.pt-BR: * (Copação oferece uma Rosquinha Coração. Os ganhos vão para o Convênio Copação. Custa 40T$.)/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1904_0.ru:
* (Серция продаёт червопончики.)
* (Вся выручка пойдёт на её здоровье. Всего 40$.)/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1904_0.zh:
* （Hathy制作的红心甜甜圈。）
* （收入都将用于Hathy医疗资金。
售价$40。）/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1918_0.de: * (Herta wirkt glücklich.) (Das HerzDonut wurde zu deinen ITEMS gelegt.)/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1918_0.en:
* (Hathy seemed happy.)
* (The Hearts Donut was added to your ITEMS.)/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1918_0.es:
* (Curazón parece feliz.)
* (El Dónut Corazón ha sido añadido a tus OBJETOS.)/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1918_0.ja:
＊ (ハーティは　うれしそうだ)
＊ (ハートドーナツが
　 「アイテム」に加わった)/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1918_0.pt-BR:
* (Copação ficou feliz.)
* (A Rosquinha Coração foi adicionada aos seus ITENS.)/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1918_0.ru:
* (Серция выглядит счастливой.)
* (Червопончик был добавлен в ваши ВЕЩИ.)/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1918_0.zh:
* （Hathy好像很开心。）
* （红心甜甜圈被放进了
你的【物品】中。）/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1922_0.de: * (Du hattest nicht genug Platz in deinen ITEMs.) (Herta wirkt traurig.)/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1922_0.en:
* (You didn't have enough room in your ITEMs.)
* (Hathy seemed sad.)/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1922_0.es:
* (No tienes suficiente espacio en tus OBJETOS.)
* (Curazón parece triste.)/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1922_0.ja:
＊ (これ以上　アイテムを持てない)
＊ (ハーティは　悲しそうだ)/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1922_0.ko:
* (아이템을 넣을 여유 공간이 없다.)
* (하티는 슬퍼 보인다.)/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1922_0.pl:
* (Masz za dużo RZECZY w kieszeniach.)
* (Sercka jest smutna.)/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1922_0.pt-BR:
* (Você não tinha espaço o suficiente nos seus ITENS.)
* (Copação pareceu triste.)/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1922_0.ru:
* (У вас не хватает места.)

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2061_0.de: 1Was? Es gibt eine Dunkle Welt in der Schule?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2061_0.en:
1* What?
* There's a Dark World inside the school?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2061_0.es:
1* ¿Qué?
* ¿Hay un Mundo Oscuro en la escuela?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2061_0.ja:
1＊ なんだって？
＊ がっこうの　なかに
　 「やみのせかい」が　ある？/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2061_0.ko:
1* 뭐?
* 학교 안에
  어둠의 세계가 있다고?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2061_0.pl:
1* Co?
* W szkole jest Ciemny Świat?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2061_0.pt-BR:
1* O quê?
* Tem um mundo das trevas na escola??/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2061_0.ru:
1* Что?
* Внутри школы есть Тёмный мир?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2061_0.zh:
1* 什么？
* 你说学校里有个暗世界？/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2062_0.ja:
2＊ あー…　うん
　 そうかそうか。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2063_0.de: 5Es gibt eh kein Gesetz gegen Dunkle Welten!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2063_0.en: 5* There's no law against Dark Worlds anyway!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2063_0.es: 5* ¡Tampoco es que haya leyes contra los Mundos Oscuros!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2063_0.ja:
5＊ ま　やみのせかいを
　 とりしまる　ほうりつは
　 ないからな！/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2063_0.ko:
5* 어차피 어둠의 세상에
  관한 법은 없는걸!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2063_0.pl: 5* Nie żeby Ciemne Światy były nielegalne!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2063_0.pt-BR: 5* Não há lei contra Mundos das Trevas mesmo!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2063_0.ru: 5* Всё равно против Тёмных миров законов нет!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2063_0.zh:
5* 反正暗世界的存在
不违反任何法律！/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2064_0.de: Das ist ein Fall für das Rektorat!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2064_0.en: * That's a job for the school board!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2064_0.ja:
＊ それは
　 きょういく　いいんかいの
　 かんかつだ！/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2064_0.pl: * Zgłoś ten problem do dyrekcji szkoły!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2064_0.pt-BR: * Isso é trabalho para o conselho escolar!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2064_0.zh: * 这种事该由学校董事会来管！/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2068_0.de: 6Ach, du willst mir helfen? Sicher doch, Punk./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2068_0.en: 6* Aww, you wanna help me? Sure, punk./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2068_0.ja:
6＊ そうかそうか　てつだって
　 くれるのか！　なら…/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2068_0.ko:
6* 와, 날 도와주고
  싶다고?
  환영이지, 꼬마./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2068_0.pl: 6* Ooo, chcesz mi pomóc? Spoko, smarku./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2068_0.pt-BR: 6* Aww, você quer me ajudar? Tranquilo, mané./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2068_0.ru: 6* О-о-о, хочешь помочь мне? Конечно, шпана./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2068_0.zh:
6* 嗷，你想帮我忙？
没问题，混球。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2069_0.de: 5Bring wen dazu, die Bank auszurauben, damit ich sie vermöbeln kann!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2069_0.en: 5* Get someone to rob the bank so I can suplex them!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2069_0.es: 5* ¡Haz que alguien robe el banco para que yo pueda hacerle un súplex!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2069_0.ja:
5＊ だれかに　ぎんこうを
　 おそわせろ！　わたしが
　 スープレックスきめてやる！/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2069_0.ko:
5* 수플렉스 좀 써 보게
  아무나 은행 좀 털라고 해 봐!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2069_0.pl: 5* Poproś kogoś, by obrabował bank, a ja go sprowadzę do parteru!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2069_0.pt-BR: 5* Faz alguém roubar um banco pra eu poder dar um suplex nele!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2069_0.ru: 5* Попроси кого-нибудь ограбить банк, чтобы я могла его повязать!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2069_0.zh:
5* 找点人去抢银行，
这样我就可以背摔他们了！/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2070_0.de: 1... warte, haben wir überhaupt eine Bank?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2070_0.en: 1* ... wait, do we even have a bank?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2070_0.ja:
1＊ …いや　まてよ。そもそも
　 このまちに　ぎんこうなんて
　 あったか？/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2070_0.pl: 1* Chwila, czy my w ogóle mamy bank?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2070_0.zh:
1* ...等等，
我们好像连银行都没有？/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2071_0.en: 5* Hey, get someone to build a bank...!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2071_0.es: 5* Oye, ¡haz que alguien construya un banco!.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2071_0.ja:
5＊ よし　だれかに
　 ぎんこう　つくらせろ！/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2071_0.ko:
5* 야, 아무나 은행 좀
  짓게 만들어 봐...!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2071_0.pl: 5* Ej, musisz najpierw poprosić kogoś, by zbudował bank...!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2071_0.pt-BR: 5* Ei, arranja alguém pra construir um banco...!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2071_0.ru: 5* Эй, найди кого-нибудь, кто построит банк!../

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2075_0.de: 6Mach ja nichts Illegales, du kleiner Punk~!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2075_0.en: 6* Don't do anything illegal, you little punk~!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2075_0.ja:
6＊ ほうりつ　いはんは
　 しちゃダメだぞ～！/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2075_0.ko:
6* 나쁜 짓 하면 안 된다,
  꼬맹이~!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2075_0.pl: 6* Nie rób niczego nielegalnego, mały smarku~!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2075_0.pt-BR: 6* Vê se não faz nada de ilegal, ô mané~!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2075_0.zh:
6* 别做违法的事哦，
你个小混球~！/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2076_0.de: 3Und lass mich wissen, wenn du Hinweise auf lila Mädchen findest./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2076_0.en: 3* And lemme know if you get a lead on any purple girls./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2076_0.es: 3* Y hazme saber si oyes algo sobre alguna chica púrpura./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2076_0.ja:
3＊ それと　ムラサキの
　 おんなのコに　こころあたり
　 あったら　おしえてくれ。/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2076_0.ko:
3* 그리고 혹시 
  보라색 여자애를 보면
  좀 알려 줘./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2076_0.pl: 3* I powiadom mnie, jak zobaczysz fioletową dziewczynę./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2076_0.pt-BR: 3* E me conta se você tiver uma pista sobre uma tal de garota roxa./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2076_0.ru: 3* И дай знать, если что-то выяснишь о фиолетовых девочках./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2076_0.zh:
3* 还有，如果你有关于紫色女孩
的线索就通知我一声。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2077_0.de: 4Es wird eines wegen ACHT Fälle Erregung öffentli- chen Schmunzelns gesucht./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2077_0.en: 4* There's one wanted on SEVERAL counts of Comic Mischief./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2077_0.es: 4* Se busca una con VARIOS cargos por Trastada Cómica./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2077_0.ja:
4＊ 「ギリギリなイタズラ」の
　 つうほうが　なんけんか
　 はいってるんだ。/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2077_0.ko:
4* 몇 번이나 만화책에
  장난을 쳐 놔서
  지금 수배 중이거든./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2077_0.pl: 4* Poszukujemy jej za NAGMINNE opowiadanie nieśmiesznych żartów./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2077_0.pt-BR: 4* Está foragida por DIVERSAS acusações de MALANDRAGEM./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2077_0.ru: 4* У одной уже несколько статей по хулиганству./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2077_0.zh:
4* 有个紫色女孩因为屡次模仿动画
里的危险恶作剧正被通缉。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2084_0.ja:
しょくばの
なかま

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2088_0.ja: 0＊ ほら　オレ！　オレだよ！/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2089_0.de: 3Willst du kurz reden bevor ich den Verstand verliere?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2089_0.en: 3* Wanna chat for a minute before I lose my mind?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2089_0.es: 3* ¿Te apetece charlar un minuto antes de que pierda la cabeza?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2089_0.ja:
3＊ オレの　アタマが
　 どうか　なっちまうまえに
　 きいときたいこと　あるか？/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2089_0.ko:
3* 나 미쳐버리기 전에
  같이 얘기 좀 해줄래?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2089_0.pl: 3* Chcesz pogadać, zanim zupełnie stracę rozum?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2089_0.pt-BR: 3* Quer conversar um pouco antes de eu enlouquecer?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2089_0.ru: 3* Хочешь поговорить, пока я не сошёл с ума?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2089_0.zh: 3* 想在我疯掉之前聊个天吗？/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2093_0.de: 0H... Hey! Hey kleiner Kumpel! Was läuft?!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2093_0.en:
0* H... Hey!
* Hey little buddy!
* What's up?!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2093_0.ja:
0＊ お…　おう！
＊ なんか　ききてーことでも
　 あんのか！？/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2093_0.ko:
0* 아... 안녕!!
* 꼬마 친구!
* 무슨 일이야?!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2093_0.pl:
0* H... Hej!
* Hej, mordeczko!
* Co tam u ciebie?!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2093_0.pt-BR:
0* E... Ei!
* Ei carinha!
* Qual as novas?!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2093_0.ru:
0* Э... эй!
* Эй, дружище!
* Как дела?!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2093_0.zh:
0* ... 嘿！
* 嘿小家伙！
* 最近怎样？！/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2102_0.de: 0Weisst du wann Azzy wieder nach Hause kommt?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2102_0.en: 0* Do you know when Azzy's coming home?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2102_0.ja:
0＊ アズのやつ　いつ
　 もどってくんだ？/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2102_0.pl: 0* Wiesz, kiedy Azzy wraca do domu?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2102_0.pt-BR: 0* Você sabe quando o Azzy volta pra casa?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2102_0.ru: 0* Слушай, не знаешь, когда Аззи вернётся домой?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2102_0.zh: 0* 你知道Azzy什么时候回家吗？/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2103_0.de: 8S... Sag's ihm nicht, aber ich vermisse den Kerl echt./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2103_0.en: 8* Y... You can't tell him this, but I really miss the guy./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2103_0.es: 8* N... no puedes decírselo, pero echo de menos al tipo./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2103_0.ja:
8＊ あいつ　いねーと
　 さみしくてさ…　あ　
　 ほんにんには　いうなよ！？/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2103_0.ko:
8* ... 너한테만 하는 말인데,
  그 친구가 너무 그리워./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2103_0.pl: 8* N... Nie mów mu tego, ale bardzo mi go brakuje./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2103_0.pt-BR: 8* N... Não diga isso pra ele, mas eu realmente sinto falta do cara./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2103_0.ru: 8* Ты... не говори ему это, но я скучаю по нему./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2103_0.zh:
8* 你... 你别告诉他啊，
但我可想他了。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2104_0.de: 8Wäre cool mal wieder durchs Dorf zu düsen, so wie früher.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2104_0.en: 8* It'd be sweet to cruise around town like old times.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2104_0.es: 8* Ojalá volver a dar vueltas por el pueblo como antaño.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2104_0.ja:
8＊ また　まえみてーに
　 いっしょに　まちを
　 クルマで　ながしてえなあ…/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2104_0.pl: 8* Czadowo byłoby poszwędać się po mieście, jak za starych, dobrych czasów./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2104_0.pt-BR: 8* Seria demais dar um rolê com ele pela cidade como nos velhos tempos.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2104_0.ru: 8* Было бы здорово вновь прокатиться по городу, как раньше.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2104_0.zh:
8* 要能像以前一样，
和他一起在镇上闲逛该多好.../

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2105_0.de: 3Und dann holten wir uns, zum Beispiel.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2105_0.ja:
3＊ そんで　きがむいたら
　 ひっかけんのさ…/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2107_0.en: 5* Which, as a matter of course/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2108_0.en: 6* May not have ever actually happened./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2108_0.es: 6* Ha podido o no haber ocurrido nunca./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2108_0.ja:
6＊ じっさい　ひっかけたことが
　 あったかどうかは
　 べつの　はなしだけどな。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2109_0.de: 2A-aber einmal hat Undyne Augenkontakt mit mir gemacht!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2109_0.en: 2* B-but one time Undyne made eye contact with me!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2109_0.es: 2* ¡P-pero una vez Undyne hizo contacto visual conmigo!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2109_0.ja:
2＊ でででも
　 いっかい　アンダインと
　 めが　あったんだぜ！？/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2109_0.ko:
2* 그, 그런데 어느 날
  언다인이 내게 눈을
  마주치더니!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2109_0.pl: 2* A-ale raz Undyne spojrzała mi prosto w oczy!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2109_0.pt-BR: 2* M-mas uma vez a Undyne fez contato visual comigo!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2109_0.ru: 2* Н-но однажды мы с Андайн столкнулись взглядами!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2109_0.zh:
2* 但-但有一次Undyne
和我目光接触了！/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2110_0.de: 7... während sie mir ein Knöllchen geschrieben hat./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2110_0.en: 7* ... while she was writing me a speeding ticket./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2110_0.es: 7* ... mientras me ponía una multa por exceso de velocidad./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2110_0.ja:
7＊ …スピードいはんの　きっぷ
　 きられたときに。/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2110_0.pl: 7* Kiedy wypisywała mi mandat za przekroczenie prędkości./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2110_0.pt-BR: 7* ... enquanto me escrevia uma multa de excesso de velocidade./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2110_0.ru: 7* ...когда она писала мне штраф за превышение скорости./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2110_0.zh:
7* ...虽然当时她是在给我
开超速罚单。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2114_0.ja:
1＊ いいか　じんせいの
　 センパイとして
　 ちゅうこく　しとくぜ。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2115_0.ja:
2＊ 「ぶるどっ君“ピー”ツア」
　 ほど　ブラックな　しょくばは
　 ねえ。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2116_0.de: 0Ich kann nicht mal ne Minute durchatmen ohne die Ohren voll zu kriegen.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2116_0.en: 0* I can't slack off for SECONDS without hearing.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2116_0.es: 0* No puedo escaquearme ni dos SEGUNDOS sin oír.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2116_0.ja:
0＊ ちょっとでも　ふまんを
　 くちに　しようものなら…/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2116_0.ko:
0* 잔소리를 안 듣고선
  몇 초도 쉴 수가
  없다니깐.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2116_0.pl: 0* Łeb mi pęka od ciągłego słuchania.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2116_0.pt-BR: 0* Eu não consigo relaxar nem por SEGUNDOS sem ouvir.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2116_0.zh: 0* 我偷懒没几秒就能听见.../

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2117_0.de: 3"Sei ein Teamplayer, es gibt kein "I" in PEZZA!"/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2117_0.en: 3* "Be a team player, there's no I in PEZZA!"/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2117_0.es: 3* "¡Juega en equipo, las PEZZAS son para compartir!"/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2117_0.ja:
3＊ 「ブラックじょうとう！
　 ピーツアには　さとうも
　 ミルクも　はいってない！」/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2117_0.ko:
3* "팀 플레이어 정신!
  파'피'자에 단독 행동은 없다!"/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2117_0.pt-BR: 3* "Seja um membro exemplar, não existe ERRE em PIZZALIA!"/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2117_0.ru: 3* «Будь в команде, в ПИЦЦЕР-И нет буквы „Я“!»/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2117_0.zh:
3* “披E萨里有个E，
店员们E起才是披E萨！”/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2118_0.de: 2DOCH GIBT ES. IHR HABT ES NUR RAUSGENOMMEN./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2118_0.en:
2* YES THERE IS.
* YOU JUST TOOK IT OUT./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2118_0.es:
2* Y ESO QUIÉN LO DICE.
* SI QUIERO COMERME UNA SOLO LO HAGO Y PUNTO./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2118_0.ja:
2＊ いやいや…　きじには
　 さとう　いれるし　チーズの

2* NIE, TO NIEPRAWDA.

* TU QUE TIROU DISG"L"AMA./

2* НЕТ, ОНА ЕСТЬ.
* ВЫ ПРОСТО ЕЁ УБРАЛИ./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2118_0.zh:
2* 明明没有的！
* 是你强行把它加进去的！/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2119_0.de: 3Aber das passt schon, kleiner Kumpel. Ich habe gespart.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2119_0.en:
3* But it's OK, little buddy.
* I've been saving up.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2119_0.es:
3* Pero no pasa nada, peque.
* He estado ahorrando.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2119_0.ja:
3＊ でも　オレは　たえるぜ。
＊ そんで　カネが
　 たまったら…/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2119_0.ko:
3* 그래도 괜찮아, 꼬마 친구.
* 어서 돈을 모아서.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2119_0.pl:
3* Ale nie martw się, mordeczko.
* Długo oszczędzałem.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2119_0.pt-BR:
3* Mas não tem problema, carinha.
* Estive economizando.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2119_0.ru:
3* Но всё в порядке, дружище.
* Я копил всё это время.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2119_0.zh:
3* 但没事的，小家伙。
* 我一直在攒钱.../

8＊ …アズのやつと　おなじ

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2121_0.en: 5* Then I'll get a theater degree, become a famous actor.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2121_0.es: 5* Entonces me licenciaré en artes dramáticas y seré un famoso actor.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2121_0.ja:
5＊ えんげきの　がくいを
　 とって　にんきはいゆうに
　 なって…/

5* 가서 영화 학위를 따고,
  유명한 배우가 되면.../

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2121_0.pt-BR: 5* Vou me formar em teatro e me tornar um ator famoso.../
