　 貸していないことにしてくれたまえ！/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_974_0.ko:
* ... 만약 왕이 다시 나타나면...
  난 아무것도 안 한 거라네!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_974_0.ru: * ...Если только Король не появится снова, в таком случае — я ни при чём!/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_978_0.ja:
＊ ドウドウ！
　 あんたたちにゃ　感謝しても
　 しきれねェなぁ。/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_978_0.ru: * Чёрт, коняка. Вы нас правда выручили./

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_979_0.ja:
＊ これで　オレたち駒の
　 コマった問題は　片づいた。
　 これからは　平和に暮らせるぜ。/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_979_0.ko:
* 이제 우리도 우리 나름대로
  평화롭게 살 수 있게 됐어./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_979_0.ru:
* Теперь все из нас смогут
жить мирно в этом мире./

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_982_0.ja:
＊ いやぁ　オレの鼻の穴も
　 あんたたちには　感謝してるぜ。/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_982_0.ko:
* 친구, 이 콧구멍으로도
  이 감사함을 이루 표현할 수가
  없군./",
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_982_0.ru: * Чёрт, даже мои ноздри не могут отблагодарить вас как надо./

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_13_0.de: * The gash weaves down as if you cry./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_13_0.en: * The gash weaves down as if you cry./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_13_0.es: * The gash weaves down as if you cry./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_13_0.ja:
＊ パックリ割れた　切り傷が
　 まるで　涙のあとみたい。/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_13_0.pl: * The gash weaves down as if you cry./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_13_0.pt-BR: * O corte tece para baixo como se você chorasse./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_13_0.zh:
* 那道撕裂的伤痕就像是
你的泪迹一样。/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_20_0.de: * It's a red wagon with a rusty birdcage in it./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_20_0.en: * It's a red wagon with a rusty birdcage in it./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_20_0.es: * It's a red wagon with a rusty birdcage in it./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_20_0.ja:
＊ あかい　カートに
　 さびた　とりかごが　のっている。/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_20_0.pl: * W środku tego czerwonego wózka znajduje się zardzewiała klatka./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_20_0.pt-BR: * Um carrinho vermelho com uma gaiola enferrujada dentro./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_20_0.ru: * Красная тележка со ржавой птичьей клеткой./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_20_0.zh:
* 一辆红色的手推车，
上面放着一个生锈的鸟笼。/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_21_0.de: * Looks like it's seen quite a few crashes./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_21_0.en: * Looks like it's seen quite a few crashes./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_21_0.es: * Looks like it's seen quite a few crashes./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_21_0.ja:
＊ カートは　なんども　ぶつかった
　 けいせきがある。/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_21_0.ko: * 몇 번 크게 부딪힌 것 같다./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_21_0.pt-BR: * Parece que já bateu muitas vezes./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_21_0.ru: * Похоже, что она пережила немало аварий./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_21_0.zh: * 看起来它经历了不少磕磕碰碰。/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_27_0.de: * Ein Vogelkäfig. Wenn die Tür geschlossen ist, gibt es kein Entkommen./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_27_0.en: * It's a birdcage. When the door's closed, there's no escape./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_27_0.es: * Es una jaula para pájaros. Cuando la puerta está cerrada, no hay escapatoria./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_27_0.ja:
＊ とりかごだ。
　 とびらが　しまっているときは
　 にげられない。/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_27_0.ko:
* 새장이다.
  문이 닫히면, 벗어날 곳은 없다./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_27_0.pl: * Klatka na ptaki. Gdy wrota się zamykają, nie ma ucieczki./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_27_0.pt-BR: * É uma gaiola de pássaro. Quando a porta está fechada, não há escapatória./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_27_0.ru: * Птичья клетка. Стоит ей захлопнуться, и выхода уже не будет./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_27_0.zh:
* 一个鸟笼。
笼门一关，无路可逃。/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_32_0.en: * (It's Chairiel, the beloved living room chair.)/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_32_0.es: * (Es Sillonriel, el amado sillón del salón.)/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_32_0.ja:
＊ (たいせつな　リビング用チェア…
　 チェアリエルだ)/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_32_0.pt-BR: * (É a Cadeiriel, a cadeira mais amada da sala de estar.)/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_32_0.zh:
* （这是Chairiel，
客厅里亲爱的椅子。）/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_79_0.en: * (It's a mannequin dressed in poor taste.)/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_79_0.es: * (Es un maniquí vestido con mal gusto.)/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_79_0.ja:
＊ (いまいちなテイストの
　 服を着たマネキンだ)/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_79_0.pt-BR: * (É um manequim vestido com mal gosto.)/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_79_0.zh: * （一个衣服品味极差的假人模特。）/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_88_0.de: * Ohne die Bäume muss ich meine Nährstoffe aus Kleidung nehmen.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_88_0.en: * Without trees, I must gain nutrients by eating clothes.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_88_0.es: * Sin árboles, tengo que ganar nutrientes comiendo ropa.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_88_0.ja:
＊ 木がなくなってしまったので
　 服を食べて
　 栄養をとらないといけません…/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_88_0.ko:
* 나무가 없어져서,
  옷을 먹으면서
  영양분을 섭취해야 해요.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_88_0.pl: * Nie ma tu drzew, więc muszę przyswajać wartości odżywcze z ubrań.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_88_0.pt-BR: * Sem árvores, eu preciso ganhar nutrientes comendo roupas.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_88_0.ru: * Без деревьев я должен добывать питательные вещества, поедая одежду.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_88_0.zh:
* 没有了树，我就只能靠吃衣服
来摄取营养.../

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_89_0.de: * So ist der Weg des Wurmes./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_89_0.en: * Such is the way of the worm./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_89_0.es: * Esa es la senda de la oruga./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_89_0.ja:
＊ それが　イモムシの生き様
　 というものです。/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_89_0.pt-BR: * Tal é o caminho da lagarta./

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_93_0.de: * Ich bin ein Wurm. Ich verstehe nichts von Steuern und Werten./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_93_0.en: * I'm a worm. I don't understand taxes and values./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_93_0.es: * Soy una oruga. No entiendo nada de impuestos ni valores./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_93_0.ja:
＊ わたしは　イモムシです。
　 モノの価値や　税金のことは
　 よくわかりません。/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_93_0.ko:
* 나는 벌레예요. 물건의 가치나
  세금 같은 건 몰라요./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_93_0.pl: * Jestem robakiem. Nie rozumiem podatków i wartości towarów./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_93_0.pt-BR: * Eu sou uma lagarta. Eu não entendo de impostos e valores./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_93_0.ru: * Я червь. Я не понимаю налогов и ценностей./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_93_0.zh:
* 我只是条蠕虫。
我不懂什么价值和税收。/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_106_0.de: * Mr. Gesellschaft ging fort, nicht wahr... Hm./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_106_0.en: * Mr. Society left, didn't he... Hm./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_106_0.es: * Sr. Sociedad se ha ido, verdad... Mm./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_106_0.ja:
＊ ミスター・ソーシャル…
　 行っちまったか…/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_106_0.pt-BR: * O Sr. Sociedade foi embora, não foi... Hm./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_106_0.zh:
* 社会先生他还是离开了... 
对吧。/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_107_0.de: * Ich schätz' ich wusst' das würd passier'n.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_107_0.en: * I reckon I knew'n this would'n happen.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_107_0.es: * Recuerdo que pensaba que esto iba a suceder.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_107_0.ja:
＊ いつか　こんな日が
　 来るような気がしてたぜ…/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_107_0.ko:
* 언젠가 이런 일이
  일어날 줄 알았지.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_107_0.pl: * Obawy me okazały się niestety uzasadnione.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_107_0.pt-BR: * Admito que eu sabia que isso iria acontecê.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_107_0.ru: * Я был уверен, что этого не случится.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_107_0.zh: * 我就知道会是这种结果.../

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_108_0.en: * It's not'n no fault of yours./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_108_0.ja: ＊ 大丈夫。あんたらのせいじゃねェ。/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_109_0.en: * He'll'n be back one day./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_109_0.es: * Él a su debido momento volverá./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_109_0.ja: ＊ いつか　もどってくるだろうよ。/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_109_0.pl: * Jestem pewny, że pewnego dnia do nas powróci./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_109_0.zh: * 他早晚有一天会回来的。/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_113_0.de: * Hey da, Pferdchen. Habt uns an einen schönen Ort g'bracht./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_113_0.en: * Whoa, horsies. You've'n brought us to a great new place./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_113_0.es: * Vaya, caballitos. Nos habéis traído a un lugar genial./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_113_0.ja:
＊ ドウドウ！　オレたちを
　 こんな　いいとこへ
　 連れてきてくれて　ありがとよ。/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_113_0.ko:
* 와우, 우릴 이렇게
  멋진 곳에 데려다줘서
  정말 고마워./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_113_0.pl: * Łoho, młokosy. Sprowadziliście nas w nowe miejsce./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_113_0.pt-BR: * Opa, cavalinhos. Ocê nos trouxe a um ótimo novo lugar./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_113_0.ru: * Ого, придержи коней. Благодаря вам мы оказались в прекрасном месте./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_113_0.zh:
* 哇哦，急性子。
你真是带我们来了个非常棒的地方。/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_114_0.de: * Wir werden uns ins Zeug legen hier auch mal aufzuräumen./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_114_0.en: * We'll'n be puttin' our own elbow grease into fixin' it, too./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_114_0.es: * Nosotros usaremos toda nuestra carne del asador para dejar este sitio perfecto./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_114_0.ja:
＊ オレらも　汗水たらして
　 町の復興に努めるぜ。/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_114_0.ko:
* 우리도 팔에서
  기름 뻘뻘 흘릴 정도로
  열심히 힘써볼게./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_114_0.pl: * Wkładamy dużo trudu, by je naprawić, bo jak wiadomo, bez pracy nie ma wołaczy./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_114_0.pt-BR: * Vamos botá nossa própria gordura de cotovelo pra arrumá isso também./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_114_0.ru: * Дабы преобразить его, мы будем работать засучив рукава./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_114_0.zh:
* 我们准备用肘部润滑油
来修缮一下这里。/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_115_0.de: * In was für Zeug? Sag nicht Zaumzeug./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_115_0.en: * Well'n, maybe not elbow'n grease. That's gross./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_115_0.es: * Bueno, quizás la carne no. Qué asco./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_115_0.ja:
＊ ま　ホントに
　 汗水たらしはしねェよ？
　 そりゃ　ちと汚ねェからよ。/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_115_0.ko:
* 음, 팔에서 기름이라니.
  그건 좀 더럽다./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_115_0.pl: * A może kołaczy? Pamięć już nie ta co kiedyś./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_115_0.pt-BR: * Bão, talvez gordura de cotovelo não. É nojento./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_115_0.ru: * Ну, не буквально. Рукавов у нас нет./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_115_0.zh:
* 好吧，肘部润滑油还是算了。
那有点恶心。/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_116_0.ja: ＊ でも　鼻水は　たらすかもな。/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_116_0.pl: * Kołacze to takie duże kwadraty, prawda?/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_123_0.en: * It's not'n no fault of yours./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_123_0.ja: ＊ あんたらのせいじゃねェ。/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_124_0.en: * He'll'n be back one day./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_124_0.es: * Él a su debido momento volverá./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_124_0.ja: ＊ いつか　もどってくるだろうよ。/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_124_0.pl: * Jestem pewny, że pewnego dnia do nas powróci./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_124_0.zh: * 他早晚有一天会回来的。/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_128_0.de: * Wir geb'n auch unser Bestes. Schmierig./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_128_0.en: * We'll'n be tryin' our best too. Greasily./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_128_0.ja:
＊ 精いっぱい　がんばらせてもらうぜ。
　 いろんな水　たらしながらな。/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_128_0.ko:
* 기름이 뻘뻘 나올 정도로
  최선을 다할게./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_128_0.pl: * Nie martw się, będziemy starać się na okrągło./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_128_0.pt-BR: * Também vamo tentá nosso melhor. Gorduramente./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_128_0.ru: * Мы будем стараться изо всех сил. Ручками./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_128_0.zh: * 我们也会滑溜溜地，尽油而为。/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_134_0.de: * Wir bau'n die Gegend wie'n Schachbrett auf./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_134_0.en: * We're'n building up the area to be a bit'n more board-like./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_134_0.es: * Estamos reformando esta zona para que se parezca más a un tablero de ajedrez./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_134_0.ja:
＊ この一角は　もうちょっと
　 盤面っぽく整えてこうと
　 思ってんだ。/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_134_0.ko:
* 이 구역을 좀 더
  체스판처럼 만들고 있어./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_134_0.pl: * Próbujemy przekształcić ten pokój w miniaturową szachownicę./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_134_0.pt-BR: * Estamos construindo a área para que fique mais como um tabuleiro./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_134_0.ru: * Мы делаем это место более похожим на доску./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_134_0.zh:
* 我们准备把这片地方布置成
棋盘的样子。/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_135_0.en: * The ponmen'll be happy, too./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_135_0.ja: ＊ ポンマンたちも　きっとよろこぶ。/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_135_0.pt-BR: * Os hompeões vão ficar felizes também./

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_142_0.de: * (Anscheinend muss man hier auch für eine Kostprobe Geld bezahlen.)/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_142_0.en: * (Looks like it costs money just to have a free sample.)/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_142_0.es: * (Parece que incluso pillar una muestra gratuita cuesta dinero.)/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_142_0.ja:
＊ (無料サンプルを　もらうだけでも
　 おカネを取られるようだ)/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_142_0.ko:
* (공짜 샘플을 받기 위해선
  돈이 필요한 것 같다.)/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_142_0.pl: * (Teraz nawet próbki są płatne. Co za czasy.)/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_142_0.pt-BR: * (Parece que custa dinheiro pra ter uma amostra grátis.)/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_142_0.zh:
* （看来就连领个免费的小样
也要花钱。）/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_149_0.de: Ruf nicht quer durch die Stadt!!
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_149_0.en: Don't yell that from across town!!
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_149_0.es: ¡¡No grites desde la otra punta de la villa!!
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_149_0.ja: 遠くから　どならないで！
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_149_0.ko:
마을 너머에서 그렇게
소리치지 좀 마!!
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_149_0.pl: Nie krzycz z drugiego końca miasta!!
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_149_0.pt-BR: Não grite isso do outro lado da cidade!!
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_149_0.zh: 不要隔着那么远大喊大叫！

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_154_0.de: LW... wer hat das mit meinem Dummy angestellt!?/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_317_0.de: * What? Don't talk to you like you're a "kid?" Fine.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_317_0.en: * What? Don't talk to you like you're a "kid?" Fine.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_317_0.es: * What? Don't talk to you like you're a "kid?" Fine.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_317_0.ja:
＊ ああ？　“こども”あつかい
　 すんなって？　フン…わかったよ。/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_317_0.ko:
* 뭐?
  꼬맹이 대하듯이 하지 말라고?
  알겠어.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_317_0.pl: * Co? Mam przestać mówić do ciebie jak do „dziecka”? Dobra.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_317_0.pt-BR: * Quê? Não falar como se você fosse uma "criança"? Tudo bem.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_317_0.ru: * Чего? Не говорить с тобой как с «ребёнком»? Ладно.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_317_0.zh:
* 怎么着？
叫我别用对“小孩”的口气对你讲话？
可以啊.../

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_318_0.de: * If you need someone to change your diaper, go ask the Cop's./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_318_0.en: * If you need someone to change your diaper, go ask the Cop's./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_318_0.es: * If you need someone to change your diaper, go ask the Cop's./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_318_0.ja:
＊ オムツを　かえてほしけりゃ
　 ケーサツに　たのみな。/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_318_0.ko:
* 기저귀 갈아 줄 
  사람이 필요하면 
  경찰한테 가 봐라./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_318_0.pl: * Jeśli poprosisz gliny, to na pewno zmienią ci pieluchę./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_318_0.pt-BR: * Se você precisar de alguém para trocar a sua fralda, peça pra polícia./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_318_0.ru: * Если тебе нужен кто-то, чтобы сменить подгузник, иди к копам./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_318_0.zh:
* 你如果想找个人帮你换尿布的话，
就去找警察吧。/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_323_0.de:
* I'm sorry, I'm sorry.
* The mayor is busy right now./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_323_0.en:
* I'm sorry, I'm sorry.
* The mayor is busy right now./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_323_0.es:
* I'm sorry, I'm sorry.
* The mayor is busy right now./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_323_0.ja:
＊ いやはや　もうしわけございません。
＊ 町長は　いま　おいそがしいのです。/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_323_0.pl:
* Wybacz, wybacz.
* Pani burmistrz jest zajęta./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_323_0.pt-BR:
* Me desculpe, me desculpe.
* A prefeita está ocupada agora./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_323_0.ru:
* Простите, простите.
* Мэр сейчас очень занята./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_323_0.zh:
* 不好意思，不好意思。
* 市长现在公务繁忙。/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_324_0.de: * If you need to see her, please try causing some terrible crisis./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_324_0.en: * If you need to see her, please try causing some terrible crisis./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_324_0.es: * If you need to see her, please try causing some terrible crisis./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_324_0.ja:
＊ おあいに　なりたければ
　 サイアクな　じけんでも
　 おひきおこしください。/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_324_0.ko:
* 지금 뵙고 싶다면,
  뭔가 끔찍한 사건을
  저질러 봐./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_324_0.pl: * Jeśli chcesz się z nią zobaczyć, spróbuj wywołać jakąś klęskę żywiołową./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_324_0.pt-BR: * Se você precisar vê-la, por favor, tente causar alguma crise terrível./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_324_0.ru: * Если вам надо встретиться с ней, пожалуйста, создайте какой-нибудь кризис./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_324_0.zh:
* 如果你想见她的话，
就去搞些大乱子出来吧。/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_328_0.de:
* I'm sorry, I'm sorry.
* Are you here to complain about your teacher?/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_328_0.en:
* I'm sorry, I'm sorry.
* Are you here to complain about your teacher?/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_328_0.es:
* I'm sorry, I'm sorry.
* Are you here to complain about your teacher?/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_328_0.ja:
＊ いやはや　もうしわけございません。
＊ たんにんの　せんせいについての
　 くじょうですか？/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_328_0.ko:
* 미안, 미안.
* 선생님이 마음에
  안 들어서 온 거니?/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_328_0.pl:
* Wybacz, wybacz.
* Chcesz złożyć skargę na swoją nauczycielkę?/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_328_0.pt-BR:
* Me desculpe, me desculpe.
* Você está aqui para reclamar da sua professora?/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_328_0.ru:
* Простите, простите.
* Вы здесь, чтобы пожаловаться на своего учителя?/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_328_0.zh:
* 不好意思，不好意思。
* 你是来投诉你老师的吗？/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_329_0.de: * If you don't like her, please blame your mother for getting her hired.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_329_0.en: * If you don't like her, please blame your mother for getting her hired.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_329_0.es: * If you don't like her, please blame your mother for getting her hired.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_329_0.ja:
＊ あのかたを　さいようしたのは
　 あなたの　おかあさまですから
　 ごふまんがあれば　おかあさまに…/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_329_0.ko:
* 마음에 안 들면,
  그 선생님을 고용한
  네 엄마를 탓해 주렴.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_329_0.pl: * Jeśli jej nie lubisz, to miej pretensje do twojej mamy, bo to ona załatwiła jej pracę.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_329_0.pt-BR: * Se você não gosta dela, por favor, culpe sua mãe por tê-la contratado.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_329_0.ru: * Если вам она не нравится, вините свою мать за то, что она наняла её.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_329_0.zh:
* 你不喜欢她的话，
就请你去怪你妈妈为什么雇她吧。/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_335_0.de:
* The mayor's charisma is about zero.
* No, it's negative./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_335_0.en:
* The mayor's charisma is about zero.
* No, it's negative./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_335_0.es:
* The mayor's charisma is about zero.
* No, it's negative./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_335_0.ja:
＊ 町長の　カリスマせいは　ゼロ。
＊ いや　むしろ　マイナスだ。/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_335_0.ko:
* 시장의 카리스마는
  완전 제로야.
* 아니, 오히려 마이너스지./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_335_0.pl:
* Urok osobisty pani burmistrz jest bliski zeru...
* Nie, jest ujemny./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_335_0.pt-BR:
* O carisma da prefeita é por volta de zero.
* Não, é negativo./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_335_0.ru:
* Харизма мэра равна нулю.
* Нет, она отрицательна./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_335_0.zh:
* 市长的领袖气质几乎为零。
* 不对，不如说是负数吧。/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_336_0.de: * But she works hard and has a good track record, so she runs unopposed./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_336_0.en: * But she works hard and has a good track record, so she runs unopposed./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_336_0.es: * But she works hard and has a good track record, so she runs unopposed./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_336_0.ja:
＊ でも　はたらきものだし　じっせきも
　 あるから　たいりつこうほが
　 でてこないのさ。/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_336_0.ko:
* 하지만 일을 열심히 하고,
  실적도 좋아서, 원하는 정책을
  별 반대 없이 실현해./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_336_0.pl: * Ale dzięki jej ciężkiej pracy, miasto prosperuje, więc nikt jej nie przeszkadza./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_336_0.pt-BR: * Mas ela trabalha duro e tem um bom histórico, então ela não tem oposição./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_336_0.ru: * Но работает она усердно, её послужной список всё растёт, поэтому конкурентов у неё нет./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_336_0.zh:
* 不过她工作奋进政绩斐然，
所以向来不会树敌。/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_337_0.ja:
＊ せいじってのは…　ふつう
　 こうは　ならないけどな。/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_337_0.zh:
* 这就是政治
* ...的话就有鬼了。/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_341_0.de: * Not only does she act icy, she always keeps her office's AC on full blast./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_341_0.en: * Not only does she act icy, she always keeps her office's AC on full blast./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_341_0.es: * Not only does she act icy, she always keeps her office's AC on full blast./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_341_0.ja:
＊ 町長は　つめたい　いんしょうの
　 じんぶつだ。しかも　オフィスを
　 エアコンで　ギンギンに　ひやす。/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_341_0.ko:
* 시장은 행동만 차가운 게 아니라,
  사무실 에어컨도 항상
  최대로 켜 놓는다니까./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_341_0.pl: * Nie tylko jest oziębła, ale również ma klimatyzację włączoną na pełne obroty./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_341_0.pt-BR: * Ela não apenas age friamente, ela sempre deixa o ar condicioado do escritório dela no máximo./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_341_0.ru: * Не только она холодна, но и её кондиционер всегда работает на полную./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_341_0.zh:
* 市长不光自己很冷淡，
她还会把自己办公室的空调开到最冷。/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_342_0.de:
* That chill I feel... is...
* Is this what politics feels like?/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_342_0.en:
* That chill I feel... is...
* Is this what politics feels like?/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_342_0.es:
* That chill I feel... is...
* Is this what politics feels like?/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_342_0.ja:
＊ なかに　はいると　さむけが…
＊ これが　せいじという
　 ものなのか…？/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_342_0.pl:
* Jej biuro mrozi krew w żyłach... dosłownie... 
* Czy taka jest polityka?/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_342_0.pt-BR:
* Aquele calafrio que sinto... é...
* Essa é a sensação da política?/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_342_0.ru:
* Подобный холод...
* Такой и должна быть политика?/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_342_0.zh:
* 令我一个劲打寒颤... 这就是... 
* 政治的感觉吗？/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_352_0.de: * Oh, Verzeihung. Du suchst nach der Bürgermeisterin./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_352_0.en: * Oh, I'm sorry. You're looking for the mayor./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_352_0.es: * Oh, si estás buscando a la alcaldesa, lo siento./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_352_0.ja:
＊ いやはや　もうしわけございません。
　 町長を　おさがしですね？/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_352_0.pl: * Ach, proszę wybaczyć. Pani burmistrz dziś nie przyjmuje petentów./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_352_0.pt-BR: * Ah, me desculpe. Você está procurando pela prefeita./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_352_0.ru: * Ой, прошу прощения. Вам нужен мэр./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_352_0.zh:
* 噢，不好意思。
你要见市长对吧。/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_353_0.de: * Sie ist sehr, sehr beschäftigt mit den Vorbereitungen für das Dorffest./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_353_0.en: * She's very, very busy preparing for the festival./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_353_0.es: * Está muy, muy ocupada preparando el festival./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_353_0.ja:
＊ 町長は　いま
　 おまつりの　じゅんびで
　 たいへん　おいそがしいのです。/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_353_0.ko:
* 시장님은 축제 준비로
  아주, 아주 바쁘셔./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_353_0.pl: * W tym momencie jest zajęta przygotowaniami do festiwalu./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_353_0.pt-BR: * Ela está muito, muito ocupada preparando o festival./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_353_0.ru: * Она очень, очень занята подготовкой к фестивалю./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_353_0.zh:
* 因为要准备庆典，
她现在非常非常的忙。/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_360_0.de: * Nun nun. Wenn das mal nicht die Teenies sind. Unsere geliebten "Stadtratten."/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_360_0.en: * Well well. If it isn't the teens. Our beloved "rats of the city."/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_360_0.es: * Bueno, bueno. Pero si son los adolescentes. Nuestras queridas "ratas de ciudad"./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_360_0.ja:
＊ これはこれは。ティーンエイジャー
　 どもの　おでましだ。あいすべき
　 「まちのドブネズミ」どもだ。/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_360_0.ko:
* 이런 이런. 우리 마을의
  사랑하는 들쥐들.
  십대 친구들 아니신가./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_360_0.pl: * No, no. Czy to nie nastolatki. Nasze kochane „miejskie szczury”./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_360_0.pt-BR: * Ora, ora. Se não são os adolescentes. Nossos amados "ratos da cidade"./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_360_0.ru: * Так-так. Уж не наши ли это подростки. Любимые «крысы города»./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_360_0.zh:
* 哎哟喂。
这不是镇上的小年轻们吗，
我们亲爱的“城市祸害”。/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_361_0.de: * Du willst mit Politik anfangen? Hah./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_361_0.en: * You wanna get into Politics? Heh./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_361_0.es: * ¿Te quieres meter en la política? Je./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_361_0.ja:
＊ おまえら
　 せいじかに　なりたいのか？
　 フン！/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_361_0.pl: * Chcecie wejść w świat polityki? Heh./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_361_0.pt-BR: * Você quer entrar na política? Heh./

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_362_0.de: * Mach erstmal 'nen Abschluss auf der Windelschule./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_362_0.en: * You better graduate from Diaper School first./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_362_0.es: * Será mejor que te gradúes del parvulario antes./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_362_0.ja:
＊ だったら　まずは
　 オムツがっこうを
　 そつぎょうすることだな。/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_362_0.ko:
* 일단 기저귀 학교부터
  졸업하는 게 좋을 거다./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_362_0.pl: * Najpierw nauczcie się zmieniać sobie pieluchę./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_362_0.pt-BR: * Você deveria se formar na Escola da Fralda antes./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_362_0.zh: * 那你最好还是先从尿布学校毕业吧。/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_363_0.de: * Das hab ich getan. Und jetzt schau mich an./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_363_0.en: * That's what I did. And look at me now./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_363_0.es: * Eso es lo que hice yo. Y mírame ahora./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_363_0.ja:
＊ オレは　そつぎょうしたぜ。
　 おかげで　いまじゃ…/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_363_0.ko:
* 내가 그랬거든.
  그리고 지금의 날 봐./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_363_0.pl: * Ja się nauczyłem. I spójrzcie na mnie./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_363_0.pt-BR: * Foi o que eu fiz. E olhe pra mim agora./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_363_0.ru: * Это то, что я сделал. И теперь посмотри на меня./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_363_0.zh:
* 我就是从那儿毕业的。
瞧我现在多风光。/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_364_0.en: * I don't even work here./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_364_0.ja: ＊ ここで　はたらいてもいない。/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_366_0.de: * Diese Untertasche ist voller Windeln. Oder wie die Pros sagen, "GEWINNdeln."/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_366_0.en: * This Briefscase, is full of Diapers. Or, to the Pro's, "Diaps."/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_366_0.es: * Este maletín está lleno de pañales. O, para los profesionales, "pañis"./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_366_0.ja:
＊ このブリーフケースには
　 オムツが　やまほど　はいってる。
　 ギョーカイようごじゃ　「OMT」だ。/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_366_0.ko:
* 이 서류 가방에는, 기저귀가
  가득 들어 있어, 전문용어로,
  "기적의 가방"이라고도 하지./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_366_0.pl: * Ta waliza pełna jest pieluszek. A dla profesjonalistów: „piechl”./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_366_0.pt-BR: * Esta maleta, está cheia de Fraldas. Ou, para os profissionais, "Fraldz"./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_366_0.ru: * Этот дипломат полон подгузников. Или, говоря профессионально, «памперсов»./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_366_0.zh:
* 我这个供闻包里面，装的全都是尿布。
或者用专业术语讲，叫“尿不湿”。/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_367_0.de: * Du musst dich erstmal raufleveln um eines Mannes Welt zu verstehen./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_367_0.en: * You're gonna have to level up to understand a Man's World./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_367_0.es: * Si queréis entender el Mundo de los Adultos, tenéis que subir de nivel./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_367_0.ja:
＊ オトナの　せかいを　りかいするには
　 おまえら　まだまだ
　 レベルが　たりてないぜ。/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_367_0.ko:
* 어른들의 세계를 이해하려면
  레벨을 더 올려야 할 거야./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_367_0.pl: * Musicie się bardziej postarać, by zrozumieć męski świat./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_367_0.pt-BR: * Você vai ter que subir de nível para entender o Mundo de um Homem./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_367_0.ru: * Вам нужно развиваться, чтобы понять Взрослый мир./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_367_0.zh:
* 要想理解成年人的世界，
你还需要提高自己的知识水平。/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_373_0.de: * Dieser Glatzkopf versucht mir andauernd etwas aus seinem Aktenkoffer zu zeigen./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_373_0.en: * That bald guy keeps trying to show me something from his briefcase./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_373_0.es: * El señor de la calva no deja de intentar enseñarme lo que hay en su maletín./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_373_0.ja:
＊ そこの　あたまがツルッとしたひと…
　 ブリーフケースの　なかみを
　 しつこく　みせようとするんだ。/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_373_0.ko:
* 저 대머리가 계속
  서류 가방 속에 있는 걸
  보여주려고 해./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_373_0.pl: * Ten łysy gostek próbuje pokazać mi wnętrze swojej walizki./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_373_0.pt-BR: * Aquele cara careca fica tentando me mostrar algo de sua maleta./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_373_0.ru: * Этот лысый парень пытается показать мне содержимое своего портфеля./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_373_0.zh:
* 那个秃子老是想给我看他公文包
里面的东西。/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_374_0.de: * Will er mich bestechen...? Ich bin jetzt ganz schön tief in der Politik.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_374_0.en: * Is it a bribe...? I'm really deep into politics now.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_374_0.es: * ¿Será un chantaje?... Ahora estoy muy metido en la política.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_374_0.ja:
＊ ワイロなのか…？
　 ああ…　オレは　すっかり
　 せいじに　そまってしまった…/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_374_0.ko:
* 혹시 뇌물일까...?
  나도 이젠 정치에 완전히
  입문해버렸구나.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_374_0.pl: * Czy to ma być łapówka...? Brutalna jest ta polityka.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_374_0.pt-BR: * Isso é um suborno...? Estou realmente muito fundo na política agora.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_374_0.ru: * Это и есть взятка?.. Я так далеко ушёл в политику.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_374_0.zh:
* 这算是贿赂吗...？
我现在真的身陷政治了.../

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_389_0.ru: 1* Ты всё ещё в мире живых./

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_406_0.de: * Uh, we'll take the special, and do you have any edible glitter...?/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_406_0.en: * Uh, we'll take the special, and do you have any edible glitter...?/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_406_0.es: * Uh, we'll take the special, and do you have any edible glitter...?/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_406_0.ja:
＊ えーっと　「ひがわりランチ」と…
　 あ　それと
　 しょくようスパンコール　あります？/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_406_0.ko:
* 어, 스페셜 코스 주세요,
  먹을 수 있는 반짝이도
  있나요...?/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_406_0.pl: * Ach, weźmiemy danie dnia. Macie może jadalny brokat...?/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_406_0.pt-BR: * Ãh, nós vamos pedir o especial e, me diz, vocês têm algum glitter comestível...?/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_406_0.ru:
* Эм, мы возьмём особое блюдо.
А съедобные блёстки у вас есть?../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_406_0.zh:
* 呃，我们要一份今天的特别菜品，
对了你们有可食用的小亮片吗？/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_407_0.de: * The youngest one won't eat anything if it doesn't look like treasure.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_407_0.en: * The youngest one won't eat anything if it doesn't look like treasure.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_407_0.es: * The youngest one won't eat anything if it doesn't look like treasure.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_407_0.ja:
＊ したのコは
　 たからものに　みえないと
　 たべてくれなくて…/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_407_0.ko:
* 어린 애가 보물처럼
  생기지 않은 건
  먹지를 않아서요.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_407_0.pl: * Moje dzieciaki nie zjedzą niczego, co nie świeci się jak złoto.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_407_0.pt-BR: * The youngest one won't eat anything if it doesn't look like treasure.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_407_0.ru: * Младшенькие не станут ничего есть, если еда не похожа на сокровище.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_407_0.zh:
* 最小的孩子只愿意吃
看起来像财宝的食物。/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_409_0.de: * In a pinch, sprinkles will work, too.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_409_0.en: * In a pinch, sprinkles will work, too.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_409_0.es: * In a pinch, sprinkles will work, too.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_409_0.ja:
＊ なければ　チョコスプレーを
　 まぶすだけでも　いいんですけど…/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_409_0.pl: * Choć w sumie... posypka powinna im wystarczyć.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_409_0.pt-BR: * In a pinch, sprinkles will work, too.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_409_0.ru: * На крайняк, настоящие блёстки тоже пойдут.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_409_0.zh:
* 实在没有的话，
彩色糖粉也可以.../

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_415_0.de: * Don't be a stranger now, alright, hun?/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_415_0.en: * Don't be a stranger now, alright, hun?/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_415_0.es: * Don't be a stranger now, alright, hun?/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_415_0.ja:
＊ また　いつでも　おいで。
　 まってるよ。/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_415_0.ko:
* 혼자 와도 되니까,
  종종 들러 줘. 알겠지?/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_415_0.pt-BR: * Don't be a stranger now, alright, hun?/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_415_0.zh:
* 这个时候就别太见外了，
好吗，亲？/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_421_0.de:
* Hey there!
* Haven't seen you in a while, hun./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_421_0.en:
* Hey there!
* Haven't seen you in a while, hun./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_421_0.es:
* Hey there!
* Haven't seen you in a while, hun./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_421_0.ja:
＊ いらっしゃい！
＊ ずいぶん　ひさしぶりじゃないか。/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_421_0.pl:
* Witaj!
* Dawno cię tu nie było, słonko./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_421_0.pt-BR:
* Hey there!
* Haven't seen you in a while, hun./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_421_0.zh:
* 嗨！
* 有阵子没来了，亲。/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_423_0.de: * I remember, back on Sundays, after service.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_423_0.en: * I remember, back on Sundays, after service.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_423_0.es: * I remember, back on Sundays, after service.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_423_0.ja:
＊ まえは　よく　かぞくみんなで
　 きてくれたけどねえ…/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_423_0.ko: * 기억난다, 매주 일요일 교회 예배 때.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_423_0.pl: * Pamiętam jak kiedyś, w każdą niedzielę po mszy.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_423_0.pt-BR: * I remember, back on Sundays, after service.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_423_0.zh:
* 我还记得，
在每周日的礼拜之后.../

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_424_0.de: * You and your family would come in and order the special./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_424_0.en: * You and your family would come in and order the special./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_424_0.es: * You and your family would come in and order the special./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_424_0.ja:
＊ にちようびの　れいはいの
　 かえりにさ。ちゅうもんは　いつも
　 きまって　「ひがわりランチ」で。/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_424_0.ko:
* 너희 가족이 가게에 들어와서
  스페셜 메뉴를 시키곤 했지./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_424_0.pl: * Rodzice zabierali ciebie i twojego brata na danie dnia./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_424_0.pt-BR: * You and your family would come in and order the special./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_424_0.ru: * Вы с семьёй приходили сюда и заказывали особое блюдо./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_424_0.zh:
* 你们全家都会过来光顾，
品尝当天的特别菜品。/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_425_0.ja:
＊ まあでも　あんたたち一家も
　 いろいろあったからねえ…/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_425_0.pl: * Niestety pewne rzeczy miały miejsce i od tamtego dnia.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_425_0.ru: * Конечно, что случилось, то случилось, и вы.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_425_0.zh:
* 当然了，也发生了不少事，
再之后呢.../

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_426_0.en:
* Y'all...
* Stopped comin' together./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_426_0.ja:
＊ もう　かぞく　そろって
　 きてくれることは
　 なくなっちまったけど。/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_426_0.ko:
* 너희 가족은...
* 더는 같이 오지 않았지./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_426_0.zh:
* 你们就... 
* 不再全家一块来了。/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_427_0.de: * But every Sunday, you and your brother'd still come in./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_427_0.en: * But every Sunday, you and your brother'd still come in./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_427_0.es: * But every Sunday, you and your brother'd still come in./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_427_0.ja:
＊ それでも　まいしゅう
　 にちようびには　おにいちゃんと
　 ２人で　きてくれてたねえ。/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_427_0.ko:
* 하지만 아스리엘은 여전히 
  일요일마다 너를 데리고 왔어./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_427_0.pl: * Ale i tak twój brat cię tutaj zabierał w każdą niedzielę./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_427_0.pt-BR: * But every Sunday, you and your brother'd still come in./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_427_0.ru: * Но каждое воскресенье вы с братом всегда возвращались./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_427_0.zh:
* 不过每当周日，
你和你哥哥还是会过来。/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_428_0.de: * He'd order you a hot chocolate.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_428_0.en: * He'd order you a hot chocolate.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_428_0.es: * He'd order you a hot chocolate.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_428_0.ja:
＊ おにいちゃんが　あんたに
　 ホットチョコレートを
　 ちゅうもんしてさ…/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_428_0.pt-BR: * He'd order you a hot chocolate.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_428_0.zh: * 他会给你点一杯热巧克力.../

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_429_0.de: * And you two'd sit down at that table in the corner.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_429_0.en: * And you two'd sit down at that table in the corner.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_429_0.es: * And you two'd sit down at that table in the corner.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_429_0.ja:
＊ あそこの　かどの　テーブルが
　 あんたたちの　とくとうせきで…/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_429_0.pl: * Siadaliście przy tamtym stoliku w kącie.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_429_0.pt-BR: * And you two'd sit down at that table in the corner.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_429_0.ru: * И вы вдвоём садились за столик в углу.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_429_0.zh:
* 然后你们两人就坐在
角落里的那张桌子旁边.../

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_430_0.de: * ... drawin' shapes in the window with your breath./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_430_0.en: * ... drawin' shapes in the window with your breath./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_430_0.es: * ... drawin' shapes in the window with your breath./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_430_0.ja:
＊ …まどガラスに　いきを
　 ふきかけちゃ　ゆびで
　 えを　かいたりしてさ…/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_430_0.ko:
* ... 창문에 입김을 불고
  삐죽삐죽 그리곤 했지./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_430_0.pl: * ...i rysowaliście na szybie rysunki waszymi oddechami./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_430_0.pt-BR: * ... drawin' shapes in the window with your breath./

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_432_0.de: * You must really miss him, huh?/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_432_0.en: * You must really miss him, huh?/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_432_0.es: * You must really miss him, huh?/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_432_0.ja:
＊ おにいちゃんが　いなくなっちまって
　 さみしいだろ？/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_432_0.pl: * Na pewno ci go brakuje, co?/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_432_0.pt-BR: * You must really miss him, huh?/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_432_0.ru: * Ты, наверное, скучаешь по нему, да?/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_432_0.zh: * 你一定特别想念他，对吧？/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_433_0.ja:
＊ …ほら　これのんで
　 げんきだしなよ。/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_434_0.ja:
＊ (クリスは　ホットチョコレートを
　 てにいれた)/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_435_0.ja:
＊ おだいは　いらないよ。
　 サービスさ。/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_442_0.de: * ... You know, I'd give you a hot chocolate on the house.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_442_0.en: * ... You know, I'd give you a hot chocolate on the house.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_442_0.es: * ... You know, I'd give you a hot chocolate on the house.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_442_0.ja:
＊ …ホントなら　ホットチョコレートを
　 サービスしてあげたいとこだけど…/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_442_0.ko:
* ... 있잖아, 핫 초콜릿을
  한 잔 내주고 싶은데.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_442_0.pl: * Wiesz, dałabym ci gorącą czekoladę na koszt firmy.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_442_0.pt-BR: * ... You know, I'd give you a hot chocolate on the house.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_442_0.ru: * ...Знаешь, я бы дала тебе горячего шоколада за счёт заведения.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_442_0.zh:
* ... 那个，我想请你喝杯
热巧克力来着.../

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_443_0.de: * ... But it looks like you've got enough things already./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_443_0.en: * ... But it looks like you've got enough things already./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_443_0.es: * ... But it looks like you've got enough things already./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_443_0.ja:
＊ …どうやら　もちものが
　 いっぱいみたいだねえ。/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_443_0.pl: * Ale widzę, że nie masz jej gdzie schować./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_443_0.pt-BR: * ... But it looks like you've got enough things already./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_443_0.ru: * ...Но, похоже, у тебя уже достаточно вещей./

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_444_0.en: * Take it easy, okay, hun?/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_444_0.ja: ＊ きをつけて　かえるんだよ。/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_468_0.de: * So, for you two girls, that'll be the crepes, a cinnamon latte.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_468_0.en: * So, for you two girls, that'll be the crepes, a cinnamon latte.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_468_0.es: * So, for you two girls, that'll be the crepes, a cinnamon latte.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_468_0.ja:
＊ ごちゅうもんを　くりかえします。
　 クレープが　おひとつ…
　 シナモンラテが　おひとつ…/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_468_0.ko:
* 그래서, 언니들 주문은,
  크레이프에, 시나몬 라떼.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_468_0.pl: * Dla was będą naleśniki, latte cynamonowe.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_468_0.pt-BR: * So, for you two girls, that'll be the crepes, a cinnamon latte.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_468_0.ru: * Так, вам, девочки, блинчики, латте с корицей.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_468_0.zh:
* 好的，两位小姐点的是，
一份可丽饼，一份肉桂拿铁.../

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_469_0.de: * Two bunny parfaits, and... a piece of firewood...?/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_469_0.en: * Two bunny parfaits, and... a piece of firewood...?/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_469_0.es: * Two bunny parfaits, and... a piece of firewood...?/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_469_0.ja:
＊ ウサパフェが　おふたつと…
　 たきぎが　１ぽん…
　 いじょうで　よろしいかしら？/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_469_0.ko:
* 토끼 파르페 두 개에,
  ... 장작 한 조각?/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_469_0.pl: * Dwa królicze parfait i... kawałek drewna...?/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_469_0.pt-BR: * Two bunny parfaits, and... a piece of firewood...?/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_469_0.zh:
* 两份兔兔芭菲，
还有... 一块柴火...？/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_472_0.de: * And, how would you like that firewood done?/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_472_0.en: * And, how would you like that firewood done?/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_472_0.es: * And, how would you like that firewood done?/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_472_0.ja: ＊ たきぎの　やきかげんは？/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_472_0.pt-BR: * And, how would you like that firewood done?/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_472_0.ru: * И какой прожарки хворост вы хотите?/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_472_0.zh: * 那么，柴火要做成几分熟的？/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_482_0.de: * Dude, remember when we used to skip the first hour of class to come here?/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_482_0.en: * Dude, remember when we used to skip the first hour of class to come here?/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_482_0.es: * Dude, remember when we used to skip the first hour of class to come here?/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_482_0.ja:
＊ てか　おぼえてる？　よく
　 いちじかんめの　じゅぎょう
　 サボって　ここ　きたじゃん？/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_482_0.ko:
* 야, 옛날에 수업
  첫 시간 째고 여기 오고
  그랬던 거 기억나?/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_482_0.pl: * Laska, pamiętasz, jak opuszczałyśmy pierwszą lekcję, by tu przyjść?/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_482_0.pt-BR: * Dude, remember when we used to skip the first hour of class to come here?/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_482_0.ru: * Чувак, помнишь, когда мы пропускали первый урок, чтобы прийти сюда?/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_482_0.zh:
* 我说，记不记得咱俩以前
时不时就翘了第一节课跑到这来？/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_483_0.de: * YOU were fine, but I almost had to repeat the year 'cause of it.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_483_0.en: * YOU were fine, but I almost had to repeat the year 'cause of it.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_483_0.es: * YOU were fine, but I almost had to repeat the year 'cause of it.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_483_0.ja:
＊ アンタは　セーフだったけど
　 アタシは　そのせいで　りゅうねん
　 しかけてさ…/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_483_0.ko:
* 넌 괜찮았겠지만,
  난 그것 때문에 
  학교 1년 더 다닐 뻔했다고.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_483_0.pl: * TOBIE to nie zaszkodziło, ale ja prawie nie zdałam.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_483_0.pt-BR: * YOU were fine, but I almost had to repeat the year 'cause of it.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_483_0.ru: * ТЕБЯ-то пронесло, а я потом весь учебный год отрабатывала.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_483_0.zh:
* 你是没什么事，
可差点害我留了一级.../

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_484_0.de: * Those crepes were MAD worth, though! Delinquency is the best condiment!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_484_0.en: * Those crepes were MAD worth, though! Delinquency is the best condiment!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_484_0.es: * Those crepes were MAD worth, though! Delinquency is the best condiment!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_484_0.ja:
＊ んでも　しょーがなくない！？
　 ここのクレープ　ぜっぴんだもん！
　 わるいことは　ミツのあじ！/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_484_0.ko:
* 물론 그 크레페는
  그럴 가치가 있었지만!
  땡땡이는 최고의 조미료지!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_484_0.pl: * Ale te naleśniki były PRZEPYSZNE! Dreszczyk emocji jest najlepszą przyprawą!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_484_0.pt-BR: * Those crepes were MAD worth, though! Delinquency is the best condiment!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_484_0.ru: * Хотя эти блинчики ТОЧНО того стоили! Преступление — лучшая приправа!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_484_0.zh:
* 不过，这里的可丽饼
值得为之疯狂！
犯点小错更能使美食增色！/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_487_0.de: * Dude, if we didn't bring Gerson our leftovers, I bet I would have failed HARD.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_487_0.en: * Dude, if we didn't bring Gerson our leftovers, I bet I would have failed HARD.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_487_0.es: * Dude, if we didn't bring Gerson our leftovers, I bet I would have failed HARD.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_487_0.ja:
＊ たべきれなかったぶんを　ガーソンに
　 もってってやったおかげで　なんとか
　 そつぎょうできたけどさー…/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_487_0.ko:
* 남은 과제를 들고
  거슨 선생님한테 가지 않았으면,
  우린 분명 낙제했을 거야.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_487_0.pl: * Laska, gdybyśmy nie przynosiły Gersonowi resztek, to by na pewno mnie uwalił.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_487_0.pt-BR: * Dude, if we didn't bring Gerson our leftovers, I bet I would have failed HARD.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_487_0.ru: * Чувак, если бы мы не принесли Герсону остатки блинов, клянусь, досталось бы ЗНАТНО.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_487_0.zh:
* 我说，当时要不是咱俩
拿剩下的食物收买Gerson，
我绝对死得要多惨有多惨.../

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_496_0.de: * Looking at my rugged body, you must wonder what kind of secrets I hold.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_496_0.en: * Looking at my rugged body, you must wonder what kind of secrets I hold.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_496_0.es: * Looking at my rugged body, you must wonder what kind of secrets I hold.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_496_0.ja:
＊ ボクの　このたくましいカラダには
　 どんなヒミツが　かくされているか
　 きになるでしょ…？/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_496_0.ko:
* 내 다부진 몸을 보고 
  운동을 어떻게 하나
  궁금해하고 있겠지.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_496_0.pl: * Podziwiając moje napakowane ciało, zastanawia cię pewnie, jakie sekrety skrywam.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_496_0.pt-BR: * Looking at my rugged body, you must wonder what kind of secrets I hold.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_496_0.ru: * Глядя на моё мужественное тело, тебе наверняка стало интересно, что за секрет я храню.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_496_0.zh:
* 见到我这高耸入云的身躯，
你一定很好奇我隐藏着什么秘密.../

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_497_0.de: * My secret is, I put all my leftover pancakes in this giant hat./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_497_0.en: * My secret is, I put all my leftover pancakes in this giant hat./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_497_0.es: * My secret is, I put all my leftover pancakes in this giant hat./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_497_0.ja:
＊ ボク　じつはね…　たべのこしの
　 パンケーキを　このでっかいぼうしに
　 いれてるんだ。/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_497_0.ko:
* 비결은,
  먹고 남은 팬케이크를
  다 모자에 넣어두는 거야./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_497_0.pl: * Otóż skrywam w tym wielkim kapeluszu niezjedzone naleśniki./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_497_0.pt-BR: * My secret is, I put all my leftover pancakes in this giant hat./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_497_0.ru: * Он в том, что я кладу все недоеденные блины в эту шляпу./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_497_0.zh:
* 我的秘密就是，
我把吃剩的煎饼全塞进这顶大帽子里了。/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_501_0.en:
* Whew!
* I sure love PANCAKE!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_501_0.ja: ＊ ボク　パンケーキ　だあいすき！/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_501_0.zh:
* 呼！
* 我可爱死煎饼了！/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_507_0.de: * Ice Wolf does not like ice in drink./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_507_0.en: * Ice Wolf does not like ice in drink./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_507_0.es: * Ice Wolf does not like ice in drink./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_507_0.ja:
＊ アイスウルフ　のみものに
　 こおり　いれる　すきじゃない。/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_507_0.ko:
* 아이스 울프는 음료수에
  얼음이 들어간 걸
  좋아하지 않는다./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_507_0.pl: * Lodny wilk nie lubi lodu w swoich napojach./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_507_0.pt-BR: * Jão Gelão gosta não gelo em bebida./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_507_0.ru: * Ледяной Волк не любит напитки со льдом./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_507_0.zh: * Ice Wolf不喜欢把冰加在饮料里。/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_508_0.ja:
＊ アイスウルフ　すきなの
　 こおり…/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_513_0.de: * Ice Wolf also like ice-themed mascots./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_513_0.en: * Ice Wolf also like ice-themed mascots./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_513_0.es: * Ice Wolf also like ice-themed mascots./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_513_0.ja:
＊ アイスウルフ
　 こおりの　ゆるキャラも　すき。/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_513_0.ko:
* 아이스 울프는
  얼음을 주제로 한
  마스코트도 좋아한다./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_513_0.pl: * Lodny wilk także lubi lodowe maskotki./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_513_0.pt-BR: * Jão Gelão gosta mascote gelo tumém./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_513_0.ru: * Ледяной Волк ещё любит талисманы на тему льда./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_513_0.zh:
* Ice Wolf也喜欢
以冰块为原型的吉祥物。/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_542_0.de: * Catti's family is always asking when her next shift is.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_542_0.en: * Catti's family is always asking when her next shift is.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_542_0.es: * La familia de Catti siempre me pregunta cuándo empieza su siguente turno.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_542_0.ja:
＊ キャッティーの　ごかぞくからは
　 いっつも　あのコの　つぎのシフトを
　 きかれるんだよ…/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_542_0.ko:
* 캣티의 가족은 늘
  캣티의 교대 타임이
  언제인지 물어봐.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_542_0.pl: * Rodzina Catti ciągle mnie pyta, jak wygląda jej grafik.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_542_0.pt-BR: * A família da Catti sempre pergunta quando vai ser o próximo turno dela.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_542_0.ru: * Семья Котти постоянно уточняет когда у неё следующая смена.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_542_0.zh:
* Catti的家人总是过来问
她什么时候上班.../

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_543_0.de: * So they can come in and cheer her on./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_543_0.en: * So they can come in and cheer her on./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_543_0.ja:
＊ そのじかんに　みんなできて
　 キャッティーを　おうえんするのさ。/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_543_0.pl: * Żeby móc przyjść tutaj i ją dopingować w pracy./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_543_0.pt-BR: * Para que eles possam vir e torcer pra ela./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_543_0.zh:
* 这样他们就能来店里
帮Catti加油鼓劲了。/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_544_0.de: * Never seen anything like it, but it's kind of nice, isn't it?/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_544_0.en: * Never seen anything like it, but it's kind of nice, isn't it?/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_544_0.es: * Nunca he visto nada parecido, pero es bonito, ¿no crees?/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_544_0.ja:
＊ そんな　かぞくは
　 ほかに　しらないけど
　 なんだか　いいと　おもわないかい？/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_544_0.ko:
* 저런 모습은 처음 보지만,
  꽤 멋진 것 같기도 해, 안 그래?/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_544_0.pl: * Pierwszy raz się z czymś takim spotkałam, ale to miło z ich strony, co nie?/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_544_0.pt-BR: * Nunca vi nada igual, mas até que é legal, não é?/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_544_0.ru: * Никогда подобного не видела, но, как по мне, это довольно мило./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_544_0.zh:
* 这种事我也是头一回见，
不过还挺感人的，对吧？/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_548_0.ja: ＊ げんきで　やってるかい？/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_549_0.de: * ... what? Sorry, couldn't hear you over the noise./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_549_0.en: * ... what? Sorry, couldn't hear you over the noise./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_549_0.es: * ... ¿Qué? Lo siento, no he podido escucharte con todo ese ruido./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_549_0.ja:
＊ …え？　まわりが　うるさくて
　 よくきこえなかったよ。/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_549_0.ko:
* ... 뭐라고? 미안하구나,
  시끄러워서 잘 못 들었단다./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_549_0.pl: * Możesz powtórzyć? Nie dosłyszałam cię przez ten harmider./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_549_0.pt-BR: * ... quê? Desculpa, não consegui ouvir por causa do barulho./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_549_0.ru: * ...что? Прости, не услышала тебя из-за шума./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_549_0.zh:
* ... 你说什么？
不好意思，店里太吵了，
我没听清楚你的话。/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_563_0.de: * Hey Schatz, wie war dein Kakao?/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_563_0.en: * Hey hon, how did you like the hot chocolate?/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_563_0.es: * Oye, corazón, ¿te gustó el chocolate caliente?/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_563_0.ja:
＊ ホットチョコレートは
　 おいしかったかい？/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_563_0.pl: * Witaj, słonko. Smakowała ci gorąca czekolada?/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_563_0.pt-BR: * Ei, filhote, o que você achou do chocolate quente?/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_563_0.ru: * Эй, дорогуша, как тебе горячий шоколад?/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_564_0.de: * ... nun, ich schätze mal das heisst er hat dir gefallen./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_564_0.en: * ... well, I'm gonna take it that means you enjoyed it./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_564_0.es: * ... bueno, tomaré eso como que lo has disfrutado./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_564_0.ja:
＊ ………
　 …それは
　 「おいしかった」って　イミかな。/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_564_0.pt-BR: * ... bom, eu vou considerar isso um sim./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_564_0.ru: * ...хорошо, приму это как то, что тебе понравилось./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_564_0.zh:
* ...好吧，
那应该是喜欢的意思吧。/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_565_0.de: * Nimm's leicht, ja? Ich bin sicher dein bruder kommt bald wieder./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_565_0.en: * Take it easy, okay? I'm sure your brother will be back in no time./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_565_0.es: * Tómatelo con calma, ¿vale? Estoy segura de que tu hermano volverá ya mismo./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_565_0.ja:
＊ ま　ほどほどに　がんばんなさいな。
　 おにいちゃんも　きっと
　 じきに　もどってくるよ。/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_565_0.ko:
* 너무 걱정 말렴, 알겠지?
  그 애도 이제 금방
  돌아올 테니까./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_565_0.pl: * Nie martw się. Zanim się obejrzysz, twój brat będzie już w domu./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_565_0.pt-BR: * Relaxa, ok? Tenho certeza que seu irmão vai voltar logo, logo./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_565_0.ru: * Не принимай близко к сердцу, ладно? Я уверена, твой брат скоро вернётся./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_565_0.zh:
* 放轻松点，好吗？
我想你哥哥很快就会回来的。/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_575_0.ja:
＊ キャッティー！は！
　 オレのともだち！だから！/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_575_0.pl: * Catti to moja przyjaciółka. A ja./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_575_0.pt-BR: * A Catti, É minha amiga. E./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_575_0.zh:
* Catti是，我的好朋友。
并且，/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_576_0.de: Ich helfe meinen Freunden, durch dick, und dünn./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_576_0.en: * I support my friends, through thick, and thin./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_576_0.es: * Y yo apoyo a mis amigos, en lo bueno y en lo malo./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_576_0.ja:
＊ どんなときでも　みすては
　 しない！　たのしいときも！
　 くるしいときも！/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_576_0.ko:
* 난 언제나 친구를 도와줘,
  두꺼울 때도, 얇을 때도./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_576_0.pl: * Wspieram swoich przyjaciół, na dobre i na złe./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_576_0.pt-BR: * Eu apoio meus amigos, faça chuva, faça sol./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_576_0.ru: * Я помогаю друзьям несмотря ни на что./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_576_0.zh:
* 不管遇到什么艰难困苦，
我都会永远支持我的朋友。/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_577_0.de: Lang, und kurz. Kalt, und heiss./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_577_0.en: * Long, and short. Cold, and hot./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_577_0.es: * Ancho o fino, grande o mediano./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_577_0.ja:
＊ ながいときも　みじかい
　 ときも！　さむいときも
　 あついときも！/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_577_0.ko:
* 길 때도, 짧을 때도.
  추울 때도, 더울 때도./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_577_0.pl: * Na małe i na duże. Na zimne i na ciepłe./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_577_0.pt-BR: * Nublado, e neve. Frio, e quente./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_577_0.ru: * В жару и холод. Как бы долго они не длились./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_577_0.zh: * 无论光阴荏苒，春去秋来。/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_578_0.de: Welche Form, die Welt auch nimmt, ich bin da./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_578_0.en: * Whatever shape, the world takes, I'll be there./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_578_0.es: * Da igual la forma que tome el mundo, yo estaré ahí./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_578_0.ja:
＊ このせかいが　どんな
　 すがたに　なったとしても！
　 オレは　いつもそばにいる！/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_578_0.ko:
* 이 세상이, 어떻게 변해도,
  나는 늘 곁에 있을거야./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_578_0.pl: * Nieważne jakie kłody jej pod nogi świat rzuci, ja będę przy niej./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_578_0.pt-BR: * Com qualquer clima, que tiver no mundo, eu estarei lá./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_578_0.ru: * Какую бы форму ни принял мир, я буду здесь./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_578_0.zh:
* 纵世间沧海桑田，
唯友情始终如一。/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_582_0.de: Das Leben ist ein, gro€es Ballspiel,/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_582_0.en: * Life is a big, ballgame,/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_582_0.es: * La vida es un gran partido de baloncesto,/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_582_0.ja:
＊ じんせいは　せいだいな
　 バスケの　しあいだ！/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_582_0.pt-BR: * A vida é um grande, jogo de bola,/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_582_0.ru: * Жизнь — это большая игра в мяч,/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_582_0.zh: * 人生，如同一场盛大的球赛，/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_583_0.de: Und wenn der Mann auf dem Feld ist./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_583_0.en: * And when the man is on the field./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_583_0.es: * Y cuando un hombre de verdad entra al campo./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_583_0.pl: * Nigdy nie wiesz, co cię spotka./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_583_0.pt-BR: * E quando o homem está no campo./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_583_0.ru: * И когда игрок выходит на поле./

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_584_0.en: * He does a big dunk./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_584_0.es: * Tiene que hacer un gran mate./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_584_0.ja:
＊ せいだいに
　 ダンクシュートを　きめる！/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_584_0.zh:
* 就必须完成一记
精彩绝伦的扣篮。/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_585_0.en: * Try, to be that dunk./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_585_0.ja:
＊ そういう　ダンクシュートに
　 なることだ！/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_585_0.ko:
* 그 덩크슛이 되기 위해,
  노력하는 거지./

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_595_0.de: * Unsere kleine Catti, sie macht uns stolz./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_595_0.en: * Our little Catti, she's doin' us proud./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_595_0.es: * Ahh, nuestra pequeña Catti, nos hace sentir tan orgullosos./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_595_0.ja:
＊ うちの　キャッティーは
　 じまんの　むすめでねえ。/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_595_0.pl: * Nasza malutka Catti, jesteśmy z niej dumni./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_595_0.pt-BR: * Nossa pequena Catti, ela nos deixa orgulhosos./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_595_0.ru: * Наша маленькая Котти, наша маленькая гордость./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_595_0.zh:
* 我们的小Catti，
她真是我们的骄傲。/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_596_0.ja:
＊ せっせと　はたらいて
　 かけいを　たすけてくれてる。/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_596_0.zh:
* 努力工作。
养家糊口。/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_597_0.de: * Serviert uns Gürkchen, erschreckt uns mit deren Form,/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_597_0.en: * Servin' us pickles, terrifyin' us with their shape,/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_597_0.es: * Nos sirve pepinillos, aterrorizándonos con su forma,/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_597_0.ja:
＊ ピクルスを　はこんできては
　 わたしらを　ふるえあがらせてね…/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_597_0.ko:
* 일부러 징그럽게 생긴
  피클을 서빙해서는,
  우릴 공포에 질리게도 하고,/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_597_0.pl: * Pokazuje nam ogórki kiszone, których kształt nas przeraża,/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_597_0.pt-BR: * Nos servindo picles, nos aterrorizando com seus formatos,/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_597_0.zh: * 上了份腌黄瓜吓唬我们，/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_598_0.de: * Versucht uns hier raus zu kriegen./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_598_0.en: * Tryin' to get us to leave./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_598_0.ja: ＊ わたしらを　おいだそうとするんだ。/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_598_0.pl: * Próbując nas wygonić ze swojego pokoju./

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_599_0.ja: ＊ ほんとうに　じまんのむすめだよ。/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_602_0.de: * Mein Lieblingsgericht? Das müssen die Katzenfutter- Pfannkuchen sein!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_602_0.en: * My favorite meal? Gotta be the catfood pancakes!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_602_0.es: * ¿Mi almuerzo favorito? ¡Las tortitas de comida de gato, por supuesto!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_602_0.ja:
＊ おじさんの　こうぶつかい？
　 そりゃあ
　 キャットフード・パンケーキさ！/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_602_0.ko:
* 내가 좋아하는 음식?
  그야 고양이 사료 케이크지!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_602_0.pl: * Moje ulubione danie? Niewątpliwie naleśniki z kociej karmy!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_602_0.pt-BR: * Meu prato preferido? É claro que são as panquecas de comida de gato!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_602_0.ru: * Моя любимая еда? Блины из кошачьей еды!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_602_0.zh:
* 我最喜欢的一道菜？
那必须得是猫粮煎饼了！/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_603_0.de: * Und der Fisch mit Gräten der aussieht wie in einem Cartoon./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_603_0.en: * And the fish with bones that looks like it's from a cartoon./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_603_0.es: * Y los peces con huesos que parecen sacados de dibujos animados./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_603_0.ja:
＊ それと　マンガに　でてくるみたいな
　 ホネつきの　おさかなだね。/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_603_0.ko:
* 만화에 나오는 것처럼 생긴
  뼈가 있는 생선도 좋아./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_603_0.pl: * I ryba z ośćmi, wyglądająca jak danie z kreskówki./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_603_0.pt-BR: * E o peixe com os ossos que parece de um desenho animado./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_603_0.ru: * И рыба с костями, прям как из мультфильма./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_603_0.zh:
* 还有就是像动画片里那种
带骨头的鱼。/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_611_0.de: * Um die Wahrheit zu sagen, ich dachte das wäre das Postbüro.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_611_0.en: * To tell you the truth, I thought this was the post office.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_611_0.es: * Si te digo la verdad, pensaba que esto era la oficina de correos.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_611_0.ja:
＊ じつは　ゆうびんきょくと
　 まちがえて　はいってきちゃってさ…/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_611_0.ko:
* 실은, 여기가 우체국인 줄
  알고 들어와버렸는데.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_611_0.pl: * Przyznam szczerze, myślałem, że to jest poczta.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_611_0.pt-BR: * Pra falar a verdade, eu achei que esse lugar era o correio.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_611_0.ru: * Сказать по правде, я думал, что это почта.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_611_0.zh:
* 和你说个事，
我原本还以为这里是邮局.../

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_612_0.de: * Doch bis mir das klar wurde... Sa€ ich schon hier.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_612_0.en: * But by the time I realized... I'd already sat down.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_612_0.es: * Pero para cuando me di cuenta... ya me había sentado.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_612_0.ja:
＊ でも　まちがいに　きづいたときには
　 もう　せきに　すわっちゃってて…/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_612_0.ko:
* 그 사실을 깨달았을 땐...
  이미 자리에 앉은
  상태였습니다.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_612_0.pl: * Zanim to do mnie doszło... zdążyłem już usiąść przy stoliku.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_612_0.pt-BR: * Mas quando eu percebi... eu já tinha sentado.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_612_0.ru: * Но к тому времени, когда я понял... я уже сел за столик.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_612_0.zh:
* 可是等我回过神来...
我就已经坐在位置上了.../

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_613_0.de: * Ich habe keinen Hunger, also sagte ich der Kellnerin ich suche noch was aus.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_613_0.en: * I'm not hungry, so I've just been telling the waitress I'm still deciding for.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_613_0.es: * No tengo hambre, así que estoy diciéndole a la camarera que estoy decidiéndome.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_613_0.ja:
＊ おなかへってないから
　 てんいんさんが　くるたびに
　 「まだ　きまってません」って…/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_613_0.ko:
* 배가 고프진 않아서,
  직원이 올 때마다
  결정 중이라고만 말하고 있습니다.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_613_0.pl: * Nie jestem głodny, więc cały czas mówię kelnerce, że nadal wybieram danie.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_613_0.pt-BR: * Eu não tô com fome, aí fiquei falando pra garçonete que ainda estou decidindo e já faz.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_613_0.ru: * Я не голоден, поэтому я говорю официантке, что всё ещё выбираю.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_613_0.zh:
* 我一点都不饿，所以我跟服务员说
还没想好要点什么吃.../

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_614_0.de: * ... schon ein Paar Stunden lang. Wie soll ich hier wieder raus kommen!?/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_614_0.en: * ... a few hours now. How am I supposed to get out of this one!?/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_614_0.es: * ... llevo aquí varias horas. ¿¡Cómo voy a salir de esta!?/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_614_0.ja:
＊ …もう　かれこれ　すうじかん
　 いいつづけてる。
　 ボクは　どうしたらいいんだ！？/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_614_0.ko:
* ... 벌써 몇 시간째인데.
  어떻게 빠져나가야 할까요!?/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_614_0.pl: * Trwa to już kilka godzin. Jak mam wyjść z twarzą z tej sytuacji!?/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_614_0.pt-BR: * ... algumas horas. Como é que vou sair dessa?!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_614_0.ru: * ...уже несколько часов подряд. Как мне выбраться отсюда?!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_614_0.zh:
* ...已经好几个小时了。
我要怎么从这里脱身啊！？/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_630_0.de: * Ich wei€ nicht ob du's bemerkt hast, doch ich bin stärker geworden./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_630_0.en: * I don't know if you noticed, but I've been getting stronger./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_630_0.es: * No sé si lo has notado, pero me estoy poniendo fuerte para el invierno./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_630_0.ja:
＊ ねえ　きづいた？
　 ボク　だいぶ　つよくなってきたよ。/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_630_0.pl: * Nie wiem, czy to widać, ale pracuję nad masą./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_630_0.pt-BR: * Eu não sei se você percebeu, mas estou ficando mais forte./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_630_0.ru: * Не знаю, заметно ли тебе, но я становлюсь сильнее./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_630_0.zh:
* 注意到没有，
我最近越来越壮实了。/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_631_0.de: * Du könntest sagen ich bekomme Winterspeck./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_631_0.en: * You could say I'm bulking up for the winter./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_631_0.es: * Ahora, cuando se ponga a nevar, se me verá el sombrero por fuera de la nieve./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_631_0.ja:
＊ ふゆに　そなえて
　 キンニクを　そだててるってわけ。/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_631_0.ko:
* 겨울을 대비해서
  근육을 키우고 있다고
  할 수 있으려나./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_631_0.pt-BR: * Pode-se dizer que estou ficando maromba pro inverno./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_631_0.zh: * 其实我是在为过冬而增肥。/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_635_0.en: * Oh boy! I love BULKING./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_635_0.ja:
＊ ボク　キンニクそだてるの
　 だあいすき！/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_635_0.pt-BR: * Ah cara! Eu amo ficar MAROMBA./

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_649_0.de: * Dieser Typ neben mir, der ist ect wuchtig. Das gefällt mir./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_649_0.en: * This guy next to me, he's really bulked up. I admire that./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_649_0.es: * El tipo que está sentado junto a mí está muy entrenado. Admiro a la gente así./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_649_0.ja:
＊ ボクの　となりのひと
　 すごく　キンニクが　そだってる。
　 ホレボレするよ。/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_649_0.ko:
* 내 옆 사람, 근육이 장난 아냐.
  완전 빠져버렸어./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_649_0.pl: * Ten gostek nabrał ostatnio masy. Podziwiam jego zapał./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_649_0.pt-BR: * Esse cara do meu lado, ele realmente ficou maromba. Eu admiro isso./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_649_0.ru: * Этот парень, что сидит рядом, весьма подкачан. Я ему поражаюсь./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_649_0.zh:
* 我旁边这个家伙，真的比以前壮了不少。
我挺佩服他的。/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_645_0.de: * Ich wei€ nicht ob du das tust, dir Winterspeck wachsen lassen.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_645_0.en: * I don't know if you do that, bulking up for the winter.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_645_0.es: * Aunque no sé si la gente suele entrenar para el invierno.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_645_0.ja:
＊ ふゆに　そなえて
　 キンニクを　そだてる…
　 それって　ふつうのこと？/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_645_0.ko:
* 너도 겨울을 대비해서
  근육을 키우는지는 모르겠어.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_645_0.pl: * Nie wiem, czy pracujesz nad masą, czy nad rzeźbą.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_645_0.pt-BR: * Eu não sei se você faz isso, ficar maromba pro inverno.../

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_681_0.pt-BR: * Eu amo lesmas. Tem como hoje ficar ainda melhor?!/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_694_0_b.de: * Hab gehört hier mach ein Hund "Donuts", also bin ich hergerast./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_694_0_b.en: * I heard a dog was doing "donuts" so I sped over here./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_694_0_b.es: * Escuché que había un perro haciendo "dónuts", así que vine hacia aquí./

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_694_0_b.pt-BR: * Eu soube que um "doge" estava fazendo "donuts", então vim correndo pra cá./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_694_0_b.ru: * Я услышал, что пёс собрался крутить «пончики» и поспешил сюда./

就赶过来了。/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_695_0_b.en: * But I just learned "Donuts" is actually the name of a special attack for cars./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_695_0_b.es: * Pero me enteré de que "Dónut" es el nombre de un ataque especial de los coches./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_695_0_b.ja:

　 クルマの　ひっさつわざの
　 なまえだっていうじゃないか。/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_695_0_b.pt-BR: * Mas descobri que "donuts" é na verdade o nome de um ataque especial para carros./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_695_0_b.ru: * Но я только что узнал: «пончики» на самом деле название спецатаки для машин./

所谓的“甜甜圈”其实是一种赛车特技。/
