scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.pl: Mówi się, że jest czyimś najlepszym przyjacielem, ale nie musi to być prawda. Wstydź się, leniwy diamencie!
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.pt-BR: Dito ser o melhor amigo de alguém, mas talvez não. Ouro de tolo...
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ru: Говорит, что он чей-то лучший друг, но это вряд ли. Сверкай-сверкай, ленивый бубен!
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.zh:
据说是某人最好的朋友，
但也好像并非如此。
闪耀吧，你这懒惰的钻石！

scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.en: * Hey, boss! I'll have a Dark Candy Starfait!/
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.es: * ¡Oye, líder! ¡Voy a tomar un Starfait de Caramelo Oscuro!/
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ja:
＊ ボス！
　 わたし　ダークキャンディ・
　 サンデーサンデーにするね！/
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ko:
* 보스, 보스!
  나 다크 캔디 별 파르페
  먹을래!/
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.pl: * Hej, szefie! Poproszę Gwiazdoktail o smaku ciemnych cukierków!/
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.pt-BR: * Ei, chefe! Eu vou querer um Starfait de Doce Trevoso!/
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ru: * Здрасьте, босс! Я буду звёздное парфе из темноконфеты!/
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.zh:
* 嘿，老板！
我要点个黑暗糖果星冰乐！/

scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.de: Ein Herz mit einem gro€en Herzen. Unterstützt andere mit Kugeln.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.en: A heart with a big heart. Always supporting others with her bullets.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.es: Un corazón con un gran corazón. Siempre apoya a los demás con sus balas.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ja:
ビッグなハートのハートさん。
バトルではもっぱらサポート担当。
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ko:
커다란 하트를 가진 하트.
탄으로 다른 친구들을 지원한다.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.pl: Serduszko z wielkim sercem. Zawsze wspiera innych swoimi pociskami.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.pt-BR: Um coração com um grande coração. Sempre apoiando os outros com suas balas.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ru: Сердце с большим сердцем. Своими снарядами способна растопить даже самое червствое сердце.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.zh:
一个心很大的红心。
总是用她的子弹支持别人。

scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.en: * (Hathy is going to order a heart-foam latte.)/
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.es: * (Curazón va a pedir un café con leche con espuma en forma de corazón.)/
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ja:
＊ (ハーティは
　 ハートチーノ・ラテを
　 注文するようだ)/
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ko:
* (하티는 하트모양 거품을 올린
  라떼를 주문하려 한다.)/
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.pl: * (Sercka zaraz zamówi latte z piankowym serduszkiem.)/
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.pt-BR: * (Copação vai pedir um latte com espuma de coração.)/
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ru: * (Серция собирается заказать латте с пеной в форме сердца.)/
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.zh: * （Hathy打算点一份心形拉花的拿铁。）/

scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.de: Eine simple Lebensform, die einfach so in das Spielbrett hinein lebt.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.en: A simple organism that takes life one square at a time.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.es: Un organismo sencillo que anda por la vida de casilla en casilla.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ja: １マス１マス日々を生きる　単細胞生物。
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ko: 한 칸 한 칸씩 살아가는 단순한 생물.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.pl: Prosty organizm, który poznaje życie skok po skoku.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.pt-BR: Um organismo simples que leva a vida um quadrado de cada vez.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ru: Простой организм, что идёт по жизни клетка за клеткой.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.zh: 一步一格走过人生路的简单生物。

scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.en: * (Looks like it wants to osmose some flavorful cubes.)/
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.es: * (Parece que quiere osmosear algunas pastillas de caldo.)/
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ja:
＊ (フレーバー付きキューブを
　 吸収したいようだ)/
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.pt-BR: * (Parece que ele quer fazer osmose com uns cubos saborosos.)/
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ru: * (Похоже, оно хочет поглотить несколько ароматических кубиков.)/
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.zh: * （看来它想要吸收一些调味块。）/

scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.de: Ein echter Wollmaushase. Kennt dreckige Tricks, spielt dennoch sauber.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.en: A real dust bunny. Known to play dirty, but loves to play clean.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.es: Un conejo muy polvoriento. Conocido por jugar sucio, pero le encanta jugar limpio.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ja:
ホコリみたいにホワホワなウサギ。
“汚い手”を使うと評判だが
ホントは清く正しいことが好き。
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ko:
진짜 먼지 토끼.
더럽게 논다고들 하지만,
깨끗하게 노는 걸 좋아한다.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.pl: Zakurzony zawodnik wagi ciężkiej. Znany z brudnych zagrywek. Uwielbia czyste serca.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.pt-BR: Um verdadeiro coelhinho sujo. Conhecido por jogar sujo, mas ama jogar limpo.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ru: Очень пыльный кролик. Знает грязные приёмы, но предпочитает чистую игру.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.zh:
一只真正的尘兔。
出了名的会玩脏手段，
但更喜欢手脚干净。

scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.de: * (Scheint so als wollte er mit Waschbenzin abgetupft werden.)/
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.en: * (Looks like it wants to be dabbed with rubbing alcohol.)/
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.es: * (Parece que quiere que le froten con alcohol para heridas.)/
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ja:
＊ (消毒用のアルコールで
　 やさしくふいてほしいようだ)/
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ko:
* (소독용 알코올로
  살살 닦아주길 원하는 것 같다.)/
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.pt-BR: * (Parece que ele quer ser esfregado com álcool isopropílico.)/
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.zh: * （看来它想涂上一些消毒酒精。）/

scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.de: Ein umbaubarer Kämpfer. Ironischerweise schlecht im Blocken.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.en: A shape changing fighter. Ironically, blocking is not its forte.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.es: Un guerrero cambiaforma. Irónicamente, bloquear no es su fuerte.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ja:
姿形が変わるファイター。
名前のわりに　こうげきを
ブロックするのはニガテ。
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ko:
모습을 바꾸는 파이터. 
이름과는 달리,
블록킹은 잘 못 한다.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.pl: Zmiennokształtny wojownik. O ironio, blokowanie to nie jego klocki.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.pt-BR: Um lutador que muda de forma. Ironicamente, bloquear não é seu forte.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ru: Меняющий форму боец. Иронично, но блокирование не его сильная сторона.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.zh:
一个能变形的战士。
讽刺的是，它防守起来并不是铁板一块。

scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ja: トレーニングシューズ

scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.de: * Alles schmeckt besser wenn mein Körper richtig rum ist!/
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.en: * Everything tastes better with a normally-shaped body!/
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.es: * ¡Todo sabe mejor con un cuerpo con forma normal!/
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ja:
＊ 体が　ちゃんとした形に整ってると
　 なにを　飲み食いしても
　 ウマいな！/
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ko:
* 정상적인 몸으로는
  뭘 먹어도 더 맛있어!/
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.pl: * Wszystko smakuje lepiej, gdy masz uporządkowane ciało!/
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.pt-BR: * Tudo tem um gosto melhor com um corpo em formato normal!/
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ru: * Всё вкуснее, если тело правильной формы!/

scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.de: Es weint vor Freude, dass du sein Boss bist.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.en: It cries tears of joy that you are its boss.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.es: Llora lágrimas de alegría porque eres su líder.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ja:
泣いている。
ボスになってもらって　よっぽどうれしい
ようだ。
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ko:
당신이 보스라는 사실에
기쁨의 눈물을 터뜨렸다.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.pl: Zawsze uroni łezkę radości na myśl, że jest twoim podwładnym.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.pt-BR: Ele chora lágrimas de felicidade por ter mudado de chefe.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ru: Плачет от счастья из-за того, что теперь вы его босс.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.zh:
因为你是它的老板，
它高兴得快要哭出来了。

scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.de: Ein Agent of CHAOS, in deiner Tasche als TEUFELSMESSER.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.en: An agent of CHAOS, he became DEVILSKNIFE to the pocket.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.es: An agent of CHAOS, he became DEVILSKNIFE to the pocket.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ja:
カオスをなすもの。
ポケットのデビルズナイフ。
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ko:
혼돈의 대리인, 주머니 속
데빌스나이프가 되었다.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.pl: Inkarnacja CHAOSU, stał się DIABŁOKOSĄ w kieszeni.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.pt-BR: Um agente do CAOS, ele virou a FACA JIAVÓLICA no bolso.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ru: Агент ХАОСА, он стал ДЬЯВОЛЬСКИМ НОЖОМ в кармане.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.zh:
【混沌】的化身，
他变成了你口袋里的恶魔飞刀。

scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ja: カオスだよ:カオスだね

scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.de: Besessen von Superheldenfilmen. Es prahlt damit, besser als Karodin zu sein.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.en: Obsessed with ranger shows, it lets everyone know it's better than Rudinn.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.es: Obsesionado con programas de superhéroes, hace saber a todo el mundo que es mejor que Ofidiamante.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ja:
戦隊モノ番組マニア。モンディより
優秀だというアピールに余念がない。
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ko:
전대물에 집착한다, 항상
자신이 루딘보다 낫다고 주장한다.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.pl: Ma obsesje na punkcie serialów o strażnikach. Na każdym kroku pokazuje swą wyższość nad Rudinem.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.pt-BR: Obcecado com séries florestais, ele diz a todos ser melhor que o Rudourado.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ru: Одержим шоу про рейнджеров, постоянно доказывает всем, что он лучше бубинна.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.zh:
痴迷于战队节目，
逢人就说它比Rudinn要强得多。

scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ja: 録画した番組を消されること

scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.de: * Boss...? Du gibst aus...? Ach, wär doch nicht nötig!/
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.en: * Boss...? You're treating me...? Oh, you shouldn't have! (smile)/
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ja:
＊ えっ…　隊長… おごってくれるで
　 ありますか…？
　 いやぁ悪いであります…(ニヤニヤ)/
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ko:
* 보스...? 한 턱 내시는 겁니까...?
  아핫, 굳이 그렇게까지야! (웃음)/
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.pl: * Szefie...? Ty mnie obsługujesz...? Oj, nie trzeba było! (uśmiech)/
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.pt-BR: * Chefia...? Você está cuidando de mim...? Ah, não precisava! (sorriso)/
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ru: * Босс?.. Сегодня ты угощаешь?.. Ох, не стоило! (улыбнулся)/
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.zh:
* 老板...？你要请客...？
噢，不用这么客气的！（笑）/

scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.de: Es ist zwar stärker als Herta, hat aber weniger Freunde.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.en: Although stronger than Hathy, seems to have fewer friends.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.es: Aunque más fuerte que Curazón, parece tener menos amigos.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ja:
ハーティよりも強いけど
ハーティよりも　友だちいなそう。
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ko:
하티보다 강하지만,
친구는 적은 것 같다.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.pl: Mimo że jest silniejsza niż Sercka, nie ma tylu przyjaciół co ona.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.pt-BR: Embora mais forte que Copação, parece ter menos amigos.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ru: Сильнее серции, но имеет меньше друзей.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.zh:
尽管比Hathy强大，
朋友却比Hathy少。

scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.en: * (Head Hathy drinks an ice tea in silence...)/
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.es: * (Oficial Curazón bebe un té helado en silencio...)/
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ja:
＊ (ヘッドハーティは　だまって
　 アイスティーを飲んでいる…)/
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ko:
* (헤드 하티는 조용히
  아이스 티를 마시고 있다...)/
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.pl: * (Naczelna Sercka pije mrożoną herbatę w ciszy...)/
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.pt-BR: * (Copação Chefe bebe um chá gelado em silêncio...)/

scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.de: Ein aggressives Antivirus. Macht keinen Quatsch mit.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.en: An aggressive antivirus. It's not down with the sickness.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.es: Un antivirus agresivo. Su batalla no ha terminado.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ja:
攻撃的な抗ウィルス体。
病気には絶対負けない。
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ko:
호전적인 항바이러스체.
질병에는 절대 쓰러지지 않는다.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.pl: Agresywny program antywirusowy. Nie pokona go byle choróbsko.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.pt-BR: Um antivírus agressivo. Ele não está doente.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.zh:
一款攻击性很强的杀毒软件。
不会被病魔打倒。

scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ja: ふざけたサウンドエフェクト

scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.de: * Tatüüü! Geht nichts über Espresso... Willst du auch ne "Dosis"!?/
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.en: * Pipooo! Nothing beats a nice shot of espresso... Want me to give you a "shot", too!?/
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.es: * ¡Pii! Nada como un buen trago de expreso ... ¿¡Tú también quieres que te pegue un trago!?/
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ja:
＊ ピーポー！
　 毎食後　忘れず飲まなきゃね…
　 １杯のエスプレッソ！/
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ko:
* 삐뽀! 에스프레소의 찌르는 듯한
  쓴맛은 정말 최고야...
  너도 한 번 찔려볼래!?/
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.pl: * Pipooo! Nie ma nic lepszego, niż espresso. Daje takiego kopa! Też chcesz „kopa”?!/
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.pt-BR: * Pipooo! Nada melhor que uma boa dose de expresso... Quer que eu te dê uma "dose" também?!/
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ru: * Виу-у! Хорошая порция эспрессо — то, что доктор прописал... Хочешь, я тебе тоже «пропишу»?!/
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.zh:
* 哔啵！
什么都比不上一壶浓咖啡... 
你也想“喝一壶”！？/

scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.de: Sagt oft ASOBOH, was "Lass uns spielen!" bedeutet... wei€ es das?
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.en: Known to say ASOBOH, which means "Let's Play!" ... does it know that?
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.es: Conocido por decir ASOBOH, que significa "¡Vamos a jugar!" ... ¿Lo sabe siquiera?
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ja:
「…アｿボウE」が口グセ。
たぶん「遊ぼうよ」と言っている。
意味がわかっているのかは不明。
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ko:
"아소보"라고 자주 말한다.
"놀자!"라는 뜻이라는데...
알고는 있는 건가?
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.pl: Lubi mówić ASOBOH, co w wolnym tłumaczeniu znaczy „Zabawmy się!” ...ale czy on o tym wie?
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.pt-BR: Conhecido por dizer ASOBOH, que significa "Vamos Brincar!"... será que sabe disso?
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ru: Постоянно говорит «АСОБО», что значит «давай поиграем!»... но знает ли он об этом сам?
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.zh:
因很爱说“來佺玩銈吧�”而闻名。
意思是“来玩吧”
...它自己知道吗？

scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.en:
* NOMU NOMU.
* BERRY GOOD!/
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ja:
＊ モグモグ…
＊ おやつ　ウマ！/

scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.en: * (It's drinking K_K's electric milk JPEG.)/
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.es: * (Está bebiendo el electrizante JPEG de leche de K_K.)/
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ja:
＊ (K_Kの　デジタルミルク.JPGを
　 飲んでいる)/
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.pt-BR: * (Está bebendo o JPEG de leite elétrico do KRJ.)/

scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.de: Es wurde von Queen kontrolliert. Doch jetzt ist es cooler, also?
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.en: It was controlled by Queen. But, it's stronger and cooler now, so?
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.es: Era controlado por Queen, pero ahora es más guay y fuerte, así que, ¿qué más da?
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ja:
クイーンに操られていたけれど
いまは強く　クールに成長。
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ko:
한 때 퀸에게 조종당했지만,
지금은 더 강하고 멋있어졌다나?
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.pl: Był kontrolowany przez Królową, ale teraz jest silniejszy i fajniejszy, więc w czym problem?
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.pt-BR: Foi controlado pela Rainha. Mas é mais forte e mais legal, então...?
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ru: Его контролировала Королева. Но теперь он сильнее и круче, так?
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.zh:
它被女王脑控着。
但是，它现在更强大也更酷炫了。
所以有什么不好呢？

scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.en: * (It has some kind of energy drink.)/
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.es: * (Está tomando algún tipo de bebida energética.)/
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ja:
＊ (エナジードリンク的なものを
　 飲んでいる)/

scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.de: Es träumt davon, Katz-und-Maus-Spiele zu spielen.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.en: It dreams of re-enacting scenes from cat and mouse cartoons.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.es: Sueña con interpretar las escenas de los dibujos animados sobre ratones y gatos.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ja:
某ネコとネズミのアニメを再現することを
夢見ている。
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ko:
고양이와 쥐가 나오는
애니메이션을 재현하는 게
꿈이다.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.pl: Marzy o zagraniu głównej roli w tamtej kreskówce z kotem i myszą.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.pt-BR: Sonha em encenar cenas de desenhos de gato e rato.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ru: Мечтает воспроизвести сцены из мультфильмов о кошках-мышках.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.zh:
它的梦中不断上演着
猫和老鼠卡通片里的情节。

scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ja: ポップアップをクリックすること
＊ (溶けたチーズを　飲んでいる)/

scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.de: Ein Virus mit kriminellem Hintergrund... und einem Herzen aus Gold.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.en: A virus with a slightly criminal streak... and a heart of gold.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.es: Un virus con un pequeño historial criminal... y un gran corazón.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ja:
ついつい犯罪に走りがち…
だけど根はいいヤツ。
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ko:
범죄에 빠지기 십상인 바이러스...
마음만은 착하다.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.pl: Wirus z wpisem w karkotece... i sercem ze złota.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.pt-BR: Um vírus com uma leve onda criminosa... e um coração de ouro.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ru: Вирус со слегка криминальной жилкой... и золотым сердцем.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.zh:
一款稍微有些犯罪倾向，
心地却很善良的病毒。

scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.de: * Willste meine Limo teilen? Dann werden wir beide krank... Hehe./
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.en: * Wanna share my soda? We'll both get sick that way... Hee hee./
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.es: * ¿Quieres probar mi soda? Así nos enfermaremos los dos... Jee, jee./
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ja:
＊ ボクのドリンク　ひと口飲む？
　 キミも　病気になっちゃうけどね。
　 ヒヒヒ。/
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ko:
* 내 음료수 같이 마실래?
  우리 같은 병에 걸리자...
  히 히./
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.pl: * Chcesz łyka? Wtedy oboje będziemy chorzy... Hee hee./
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.pt-BR: * Quer compartilhar meu refri? Assim nós dois vamos ficar doentes... Hee hee./
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ru: * Хочешь помочь мне с газировкой? Ну, так мы вместе заболеем... Хе-хе./
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.zh:
* 想不想尝尝我的汽水？
这样我们就可以一起闹肚子了... 嘻嘻。/

scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.de: Bunt und glücklich, er arbeitet immer flei€ig.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.en: Colorful and dandy, you can always count on him to work hard.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.es: Colorido y todo un caballero, siempre puedes confiar en que trabajará duro.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ja:
カラフルでダンディ。
どんなときでも仕事はキッチリ。
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ko:
컬러풀하고 댄디하다. 어떤 힘든 일이라도
언제나 믿고 맡길 수 있다.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.pl: Kolorowy i dostojny. Zawsze dobrze wykonuje zlecone zadania.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.pt-BR: Colorido e elegante, você sempre pode contar com ele pra trabalhar duro.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ru: Колоритный щегол, в сложных ситуациях на него всегда можно положиться.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.zh:
多彩而华丽。
你永远可以指望他努力工作。

scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.de: * Boss? Wollen wir zusammen einen Earl Grey trinken?/
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.en: * Boss? Shall we sit down and enjoy a nice earl grey?/
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.es: * ¿Líder? ¿Nos sentamos y disfrutamos de un buen té verde?/
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ja:
＊ ご主人さま。こちらのお席で
　 ごいっしょに　おいしい
　 アールグレイでも　いかがでしょう？/
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ko:
* 주인님? 이 쪽 자리에서 함께
  얼 그레이 한 잔 어떻습니까?/
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.pl: * Szefie? Czy masz ochotę usiąść ze mną i wypić filiżankę herbaty?/
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.pt-BR: * Chefia? Gostaria de sentar e beber um bom Earl Grey?/
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ru: * Босс? Как насчёт перерыва на прекрасный эрл грей?/
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.zh:
* 老板？要不要坐下一起喝一杯
伯爵红茶？/

scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.de: Es hat sich das Kabel mit Kampfgeist einverleibt. Wird schnell rot.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.en: It absorbed the wire with fighting spirit. Gets flustered easily.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.es: Ha absorbido el cable con su fuerza de voluntad. Se pone nervioso con facilidad.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ja:
闘志を燃やして　制御ケーブルを体内に
取り込んでしまった個体。
ちょっとのことですぐキョドる。
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ko:
투지를 불태워 전선을 흡수해버렸다.
쉽게 당황한다.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.pl: Jego wola walki umożliwiła mu wchłoniecie kabla. Łatwo go wytrącić z równowagi.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.pt-BR: Absorveu o fio com espírito de luta. Fica afobado facilmente.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ru: Поглотил провод под воздействием духа битвы. Чересчур возбудим.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.zh:
它凭借自己的斗志
把电线吸收掉了。
很容易慌神。

scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ja: スーパーチャージ戦法

scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.es: * (... está sujetando con fuerza su bebida energética...)/
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ja:
＊ (…エナジードリンクの缶を
　 手で　にぎりつぶしている…)/
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ko:

scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.pt-BR: * (... está esmagando seu energético com sua mão...)/

scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.de: Gleicht gerne Outfits aneinander an. Kann Clowns nicht ausstehen.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.en: Loves to coordinate outfits. Strongly dislikes clowns.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.es: Le gusta coordinar conjuntos. Odia los payasos.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ja:
服のコーディネートが大好き。
ピエロは大きらい。
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ko:
의상 코디를 매우 좋아하지만,
광대는 정말 싫어한다.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.pt-BR: Ama combinar roupas. Realmente não gosta de palhaços.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ru: Любит согласовывать наряды. Сильно не любит клоунов.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.zh:
喜欢搭配服装。
极度厌恶小丑。

scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.es: Calcetines que no van a juego
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ja: そろっていないソックス

scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.de: Du hast 3 gro€e Mäuse rekrutiert und musst nun damit leben.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.en: You recruited 3 big mice and you're stuck with it.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.es: Reclutaste 3 ratones grandes y ahora te aguantas.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ja:
大きなネズミ３匹。
なかまにしてしまった以上　もう逃れる
すべはない。
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ko:
큰 쥐 세 마리를 영입한 이상
어쩔 수 없다.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.pl: Masz 3 myszy i teraz się z nimi męcz.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.pt-BR: Você recrutou 3 grandes ratos e está preso com eles.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ru: Вы пригласили три больших мыши и не знаете, что с ними делать.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.zh:
你招揽了三只大老鼠。
现在你甩不掉了。

scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.de: * (Es zieht Strom aus dem geschmolzenen Käse, wie ein Wasserrad.)/

scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.es: * (Está consiguiendo electricidad con el queso fundido imitando una rueda hidráulica.)/
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ja:

scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ko:
* (녹인 치즈로 물레방아를 돌리며

scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.pl: * (Uzyskuje energię ze stopionego sera niczym reaktor jądrowy.)/
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.pt-BR: * (Está ganhando eletricidade do queijo derretido como uma roda de água)/
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ru: * (Оно получает электричество из плавленого сыра, как водяное колесо)/
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.zh:
* （它正在像水车一样，

Viele verschiede Fähigkeiten.
Hat nichts mit Magie zu tun.

scr_spellinfo_slash_scr_spellinfo_gml_24.de:
Verteilt mä€igen Rüpel-Elementarschaden auf
einen Gegner. Abhängig von Angriff und Magie.
scr_spellinfo_slash_scr_spellinfo_gml_24.en:
Deals moderate Rude-elemental damage to
one foe. Depends on Attack 
 Magic.
scr_spellinfo_slash_scr_spellinfo_gml_24.es:
Hace daño moderado de elemento brutal
a un enemigo. Depende del Ataque y Magia.
scr_spellinfo_slash_scr_spellinfo_gml_24.ja:
敵1体に　中程度の暴属性ダメージ
こうげきまりょく値によってダメージ量変化
scr_spellinfo_slash_scr_spellinfo_gml_24.ko:
적 하나에 깡 속성 중간 피해
공격력과 마법에 따라 피해량 변화.
scr_spellinfo_slash_scr_spellinfo_gml_24.pl:
Zadaje umiarkowane czelne obrażenia
jednemu wrogowi. Zależy od ataku i magii.
scr_spellinfo_slash_scr_spellinfo_gml_24.pt-BR:
Causa um dano de elemento-brutal moderado a
um inimigo. Depende de Ataque e Magia.
scr_spellinfo_slash_scr_spellinfo_gml_24.ru:
Наносит значительный грубый урон
одному врагу. Зависит от Магии и Атаки.
scr_spellinfo_slash_scr_spellinfo_gml_24.zh:
对单个敌人造成中等粗暴属性伤害。

scr_spellinfo_slash_scr_spellinfo_gml_34.de:
Himmlisches Licht heilt ein Teammitglied um
einige HP. Abhängig von Magie.
scr_spellinfo_slash_scr_spellinfo_gml_34.en:
Heavenly light restores a little HP to
one party member. Depends on Magic.
scr_spellinfo_slash_scr_spellinfo_gml_34.es:
Luz celestial que restaura algunos PV a
un miembro del equipo. Depende de la Magia.
scr_spellinfo_slash_scr_spellinfo_gml_34.ja:
天から降り注ぐ光が仲間1人のHPを少量回復。
まりょくによって回復量変化。
scr_spellinfo_slash_scr_spellinfo_gml_34.ko:
천국의 빛으로 한 명의 HP 약간 회복
마법에 따라 효과 변화.
scr_spellinfo_slash_scr_spellinfo_gml_34.pl:
Anielskie światło, które odnawia trochę PZ
jednemu kompanowi. Zależy od magii.
scr_spellinfo_slash_scr_spellinfo_gml_34.pt-BR:
Luz celestial restaura um pouco de PV de
um membro do time. Depende de Magia.
scr_spellinfo_slash_scr_spellinfo_gml_34.ru:
Небесный свет восполняет немного ОЗ
одному члену команды. Зависит от Магии.
scr_spellinfo_slash_scr_spellinfo_gml_34.zh:
神圣的光芒使一名队友回复少量HP。
效果取决于魔力。

くたびれた
敵を逃がす

VERSCHONT einen müden Gegner, indem er
ihn einschläfert.

scr_spellinfo_slash_scr_spellinfo_gml_45.es:
Retira del combate a un enemigo
fatigado al dormirle.
scr_spellinfo_slash_scr_spellinfo_gml_45.ja: 「くたびれ」状態の敵を眠らせて逃がす。
scr_spellinfo_slash_scr_spellinfo_gml_45.ko: 지친 적을 잠에 빠져들게 하여 보내준다.
scr_spellinfo_slash_scr_spellinfo_gml_45.pl: OSZCZĘDŹ sennego wroga, kładąc go do snu.
scr_spellinfo_slash_scr_spellinfo_gml_45.pt-BR: POUPE um INIMIGO cansado fazendo-o dormir.
scr_spellinfo_slash_scr_spellinfo_gml_45.zh: 使疲惫的敌人睡着以便【饶恕】它们。

scr_spellinfo_slash_scr_spellinfo_gml_89.de:
Macht alles mögliche.
Ist kein Zauber.
scr_spellinfo_slash_scr_spellinfo_gml_89.en:
Do all sorts of things.
It isn't magic.
scr_spellinfo_slash_scr_spellinfo_gml_89.es:
Hace todo tipo de cosas.
No es magia.
scr_spellinfo_slash_scr_spellinfo_gml_89.ja:
いろんなことをする。
まほうではない。
scr_spellinfo_slash_scr_spellinfo_gml_89.pl:
Robi mnóstwo rzeczy.
To nie jest magia.
scr_spellinfo_slash_scr_spellinfo_gml_89.pt-BR:
Faz todo tipo de coisa.
Não é magia.
scr_spellinfo_slash_scr_spellinfo_gml_89.ru:
Делает всё, что угодно.
Это не магия.
scr_spellinfo_slash_scr_spellinfo_gml_89.zh:
可以做各种各样的事。
这不是魔法。

scr_spellinfo_slash_scr_spellinfo_gml_93.en:
You can do many things.
Don't confuse it with magic.
scr_spellinfo_slash_scr_spellinfo_gml_93.es:
Puedes hacer muchas cosas.
No confundirlo con magia.
scr_spellinfo_slash_scr_spellinfo_gml_93.ja:

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_329_0.en: 6* But, Kris, I believe YOUR choices are important, too./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_329_0.es: 6* But, Kris, I believe YOUR choices are important, too./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_329_0.ja:
6＊ だけど…ボクは　キミが
　 自分の意志で決めることも
　 とても大事だと思うんだ。/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_329_0.ko:
6* 하지만, 크리스,
  난 네 선택도 중요하다고
  생각해./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_329_0.pl: 6* Ale Kris, wierzę, że TWOJE wybory też mają znaczenie./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_329_0.pt-BR: 6* But, Kris, I believe YOUR choices are important, too./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_329_0.ru: 6* Но, Крис, я верю, что ТВОЙ выбор тоже важен./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_329_0.zh:
6* 但是，Kris，我相信
【你】的选择也很重要。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_330_0.de: 0* This world is full of all kinds of people, Kris./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_330_0.en: 0* This world is full of all kinds of people, Kris./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_330_0.es: 0* This world is full of all kinds of people, Kris./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_330_0.ja:
0＊ この世界には　本当に
　 いろんなひとたちがいる。/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_330_0.ko:
0* 이 세상엔 다양한
  사람들이 있지만, 크리스./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_330_0.pl: 0* W tym świecie pełno jest różnych osób, Kris./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_330_0.pt-BR: 0* This world is full of all kinds of people, Kris./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_330_0.ru: 0* Этот мир полон самых разных существ, Крис./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_330_0.zh:
0* 这个世界上充满了
形形色色的人，Kris。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_331_0.de: 6* In the end, how we treat them makes all the difference./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_331_0.en: 6* In the end, how we treat them makes all the difference./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_331_0.es: 6* In the end, how we treat them makes all the difference./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_331_0.ja:
6＊ 大切なのは　そのひとたちと
　 どう接するか　だと思う。/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_331_0.ko:
6* 결국엔 우리가 그들을
  대하는 방식이 변화를
  만들어내지./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_331_0.pl: 6* To jak ich potraktujemy, zmieni bieg dziejów./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_331_0.pt-BR: 6* In the end, how we treat them makes all the difference./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_331_0.ru: 6* В конце концов, от того, как мы к ним отнесёмся, будет зависеть исход./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_331_0.zh:
6* 在最后，一切都会因我们
如何对待他们而不同。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_332_0.de: 8* So let's try our best to get by without FIGHTing./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_332_0.en: 8* So let's try our best to get by without FIGHTing./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_332_0.es: 8* So let's try our best to get by without FIGHTing./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_332_0.ja:

　 誰とも　たたかわなくて
　 すむようにしよう。/

8* 그러니 최선을 다해
  싸우지 않고 가도록 하자./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_332_0.pt-BR: 8* So let's try our best to get by without FIGHTing./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_332_0.ru: 8* Так что давай сделаем всё возможное, чтобы обойтись без СРАЖЕНИЙ./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_332_0.zh:
8* 所以尽我们最大的努力
避免【战斗】地走下去吧。/

0＊ この物語は
　 ハッピーエンドを
　 むかえられると思うんだ。/

0* 이 여정의 끝에는
  행복한 결말이 기다리고
  있을 거야./

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_334_0.pt-BR: 0* I believe this tale may have a happy ending./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_334_0.ru: 0* Я верю, что в этой истории наступит хороший конец./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_334_0.zh:
0* 我相信这个传说
会有一个圆满的结局。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_337_0.zh:

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_343_0.de: 0* Kris, I knew you were a hero the moment I saw you./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_343_0.en: 0* Kris, I knew you were a hero the moment I saw you./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_343_0.es: 0* Kris, I knew you were a hero the moment I saw you./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_343_0.ja:
0＊ やっぱり　キミは勇者だ！
　 一目見た瞬間
　 そう思ったよ。/

0* 크리스, 널 처음 본 순간
  네가 영웅이란 걸 직감했어./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_343_0.pl: 0* Kris, takie słowa mógłby powiedzieć tylko prawdziwy bohater./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_343_0.pt-BR: 0* Kris, I knew you were a hero the moment I saw you./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_343_0.ru: 0* Крис, я понял, что ты герой, как только увидел тебя./

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_349_0.de: 6* Kris, in the end, what you choose is up to you./

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_350_0.de: 8* As long as you're happy with it, I'm happy too./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_350_0.en: 8* As long as you're happy with it, I'm happy too./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_350_0.es: 8* As long as you're happy with it, I'm happy too./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_350_0.ja:
8＊ キミが満足なら
　 ボクも　それで満足だよ。/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_350_0.pl: 8* Jeśli rezultat będzie cię satysfakcjonował, to i ja będę zadowolony./

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_350_0.ru: 8* Пока тебя это счастливит, я тоже буду счастлив./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_350_0.zh:
8* 只要你开心就好，
你开心我就开心。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_573_0.ru: * Во-вторых, что о нас подумают наши враги?/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_574_0.de: 2* That we're gonna be BUDDIES with 'em?/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_574_0.zh:

成为小伙伴啊？/

更唬人！/

* Well, uh...

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1225_0.de:
* TP only lasts, inside a fight.
* Once you win, it's out of sight./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1225_0.en:
* TP only lasts, inside a fight.
* Once you win, it's out of sight./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1225_0.es:
* TP only lasts, inside a fight.
* Once you win, it's out of sight./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1225_0.ja:

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1226_0.de:
* Having extra, feels unbearable.
* No point in saving, it's straight-up terrible./

* Having extra, feels unbearable.
* No point in saving, it's straight-up terrible./

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1361_0.zh: * 看来SUSIE总算有了，一丝丝改变。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1362_0.en: * That kind of growth is actually rare./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1362_0.es: * That kind of growth is actually rare./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1362_0.ja: ＊ そんな成長　かなりレアァ！/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1362_0.ko: * 이런 거 살짝 드문 것 같아./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1362_0.pl: * Taka zmiana charakteru jest dziś bardzo rzadka./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1362_0.pt-BR: * That kind of growth is actually rare./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1362_0.ru: * Как мало всех тех, кто растёт над собой./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1362_0.zh: * 这样的成长还是挺罕见。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1378_0.de:
* I'm Kris Master.
* Ask me about KRIS's./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1378_0.en:
* I'm Kris Master.
* Ask me about KRIS's./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1378_0.es:
* I'm Kris Master.
* Ask me about KRIS's./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1378_0.ja:
＊ ボクは　クリス・マスター。
＊ クリスのことなら　なんでも聞いて。/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1378_0.ko:
* 나는 크리스 마스터.
* 크리스에 관한 거라면
  뭐든 물어봐./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1378_0.pl:
* Nauczam o Kris.
* Pytaj mnie o KRIS./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1378_0.pt-BR:
* I'm Kris Master.
* Ask me about KRIS's./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1378_0.zh:
* 我是Kris大师。
* 问我关于KRIS的事。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1386_0.de: * When HP goes negative, your friends fall down/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1386_0.en: * When HP goes negative, your friends fall down/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1386_0.es: * When HP goes negative, your friends fall down/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1386_0.ja:
＊ HPゼロより下がると
　 仲間は気絶ゥ。/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1386_0.pl: * Kiedy PZ zabraknie, padną na glebę twoi przyjaciele./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1386_0.pt-BR: * When HP goes negative, your friends fall down/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1386_0.ru: * Как ОЗ упадут, так ваш друг вслед за ним./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1386_0.zh: * HP变成负数时，你的朋友会倒下。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1387_0.de: * But bringing them back, is easy-town/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1387_0.en: * But bringing them back, is easy-town/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1387_0.es: * But bringing them back, is easy-town/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1387_0.ja: ＊ でもだいじょうぶゥ。すぐに復活ゥ。/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1387_0.pl: * Ale wyleczenie ich, nie kosztuje wiele./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1387_0.pt-BR: * But bringing them back, is easy-town/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1387_0.ru: * Но верни его в строй, знай секрет лишь один./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1387_0.zh: * 要让他们站起来，方法简单又廉价。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1388_0.de: * Plain foods and spells, work like a charm -/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1388_0.en: * Plain foods and spells, work like a charm -/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1388_0.es: * Plain foods and spells, work like a charm -/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1388_0.ja:
＊ 普通の食べ物…　回復まほうゥ…
　 どちらも　バッチリ効果アリィ！/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1388_0.ko:
* 그냥 음식과 마법만 있으면
  요술같이 해결돼./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1388_0.pl: * Zwykłe jedzenie i czary, działają jak marzenie.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1388_0.pt-BR: * Plain foods and spells, work like a charm -/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1388_0.zh: * 简单的食物和法术，效果响当当-/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1389_0.de: * And with a MINT, you can cure all HARM./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1389_0.en: * And with a MINT, you can cure all HARM./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1389_0.es: * And with a MINT, you can cure all HARM./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1389_0.ja:
＊ 「ミント」を使えば　一気に復活ゥ！
　 HPだってMAXにィ！/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1389_0.ko:
* 근데 부활 민트가 있으면
  완전하게 해결돼./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1389_0.pl: * A dzięki MIĘTCE, członek drużyny przejdzie pełne leczenie./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1389_0.pt-BR: * And with a MINT, you can cure all HARM./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1389_0.ru: * А ЛЕДЕНЦОМ ты можешь с нуля воскресить./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1389_0.zh: * 要是用上了薄荷糖，治疗所有伤。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1391_0.de: * Even normal items and spells can revive people, huh?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1391_0.en: * Even normal items and spells can revive people, huh?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1391_0.es: * Even normal items and spells can revive people, huh?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1391_0.ja:
＊ つまり　普通の回復アイテムや
　 まほうでも　気絶した仲間を
　 復活させられるってこと？/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1391_0.ko:
* 그러니까 평범한 음식이랑
  마법으로도 동료들을
  살릴 수 있단 말이죠?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1391_0.pl: * Wiesz, że nawet normalne jedzenie i czary są w stanie odrodzić?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1391_0.pt-BR: * Even normal items and spells can revive people, huh?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1391_0.ru: * То есть можно исцелять даже обычными вещами, да?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1391_0.zh:
* 就连一般的物品和法术
也能使人复活，对吧？/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1393_0.en: * Yeah, that's what I'm saying!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1393_0.pl: * Tak, dokładnie to miałem na myśli!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1393_0.ru: * Да, о чём я и говорю!/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1398_0.de: * If you only ACT, you might start to think -/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1398_0.en: * If you only ACT, you might start to think -/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1398_0.es: * If you only ACT, you might start to think -/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1398_0.ja:
＊ キミはきっと　こう思うゥ。
　 「自分ばっかり『こうどう』」ゥ…/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1398_0.ko:
* 행동만 할 때는
  고민할 수 있지./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1398_0.pl: * Jeśli tylko ty możesz CZYNIĆ, to pewnie ci wpadło do głowy.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1398_0.pt-BR: * If you only ACT, you might start to think -/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1398_0.ru: * Коль ДЕЙСТВУЕШЬ, то держи при уме.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1398_0.zh: * 当你采取【行动】时，可以想想看-/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1399_0.de: * What about the guy with the scarf in pink?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1399_0.en: * What about the guy with the scarf in pink?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1399_0.es: * What about the guy with the scarf in pink?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1399_0.ja:
＊ 「ピンクのマフラーのヤツは
　 なにする」ゥ？/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1399_0.ko:
* 스카프 두른 애는
  뭘 시켜야 하지?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1399_0.pl: * Po co w drużynie ten w szaliku gość młody?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1399_0.pt-BR: * What about the guy with the scarf in pink?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1399_0.ru: * Что ты не один ведёшь бой в этой тьме./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1399_0.zh: * 让那个戴粉色围巾的怎么干？/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1401_0.de: * If you know ACTing will make the enemy friendly -/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1401_0.en: * If you know ACTing will make the enemy friendly -/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1401_0.es: * If you know ACTing will make the enemy friendly -/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1401_0.ja:
＊ クリスの「こうどう」で
　 敵と仲よくなれると
　 わかっているときは…/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1401_0.ko:
* 네 행동으로 상대가
  얌전해질 것 같으면.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1401_0.pl: * Jeśli wiesz, że twój CZYN uszczęśliwi wroga,/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1401_0.pt-BR: * If you know ACTing will make the enemy friendly -/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1401_0.ru: * Если ты знаешь, что твоё ДЕЙСТВИЕ расположит врага к нам.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1401_0.zh:
* 如果你事先知道这次
【行动】会让敌人变得友好-/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1402_0.de: * Then you can ask me to SPARE on the SAME TURN./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1402_0.en: * Then you can ask me to SPARE on the SAME TURN./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1402_0.es: * Then you can ask me to SPARE on the SAME TURN./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1402_0.ja:
＊ ボクには　敵を「にがす」
　 ように指示してくれれば
　 ターンを節約できるよ。/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1402_0.ko:
* 같은 턴에 나한테
  보내주라고 지시하면 돼./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1402_0.pl: * To możesz mnie poprosić, bym go OSZCZĘDZIŁ w TEJ SAMEJ TURZE./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1402_0.pt-BR: * Then you can ask me to SPARE on the SAME TURN./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1402_0.ru: * То ты можешь попросить меня ПОЩАДИТЬ его в тот же ход./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1402_0.zh:
* 那么你就可以让我
在同一回合内使用【饶恕】。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1403_0.de: * Or, cast PACIFY if you know they'll get TIRED./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1403_0.en: * Or, cast PACIFY if you know they'll get TIRED./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1403_0.es: * Or, cast PACIFY if you know they'll get TIRED./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1403_0.ja:
＊ 敵が「くたびれ」ると
　 わかっているときは
　 「スリープ」を使えばいい。/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1403_0.ko:
* 적이 지칠 것 같으면
  진정 마법을 쓰면 돼./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1403_0.pl: * Albo mogę rzucić zaklęcie SENNIK, gdy wiesz, że będzie SENNY./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1403_0.pt-BR: * Or, cast PACIFICAR if you know they'll get TIRED./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1403_0.ru: * Или использовать УСМИРЕНИЕ, если знаешь, что он УСТАНЕТ./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1403_0.zh:
* 或者，在你知道他们将要【疲惫】
的时候施展【安抚】。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1404_0.de: * If you plan ahead, a lot can happen in ONE TURN!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1404_0.en: * If you plan ahead, a lot can happen in ONE TURN!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1404_0.es: * If you plan ahead, a lot can happen in ONE TURN!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1404_0.ja:
＊ うまく先を読んで動けば
　 1ターンのあいだに
　 いろんなことができるよ！/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1404_0.ko:
* 계획만 잘 세우면,
  한 턴에 많은 걸
  할 수 있어!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1404_0.pl: * Jeśli zaplanujesz swoje ruchy, to możesz wiele osiągnąć w JEDNEJ TURZE!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1404_0.pt-BR: * If you plan ahead, a lot can happen in ONE TURN!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1404_0.ru: * Если планировать всё наперёд, многое можно сделать ЗА ХОД!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1404_0.zh:
* 只要你提前规划好，
就可以在一回合里解决很多事！/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1406_0.de: 1* Hey, who's the MASTER here, me or you!?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1406_0.en: 1* Hey, who's the MASTER here, me or you!?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1406_0.es: 1* Hey, who's the MASTER here, me or you!?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1406_0.ja:
1＊ ちょっと！　マスターはボクだ！
　 キミじゃない！/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1406_0.pl: 1* Ej, kto tu jest NAUCZYCIELEM, ty, czy ja!?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1406_0.pt-BR: 1* Hey, who's the MASTER here, me or you!?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1406_0.ru: 1* Эй, кто здесь МАСТЕР, я или ты?!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1406_0.zh:
1* 嘿，这儿谁才是大师，
是你还是我！？/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1410_0.de: * It's a good idea, to give us BUCKs./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1410_0.en: * It's a good idea, to give us BUCKs./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1410_0.es: * It's a good idea, to give us BUCKs./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1410_0.ja: ＊ どんどんしよう　ボクらに寄付ゥ。/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1410_0.ko:
* 너희 돈을 내게 주면,
  좋은 일 벌어지지./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1410_0.pl: * Dobrym planem jest dać nam SZMAL./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1410_0.pt-BR: * It's a good idea, to give us BUCKs./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1410_0.zh: * 若给我们钱，是个好主意。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1411_0.de: * It'll make you happy, and fill you with LUCKs./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1411_0.en: * It'll make you happy, and fill you with LUCKs./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1411_0.es: * It'll make you happy, and fill you with LUCKs./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1411_0.ja: ＊ 幸運授かり　ハッピーになるゥ。/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1411_0.pl: * Dzięki temu nie będzie cię trapił ŻAL./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1411_0.pt-BR: * It'll make you happy, and fill you with LUCKs./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1411_0.zh: * 带给你开心，还有好运气。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1412_0.de: * Over there, is our DONATION HOLE./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1412_0.en: * Over there, is our DONATION HOLE./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1412_0.es: * Over there, is our DONATION HOLE./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1412_0.ja: ＊ あそこにあるよ　「募金ホール」ゥ。/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1412_0.pl: * Oto nasza dziura DOTACJI, jakbyście nie zgadli./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1412_0.pt-BR: * Over there, is our DONATION HOLE./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1412_0.ru: * ЯМУ для денег мы здесь откопали./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1412_0.zh: * 我们的募捐洞，就在那头。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1413_0.de: * We had a BOX, but it got STOLE./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1413_0.en: * We had a BOX, but it got STOLE./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1413_0.es: * We had a BOX, but it got STOLE./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1413_0.ja:
＊ 盗まれちゃったよ
　 「募金ボックス」ゥ。/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1413_0.pl: * Mieliśmy PUDEŁKO, ale nam je ukradli./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1413_0.pt-BR: * We had a BOX, but it got STOLE./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1413_0.zh: * 我们曾有个箱子，但它早已被偷。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1423_0.de: * (If you like our tutorials, please throw your money into a hole.)/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1423_0.en: * (If you like our tutorials, please throw your money into a hole.)/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1423_0.es: * (If you like our tutorials, please throw your money into a hole.)/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1423_0.ja:
＊ (私たちの　チュートリアルに
　 ご満足いただけたなら
　 穴に　おカネを入れてください)/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1423_0.ko:
* (우리 튜토리얼이 마음에 드시면,
  돈을 구멍에 넣어 주세요.)/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1423_0.pl: * (Proszę, jeśli lubisz nasze samouczki, wrzuć do dziury pieniążki.)/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1423_0.pt-BR: * (Se você gosta de nossos tutoriais, por favor, jogue seu dinheiro em um buraco.)/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1423_0.ru: * (Если вам понравились наши обучения, бросьте немного денег в нору.)/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1423_0.zh:
* （如果你喜欢我们的教程，
请把你的钱扔进洞里。）/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1427_0.de: * (The hole is filled to the brim with cash.)/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1427_0.en: * (The hole is filled to the brim with cash.)/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1427_0.es: * (The hole is filled to the brim with cash.)/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1427_0.ja:
＊ (穴には　現金が
　 ギッシリ詰まっている)/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1427_0.pt-BR: * (The hole is filled to the brim with cash.)/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1427_0.zh: * （这个洞被现金装的快满出来了。）/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1434_0.en: * (You put a dollar in the "Hole.")/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1442_0.de: * (You failed to budget enough money to throw into a hole...)/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1442_0.en: * (You failed to budget enough money to throw into a hole...)/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1442_0.es: * (You failed to budget enough money to throw into a hole...)/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1442_0.ja:
＊ (穴に　おカネを投げ入れる予算を
　 確保できなかった…)/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1442_0.ko:
* (당신은 구멍에 던져넣을 만큼
  돈을 저축하지 못했다...)/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1442_0.pl: * (Nie udało ci się zaoszczędzić jednego dolara?)/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1442_0.pt-BR: * (You failed to budget enough money to throw into a hole...)/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1442_0.ru: * (Ваш бюджет не позволяет бросить доллар в нору...)/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1442_0.zh: * （你没有足够的预算来扔进这个洞...）/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1790_0.de: * Well, well. I am the smith Malius. I can fix anything. Weapon, armor.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1790_0.en: * Well, well. I am the smith Malius. I can fix anything. Weapon, armor.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1790_0.es: * Well, well. I am the smith Malius. I can fix anything. Weapon, armor.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1790_0.ja:
＊ わが名はマリウス。鍛冶を極めし者。
　 私に直せぬものはない。
　 武器だろうと　防具だろうと…/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1790_0.ko:
* 그래... 나는 대장장이 말리우스.
  뭐든 고칠 수 있지. 무기, 방어구.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1790_0.pl: * Witam, witam. Zwą mnie Kowalskim. Mogę naprawić wszystko. Zbroję, broń.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1790_0.pt-BR: * Well, well. I am the smith Malius. I can fix anything. Weapon, armor.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1790_0.ru: * Что ж, что ж. Я кузнец Малиус. Я могу починить что угодно. Оружие, броню.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1790_0.zh:
* 哎呀，哎呀。我是铁匠Malius。
我什么都会修理。武器，防具.../

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1791_0.de: * ... I can even fix you! Well, well, what will it be?/

  뭘 고치겠소?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1791_0.pl: * ...nawet WAS! Dobrze, już dobrze, w czym mogę pomóc?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1791_0.pt-BR: * ... I can even fix you! Well, well, what will it be?/

  내가 얘들 없이 어떻게
  일을 할까?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2135_0.pl: 3* Ach, moi znajomi z pracy. Co ja bym bez nich zrobił?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2135_0.pt-BR: 3* Ah, my co-workers. Where would I be without them?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2135_0.ru: 3* Ах, мои коллеги. Как бы я жил без них?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2135_0.zh:
3* 啊，我的同事们。
没了他们我能去哪？/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2136_0.de: 1* A happy place, little buddy. A much happier place./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2136_0.en: 1* A happy place, little buddy. A much happier place./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2136_0.es: 1* A happy place, little buddy. A much happier place./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2136_0.ja:
1＊ ここより　ずっとマシな
　 ばしょで　ずっとマシな
　 じんせい　おくってるぜ。/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2136_0.ko:
1* ... 행복하게... 지금보다 
  훨씬 더 행복하게 일하겠지./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2136_0.pl: 1* Życie bym sobie ułożył, mordeczko. Życie bym sobie ułożył./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2136_0.pt-BR: 1* A happy place, little buddy. A much happier place./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2136_0.zh:
1* 一个好地方，小家伙。
一个好得多的地方。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2141_0.de: 3* It's fine, Little Buddy. You don't have to watch me suffer./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2141_0.en: 3* It's fine, Little Buddy. You don't have to watch me suffer./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2141_0.es: 3* It's fine, Little Buddy. You don't have to watch me suffer./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2141_0.ja:
3＊ かまわないぜ。オレの
　 なさけない　すがたなんて
　 みなくていい。/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2141_0.ko:
3* 괜찮아, 꼬마 친구.
  남의 고통을 굳이
  지켜보고 있을 필요는 없어./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2141_0.pl: 3* Dobrze, mordeczko. Nie musisz patrzeć jak cierpię./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2141_0.pt-BR: 3* It's fine, Little Buddy. You don't have to watch me suffer./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2141_0.ru: 3* Всё в порядке, дружище. Не стоит смотреть на мои страдания./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2141_0.zh:
3* 没事，小家伙。
你不用看着我遭受苦难。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2142_0.de: 1* Just enjoy your freedom... While it lasts.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2142_0.en: 1* Just enjoy your freedom... While it lasts.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2142_0.es: 1* Just enjoy your freedom... While it lasts.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2142_0.ja:
1＊ アンタは　じゆうを
　 たのしみな。それができる
　 いまのうちにな…/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2142_0.ko:
1* 자유를 즐겨...
  즐길 수 있을 때.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2142_0.pt-BR: 1* Just enjoy your freedom... While it lasts.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2142_0.ru: 1* Просто... Наслаждайся свободой... Пока ещё можешь.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2142_0.zh:
1* 好好享受自由吧...
趁你还没失去它.../

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2147_0.ja:
ジュース
ください

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2151_0.de:
* Kris... What a pleasant surprise to see you here.
* And on a school day./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2151_0.en:
* Kris... What a pleasant surprise to see you here.
* And on a school day./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2151_0.es:
* Kris... What a pleasant surprise to see you here.
* And on a school day./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2151_0.ja:
＊ おやおや　クリス…　めずらしい。
　 でも　うれしいですね。へいじつに
　 きょうかいへ　きてくれるとは。/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2151_0.ko:
* 크리스... 혼자서도
  교회에 오다니 기쁘구나.
* 그것도 평일에 말이야./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2151_0.pl:
* Kris... Twoja dzisiejsza wizyta jest miłą niespodzianką.
* I to w dzień powszedni./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2151_0.pt-BR:
* Kris... What a pleasant surprise to see you here.
* And on a school day./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2151_0.ru:
* Крис... Как приятно видеть тебя здесь.
* Особенно в учебный день./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2151_0.zh:
* Kris... 
能在这儿遇到你还真是个惊喜。
* 况且还是上学的日子。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2152_0.de: * There must be a reason that you came here at such a time./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2152_0.en: * There must be a reason that you came here at such a time./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2152_0.es: * There must be a reason that you came here at such a time./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2152_0.ja:
＊ わざわざ　たずねてきたのには
　 なにか　わけが　あるのでしょう。/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2152_0.ko:
* 이런 시간에 찾아온 데에는
  분명 뭔가 이유가 있겠지./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2152_0.pl: * Musisz mieć jakiś bardzo ważny powód./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2152_0.pt-BR: * There must be a reason that you came here at such a time./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2152_0.ru: * Интересно, что привело тебя ко мне в такое время./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2152_0.zh:
* 你现在这个时候过来
肯定有什么原因吧。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2153_0.de:
* I, Father Alvin, implore you.
* If you have anything weighing on your mind, please, speak./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2153_0.en:
* I, Father Alvin, implore you.
* If you have anything weighing on your mind, please, speak./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2153_0.es:
* I, Father Alvin, implore you.
* If you have anything weighing on your mind, please, speak./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2153_0.ja:
＊ さあ　このアルビン師に
　 はなしてごらんなさい。
＊ なやみごとが　あるのですか？/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2153_0.ko:
* 나, 앨빈 신부가 청하니, 
* 마음속에 짐이 있다면,
  털어놓아도 좋단다./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2153_0.pl:
* Ja, ojciec Alvin, nalegam.
* Przemów, jeśli coś ci leży na sercu./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2153_0.pt-BR:
* I, Father Alvin, implore you.
* If you have anything weighing on your mind, please, speak./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2153_0.ru:
* Я, отец Элвин, прошу тебя.
* Если тебя что-то тяготит, поделись этим со мной./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2153_0.zh:
* 我，Alvin神父，殷切地希望... 
* 如果你有任何精神负担的话，
请一定要，向我倾诉。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2160_0.de: * Kris, if you want some of our "sick" Fruit Juice, you should come to our service./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2160_0.en: * Kris, if you want some of our "sick" Fruit Juice, you should come to our service./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2160_0.es: * Kris, if you want some of our "sick" Fruit Juice, you should come to our service./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2160_0.ja:
＊ クリス　きょうかいの　「ヤバい」
　 ジュースが　のみたいのなら
　 れいはいに　くることですよ。/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2160_0.ko:
* 크리스, 우리 교회의 
  과일 주스가 그렇게 좋다면
  우리와 함께하는 건 어떠니./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2160_0.pl: * Kris, jeśli chcesz napić się naszego „fajowego” soku owocowego, przyjdź na mszę./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2160_0.pt-BR: * Kris, if you want some of our "sick" Fruit Juice, you should come to our service./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2160_0.ru: * Крис, если ты хочешь нашего «крутого» сока, тебе стоит прийти на службу./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2160_0.zh:
* Kris，想喝我们的“奇葩”果汁
的话，你就应该来参加礼拜。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2161_0.de: * Our choir sounds a bit thinner since your brother went away./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2161_0.en: * Our choir sounds a bit thinner since your brother went away./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2161_0.es: * Our choir sounds a bit thinner since your brother went away./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2161_0.ja:
＊ クリスのおにいさんが　ぬけて
　 コーラスたいの　うたごえにも
　 はりが　なくなってしまいました。/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2161_0.ko:
* 아스리엘이 떠난 뒤로
  합창단의 화음이 많이
  약해졌단다./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2161_0.pl: * Nasz chór jest niekompletny, odkąd twój brat wyjechał na studia./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2161_0.pt-BR: * Our choir sounds a bit thinner since your brother went away./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2161_0.ru: * Наш хор стал звучать чуть тоньше с тех пор, как твой брат уехал./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2161_0.zh:
* 我们的唱诗班自从你哥哥离开后
音色就稍显不够丰满了。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2162_0.de: * Kris, it would be wonderful if you would sing with us./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2162_0.en: * Kris, it would be wonderful if you would sing with us./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2162_0.es: * Kris, it would be wonderful if you would sing with us./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2162_0.ja:
＊ かわりに　クリスが
　 はいってくれたら
　 だいかんげいですよ。/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2162_0.ko:
* 크리스, 네가 우리와 함께
  노래해 준다면 정말 기쁠 거야./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2162_0.pl: * Kris, byłoby cudownie, jakby twój głos zasilił nasze szeregi./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2162_0.pt-BR: * Kris, it would be wonderful if you would sing with us./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2162_0.ru: * Крис, было бы чудесно услышать твой голос в нашем хоре./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2162_0.zh:
* Kris，如果你能来和我们一起唱
就再好不过了。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2163_0.de: * Or even participated to any extent,/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2163_0.en: * Or even participated to any extent,/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2163_0.es: * Or even participated to any extent,/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2163_0.ja:
＊ せめて　きょうかいの　かつどうに
　 さんかしてくれるだけでも
　 いいのです。/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2163_0.ko:
* 노래가 아니더라도, 
  어떤 역할이든 기여해 주면
  고마울 거야./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2163_0.pl: * Lecz nie pogardzimy samą twoją obecnością,/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2163_0.pt-BR: * Or even participated to any extent,/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2163_0.ru: * Или получить хоть какую-то помощь от тебя,/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2163_0.zh: * 哪怕只是随便参与一下，/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2164_0.de: * Instead of just trying to drink the Fruit Juice./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2164_0.en: * Instead of just trying to drink the Fruit Juice./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2164_0.es: * Instead of just trying to drink the Fruit Juice./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2164_0.ja:
＊ ジュースだけ　もらおうと
　 するのではなくてね。/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2164_0.ko: * 그냥 과일 주스만 마시려 하지 말고./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2164_0.pl: * Jeśli nie rzucisz się od razu na sok owocowy./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2164_0.pt-BR: * Instead of just trying to drink the Fruit Juice./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2164_0.ru: * Вместо постоянных попыток выпить нашего сока./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2164_0.zh:
* 也总比一门心思
就想喝那果汁来得好。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2168_0.de:
* I understand.
* I hope in time you may find the words you seek./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2168_0.en:
* I understand.
* I hope in time you may find the words you seek./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2168_0.es:
* I understand.
* I hope in time you may find the words you seek./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2168_0.ja:
＊ わかりました。
＊ じきに　じぶんでも　はなしたい
　 ことが　わかってくるでしょう。/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2168_0.ko:
* 이해한단다.
* 진정 원하는 것을
  찾는 날이 금방 오길 바라마./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2168_0.pl:
* Rozumiem.
* Wierzę, że niedługo objawią ci się słowa, których szukasz./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2168_0.pt-BR:
* I understand.
* I hope in time you may find the words you seek./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2168_0.ru:
* Понимаю.
* Надеюсь, ты найдёшь слова, которые ищешь./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2168_0.zh:
* 我明白了。
* 希望终有一天你能寻找到
想要倾诉的话语。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2169_0.de: * Let the Angel's power light your way./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2169_0.en: * Let the Angel's power light your way./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2169_0.es: * Let the Angel's power light your way./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2169_0.ja:
＊ てんしさまの　みちからが
　 クリスの　ゆくてを
　 てらしますよう。/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2169_0.ko:
* 너의 앞길을 천사의 힘이
  밝혀 주기를./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2169_0.pl: * Niech moc Anioła oświetli ci drogę./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2169_0.pt-BR: * Let the Angel's power light your way./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2169_0.zh: * 愿天使之力照亮你的前路。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2178_0.ja: ＊ (かおりつきの　マーカーだ)/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2185_0.de: * (You dig out the marshmallow one and start huffing it.)/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2185_0.en: * (You dig out the marshmallow one and start huffing it.)/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2185_0.es: * (You dig out the marshmallow one and start huffing it.)/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2185_0.ja:
＊ (マシュマロの　かおりの
　 マーカーを　てにとり
　 クンクン　においを　かいだ)/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2185_0.pl: * (Znajdujesz marker o zapachu pianek i zaczynasz go wdychać.)/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2185_0.pt-BR: * (Você pega o de marshmallow e dá umas cheiradas nele.)/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2185_0.ru: * (Вы достали маркер с ароматом зефира и стали обнюхивать.)/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2185_0.zh:
* （你把棉花糖味的那支挖出来
并朝着笔尖哈气。）/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2189_0.de: * (The chocolate one smells too fake anyway.)/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2189_0.en: * (The chocolate one smells too fake anyway.)/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2189_0.es: * (The chocolate one smells too fake anyway.)/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2189_0.ja:
＊ (どうせ　チョコレートの　かおりの
　 マーカーは　ニセモノしゅうが
　 ひどい)/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2189_0.pl: * (Ten czekoladowy i tak pachnie zbyt sztucznie.)/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2189_0.pt-BR: * (O de chocolate tem um cheiro falso demais, mesmo.)/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2189_0.zh: * （反正那支巧克力味的闻起来太假了。）/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2198_0.ja:
＊ (トイレだ)
＊ (みずを　ながす？)/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2219_0.de: * (Wasser sparen ist gut für die Umwelt.)/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2219_0.ja:
＊ (みずを　むだづかい　しないのは
　 いいことだ)/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2228_0.de: * (It's an obligatory hospital piano, shrunk to fit in the corner.)/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2228_0.en: * (It's an obligatory hospital piano, shrunk to fit in the corner.)/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2228_0.es: * (It's an obligatory hospital piano, shrunk to fit in the corner.)/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2228_0.ja:
＊ (びょういんに　とってつけたように
　 おいてある　ピアノだ。スペースに
　 はまるよう　ちぢめてある)/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2228_0.ko:
* (의무상 비치된 병원 피아노,
  구석에 비집어 넣어두려고
  크기를 줄였다.)/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2228_0.pl: * (Szpitalne pianino. Pomniejszono je, by zmieściło się w kącie.)/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2228_0.pt-BR: * (É um piano hospitalar obrigatório, encolhido para caber no canto.)/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2228_0.ru: * (Стандартное больничное пианино. Чтобы уместилось в угол, пришлось его уменьшить.)/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2228_0.zh:
* （医院的公用钢琴，
为了能放在角落里而做得很小。）/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2229_0.de: * (As a result, it's missing most of the good keys.)/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2229_0.en: * (As a result, it's missing most of the good keys.)/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2229_0.es: * (As a result, it's missing most of the good keys.)/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2229_0.ja:
＊ (そのせいで
　 よい　けんばんが
　 ほとんど　なくなっている)/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2229_0.pl: * (Niestety przez to brakuje w nim większości dobrych klawiszy.)/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2229_0.pt-BR: * (Como resultado, falta a maioria das teclas boas.)/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2229_0.ru: * (В результате большинства нужных клавиш тут нет.)/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2229_0.zh: * （后果就是，很多常用音阶都没了。）/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2243_0.de: * (Your hands linger over the keys doing nothing.)/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2243_0.en: * (Your hands linger over the keys doing nothing.)/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2243_0.es: * (Your hands linger over the keys doing nothing.)/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2243_0.ja:
＊ (りょうては　なにも　ひかずに
　 けんばんの　うえを　さまよった)/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2243_0.pt-BR: * (Suas mãos permanecem nas notas sem fazer nada.)/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2701_0.ja:
＊ それは　望みでした　王たちの。　
　 ワタシの体を　罰として
　 閉じ込める。このオリに。/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2701_0.ko:
* 벌을 내리겠노라고,
  제 몸을 가두려고 했어요./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2701_0.pl: * BY MNIE UKARAĆ, ZAPRAGNĘLI UWIĘZIĆ MOJE CIAŁO./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2701_0.pt-BR: * AS PUNISHMENT, THEY CRAVED TO IMPRISON MY BODY./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2701_0.ru: * И РЕШИЛИ В НАКАЗАНИЕ ЗАТОЧИТЬ МОЁ ТЕЛО./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2701_0.zh:
* 他们气急败坏地要惩罚我，
要把我囚禁起来。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2702_0.de: * BUT I'M FAST, FAST, CLEVER, CLEVER./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2702_0.en: * BUT I'M FAST, FAST, CLEVER, CLEVER./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2702_0.es: * BUT I'M FAST, FAST, CLEVER, CLEVER./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2702_0.ja:
＊ ワシは　足が速いぞよ？
　 頭もキレる。頭が回る。/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2702_0.ko:
* 하지만 난 빨라요, 빨라,
  똑똑해요, 똑똑해./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2702_0.pl: * ALE JESTEM ZWINNY, ZWINNY, SPRYTNY, SPRYTNY./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2702_0.pt-BR: * BUT I'M FAST, FAST, CLEVER, CLEVER./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2702_0.ru: * НО Я БЫСТР, БЫСТР, УМЁН, УМЁН./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2702_0.zh:
* 但我很快，很快，
很聪明，很聪明。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2703_0.de: * THEY LOST THE CHASE, AND LOCKED UP THEIR ENTIRE RACE,/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2703_0.en: * THEY LOST THE CHASE, AND LOCKED UP THEIR ENTIRE RACE,/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2703_0.es: * THEY LOST THE CHASE, AND LOCKED UP THEIR ENTIRE RACE,/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2703_0.ja:
＊ 追いかけっこは　ボクの勝ち。
　 王たちが捕えたのは　自分の民。/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2703_0.ko:
* 그들은 나를 놓쳐놓고는.
* 자기들을 전부 가뒀어요,/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2703_0.pl: * STRACILI MNIE Z OCZU I UWIĘZILI CAŁY SWÓJ LUD./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2703_0.pt-BR: * THEY LOST THE CHASE, AND LOCKED UP THEIR ENTIRE RACE,/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2703_0.ru: * ОНИ ПРОИГРАЛИ В ГОНКЕ, ТЕПЕРЬ СВЕТА НЕ УВИДЕТЬ ПОТОМКАМ,/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2703_0.zh:
* 国王们抓不到我，
便把自己的族人统统关了起来，/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2704_0.de: * BUILDING A PRISON AROUND THE WHOLE WORLD. NOW I'M THE ONLY FREE ONE./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2704_0.en: * BUILDING A PRISON AROUND THE WHOLE WORLD. NOW I'M THE ONLY FREE ONE./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2704_0.es: * BUILDING A PRISON AROUND THE WHOLE WORLD. NOW I'M THE ONLY FREE ONE./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2704_0.ja:
＊ 世界のぐるりを囲むよに
　 大きな　ろう屋を　こしらえた。
　 自由の身なのは　私だけ。/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2704_0.ko:
* 온 세상 둘러 감옥을 세웠어요.
  이젠 나만 자유로운 몸./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2704_0.pl: * OTOCZYLI KRÓLESTWO MURAMI, NICZYM WIĘZIENIE. TERAZ TYLKO JA JESTEM WOLNY./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2704_0.pt-BR: * BUILDING A PRISON AROUND THE WHOLE WORLD. NOW I'M THE ONLY FREE ONE./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2704_0.ru: * ПОСТРОИВ ТЮРЬМУ МИР ОХВАТИВ. ОСТАВИВ ЛИШЬ МЕНЯ НА СВОБОДЕ./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2704_0.zh:
* 围绕整个世界建起了监狱。
现在我是唯一自由的人。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2706_0.de: * Huh? Free? But you're clearly the one behind bars.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2706_0.en: * Huh? Free? But you're clearly the one behind bars.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2706_0.es: * Huh? Free? But you're clearly the one behind bars.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2706_0.ja:
＊ 自由…って…　でも
　 あなたは　どう見ても
　 オリの中ですよね…/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2706_0.ko:
* 자유?
  철창 안에 있는 것 같은데 .../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2706_0.pl: * Co? Wolny? Ale przecież to ty jesteś za kratami.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2706_0.pt-BR: * Huh? Free? But you're clearly the one behind bars.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2706_0.ru: * А? На свободе? Но тут только ты за решёткой, начистоту.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2706_0.zh:
* 啊？自由？可明显你才是
被关起来的那个.../

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2708_0.de: J* THINGS DON'T SEEM SUCH FROM HERE, LIGHTNERS!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2708_0.en: J* THINGS DON'T SEEM SUCH FROM HERE, LIGHTNERS!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2708_0.es: J* THINGS DON'T SEEM SUCH FROM HERE, LIGHTNERS!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2708_0.ja:
J＊ こちら側より　物見れば
　 そうは見えぬぞ　ライトナー！/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2708_0.ko:
J* 여기선 그렇게 안 보여요 ,
  라이트너들아!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2708_0.pl: J* NIE WYGLĄDA TO TAK Z MOJEJ PERSPEKTYWY, ŚWIETLANIE!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2708_0.pt-BR: J* THINGS DON'T SEEM SUCH FROM HERE, LIGHTNERS!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2708_0.ru: J* ОТСЮДА ВСЁ СМОТРИТСЯ НЕ ТАК ОДНОЗНАЧНО, СВЕТЛЫЕ!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2708_0.zh:
J* 从我的角度看并非如此，
光之民！/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2710_0.de: * Well, sounds like you don't need any help, then./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2710_0.en: * Well, sounds like you don't need any help, then./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2710_0.es: * Well, sounds like you don't need any help, then./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2710_0.ja:
＊ じゃ　オレらの助けも
　 いらなそうだな。/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2710_0.pl: * Dobra, czyli nie potrzebujesz naszej pomocy./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2710_0.pt-BR: * Well, sounds like you don't need any help, then./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2710_0.ru: * Ну, значит, тебе не нужна помощь./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2710_0.zh:
* 好吧，
那这么说你是不需要帮助了。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2712_0.de:
J* THAT IS UN-SO.
* I GROW LONELY IN MY LITTLE FREEDOM./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2712_0.en:
J* THAT IS UN-SO.
* I GROW LONELY IN MY LITTLE FREEDOM./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2712_0.es:
J* THAT IS UN-SO.
* I GROW LONELY IN MY LITTLE FREEDOM./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2712_0.ja:
J＊ ノン　です　それは。
＊ さみしくなります　どんどん　私。
　 この　ささやかな　自由の中で。/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2712_0.ko:
J* 그렇진 않아요..
* 나 이 작은 자유 속에서,
  점점 더 외로워져요./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2712_0.pl:
J* PRAWDĄ TO NIE JEST.
* SAMOTNOŚĆ MI DOSKWIERA W MEJ WOLNOŚCI./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2712_0.pt-BR:
J* THAT IS UN-SO.
* I GROW LONELY IN MY LITTLE FREEDOM./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2712_0.ru:
J* ЭТО НЕ ТАК.
* МНЕ ОДИНОКО В МОЕЙ УЮТНОЙ СВОБОДЕ./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2712_0.zh:
J* 并非如此。
* 在这小小的自由世界中，
我感到孤独。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2713_0.de: * SO, SHALL YOU PLAY A GAME WITH ME, ME...?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2713_0.en: * SO, SHALL YOU PLAY A GAME WITH ME, ME...?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2713_0.es: * SO, SHALL YOU PLAY A GAME WITH ME, ME...?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2713_0.ja:
＊ 遊ぼうヨ？　遊ぼうネ？
　 ボクと　ゲームをして遊ぼう？/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2713_0.pl: * PYTANIE STAWIAM WAM: CZY ZAGRACIE ZE MNĄ W GRĘ, GRĘ...?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2713_0.pt-BR: * SO, SHALL YOU PLAY A GAME WITH ME, ME...?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2713_0.ru: * ИТАК, НЕ ПОИГРАЕТЕ ЛИ ВЫ СО МНОЙ, МНОЙ?../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2713_0.zh:
* 所以，你想不想和我，
玩个游戏...？/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2714_0.de: * I'LL SHOW YOU WHAT IT MEANS TO BE FREE!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2714_0.en: * I'LL SHOW YOU WHAT IT MEANS TO BE FREE!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2714_0.es: * I'LL SHOW YOU WHAT IT MEANS TO BE FREE!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2714_0.ja:
＊ 真の自由は　いかなるものか
　 われが　とくと教えてやろう！/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2714_0.pt-BR: * I'LL SHOW YOU WHAT IT MEANS TO BE FREE!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2714_0.zh:
* 我会带你见识一下
真正的自由！/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2719_0.de: * FIND THE KEY, AND I'LL LET YOU BE FREE, FREE./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2719_0.en: * FIND THE KEY, AND I'LL LET YOU BE FREE, FREE./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2719_0.es: * FIND THE KEY, AND I'LL LET YOU BE FREE, FREE./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2719_0.ja:
＊ カギを　見つけろ　見つければ
　 自由にしてやる　おまえたち。/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2719_0.ko:
* 열쇠를 찾아요,
  그럼 자유, 자유를 줄게요./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2719_0.pl: * ZNAJDŹCIE KLUCZ, A ZAZNACIE WOLNOŚCI, WOLNOŚCI./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2719_0.pt-BR: * FIND THE KEY, AND I'LL LET YOU BE FREE, FREE./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2719_0.ru: * НАЙДИТЕ КЛЮЧ, И Я ВЫПУЩУ ВАС НА СВОБОДУ, СВОБОДУ./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2719_0.zh: * 找到钥匙，我就放你自由，自由。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2720_0.de: * THE KEY IS HIDDEN FROM THE EYES. THE OLD SHOPKEEPER KNOWS A SECRET./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2720_0.en: * THE KEY IS HIDDEN FROM THE EYES. THE OLD SHOPKEEPER KNOWS A SECRET./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2720_0.es: * THE KEY IS HIDDEN FROM THE EYES. THE OLD SHOPKEEPER KNOWS A SECRET./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2720_0.ja:
＊ カギは　隠されていましょうね。
　 その目からは。年老いた店主が
　 知っています。ヒミツ。カギの。/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2720_0.ko:
* 열쇠는 눈을 피해 숨었네.
  늙은 상인이 비밀을 아네./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2720_0.pl: * KLUCZ UKRYTY ZOSTAŁ STARANNIE. STARY SKLEPIKARZ ZNA SEKRET./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2720_0.pt-BR: * THE KEY IS HIDDEN FROM THE EYES. THE OLD SHOPKEEPER KNOWS A SECRET./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2720_0.ru: * КЛЮЧ СКРЫТ ОТ ГЛАЗ. СТАРЫЙ ЛАВОЧНИК ЗНАЕТ СЕКРЕТ./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2720_0.zh:
* 钥匙被藏了起来。
老店主知道秘密。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2739_0.en: * HOW CAN YOU REFUSE, WHEN YOU ARE ALREADY PLAYING...?/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2749_0.en: * UEE HEE HEE, THE KEY, THE KEY./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2749_0.es: * UEE HEE HEE, THE KEY, THE KEY./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2749_0.ja:

　 カギですヨ？　カギですネ？/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2749_0.pt-BR: * UEE HEE HEE, THE KEY, THE KEY./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2749_0.zh: * 呃嘿嘿，钥匙来啦，钥匙来啦。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2750_0.de: * A MARVELLOUS FUN IS ABOUT TO BREAK FREE./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2750_0.en: * A MARVELLOUS FUN IS ABOUT TO BREAK FREE./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2750_0.es: * A MARVELLOUS FUN IS ABOUT TO BREAK FREE./

美妙绝伦的狂欢

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2751_0.en: * WON'T YOU LET YOURSELF OUTSIDE?/

　 するのです　みずからを　解放。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2751_0.zh: * 你难道不想到外面来吗？/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2766_0.en: * (You put the Door Key in front of the Door.)/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2766_0.es: * (You put the Door Key in front of the Door.)/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3142_0.de: * Marga riba! Diese Torte! Sie strahlt vor Macht!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3142_0.en:
* Marga riba!
* That cake!
* It's seething with power!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3142_0.es:
* Marga riba!
* That cake!
* It's seething with power!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3142_0.ja:
＊ マーマ　レード！
＊ そのケーキ！
＊ すさまじい気を　発しているヨ！/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3142_0.pl:
* Marga riba!
* To ciasto!
* Wypełnia je moc!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3142_0.pt-BR:
* Marga riba!
* Aquele bolo!
* Está fervendo com poder!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3142_0.ru:
* Марга риба!
* Этот торт!
* Он кипит силой!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3142_0.zh:
* 嘛噶里叭！
* 那个蛋糕！
* 它里面翻腾着力量！/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3143_0.de: * Sie ist meine Torte, nicht war!? Habt ihr sie repariert!? Gebt ihr sie zurück!?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3143_0.en:
* It's my cake, isn't it!?
* Did you repair it!?
* Will you return it!?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3143_0.es:
* It's my cake, isn't it!?
* Did you repair it!?
* Will you return it!?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3143_0.ja:
＊ それ　ワタシのケーキですネ？
＊ 修理したのですネ？
＊ 返してくれますネ！？/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3143_0.ko:
* 내 케이크, 맞지!?
* 자네들이 고쳤군!?
* 돌려주지 않겠나!?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3143_0.pl:
* To moje ciasto, prawda!?
* Naprawiliście je!?
* Mogę je odzyskać!?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3143_0.pt-BR:
* É meu bolo, não é?!
* Você reparou ele?!
* Você irá retornar ele a mim?!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3143_0.ru:
* Это ж мой торт, да?!
* Вы его починили?!
* Вернёте?!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3143_0.zh:
* 这是我的蛋糕，对不对！？
* 你把它修好了！？
* 你能还给我吗！？/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3152_0.de: * Edamame! Meine alte Torte! Ich freue mich so, ich könnte mich drehen!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3152_0.en: * Edamame! My old cake! I'm so happy I could spin!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3152_0.es: * Edamame! My old cake! I'm so happy I could spin!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3152_0.ja:
＊ エーダマーメ！
　 ワタシの傑作ケーキ！　うれしくって
　 クルクル回っちゃいそうネ！/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3152_0.ko:
* 에다마-메! 나의 오랜 케이크!
  행복해서 돌아버리겠네!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3152_0.pl: * Edamame! Moje stare ciasto! Z radości mógłbym zacząć się kręcić!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3152_0.pt-BR: * Edamame! Meu velho bolo! Eu estou tão feliz que poderia girar!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3152_0.ru: * Эдамаме! Мой старый торт! Я так счастлив, что аж верчусь!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3152_0.zh:
* 俺哒妈咩！我的旧蛋糕！
我高兴得都快要转起来了！/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3153_0.de: * Meine Freunde, ich teile mit euch! Ich habe viele schlechtere Torten, die du haben kannst!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3153_0.en: * My friend, share in my riches! I have many worse cakes I do not want!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3153_0.es: * My friend, share in my riches! I have many worse cakes I do not want!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3153_0.ja:
＊ あなたたちに　お礼がしたいヨ！
　 失敗作ケーキ　たくさんあるヨ！/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3153_0.ko:
* 친구들, 보답하고 싶네!
  내겐 원치 않는
   저급 케이크가 많이 있네!!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3153_0.pl: * Moi przyjaciele, podzielę się swym bogactwem! Mam mnóstwo ciast, których nie chcę!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3153_0.pt-BR: * Meu amigo, divido as minhas riquezas! Eu tenho muitos bolos piores que não quero!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3153_0.ru: * Друзья, я поделюсь богатствами! У меня есть ненужные мне торты похуже!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3153_0.zh:
* 我的朋友们，来分享我的财富吧！
我还存着很多不那么好的蛋糕，
都不想要了！/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3154_0.de: * Trägst du keine Torte, komm her und ich gebe dir eine! Für immer!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3154_0.en: * If you're not carrying a Cake, come here and I'll give you one! Forever!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3154_0.es: * If you're not carrying a Cake, come here and I'll give you one! Forever!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3154_0.ja:
＊ ケーキ　1つも持っていないなら
　 ワタシのところへ来てヨ！
　 ケーキあげるヨ！　何度でも！/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3154_0.ko:
* 케이크가 없을 때,
  여기로 오면 하나 주지!
  영원히!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3154_0.pl: * Jeśli nie macie żadnego mojego ciasta, to wam jakieś dam! Tylko poproście!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3154_0.pt-BR: * Se não estiver carregando um bolo, venha aqui e vou te dar um! Pra sempre!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3154_0.ru: * Если у вас нет с собой торта, возвращайтесь, и я вам его дам! Навсегда!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3154_0.zh:
* 如果你身上没有蛋糕，就来我这里！
我会送你一个，多少次都行！/
