scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3157_0.de: * Now, I'm going to continue to spin and cry! Spin and cry!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3157_0.en: * Now, I'm going to continue to spin and cry! Spin and cry!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3157_0.es: * Now, I'm going to continue to spin and cry! Spin and cry!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3157_0.ja:
＊ それじゃあ　ワタシは　ここで
　 クルクル涙を　流すヨ！/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3157_0.ko:
* 자, 이제 다시
  돌면서! 울고! 돌고! 울고!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3157_0.pl: * A teraz wracam do piruetów i krzyków! Piruetów i krzyków./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3157_0.pt-BR: * Agora, eu vou continuar a girar e chorar! Girar e chorar!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3157_0.ru: * Теперь я продолжу вертеться и плакать! Вертеться и плакать!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3157_0.zh:
* 现在，我要继续旋转着喜极而泣了！
边转边落泪！/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3162_0.de: * Sweet in cake, but not in character! A tragedy!!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3162_0.en: * Sweet in cake, but not in character! A tragedy!!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3162_0.es: * Sweet in cake, but not in character! A tragedy!!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3162_0.ja:
＊ ケーキは　こんなに甘～いのに
　 せち“辛い”世の中だヨ！/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3162_0.pl: * Słodcy od ciasta, ale o gorzkim charakterze! Tragedia!!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3162_0.pt-BR: * Doce em bolo, mas não em caráter! Que tragédia!!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3162_0.ru: * Сладок торт, но не характер! Трагедия!!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3162_0.zh: * 蛋糕甜美，性格非也！悲剧啊！！/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3174_0.de: * Mama miba! Wie gefallen dir meine ungeliebten Backwaren?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3174_0.en: * Mama miba! How are you enjoying my rejected pastries?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3174_0.es: * Mama miba! How are you enjoying my rejected pastries?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3174_0.ja:
＊ マーマ　ミーバ！
　 返品された菓子パン　どうデスカ？
　 おいしいでショウ？/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3174_0.ko:
* 맘마미-바!
  내가 거부한 빵은
  잘 먹고 있나?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3174_0.pl: * Mama miba! Jak wam smakują moje odrzucone wypieki?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3174_0.pt-BR: * Mama miba! Como estão meus doces rejeitados?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3174_0.ru: * Мама-шиба! Как вам моя отвергнутая выпечка?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3174_0.zh: * 妈妈咪叭！你喜欢我的淘汰甜品吗？/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3178_0.de: * Mom amiga! Wollt ihr eine schlechtere Torte, meine Freunde?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3178_0.en: * Mom amiga! You want an inferior cake, my friend?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3178_0.es: * Mom amiga! You want an inferior cake, my friend?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3178_0.ja:
＊ マア　アミーゴ！
　 三流ケーキを　もらいにきたのカナ？/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3178_0.ko:
* 맘～마미가!
  저급 케이크를
  먹고 싶나, 친구?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3178_0.pl: * Mom amiga! Chcecie gorszej jakości ciasto, moi przyjaciele?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3178_0.pt-BR: * Mom amiga! Você quer um bolo inferior, meu amigo?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3178_0.ru: * Мам амига! Хочешь худший торт, мой друг?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3178_0.zh:
* 麦啊咪勾！你想要一份次品蛋糕吗，
我的朋友？/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3187_0.de: * Bitte nehmt diese Torte! Sie ist wertlos, meine lieben Freunde!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3187_0.en: * Please take this cake! It's worthless, my dear friend!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3187_0.es: * Please take this cake! It's worthless, my dear friend!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3187_0.ja:
＊ このケーキ　受け取ってヨ！
　 どうせクズケーキだヨ！/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3187_0.ko:
* 이 케이크를 받게!
  가치없는 거라네, 나의 친구!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3187_0.pl: * Weźcie to ciasto! Jest bezwartościowe, moi przyjaciele!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3187_0.pt-BR: * Por favor, pegue esse bolo! É inútil, meu caro amigo!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3187_0.ru: * Возьми этот!! Он недостоин, мой дорогой друг!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3187_0.zh:
* 请拿着这个蛋糕！
它一文不值，我亲爱的朋友！/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3189_0.ja: 0＊ (スピンロールを　手に入れた)/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3192_0.de: * Mama shiba! Du trägst zu viele Sachen, die keine Torten sind!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3192_0.en: * Mama shiba! You're carrying too many things that aren't cakes!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3192_0.es: * Mama shiba! You're carrying too many things that aren't cakes!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3192_0.ja:
＊ マーメシーバ！　あなた
　 ケーキじゃない持ち物で
　 いっぱいだヨ！/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3192_0.ko:
* 맘마시-바!
  케이크가 아닌 걸
  너무 많이 들고 있군!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3192_0.pl: * Mama shiba! Macie w kieszeniach zbyt dużo rzeczy, które nie są ciastem!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3192_0.pt-BR: * Mama shiba! Você está carregando muitas coisas que não são bolos!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3192_0.ru: * Мама-шиба! Вы тащите слишком много не-тортов!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3192_0.zh:
* 妈妈西叭！你身上太多
不是蛋糕的东西了！/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3197_0.de: * Ich verstehe!! Zu viele Torten bringen dich zum Drehen und Weinen!!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3197_0.en: * I understand!! Too much cake will make you spin and cry!!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3197_0.es: * I understand!! Too much cake will make you spin and cry!!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3197_0.ja:
＊ わかったヨ！　ケーキ食べ過ぎると
　 クルクル涙が　出ちゃうしネ！/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3197_0.ko:
* 이해하네!!
  케이크를 너무 먹으면
  돌면서 울부짖게 되지!!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3197_0.pl: * Rozumiem!! Jak zjecie zbyt dużo ciasta, to zaczniecie się kręcić i krzyczeć!!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3197_0.pt-BR: * Eu entendo!! Muito bolo vai te fazer girar e chorar!!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3197_0.ru: * Я понимаю!! Много тортов вас закружат и заставят плакать!!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3197_0.zh:
* 我知道！
太多蛋糕会让你边转边落泪！！/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3206_0.en: * (Well, there is a man here.)/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3207_0.ja: ＊ (男は　なにかを差し出した)/

　 ここにいる必要は　ない)/

eu durmo

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3241_0.de: 9Du hast deswegen keinen Schlaf verloren, oder?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3241_0.en: 9* You didn't lose sleep over it, did you?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3241_0.es: 9* No te habrá quitado el sueño, ¿verdad?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3241_0.ja:
9＊ パートナーとの　かだいが
　 しんぱいで　きのう　あまり
　 ねむれなかったから…？/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3241_0.ko:
9* 짝 문제가 걱정돼서
  밤에 잠을 못 잔거지?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3241_0.pt-BR: 9* Você não perdeu sono por causa disso, né?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3241_0.ru: 9* У тебя же бессонница не из-за этого, да?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3241_0.zh:
9* 你该不会是因为这个

　 いわれても…/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3250_0.zh:
1* 你说这话的时候，
没带一点儿负面情绪。/

1＊ クリス　あなたの

1* Kris，作为你的老师，

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3253_0.en: 5* A limit. To the advice I'm qualified for./

5＊ せんせいが　できる
　 アドバイスは
　 かぎられてるけど…/

5* 我在自己的职权范围内，
能给出的建议非常有限。/

7＊ よかったら
　 ひとつ　おすすめが
　 あります。/

7* 하지만 네가 관심이 있다면,

A＊ …FPSゲームの

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3263_0.es: 7* ¿Quedado hasta tarde hablando con Asriel por internet otra vez?/

　 チャットしてて　ねるのが

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3265_0.ru: 9* Я... я надеюсь, что интернет скоро починят./

退化回原始形态。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3291_0.de: 2Wei€t schon, nur... allein zu zweit im Wandschrank rumhängen./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3291_0.en: 2* Y'know, just... chillin' out alone in the closet./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3291_0.es: 2* Ya sabes, vamos a... estar pasando el rato a solas en el trastero./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3291_0.ja:
2＊ えーっと…　これから
　 ふたりで　ものおきに
　 はいるところでさ…/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3291_0.ko:
2* 그 뭐, 그냥 같이...
  비품함 안에서 좀 노는 거지./

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3291_0.pt-BR: 2* Cê sabe, só... curtindo no armário, a sós./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3291_0.ru: 2* Ну, типа, мы прост... тусуемся в кладовке./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3291_0.zh:
2* 那个，就是... 
去储物间里一起玩玩而已。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3292_0.de: ABlo€ zwei Freunde, die im Schrank chillen, so wie immer./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3292_0.en: A* Just two friends, chillin' out in the closet, like normal./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3292_0.es: A* Solo dos colegas, de tranquileo en el trastero, lo típico./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3292_0.ja:
A＊ ほら　ダチどうし　ふたりで
　 サクッと　ものおきにでも
　 はいるかー…っつって？/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3292_0.ko:
A* 친구끼리 딱,
  비품함 좀 들어가고 하잖아...
  평범하게 말야./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3292_0.pl: A* Dwójka znajomych, odpoczynek w schowku, nic niezwykłego./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3292_0.pt-BR: A* Só os brôs, curtindo no armário, normal./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3292_0.ru: A* Просто два приятеля, тусуемся в кладовке как нормальные приятели./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3292_0.zh:
A* 两个好朋友，和往常一样，
去储物间里面玩耍。
/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3293_0.de: KUnd unsere... Besen anfassen und so./

K＊ んで　ほら…　ほうきとか？
　 いろいろさわったり
　 するかー…っつって？/

K* 그리고 뭐... 빗자루라든지

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3293_0.pt-BR: K* Pegando em... vassouras e tal./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3293_0.ru: K* Трогаем мётлы и всё такое.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3293_0.zh:

扫帚之类的东西。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3298_0.de: 2Wei€t schon, nur... so ein Paar Verbrechen begehen./

　 はんざい　おかさないと
　 いけなくてさー。/

2* 그래, 그런 거, 뭐...
  범죄... 같은 거./

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3298_0.zh:
2* 那个，就是... 
去犯个罪而已。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3299_0.de: AWir brechen nur ein Paar Gesetze und landen im... Knast./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3299_0.en: A* Just gonna do some crimes and go to... jail./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3299_0.es: A* Haremos algún crimen e iremos a... la cárcel./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3299_0.ja:
A＊ はんざいおかして
　 そんで…
　 ケームショに　はいる。/

A* 범죄 좀 저지르고...
  감옥으로 가려고./

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3299_0.pt-BR: A* Só vamos cometer uns crimes e ir pra... cadeia./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3299_0.ru:
A* Собирались, типа, пойти грабить, убивать и пере-
ходить на красный свет./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3299_0.zh: A* 犯个罪... 然后去坐个牢。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3300_0.ja: H＊ シューシンケイだ。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3321_0.ja: ＊ マネキンを　ハグした。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3322_0.de: * Etwas mehr Flauschigkeit in deinem Leben kann nicht schaden./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3322_0.en: * Nothing wrong with a little extra fluffiness in your life./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3322_0.es: * No hay nada de malo en buscar un poco de suavidad extra en tu vida./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3322_0.ja:
＊ 少しぐらいモフっても
　 バチは当たらない。/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3322_0.ko:
* 인생에 폭신함을 약간 더해서
  나쁠 것 없으니까./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3322_0.pl: * Dodatkowa puszystość nigdy jeszcze nikomu nie zaszkodziła./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3322_0.pt-BR: * Nada de errado com uma fofura extra na sua vida./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3322_0.ru: * Немного пушистости в вашей жизни не помешает./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3322_0.zh: * 生活中多一点毛茸茸也没什么不好的。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3327_0.en: * You did not hug the dummy./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3327_0.ja: ＊ マネキンを　ハグしなかった。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3328_0.de: * Du hast dem Pfad der Flauschigkeit entsagt./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3328_0.en: * You won't take the path of fluffiness any longer./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3328_0.es: * Te niegas a continuar por la senda de la suavidad./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3328_0.ja:
＊ もうこれ以上
　 モフる道は　歩まない。/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3328_0.pt-BR: * Você não seguirá mais o caminho da fofura./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3328_0.ru: * Вы больше не пойдёте по пути пушистости./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3328_0.zh: * 你决定不再走上这条毛茸茸的道路。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3421_0.pl: 6* Sam nie wiem!! Nadal nie spotkaliśmy się w prawdziwym życiu!!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3421_0.pt-BR: 6* Eu... na verdade não sei!! Eu não conheci ela na vida real!!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3421_0.ru: 6* Я... на самом деле не знаю!! Я не встречал её в реальной жизни!!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3421_0.zh:
6* 我... 我其实也不知道！！
我们还没在现实里见过面！/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3422_0.de: 5Doch von der Art wie sie SCHREIBT?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3422_0.en: 5* But from the way she TEXTS?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3422_0.es: 5* ¿Pero por la forma en la que ESCRIBE?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3422_0.ja:
5＊ でも　テキストチャット
　 してるかんじだと…/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3422_0.pl: 5* Ale po sposobie w jaki pisze?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3422_0.pt-BR: 5* Mas só pelo jeito que ela DIGITA?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3422_0.zh:
5* 不过通过她打的字，
我能感受的到。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3423_0.de: 1Gott, kleiner Kumpel. Sie muss ARGUMENTE haben./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3423_0.en: 1* God, Little Buddy. She must be STACKED./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3423_0.es: 1* Dios, peque. Tiene que ser un PARTIDAZO./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3423_0.ja:
1＊ いやあ～　そうとう
　 グラマーそうな
　 かんじだよ。/

1* 세상에, 꼬마 친구.
  진짜 분명 장난 아닐거라고./

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3423_0.pt-BR: 1* Nossa, carinha. Ela deve ser um XUXUZINHO./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3423_0.ru: 1* Боже, дружище. Она, должно быть, настоящая БОМБА./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3423_0.zh:
1* 哎呀，小家伙，
她肯定很正点啦。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3428_0.de: 3Kleiner Kumpel!! Willst du von meiner, hah, FREUNDIN hören!?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3428_0.en: 3* Little buddy!! Here to hear about my, heh, GIRLFRIEND!?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3428_0.es: 3* ¡¡Peque!! ¿¡Vienes a oírme hablar sobre mi, je, NOVIA!?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3428_0.ja:
3＊ お！　ききたいか！？　
　 オレの…　ヘヘッ…
　 カノジョの　はなしをさ！/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3428_0.ko:
3* 꼬마 친구!! 내, 히히,
  내 여친 얘기 들으러 온 거야!?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3428_0.pl: 3* Mordunio!! Chcesz posłuchać o mojej, heh, DZIEWCZYNIE?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3428_0.pt-BR: 3* Carinha!! Veio ouvir sobre a minha, heh, NAMORADA?!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3428_0.ru: 3* Дружище!! Ты здесь, чтобы услышать о моей, хех, ДЕВУШКЕ?!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3428_0.zh:
3* 小家伙！！你想听一听，嘿嘿，
关于我女朋友的事吗！？/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3437_0.de: 1Bisher ist sie das perfekte Mädel, kleiner Kumpel./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3437_0.en: 1* So far, she's the perfect girl, little buddy./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3437_0.es: 1* De momento, es la chica perfecta, peque./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3437_0.ja:
1＊ いまんとこ
　 いうことナシだな。/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3437_0.ko:
1* 지금까진,
  아주 완벽한 여자야,
  꼬마 친구./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3437_0.pl: 1* Jak na razie, jest ideałem. Istnym ideałem./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3437_0.pt-BR: 1* Até agora, ela é a garota perfeita, carinha./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3437_0.zh: 1* 她可真是太完美了，小家伙。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3438_0.ja:
3＊ カノジョは
　 ピザが　すきで…/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3440_0.de: 5Und obendrauf... hat sie mir ein Bild geschickt./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3440_0.en: 5* And to top it off... she sent me a picture./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3440_0.es: 5* Y para rematar la faena... me ha enviado una foto./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3440_0.ja:
5＊ しかも…
　 しゃしんまで
　 おくってくれたんだぜ。/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3440_0.pl: 5* I teraz wisienka na torcie... Dostałem od niej zdjęcie./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3440_0.pt-BR: 5* E ainda por cima... ela me mandou uma foto./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3440_0.ru: 5* И в довесок... она отправила мне фотографию./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3440_0.zh:

她给我发了一张照片。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3441_0.en: 1* Of herself. Wearing a pizza bikini./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3441_0.es: 1* Una foto suya. Llevando un bikini de pizza./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3441_0.ja:
1＊ ピザのビキニをきた
　 じぶんの　しゃしんをな。/

穿着一条披萨比基尼。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3442_0.de: 6Kleiner Kumpel, vielleicht gehört sich das nicht, aber.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3442_0.en: 6* Little buddy, perhaps it is uncouth, but.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3442_0.es: 6* Peque, puede que esto sea un poco de mal gusto, pero.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3442_0.ja:
6＊ まあ　こういうこというのは
　 あんま　ほめられたもんじゃ
　 ないかもしれないが…/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3442_0.ko:
6* 꼬마 친구야,
  좀 낯간지러울지도
  모르겠는데 말이다.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3442_0.pl: 6* Mordunio, może wyjdę teraz na prostaka, ale.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3442_0.ru: 6* Дружище, возможно, она немного неуклюжа, но.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3442_0.zh:

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3443_0.de: 2Schau!!! GUCK DIR DAS AN!!!! ALTER FALTER!!!!/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3445_0.ja:
＊ (ピクセルが　ならんでいる。ピザの
　 JPEGしゃしんを　かくだいしたものに
　 みえなくもない)/

* (이 픽셀 덩어리는 페퍼로니
  피자 JPEG를 확대한
  것처럼 보인다.)./

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3445_0.pt-BR: * (São vários pixels que vagamente se parecem com um JPG de uma pizza de calabresa.)/

* （照片里是几个模糊的像素块，
看着像放大的意大利香肠披萨。）/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3447_0.de: 6Ja, ich wei€ was du denkst, kleiner Kumpel./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3447_0.en: 6* Yes, I know what you're thinking, Little Buddy./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3447_0.es: 6* Sí, ya sé lo que estás pensando, peque./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3447_0.ja:
6＊ ああ。アンタの
　 かんがえてることは
　 わかるぜ。/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3447_0.ko:
6* 그래, 무슨 생각 중인지 알아,
  꼬마 친구./

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3447_0.zh:

小家伙。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3448_0.zh: 5* 她相机的性能，并不是很好。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3449_0.de: 3Doch für die Gelehrten der Welt, so wie mich,/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3449_0.es: 3* Pero para un hombre que sabe del mundo como yo,/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3449_0.ja:

　 ガクのある
　 オトコにとっちゃ…/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3449_0.pt-BR: 3* Mas para um sábio homem do mundo como eu,/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3449_0.ru: 3* Но для такого образованного интеллигента как я,/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3449_0.zh:

见多识广的人来说，/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3450_0.en: 6* This is what love looks like, Little Buddy./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3450_0.es: 6* Este es el aspecto del amor, peque./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3450_0.ja:
6＊ これぞ　まさに
　 あいのすがた　そのものさ。/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3450_0.ko:
6* 이것이야말로 사랑 그 자체의
  모습이란다, 꼬마 친구야./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3450_0.pt-BR: 6* É assim que o amor se parece, carinha./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3450_0.zh:
6* 这就是爱的体现啊，
小家伙。/

0* 小Krissy。
来参观我的巷子吗？/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3744_0.de: 5Hahaha. Ich bin ein echter Alli-Gassor, nicht wahr~?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3744_0.en: 5* Hahaha. I'm a real alley-gator, aren't I~?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3744_0.es: 5* Ja, ja. Los caimanes somos, en plan, muy territoriales, ¿sabes?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3744_0.ja:
5＊ 「ワニ」だけに～？
　 なんてぇ～！　アハハ～/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3744_0.ko:
5* 하하 막, 악어 아니랄까 봐,
  입만 열고 있어도
  친구가 찾아오네?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3744_0.pl: 5* Hahaha. Jestem najlepszą śmieciarką w tym mieście, czyż nie~?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3744_0.pt-BR: 5* Hahaha. Eu sou uma verdadeira bec-rocodila, não sou~?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3744_0.ru: 5* Ха-ха-ха. Я прям настоящий улок-гатор, а~?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3744_0.zh:
5* 哈哈哈。
我真是条巷子鳄，
不是吗~？。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3754_0.ja:
3＊ てか　クリリぃ～
　 ちょっときいて～/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3754_0.ko:
3* 크리시 크리시, 막,
  내 말 좀 들어볼래?/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3755_0.de: 0Heute war ich so, am Strand um meine Uke zu spielen, und.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3755_0.en: 0* Today I like, went to the beach to play my uke, and.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3755_0.es: 0* Hoy, en plan, como que fui a la playa a tocar mi uke, y.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3755_0.ja:
0＊ きょう～　ビーチに
　 ウクレレ　ひきに
　 いったらぁ～/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3755_0.ko:
0* 오늘 막, 해변가에
  우쿨렐레를 치러 갔는데.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3755_0.pl: 0* Dzisiaj, no wiesz, poszłam na plażę, by pograć na ukulele i.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3755_0.pt-BR: 0* Hoje eu tipo, fui na praia pra tocar meu ukulele, e.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3755_0.ru: 0* Сегодня я типа, пошла на пляж, чтобы поиграть на укулеле, и.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3755_0.zh:
0* 今天我那个，
去了趟沙滩弹我的尤克里里，
接着.../

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3756_0.de: 6Also, rate mal wer SCHON da ist?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3756_0.ja: 6＊ だれが　いたとおもう～？/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3756_0.ko:
6* 막, 거기에
  누가 먼저 와 있었게?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3756_0.pl: 6* Cóż, nie zgadniesz, KTO już tam był./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3756_0.pt-BR: 6* Tipo, adivinha quem JÁ TAVA lá?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3756_0.ru: 6* Типа, угадай, кто ЕЩЁ был там?/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3757_0.de: 3Diese NACHÄFFERIN, spielte den gleichen Song den ich spielen wollte./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3757_0.en: 3* That COPYCAT, playing the same song I wanted to play./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3757_0.es: 3* Esa GATA COPIONA, tocando la misma canción que quería tocar yo./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3757_0.ja:
3＊ れいの　まねっこネコが～
　 あたしが　ひこうとしてた
　 きょくを　ひいてて～！/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3757_0.ko:
3* 그 카피캣이,
  내가 연주하려던 곡을
  연주하고 있더라구./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3757_0.pl: 3* Ta KOPIARKA! I jeszcze grała piosenkę, którą ja chciałam zagrać./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3757_0.pt-BR: 3* Aquela INVEJOSA, tocando a mesma música que eu queria tocar./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3757_0.ru: 3* Эта КОПИКОШКА, она играла ту же песню, какую хотела я./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3757_0.zh:
3* 是那只复读猫，
正弹着我打算弹的曲子。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3758_0.de: 6Oh mein Gott. Katzen am Strand. Ekelhaft./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3758_0.en: 6* Oh my god. Cat on the beach. Grody./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3758_0.es: 6* Oh, Dios mío. Un gato en la playa. Uf./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3758_0.ja:
6＊ てか　ビーチに
　 ネコが　いるとか
　 キショくな～い？/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3758_0.ko:
6* 세상에나 말야.
  해변에 고양이 납셨어 아주./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3758_0.pt-BR: 6* Ai meu Deus. Gata na praia. Nojento./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3758_0.ru: 6* О Господи. Что она забыла на пляже?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3758_0.zh:
6* 我的老天爷，
一只猫在沙滩上，
真令人恶心。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3759_0.de: 3Hat sie denn, also, sich auf dem Weg zum Katzenklo verlaufen?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3759_0.en: 3* Did she, like, get lost looking for the litter box?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3759_0.es: 3* ¿Acaso, en plan, se perdió buscando su cajita de arena?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3759_0.ja:
3＊ ビーチの　すなを
　 トイレの　すなと
　 まちがえたとか～？/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3759_0.ko:
3* 무슨, 막,
  쓰레기통 찾다가
  길을 잃기라도 한 걸까?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3759_0.pl: 3* Czy ona, no wiesz, zgubiła się, szukając kuwety?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3759_0.pt-BR: 3* Ela, tipo, se perdeu procurando a caixinha de areia?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3759_0.ru: 3* Может, она, типа, не могла найти свой мусорный бак?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3759_0.zh:
3* 她是，那个，
在找猫砂盆的时候迷路了吗？/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3760_0.de: 0Also dann so, hab ich dann so, auch den Song gespielt,/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3760_0.en: 0* So like, I try to like, play the same song, too.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3760_0.es: 0* Total, que intento, en plan, tocar la misma canción y tal.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3760_0.ja:
0＊ で！　あたしも
　 その　きょく
　 ひこうとしたわけ～/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3760_0.ko:
0* 그래서, 나도 막,
  같은 노래를,
  연주했거든.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3760_0.pl: 0* Więc zaczęłam, no wiesz, grać tę samą piosenkę,/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3760_0.pt-BR: 0* Então tipo, eu tento tipo, tocar a mesma música, também.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3760_0.ru: 0* Так что, я пыталась, типа, играть эту же песню, тоже.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3760_0.zh:
0* 所以那个，我试着，
也弹了一样的曲子.../

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3761_0.de: 5Um, du wei€t, meine Ukelele-Überlegenheit zu zeigen./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3761_0.en: 5* To, you know, assert my ukelele dominance./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3761_0.es: 5* Para, ya sabes, demostrar mi dominancia ukelelil./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3761_0.ja:
5＊ あたしの　ウクレレりょくの
　 ほうが　うえだって
　 わからせたくて～！/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3761_0.ko:
5* 그 있잖아, 막,
  내 우클렐레가 더 위라는 걸 
  알려주고 싶었으니까./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3761_0.pl: 5* Żeby, no wiesz, zaznaczyć swoje terytorium./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3761_0.pt-BR: 5* Pra, sabe, mostrar minha superioridade com o ukulele./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3761_0.ru: 5* Чтобы, понимаешь, отстоять своё укулельное превосходство./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3761_0.zh:
5* 你也知道，
为了展示我更高超的
尤克里里演奏水平。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3762_0.de: 3Und am Ende haben wir, ach - schnall das mal -/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3762_0.en: 3* And we end up, ugh - get this -/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3762_0.es: 3* Y como que acabamos, uf - agárrate -/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3762_0.ja: 3＊ そしたらぁ～　なんかぁ～/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3762_0.pl: 3* I okazało się, że, ha, nie zgadniesz,/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3762_0.pt-BR: 3* E a gente acaba, argh - escuta só -/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3762_0.ru: 3* Но мы закончили тем, что... приготовься.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3762_0.zh:
3* 最终我们，
呃-变成了那样-/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3763_0.ja:
6＊ ふたりで
　 まるまる　いっきょく
　 ひいちゃってぇ～/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3763_0.zh:
6* 一起弹完了整首曲子。
一起弹的。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3764_0.de: 3Also, oh mein Gott, für wen HÄLT sich dieses Mädel?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3764_0.en: 3* Like, oh my god, who does this girl think she IS?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3764_0.es: 3* En plan, oh, Dios mío, ¿quién se cree esta chica que ES?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3764_0.ja:
3＊ てか　なにさまの
　 つもりぃ～？/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3764_0.ko:
3* 세상에, 막,
  자기가 뭐라고
  생각하는 거람?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3764_0.pl: 3* Jakby, o jeju, za kogo ona się uważa?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3764_0.pt-BR: 3* Tipo, ai meu Deus, quem essa garota PENSA que é?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3764_0.ru: 3* Типа, боже мой, кем ЭТА девчонка себя возомнила?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3764_0.zh:
3* 那个，我的老天爷啊，
这个小姑娘觉得自己是谁啊？/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3765_0.de: 3Denkt sie sie könnte einfach, so, mit mir HARMONIEREN!?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3765_0.en: 3* She thinks she can just, like, HARMONIZE with me!?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3765_0.es: 3* Se cree que puede, en plan, ¿¡ARMONIZAR CONMIGO!?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3765_0.ja:
3＊ あたしと　フツーに
　 ハモるとか　どーゆー
　 しんけいしてんの！？/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3765_0.ko:
3* 막, 나랑,
  화음이라도 맞출 수
  있을 거라고 생각한 건가!?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3765_0.pl: 3* Czy ona myśli, no wiesz, że może grać ze mną w tandemie!?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3765_0.pt-BR: 3* Ela acha que pode só, tipo, HARMONIZAR comigo?!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3765_0.ru: 3* Она думает, что может, типа, ИГРАТЬ вместе со мной?!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3765_0.zh:
3* 她觉得她能够，那个，
跟我和谐同奏！？/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3766_0.ja: 0＊ はぁ～！　ホンット　ウザ～/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3766_0.ru: 0* Фу. Я просто НЕ ВЫНОШУ её./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3766_0.zh: 0* 呃啊，我简直对她不能忍。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3772_0.de: 6(Aber also... das hier ist MEINE verdreckte Gasse? Also...)/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3772_0.en: 6* (But like... this is MY polluted alleyway? So like...)/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3772_0.es: 6* (Pero.. ¿este es MI callejón repugnante? Así que...)/

6＊ (でも～　この
　 きったない　ろじうらは
　 あたしの　だから…)/

6* (하지만 뭐랄까... 여긴 "내"

6* （但是那个... 
这条脏小巷是我的地盘，

0＊ (町長に　たのんで
　 ひょうしき　たてて

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3779_0.en: 5* Oh, like, you, like, just like, like alleys?/

　 あたしの　にわ

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3779_0.zh:
5* 噢，那个，你，那个，
你喜欢，喜欢巷子吗？/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3780_0.en: 3* Oh my god. Like, me too. I LOVE alleys./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3780_0.es: 3* Oh, Dios mío. En plan, a mí también. Me ENCANTAN los callejones./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3780_0.ja:
3＊ てか　あたし
　 「にわ」って
　 なんか　すきでぇ～/

3* 세상에. 막, 나도거든.
  난 뒷골목이 정말 좋아./

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3780_0.pt-BR: 3* Ai meu Deus. Tipo, eu também. Eu AMO becos./
