scr_recruit_info_all_slash_scr_recruit_i.ja: まだ　なかまに　なっていない。

scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.de: Mag scharfkantig wirken, ist jedoch eher zahm. Weiter so, du lahmes Karo!
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.en: Said to be someone's best friend, but maybe not. Shine on, you lazy diamond!
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.es: Se dice que es el mejor amigo de alguien, pero quizás no. ¡No dejes de brillar, diamante perezoso!
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ja:
だれかのベストフレンドだというウワサも
あるが真相は不明。クレイジーだという
評判も。
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ko:
누군가의 베스트 프렌드라고 하지만 아닐지도.
게으른 다이아몬드 같으니!
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.pl: Mówi się, że jest czyimś najlepszym przyjacielem, ale nie musi to być prawda. Wstydź się, leniwy diamencie!
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.pt-BR: Dito ser o melhor amigo de alguém, mas talvez não. Ouro de tolo...
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ru: Говорит, что он чей-то лучший друг, но это вряд ли. Сверкай-сверкай, ленивый бубен!
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.zh:
据说是什么人最好的朋友，
但也好像并非如此。
闪耀吧，你这懒惰的钻石！

scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.en: * Hey, boss! I'll have a Dark Candy Starfait!/
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.es: * ¡Oye, líder! ¡Voy a tomar un Starfait de Caramelo Oscuro!/
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ja:
＊ ボス！
　 わたし　ダークキャンディ・
　 サンデーサンデーにするね！/
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ko:
* 보스, 보스!
  나 다크 캔디 별 파르페
  먹을래!/
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.pl: * Hej, szefie! Poproszę Gwiazdoktail o smaku ciemnych cukierków!/
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.pt-BR: * Ei, chefe! Eu vou querer um Starfait de Doce Trevoso!/
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ru: * Здрасьте, босс! Я буду звёздное парфе из темноконфеты!/
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.zh:
* 嘿，老板！
我要点个黑暗糖果星冰乐！/

scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.de: Ein Herz mit einem gro€en Herzen. Unterstützt andere mit Kugeln.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.en: A heart with a big heart. Always supporting others with her bullets.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.es: Un corazón con un gran corazón. Siempre apoya a los demás con sus balas.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ja:
ビッグなハートのハートさん。
バトルではもっぱらサポート担当。
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ko:
커다란 하트를 가진 하트.
탄으로 다른 친구들을 지원한다.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.pl: Serduszko z wielkim sercem. Zawsze wspiera innych swoimi pociskami.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.pt-BR: Um coração com um grande coração. Sempre apoiando os outros com suas balas.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ru: Сердце с большим сердцем. Своими снарядами способна растопить даже самое червствое сердце.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.zh:
一个心很大的红心。
总是用她的子弹支持别人。

scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.en: * (Hathy is going to order a heart-foam latte.)/
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.es: * (Curazón va a pedir un café con leche con espuma en forma de corazón.)/
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ja:
＊ (ハーティは
　 ハートチーノ・ラテを
　 注文するようだ)/
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ko:
* (하티는 하트모양 거품을 올린
  라떼를 주문하려 한다.)/
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.pl: * (Sercka zaraz zamówi latte z piankowym serduszkiem.)/
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.pt-BR: * (Copação vai pedir um latte com espuma de coração.)/
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ru: * (Серция собирается заказать латте с пеной в форме сердца.)/
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.zh:
* （Hathy打算点一份心形拉花的
拿铁咖啡。）/

scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.de: Eine simple Lebensform, die einfach so in das Spielbrett hinein lebt.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.en: A simple organism that takes life one square at a time.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.es: Un organismo sencillo que anda por la vida de casilla en casilla.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ja: １マス１マス日々を生きる　単細胞生物。
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ko: 한 칸 한 칸씩 살아가는 단순한 생물.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.pl: Prosty organizm, który poznaje życie skok po skoku.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.pt-BR: Um organismo simples que leva a vida um quadrado de cada vez.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ru: Простой организм, что идёт по жизни клетка за клеткой.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.zh:
一步一格走过人生路
的简单生物。

scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.en: * (Looks like it wants to osmose some flavorful cubes.)/
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.es: * (Parece que quiere osmosear algunas pastillas de caldo.)/
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ja:
＊ (フレーバー付きキューブを
　 吸収したいようだ)/
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.pt-BR: * (Parece que ele quer fazer osmose com uns cubos saborosos.)/
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ru: * (Похоже, оно хочет поглотить несколько ароматических кубиков.)/
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.zh: * （看来它想要吸收一些调味块。）/

scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.de: Ein echter Wollmaushase. Kennt dreckige Tricks, spielt dennoch sauber.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.en: A real dust bunny. Known to play dirty, but loves to play clean.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.es: Un conejo muy polvoriento. Conocido por jugar sucio, pero le encanta jugar limpio.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ja:
ホコリみたいにホワホワなウサギ。
“汚い手”を使うと評判だが
ホントは清く正しいことが好き。
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ko:
진짜 먼지 토끼.
더럽게 논다고들 하지만,
깨끗하게 노는 걸 좋아한다.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.pl: Zakurzony zawodnik wagi ciężkiej. Znany z brudnych zagrywek. Uwielbia czyste serca.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.pt-BR: Um verdadeiro coelhinho sujo. Conhecido por jogar sujo, mas ama jogar limpo.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ru: Очень пыльный кролик. Знает грязные приёмы, но предпочитает чистую игру.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.zh:
一只真正的尘兔。
出了名的会玩脏手段，
但更喜欢手脚干净。

scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.de: * (Scheint so als wollte er mit Waschbenzin abgetupft werden.)/
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.en: * (Looks like it wants to be dabbed with rubbing alcohol.)/
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.es: * (Parece que quiere que le froten con alcohol para heridas.)/
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ja:
＊ (消毒用のアルコールで
　 やさしくふいてほしいようだ)/
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ko:
* (소독용 알코올로
  살살 닦아주길 원하는 것 같다.)/
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.pt-BR: * (Parece que ele quer ser esfregado com álcool isopropílico.)/
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.zh: * （看来它想涂上一些清洁酒精。）/

scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.de: Ein umbaubarer Kämpfer. Ironischerweise schlecht im Blocken.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.en: A shape changing fighter. Ironically, blocking is not its forte.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.es: Un guerrero cambiaforma. Irónicamente, bloquear no es su fuerte.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ja:
姿形が変わるファイター。
名前のわりに　こうげきを
ブロックするのはニガテ。
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ko:
모습을 바꾸는 파이터. 
이름과는 달리,
블록킹은 잘 못 한다.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.pl: Zmiennokształtny wojownik. O ironio, blokowanie to nie jego klocki.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.pt-BR: Um lutador que muda de forma. Ironicamente, bloquear não é seu forte.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ru: Меняющий форму боец. Иронично, но блокирование не его сильная сторона.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.zh:
一个能变形的战士。
讽刺的是，它并不擅长格挡。

scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ja: トレーニングシューズ

scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.de: * Alles schmeckt besser wenn mein Körper richtig rum ist!/
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.en: * Everything tastes better with a normally-shaped body!/
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.es: * ¡Todo sabe mejor con un cuerpo con forma normal!/
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ja:
＊ 体が　ちゃんとした形に整ってると
　 なにを　飲み食いしても
　 ウマいな！/
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ko:
* 정상적인 몸으로는
  뭘 먹어도 더 맛있어!/
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.pl: * Wszystko smakuje lepiej, gdy masz uporządkowane ciało!/
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.pt-BR: * Tudo tem um gosto melhor com um corpo em formato normal!/
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ru: * Всё вкуснее, если тело правильной формы!/

scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.de: Es weint vor Freude, dass du sein Boss bist.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.en: It cries tears of joy that you are its boss.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.es: Llora lágrimas de alegría porque eres su líder.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ja:
泣いている。
ボスになってもらって　よっぽどうれしい
ようだ。
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ko:
당신이 보스라는 사실에
기쁨의 눈물을 터뜨렸다.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.pl: Zawsze uroni łezkę radości na myśl, że jest twoim podwładnym.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.pt-BR: Ele chora lágrimas de felicidade por ter mudado de chefe.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ru: Плачет от счастья из-за того, что теперь вы его босс.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.zh:
因为你是它的老板，
它高兴得快要哭出来了。

scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.de: Ein Agent of CHAOS, in deiner Tasche als TEUFELSMESSER.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.en: An agent of CHAOS, he became DEVILSKNIFE to the pocket.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.es: An agent of CHAOS, he became DEVILSKNIFE to the pocket.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ja:
カオスをなすもの。
ポケットのデビルズナイフ。
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ko:
혼돈의 대리인, 주머니 속
데빌스나이프가 되었다.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.pl: Inkarnacja CHAOSU, stał się DIABŁOKOSĄ w kieszeni.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.pt-BR: Um agente do CAOS, ele virou a FACA JIAVÓLICA no bolso.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ru: Агент ХАОСА, он стал ДЬЯВОЛЬСКИМ НОЖОМ в кармане.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.zh:
【混沌】的化身，
他变成了你口袋里的【恶魔飞刀】。

scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ja: カオスだよ:カオスだね

scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.de: Besessen von Superheldenfilmen. Es prahlt damit, besser als Rudinn zu sein.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.en: Obsessed with ranger shows, it lets everyone know it's better than Rudinn.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.es: Obsesionado con programas de superhéroes, hace saber a todo el mundo que es mejor que Ofidiamante.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ja:
戦隊モノ番組マニア。モンディより
優秀だというアピールに余念がない。
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ko:
전대물에 집착한다, 항상
자신이 루딘보다 낫다고 주장한다.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.pl: Ma obsesje na punkcie serialów o strażnikach. Na każdym kroku pokazuje swą wyższość nad Rudinem.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.pt-BR: Obcecado com séries florestais, ele diz a todos ser melhor que o Rudourado.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ru: Одержим шоу про рейнджеров, постоянно доказывает всем, что он лучше бубинна.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.zh:
痴迷于战队节目，
逢人就说它比Rudinn要强得多。

scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ja: 録画した番組を消されること

scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.de: * Boss...? Du gibst aus...? Ach, wär doch nicht nötig!/
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.en: * Boss...? You're treating me...? Oh, you shouldn't have! (smile)/
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ja:
＊ えっ…　隊長… おごってくれるで
　 ありますか…？
　 いやぁ悪いであります…(ニヤニヤ)/
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ko:
* 보스...? 한 턱 내시는 겁니까...?
  아핫, 굳이 그렇게까지야! (웃음)/
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.pl: * Szefie...? Ty mnie obsługujesz...? Oj, nie trzeba było! (uśmiech)/
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.pt-BR: * Chefia...? Você está cuidando de mim...? Ah, não precisava! (sorriso)/
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ru: * Босс?.. Сегодня ты угощаешь?.. Ох, не стоило! (улыбнулся)/
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.zh:
* 老板...？你要请客...？
噢，不用这么客气的！（笑）/

scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.de: Es ist zwar stärker als Hathy, hat aber weniger Freunde.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.en: Although stronger than Hathy, seems to have fewer friends.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.es: Aunque más fuerte que Curazón, parece tener menos amigos.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ja:
ハーティよりも強いけど
ハーティよりも　友だちいなそう。
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ko:
하티보다 강하지만,
친구는 적은 것 같다.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.pl: Mimo że jest silniejsza niż Sercka, nie ma tylu przyjaciół co ona.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.pt-BR: Embora mais forte que Copação, parece ter menos amigos.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ru: Сильнее серции, но имеет меньше друзей.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.zh:
尽管比Hathy强大，
朋友却比Hathy少。

scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.de: * (Head Hathy trinkt in Ruhe einen Eistee...)/
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.en: * (Head Hathy drinks an ice tea in silence...)/
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.es: * (Oficial Curazón bebe un té helado en silencio...)/
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ja:
＊ (ヘッドハーティは　だまって
　 アイスティーを飲んでいる…)/
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ko:
* (헤드 하티는 조용히
  아이스 티를 마시고 있다...)/
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.pl: * (Naczelna Sercka pije mrożoną herbatę w ciszy...)/
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.pt-BR: * (Copação Chefe bebe um chá gelado em silêncio...)/

scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.de: Ein aggressives Antivirus. Macht keinen Quatsch mit.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.en: An aggressive antivirus. It's not down with the sickness.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.es: Un antivirus agresivo. Su batalla no ha terminado.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ja:
攻撃的な抗ウィルス体。
病気には絶対負けない。
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ko:
호전적인 항바이러스체.
질병에는 절대 쓰러지지 않는다.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.pl: Agresywny program antywirusowy. Nie pokona go byle choróbsko.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.pt-BR: Um antivírus agressivo. Ele não está doente.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.zh:
一款攻击性很强的杀毒软件。
不会被病魔打倒。

scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ja: ふざけたサウンドエフェクト

scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.de: * Tatüüü! Geht nichts über Espresso... Willst du auch ne "Dosis"!?/
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.en: * Pipooo! Nothing beats a nice shot of espresso... Want me to give you a "shot", too!?/
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.es: * ¡Pii! Nada como un buen trago de expreso ... ¿¡Tú también quieres que te pegue un trago!?/
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ja:
＊ ピーポー！
　 毎食後　忘れず飲まなきゃね…
　 １杯のエスプレッソ！/
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ko:
* 삐뽀! 에스프레소의 찌르는 듯한
  쓴맛은 정말 최고야...
  너도 한 번 찔려볼래!?/
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.pl: * Pipooo! Nie ma nic lepszego, niż espresso. Daje takiego kopa! Też chcesz „kopa”?!/
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.pt-BR: * Pipooo! Nada melhor que uma boa dose de expresso... Quer que eu te dê uma "dose" também?!/
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ru: * Виу-у! Хорошая порция эспрессо — то, что доктор прописал... Хочешь, я тебе тоже «пропишу»?!/
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.zh:
* 哔啵！
什么都比不上一杯浓咖啡... 
你也想来“一杯”！？/

scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.de: Sagt oft ASOBOH, was "Lass uns spielen!" bedeutet... wei€ es das?
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.en: Known to say ASOBOH, which means "Let's Play!" ... does it know that?
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.es: Conocido por decir ASOBOH, que significa "¡Vamos a jugar!" ... ¿Lo sabe siquiera?
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ja:
「…アｿボウE」が口グセ。
たぶん「遊ぼうよ」と言っている。
意味がわかっているのかは不明。
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.pl: Lubi mówić ASOBOH, co w wolnym tłumaczeniu znaczy „Zabawmy się!” ...ale czy on o tym wie?
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.pt-BR: Conhecido por dizer ASOBOH, que significa "Vamos Brincar!"... será que sabe disso?
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ru: Постоянно говорит «АСОБО», что значит «давай поиграем!»... но знает ли он об этом сам?
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.zh:
因很爱说“來佺玩銈吧�”而闻名。
意思是“来玩吧”
...它自己知道吗？

scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.en:
* NOMU NOMU.
* BERRY GOOD!/
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ja:
＊ モグモグ…
＊ おやつ　ウマ！/

scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.en: * (It's drinking K_K's electric milk JPEG.)/
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.es: * (Está bebiendo el electrizante JPEG de leche de K_K.)/
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ja:
＊ (K_Kの　デジタルミルク.JPGを
　 飲んでいる)/
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.pt-BR: * (Está bebendo o JPEG de leite elétrico do KRJ.)/

scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.de: Es wurde von Queen kontrolliert. Doch jetzt ist es cooler, also?
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.en: It was controlled by Queen. But, it's stronger and cooler now, so?
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.es: Era controlado por Queen, pero ahora es más guay y fuerte, así que, ¿qué más da?
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ja:
クイーンに操られていたけれど
いまは強く　クールに成長。
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ko:
한 때 퀸에게 조종당했지만,
지금은 더 강하고 멋있어졌다나?
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.pl: Był kontrolowany przez Królową, ale teraz jest silniejszy i fajniejszy, więc w czym problem?
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.pt-BR: Foi controlado pela Rainha. Mas é mais forte e mais legal, então...?
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ru: Его контролировала Королева. Но теперь он сильнее и круче, так?
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.zh:
它被女王脑控着。
但是，它现在更强大也更酷炫了。
所以有什么不好呢？

scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.en: * (It has some kind of energy drink.)/
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.es: * (Está tomando algún tipo de bebida energética.)/
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ja:
＊ (エナジードリンク的なものを
　 飲んでいる)/

scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.de: Es träumt davon, Katz-und-Maus-Spiele zu spielen.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.en: It dreams of re-enacting scenes from cat and mouse cartoons.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.es: Sueña con interpretar las escenas de los dibujos animados sobre ratones y gatos.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ja:
某ネコとネズミのアニメを再現することを
夢見ている。
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ko:
고양이와 쥐가 나오는
애니메이션을 재현하는 게
꿈이다.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.pl: Marzy o zagraniu głównej roli w tamtej kreskówce z kotem i myszą.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.pt-BR: Sonha em encenar cenas de desenhos de gato e rato.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ru: Мечтает воспроизвести сцены из мультфильмов о кошках-мышках.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.zh:
它的梦中不断上演着
猫和老鼠卡通片里的情节。

scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ja: ポップアップをクリックすること
＊ (溶けたチーズを　飲んでいる)/

scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.de: Ein Virus mit kriminellem Hintergrund... und einem Herzen aus Gold.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.en: A virus with a slightly criminal streak... and a heart of gold.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.es: Un virus con un pequeño historial criminal... y un gran corazón.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ja:
ついつい犯罪に走りがち…
だけど根はいいヤツ。
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ko:
범죄에 빠지기 십상인 바이러스...
마음만은 착하다.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.pl: Wirus z wpisem w karkotece... i sercem ze złota.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.pt-BR: Um vírus com uma leve onda criminosa... e um coração de ouro.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ru: Вирус со слегка криминальной жилкой... и золотым сердцем.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.zh:
一款稍微有些犯罪倾向，
心地却很善良的病毒。

scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.de: * Willste meine Limo teilen? Dann werden wir beide krank... Hehe./
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.en: * Wanna share my soda? We'll both get sick that way... Hee hee./
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.es: * ¿Quieres probar mi soda? Así nos enfermaremos los dos... Jee, jee./
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ja:
＊ ボクのドリンク　ひと口飲む？
　 キミも　病気になっちゃうけどね。
　 ヒヒヒ。/
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ko:
* 내 음료수 같이 마실래?
  우리 같은 병에 걸리자...
  히 히./
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.pl: * Chcesz łyka? Wtedy oboje będziemy chorzy... Hee hee./
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.pt-BR: * Quer compartilhar meu refri? Assim nós dois vamos ficar doentes... Hee hee./
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ru: * Хочешь помочь мне с газировкой? Ну, так мы вместе заболеем... Хе-хе./
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.zh:
* 想不想尝尝我的汽水？
这样我们就可以一起闹肚子了... 嘻嘻。/

scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.de: Bunt und glücklich, er arbeitet immer flei€ig.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.en: Colorful and dandy, you can always count on him to work hard.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.es: Colorido y todo un caballero, siempre puedes confiar en que trabajará duro.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ja:
カラフルでダンディ。
どんなときでも仕事はキッチリ。
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ko:
컬러풀하고 댄디하다. 어떤 힘든 일이라도
언제나 믿고 맡길 수 있다.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.pl: Kolorowy i dostojny. Zawsze dobrze wykonuje zlecone zadania.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.pt-BR: Colorido e elegante, você sempre pode contar com ele pra trabalhar duro.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ru: Колоритный щегол, в сложных ситуациях на него всегда можно положиться.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.zh:
多彩而华丽。
你永远可以指望他努力工作。

scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.de: * Boss? Wollen wir zusammen einen Earl Grey trinken?/
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.en: * Boss? Shall we sit down and enjoy a nice earl grey?/
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.es: * ¿Líder? ¿Nos sentamos y disfrutamos de un buen té verde?/
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ja:
＊ ご主人さま。こちらのお席で
　 ごいっしょに　おいしい
　 アールグレイでも　いかがでしょう？/
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ko:
* 주인님? 이 쪽 자리에서 함께
  얼 그레이 한 잔 어떻습니까?/
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.pl: * Szefie? Czy masz ochotę usiąść ze mną i wypić filiżankę herbaty?/
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.pt-BR: * Chefia? Gostaria de sentar e beber um bom Earl Grey?/
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ru: * Босс? Как насчёт перерыва на прекрасный эрл грей?/
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.zh:
* 老板？我们要不要坐下一起喝一杯
伯爵红茶？/

scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.de: Es hat sich das Kabel mit Kampfgeist einverleibt. Wird schnell rot.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.en: It absorbed the wire with fighting spirit. Gets flustered easily.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.es: Ha absorbido el cable con su fuerza de voluntad. Se pone nervioso con facilidad.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ja:
闘志を燃やして　制御ケーブルを体内に
取り込んでしまった個体。
ちょっとのことですぐキョドる。
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ko:
투지를 불태워 전선을 흡수해버렸다.
쉽게 당황한다.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.pl: Jego wola walki umożliwiła mu wchłoniecie kabla. Łatwo go wytrącić z równowagi.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.pt-BR: Absorveu o fio com espírito de luta. Fica afobado facilmente.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ru: Поглотил провод под воздействием духа битвы. Чересчур возбудим.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.zh:
它凭借自己的斗志
把电线吸收掉了。
很容易慌神。

scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ja: スーパーチャージ戦法

scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.en: * (... it's crushing its energy drink with its hand...)/
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.es: * (... está sujetando con fuerza su bebida energética...)/
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ja:
＊ (…エナジードリンクの缶を
　 手で　にぎりつぶしている…)/
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ko:
* (... 손에 든 에너지 음료를
  짜부러뜨리고 있다...)/
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.pt-BR: * (... está esmagando seu energético com sua mão...)/

scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.de: Gleicht gerne Outfits aneinander an. Kann Clowns nicht ausstehen.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.en: Loves to coordinate outfits. Strongly dislikes clowns.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.es: Le gusta coordinar conjuntos. Odia los payasos.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ja:
服のコーディネートが大好き。
ピエロは大きらい。
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ko:
의상 코디를 매우 좋아하지만,
광대는 정말 싫어한다.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.pt-BR: Ama combinar roupas. Realmente não gosta de palhaços.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ru: Любит согласовывать наряды. Сильно не любит клоунов.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.zh:
喜欢搭配服装。
极度厌恶小丑。

scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ja: ニューウェーブ・シンセポップ

scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.es: Calcetines que no van a juego
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ja: そろっていないソックス

scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.de: Du hast 3 gro€e Mäuse rekrutiert und musst nun damit leben.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.en: You recruited 3 big mice and you're stuck with it.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.es: Reclutaste 3 ratones grandes y ahora te aguantas.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ja:
大きなネズミ３匹。
なかまにしてしまった以上　もう逃れる
すべはない。
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ko:
큰 쥐 세 마리를 영입한 이상
어쩔 수 없다.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.pl: Masz 3 myszy i teraz się z nimi męcz.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.pt-BR: Você recrutou 3 grandes ratos e está preso com eles.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ru: Вы пригласили три больших мыши и не знаете, что с ними делать.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.zh:
你招揽了三只大老鼠。
现在你甩不掉了。

scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.de: * (Es zieht Strom aus dem geschmolzenen Käse, wie ein Wasserrad.)/
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.en: * (It's getting electricity from the melted cheese like a water wheel)/
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.es: * (Está consiguiendo electricidad con el queso fundido imitando una rueda hidráulica.)/
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ja:
＊ (溶けたチーズを利用して
　 水力発電の要領で　電力を得ている)/
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ko:
* (녹인 치즈로 물레방아를 돌리며
  전기를 생산하고 있다.)/
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.pl: * (Uzyskuje energię ze stopionego sera niczym reaktor jądrowy.)/
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.pt-BR: * (Está ganhando eletricidade do queijo derretido como uma roda de água)/
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ru: * (Оно получает электричество из плавленого сыра, как водяное колесо)/
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.zh:
* （它正在利用融化的奶酪发电，
就像水车一样。）/

scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.de: Es liebt Musik, wird jedoch oft von fiesen Gestalten ausgenutzt.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.en: Passionate about music, but often taken advantage of by sinister types.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.es: Les apasiona la música, pero suelen aprovecharse de ellos gente siniestra.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ja:
音楽に情熱を燃やすが
悪意を持つ者に利用されやすい。
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ko: 음악에 대한 열정을 가졌지만, 악당에게 쉽게 이용당한다.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.pl: Jego pasją jest muzyka. Szemrani goście wykorzystują go do własnych celów.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.pt-BR: Apaixonado por música, mas costuma ser manipulado por indivíduos sinistros.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ru: Увлечён музыкой, но коварные типы часто пользуются им в своих интересах.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.zh:
热爱音乐，
但经常被心怀不轨的人利用。

scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.en: * (Seems to just be enjoying the musical ambience.)/
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.es: * (Seems to just be enjoying the musical ambience.)/
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ja:

scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.de: Es hätte gerne ein Retake! Etwas weiter links, weiter rechts, näher, näher, näher... Ooh la la.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.en: Don't scream...! It's not the real monster, just the Darkner. Ooo la la.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.es: ¡Rápido, posa!... Podría sacarte una foto en cualquier momento. Ooo la la.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ja:
手なの？　目なの？　両方なの？
やだぁ～ミステリアス～！
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ko: 비명 지르지 말아요...! 난 괴물이 아니라, 다크너일 뿐. 울랄라
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.pl: Nie krzycz...! Nie jestem prawdziwym potworem, tylko Ciemnianem. Ooo la la.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.pt-BR: Não grite...! Não é de fato o monstro, é só o Treviano. Ooo la la.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ru: Незачем так орать!.. Это не настоящий монстр, а лишь Тёмный. У-ля-ля.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.zh:
别尖叫...！并非真正的怪物，
只是暗之民而已。哦啦啦。

scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.de: * Schhh! Nicht bewegen... Ich mache ein Foto vom Drink!/
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.en: * Shush! Don't do the move... I am photographing the drink!/
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.es: * Shush! Don't do the move... I am photographing the drink!/
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ja:
＊ シッ！　話しかけないで…
　 ドリンクの写真　撮ってるんだから！/
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ko: * 쉿! 자세 잡지 마세요... 음료를 찍는 중이랍니다!/
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.pl: * Cii! Nie ruszaj się... Cykam fotki tego napoju!/
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.pt-BR: * Shush! Don't do the move... I am photographing the drink!/
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ru: * Тс-с-с! Не шевелись... я фотографирую напиток!/
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.zh:
* 嘘！别乱动...
我在给饮料拍特写呢！/

scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.de: Ein Türsteher, der Stärke vor Schönheit schätzt. Verirrt sich oft.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.en: A bouncer that favors brute force over beauty. Gets lost easily.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.es: Un segurata que prioriza la fuerza bruta a la belleza. Se pierde fácilmente.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ja:
見た目の美しさよりも　腕力重視な用心棒。
迷子になりがち。
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ko: 미보다는 무력을 선호하는 보안요원. 길을 자주 잃는다.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.pl: Klubowy bramkarz, który woli przemoc niż urodę. Łatwo się gubi.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.pt-BR: Um leão de chácara que prefere força bruta à beleza. Fica perdido facilmente.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ru: Прыгучий вышибала, предпочитающий грубую силу красоте. Легко теряется.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.zh:
一位更崇尚蛮力而非美貌的保镖。
很容易迷路。

scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ja: ボタンを押されること

scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.de: * Sag Bescheid, Boss... Ich mach' diesen Drink alle./
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.en: * Say da word, boss... I'll give dis drink a sip it won't forget./
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.es: * Say da word, boss... I'll give dis drink a sip it won't forget./
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ja:
＊ ボス　このドリンク　やっちまって
　 いいですか？　ズルッズルに
　 吸いつくしてやりますよ。/
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ko: * 사장님은 말만 하쇼... 이 컵을 (설거지에) 담궈버릴라니까./
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.pl: * Powiedz słówko, szefie... a wezmę łyka, który ten napój popamięta na zawsze./
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.pt-BR: * Say da word, boss... I'll give dis drink a sip it won't forget./
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ru: * Только дай знак, босс... я щас такой глоток сделаю, что пойло не забудет./
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.zh:
* 发个话吧老板...
我会让这杯饮料被喝得永生难忘。/

scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.de: Ein echter Wollmaus... Frosch. Kennt dreckige Tricks, spielt aber... dreckig.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.en: A real dust... frog. Known to play dirty, but loves to play... dirty.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.es: Una rana muy... polvorienta. Conocida por jugar sucio, pero le encanta jugar... sucio.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ja:
ホコリみたいな…カエル。
“汚い手”を使うと評判だが
ホントは…汚いことが好き。
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ko: 진짜 먼지... 개구리. 더럽게 논다고들 하지만... 더럽게 노는 걸 좋아한다.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.pl: Zakurzony zawodnik wagi... lekkiej. Znany z brudnych zagrywek, lecz mimo tego kocha... brudne serca.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.pt-BR: Um verdadeiro sapo... sujo. Conhecido por jogar sujo, mas ama jogar... sujo.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ru: Настоящая лягушка... из пыли. Известен за грязную игру, но любит играть... с грязью.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.zh:
一只真正的尘...蛙。
出了名的会玩脏手段，
但更喜欢...玩脏手段。

scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.en: * (Looks like it want to be dabbed with rubbing alcohol.)/

scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.zh: * （看起来它渴望被酒精棉片擦拭。）/

scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.de: Das gesprächige Büro-Sternchen. Trotz der rauhen Oberfläche ein echter Hingucker.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.en: The chatty office star. Obviously quite a looker despite her prudish wear.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.es: La estrella de los oficinistas charlatanes. Obviamente toda una belleza a pesar de su apariencia pudorosa.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ja:
おしゃべり好きの　オフィスの人気者。
おカタい服装をしているけれど
だれもが認める美人。
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ko: 사무실의 인기 수다쟁이. 수수하게 입었지만 상당한 미녀다.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.pl: Rozmowna gwiazda każdego biura. Piękna laska, która ukrywa się pod świętoszkowatym strojem.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.pt-BR: A estrela loquaz do escritório. Obviamente ela é de dar água na boca apesar de sua aparência recatada.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ru: Болтливая звезда офиса. Явно симпатичная, хоть и одевается скромно.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.zh:
办公室的话痨明星。
尽管穿着古朴，
却掩不住天生丽质。

* (Es scheint Wasser zu trinken.)
* (... schon fragwürdig.)/
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.en:
* (Seems like they're drinking water.)
* (... feels questionable.)/

* (Seems like they're drinking water.)
* (... feels questionable.)/

＊ (…それって　どうなのか)/

* (물을 마시고 있는 것 같다.)
* (... 따지고 싶어진다.)/

* （...总觉得不太对劲。）/

scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.de: Ein gerissener Zocker, der auf sein Glück wartet. ... oder schummelt.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.en: A sly customer that takes risk until luck strikes. ... cheating also works.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.es: Un astuto consumidor que toma riesgos hasta que la suerte le sonríe. ... hacer trampas también sirve.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ja:
ツキがめぐってくるまで　リスクを冒す。
イカサマぐせのある　要注意人物。
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ko: 운이 다할 때까지 지르고 보는 약삭빠른 고객... 운 대신 속임수도 쓴다.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.pl: Cwany klient, który ryzykuje, póki mu się nie poszczęści. ...a w razie potrzeby oszukuje.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.pt-BR: Um freguês fanfarrão que gosta de se arriscar até a sorte bater... mas trapacear funciona também.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ru: Хитрый клиент, который рискует, пока ему не повезёт. ...Не против и сжульничать.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.zh:
狡猾的赌徒，不撞大运不罢休。
... 就算要作弊也无所谓。

scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.de: * Das ist nicht mein Drink? Kein Stress. Ich halt' ihn blo€ warm./
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.en: * This drink's not mine? It's fine. I'm just keeping it warm./
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.es: * This drink's not mine? It's fine. I'm just keeping it warm./
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ja:
＊ このドリンク　ワイのとちゃうって？
　 心配せんでええ。
　 あっためとるだけやさかい。/
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ko: * 이 음료는 내 게 아니라고? 괜찮아. 그냥 따뜻하게 맡아두는 거야./
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.pl: * To nie mój napój? Spokojnie. Ja tylko pilnuję, by nie ostygł./
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.pt-BR: * This drink's not mine? It's fine. I'm just keeping it warm./
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ru: * Не мой напиток? Всё в порядке. Я просто сохраняю в нём тепло./
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.zh:
* 这杯饮料不是我的？
没关系。我只是在帮它保温。/

scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.de: Dieses Wetter-Mädel macht alle nass. Mit Regen, versteht sich.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.en: The weather girl who really "makes it rain." Like... with water, though.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.es: La chica del tiempo que tiende a aguar las fiestas... ¿para bien?
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ja:
いわゆる「レインメーカー」の
お天気おねえさん。
ただし　降らせるのは　ふつうに雨。
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ko: 비도 펑펑, 소비도 펑펑인 능력 있는 기상캐스터.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.pl: Pogodynka, dzięki której „pada”. Nie twoja firma... lecz deszcz.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.pt-BR: A garota do tempo que realmente deixa "o clima pesado". Só que... pesado de chuva, no caso.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ru: Девушка-синоптик, которая действительно «заливает». Но... водой, конечно же.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.zh:
“花钱如流水”的天气女孩。
不过... 流的是真正的水。

scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.de: * Oh nein, wo ist Lanino? Er wird wohl keine neue Teambeziehung haben.../
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.en: * Oh no, where's Lanino? He better not be having a team relationship.../
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.es: * Oh no, where's Lanino? He better not be having a team relationship.../
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ja:
＊ …ラニーノは　どこ！？
　 またチーム交際してたら　どうしよう…/
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ko:
* 이런, 라니뇨는 어디야?
  누구랑 팀 하고 있다간 두고 봐라.../
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.pl: * O nie, gdzie jest Lanino? Pożałuje, jeśli jest w jakiejś relacji grupowej.../
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.pt-BR: * Oh no, where's Lanino? He better not be having a team relationship.../
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ru: * О нет, где же Ланино? Лишь бы он не влез в групповые отношения.../
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.zh:
* 噢不，Lanino去哪了？
他最好没在搞什么多人关系.../

scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.de: Ein charmanter Wettermann, der das Wetter kontrolliert. Klingt unfair.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.en: A charming weatherman who can control the weather. Which, seems like cheating.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.es: Un encantador hombre del tiempo que puede controlar el clima. Lo cual es un poco hacer trampas.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ja:
天気をコントロールできる
お天気おにいさん。
でも　それってズルでは…？
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ko: 날씨를 조종할 수 있는 매력적인 기상캐스터. 근데 그건... 사기 아닌가?
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.pl: Czarujący pogodynek, który może kontrolować pogodę. Co jest trochę pójściem na skróty.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.pt-BR: Um charmoso senhor do tempo que pode controlar o tempo. O que, parece trapaça.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ru: Очаровательный синоптик, который может управлять погодой, что кажется довольно нечестным.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.zh:
富有魅力的气象员，可以控制天气。
听上去就和作弊一样。

scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.de: * Hatte schon lange kein Date alleine mehr! ... was dann kein Date wäre./
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.en: * Haven't been on a date alone for a while! ... which, isn't a date./
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.es: * Haven't been on a date alone for a while! ... which, isn't a date./
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ja:
＊ ひとりでデートなんて　ひさしぶりだ…
　 …ひとりだから
　 デートじゃないけど。/
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ko: * 데이트 나와서 혼자 있는 건 오랜만이네! ... 혼자 있는 건, 데이트가 아니니까./
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.pl: * Nie byłem sam na randce od dawna! ...jak coś to nie jest randka./
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.pt-BR: * Haven't been on a date alone for a while! ... which, isn't a date./
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ru: * Давненько не ходил на свидания один! ...что, на самом деле, и не свидание вовсе./
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.zh:
* 好久没独自一人出来约会了！
...但这也不算约会。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_294_0.ru: 8* Сейчас, похоже, отличный шанс подготовиться к битве./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_294_0.zh:
8* 不如我们趁着这个机会，
来为应对敌人做些准备吧？/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_309_0.de: 1I was so excited to teach you, I absolutely blanked!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_309_0.en: 1* I was so excited to teach you, I absolutely blanked!/

1＊ 教えてあげるのが
　 楽しみすぎて
　 うっかりしてたな…/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_309_0.ko:
1* 이것저것 잔뜩 가르쳐주고
  싶어서 정신이 없었어!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_309_0.pl: 1* Tak się zastanawiałem, czego cię nauczę, że przegapiłem tamtą walkę!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_309_0.pt-BR: 1* I was so excited to teach you, I absolutely blanked!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_309_0.ru: 1* Мне так не терпелось научить тебя, что я совершенно растерялся!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_309_0.zh:
1* 我一直期待着要教你，
搞得我都忘光了！/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_324_0.de: * No wonder Lancer was able to come through.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_324_0.en: * No wonder Lancer was able to come through.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_324_0.es: * No wonder Lancer was able to come through.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_324_0.ja:
＊ そっか…　ランサーさんが
　 こっち側へ来られたのは
　 そういうわけだったんだ…/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_324_0.pl: * Nie dziwota, że Lancer się tutaj dostał.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_324_0.pt-BR: * No wonder Lancer was able to come through.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_324_0.ru: * Неудивительно, что Лансер так легко пробрался сюда.../

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_326_0.de: * Kris, once we pass through this door.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_326_0.en: * Kris, once we pass through this door.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_326_0.es: * Kris, once we pass through this door.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_326_0.ja:
＊ クリス…
　 このとびらを抜けたら…/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_326_0.pl: * Kris, kiedy przekroczymy próg tych drzwi.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_326_0.pt-BR: * Kris, once we pass through this door.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_326_0.ru: * Крис, как только мы пройдём через эти врата.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_326_0.zh:
* Kris，一旦我们
通过了这扇门.../

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_327_0.en: * Our adventure will really begin./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_327_0.ja:
＊ ボクたちの旅は
　 本当に始まってしまう。/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_327_0.zh: * 我们的冒险就真正开始了。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_328_0.de: * A journey foretold exactly by the prophecy.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_328_0.en: * A journey foretold exactly by the prophecy.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_328_0.es: * A journey foretold exactly by the prophecy.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_328_0.ja:
＊ 予言に伝えられる
　 勇者の旅がね…/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_328_0.ko:
* 예언으로 전해 내려오는
  바로 그 여정.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_328_0.pt-BR: * A journey foretold exactly by the prophecy.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_328_0.zh: * 一段由预言所昭示的旅程.../

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_329_0.de: 6But, Kris, I believe YOUR choices are important, too./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_329_0.en: 6* But, Kris, I believe YOUR choices are important, too./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_329_0.es: 6* But, Kris, I believe YOUR choices are important, too./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_329_0.ja:
6＊ だけど…ボクは　キミが
　 自分の意志で決めることも
　 とても大事だと思うんだ。/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_329_0.ko:
6* 하지만, 크리스,
  난 네 선택도 중요하다고
  생각해./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_329_0.pl: 6* Ale Kris, wierzę, że TWOJE wybory też mają znaczenie./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_329_0.pt-BR: 6* But, Kris, I believe YOUR choices are important, too./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_329_0.ru: 6* Но, Крис, я верю, что ТВОЙ выбор тоже важен./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_329_0.zh:
6* 但是，Kris，我相信
【你】的选择也很重要。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_330_0.de: 0This world is full of all kinds of people, Kris./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_330_0.en: 0* This world is full of all kinds of people, Kris./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_330_0.es: 0* This world is full of all kinds of people, Kris./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_330_0.ja:
0＊ この世界には　本当に
　 いろんなひとたちがいる。/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_330_0.ko:
0* 이 세상엔 다양한
  사람들이 있지만, 크리스./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_330_0.pl: 0* W tym świecie pełno jest różnych osób, Kris./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_330_0.pt-BR: 0* This world is full of all kinds of people, Kris./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_330_0.ru: 0* Этот мир полон самых разных существ, Крис./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_330_0.zh:
0* 这个世界上充满了
形形色色的人，Kris。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_331_0.de: 6In the end, how we treat them makes all the difference./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_331_0.en: 6* In the end, how we treat them makes all the difference./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_331_0.es: 6* In the end, how we treat them makes all the difference./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_331_0.ja:
6＊ 大切なのは　そのひとたちと
　 どう接するか　だと思う。/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_331_0.ko:
6* 결국엔 우리가 그들을
  대하는 방식이 변화를
  만들어내지./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_331_0.pl: 6* To jak ich potraktujemy, zmieni bieg dziejów./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_331_0.pt-BR: 6* In the end, how we treat them makes all the difference./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_331_0.ru: 6* В конце концов, от того, как мы к ним отнесёмся, будет зависеть исход./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_331_0.zh:
6* 在最后，一切都会因为我们怎么
对待他们而不同。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_332_0.de: 8So let's try our best to get by without FIGHTing./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_332_0.en: 8* So let's try our best to get by without FIGHTing./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_332_0.es: 8* So let's try our best to get by without FIGHTing./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_332_0.ja:
8＊ だから　なるべく
　 誰とも　たたかわなくて
　 すむようにしよう。/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_332_0.ko:
8* 그러니 최선을 다해
  싸우지 않고 가도록 하자./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_332_0.pt-BR: 8* So let's try our best to get by without FIGHTing./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_332_0.ru: 8* Так что давай сделаем всё возможное, чтобы обойтись без СРАЖЕНИЙ./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_332_0.zh:
8* 所以尽我们最大的努力
避免【战斗】走下去吧。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_333_0.de: 1If we can manage to do that.../

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_333_0.es: 1* If we can manage to do that.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_333_0.pt-BR: 1* If we can manage to do that.../

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_334_0.de: 0I believe this tale may have a happy ending./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_334_0.en: 0* I believe this tale may have a happy ending./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_334_0.es: 0* I believe this tale may have a happy ending./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_334_0.ja:
0＊ この物語は
　 ハッピーエンドを
　 むかえられると思うんだ。/

0* 이 여정의 끝에는
  행복한 결말이 기다리고
  있을 거야./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_334_0.pl: 0* To wierzę, że ta historia będzie miała szczęśliwe zakończenie./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_334_0.pt-BR: 0* I believe this tale may have a happy ending./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_334_0.ru: 0* Я верю, что в этой истории наступит хороший конец./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_334_0.zh:
0* 我相信这个传说
会有一个圆满的结局。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_335_0.ja:
6＊ でも　そうしなかった
　 場合は…/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_335_0.pl: 6* A jeśli nie, to obawiam się, że.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_335_0.zh: 6* 如果不这样做的话，恐怕.../

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_336_0.de: 1... you may not... find the result favorable./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_336_0.en: 1* ... you may not... find the result favorable./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_336_0.es: 1* ... you may not... find the result favorable./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_336_0.ja:
1＊ キミにとって残念な結末に
　 なってしまうかもしれない…/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_336_0.ko:
1* ... 만족스러운 결말에...
  다다를 수 없을지도 몰라./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_336_0.pt-BR: 1* ... you may not... find the result favorable./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_336_0.zh:
1* ...你可能不会...
得到你喜欢的结果。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_337_0.de: 3... Oh, I'm sorry! Is that too much to ask?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_337_0.en: 3* ... Oh, I'm sorry! Is that too much to ask?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_337_0.es: 3* ... Oh, I'm sorry! Is that too much to ask?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_337_0.ja:
3＊ あ…ゴメン！
　 ちょっと難しい
　 お願いだったかな…？/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_337_0.pl: 3* Ach, przepraszam! Czy proszę o zbyt wiele?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_337_0.pt-BR: 3* ... Oh, I'm sorry! Is that too much to ask?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_337_0.zh:
3* ...噢，对不起！
我是不是要求得过多了？/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_343_0.de: 0Kris, I knew you were a hero the moment I saw you./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_343_0.en: 0* Kris, I knew you were a hero the moment I saw you./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_343_0.es: 0* Kris, I knew you were a hero the moment I saw you./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_343_0.ja:
0＊ やっぱり　キミは勇者だ！
　 一目見た瞬間
　 そう思ったよ。/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_343_0.ko:
0* 크리스, 널 처음 본 순간
  네가 영웅이란 걸 직감했어./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_343_0.pl: 0* Kris, takie słowa mógłby powiedzieć tylko prawdziwy bohater./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_343_0.pt-BR: 0* Kris, I knew you were a hero the moment I saw you./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_343_0.ru: 0* Крис, я понял, что ты герой, как только увидел тебя./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_343_0.zh:
0* Kris，见到你的那一瞬间
我就知道你是个英雄。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_344_0.ja: 8＊ それじゃ　がんばろうね。/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_344_0.ru: 8* Давай постараемся изо всех сил, хорошо?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_344_0.zh: 8* 尽我们最大的努力吧，好吗？/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_349_0.de: 6Kris, in the end, what you choose is up to you./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_349_0.en: 6* Kris, in the end, what you choose is up to you./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_349_0.es: 6* Kris, in the end, what you choose is up to you./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_349_0.ja:
6＊ やっぱり　気にしないで。
　 どうするかは
　 キミの自由だから。/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_349_0.ko:
6* 결국 선택은, 크리스,
  네가 하는 거니까./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_349_0.pl: 6* Kris, ostatecznie wybór należy do ciebie./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_349_0.pt-BR: 6* Kris, in the end, what you choose is up to you./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_349_0.ru: 6* Крис, в конце концов, твой выбор зависит от тебя./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_349_0.zh:
6* Kris，到最后，
一切选择都在于你。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_350_0.de: 8As long as you're happy with it, I'm happy too./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_350_0.en: 8* As long as you're happy with it, I'm happy too./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_350_0.es: 8* As long as you're happy with it, I'm happy too./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_350_0.ja:
8＊ キミが満足なら
　 ボクも　それで満足だよ。/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_350_0.pl: 8* Jeśli rezultat będzie cię satysfakcjonował, to i ja będę zadowolony./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_350_0.pt-BR: 8* As long as you're happy with it, I'm happy too./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_350_0.ru: 8* Пока тебя это счастливит, я тоже буду счастлив./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_350_0.zh:
8* 只要你开心就好，
你开心我就开心。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_351_0.de: 0So just try your best, and don't worry!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_351_0.en: 0* So just try your best, and don't worry!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_351_0.es: 0* So just try your best, and don't worry!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_351_0.ja:

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_613_0.es: 2* Don't worry, there's no way you can bore me right now!/

2＊ えんりょは　いらないぞ。
　 おじさん　いま　ヒマだけは
　 たーっぷりあるからねえ！/

2* 부담 갖지 말고,

  세상에서 제일 심심하거든!/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_613_0.pt-BR: 2* Don't worry, there's no way you can bore me right now!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_613_0.ru: 2* Не волнуйся, сейчас ты мне никак не наскучишь!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_613_0.zh:
2* 别担心，你讲什么我都不会
嫌你无聊的！/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_619_0.de:
2Hahaha, that's what I thought!

2* Hahaha, that's what I thought!

* She's a PEACH, huh...?/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_619_0.pt-BR:
2* Hahaha, that's what I thought!
* She's a PEACH, huh...?/

2* Ха-ха-ха, так я и думал!
* Она тот ещё ПЕРСИК, да?../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_619_0.zh:
2* 哈哈，我就是那么想的！

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_620_0.de: 7Fuzzy n' sweet on the outside, a total NUT on the inside!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_620_0.en: 7* Fuzzy n' sweet on the outside, a total NUT on the inside!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_620_0.es: 7* Fuzzy n' sweet on the outside, a total NUT on the inside!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_620_0.ja:
7＊ そとは　フワフワで
　 スイート…　でも　しんは
　 ゴツゴツの　カッチカチだ！/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_620_0.ko:
7* 겉은 다정하고 푹신하지만,
  잘못 물면 주둥이가 깨지지!/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_620_0.pt-BR: 7* Fuzzy n' sweet on the outside, a total NUT on the inside!/

7* 表面和桃一样毛茸又甜蜜，

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_621_0.de: 0Oh, your dad? Yeah, he's a real fruit himself too./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_621_0.en: 0* Oh, your dad? Yeah, he's a real fruit himself too./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_621_0.es: 0* Oh, your dad? Yeah, he's a real fruit himself too./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_621_0.ja:
0＊ ん？　きみのパパかい？
　 アズゴアも　やっぱり
　 フルーツみたいなヤツだよ。/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_621_0.ko:
0* 너희 아빠?
  그 친구도 
  과일은 과일이지./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_621_0.pl: 0* Ach, a twój tata? Ta, też mogę go porównać do owoca./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_621_0.pt-BR: 0* Oh, your dad? Yeah, he's a real fruit himself too./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_621_0.ru: 0* Ох, твой папа? Да, он тоже тот ещё фрукт./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_621_0.zh:
0* 哦，你爸爸？
唔，他这家伙也能是个水果。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_622_0.de: 7Which one? I dunno, probably a hairy one... like a kiwi./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_622_0.en: 7* Which one? I dunno, probably a hairy one... like a kiwi./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_622_0.es: 7* Which one? I dunno, probably a hairy one... like a kiwi./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_622_0.ja:
7＊ どのフルーツかって？

　 だから…　キウイ　かな？/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_622_0.ko:
7* 무슨 과일이냐고?
  글쎄다, 털 많은 과일이지...
  키위라든지./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_622_0.pl: 7* Do którego? Nie wiem, ale pewnie jakiegoś włochatego... jak kiwi./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_622_0.pt-BR: 7* Which one? I dunno, probably a hairy one... like a kiwi./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_622_0.ru: 7* Какой из? Без понятия, какой-нибудь волосатый... как киви./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_622_0.zh:
7* 哪种水果？我不知道，
估计也是毛茸茸的水果...
比如猕猴桃。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_626_0.en: 0* Okay, okay, seriously, you wanna chat or something?/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_630_0.de:
1Really?
* You've grown up a lot, Kris./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_630_0.en:
1* Really?
* You've grown up a lot, Kris./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_630_0.es:
1* Really?
* You've grown up a lot, Kris./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_630_0.ja:
1＊ へえ？

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_630_0.pt-BR:
1* Really?

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_630_0.zh:
1* 真的吗？
* 你真是长大了啊，Kris。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_631_0.ja: 4＊ おじさんも　うれしいよ。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_632_0.de: 5Wasn't too long ago you were just the creepy kid next door./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_632_0.en: 5* Wasn't too long ago you were just the creepy kid next door./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_632_0.es: 5* Wasn't too long ago you were just the creepy kid next door./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_632_0.ja:
5＊ ちょっと　まえまで　なにを
　 かんがえてるのか　わからん
　 おとなりのコ　だったのに。/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_632_0.ko:
5* 엊그제만 해도
  그냥 옆집 사는 괴상한

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_632_0.zh:
5* 不久之前你还只是隔壁家的

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_633_0.de: 7Now you're the creepy kid right in front of me!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_633_0.en: 7* Now you're the creepy kid right in front of me!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_633_0.es: 7* Now you're the creepy kid right in front of me!/

7＊ いまじゃ　なにを
　 かんがえてるのか　わからん
　 めのまえのコだ！/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_633_0.ko:
7* 이젠 내 눈앞의
  괴상한 꼬마가
  됐잖아!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_633_0.pl: 7* Ale w rzeczywistości jesteś dziwnym dzieciakiem u mego boku!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_633_0.pt-BR: 7* Now you're the creepy kid right in front of me!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_633_0.ru: 7* А сейчас ты жуткий ребёнок, что стоит передо мной!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_633_0.zh:
7* 现在你成为了在我面前的
怪小孩！/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_647_0.de: 0Smart, kind, sweet... couldn't ask for a better daughter./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_647_0.en: 0* Smart, kind, sweet... couldn't ask for a better daughter./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_647_0.es: 0* Smart, kind, sweet... couldn't ask for a better daughter./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_647_0.ja:
0＊ かしこくて　やさしくて…
　 おじさんには　もったいない
　 ぐらいの　むすめだよ。/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_647_0.ko:
0* 머리 좋고, 착하고... 
  더 바랄 게 없는
  딸이야./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_647_0.pl: 0* Mądra, miła, słodka... nie mógłbym mieć lepszej córki./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_647_0.pt-BR: 0* Smart, kind, sweet... couldn't ask for a better daughter./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_647_0.ru: 0* Умная, добрая, милая... мог ли я мечтать о лучшей дочери?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_647_0.zh:
0* 聪明，善良，可爱...
没有比她更好的女儿了。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_648_0.de: 5I just wish she wasn't so... defenseless./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_648_0.en: 5* I just wish she wasn't so... defenseless./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_648_0.es: 5* I just wish she wasn't so... defenseless./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_648_0.ja:
5＊ ただなあ…　こわがりな
　 ところだけは　おじさんも
　 きがかりでねえ。/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_648_0.ko:
5* 그냥 지금보다 조금 더...
  강하게 자랐으면 좋겠어./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_648_0.pl: 5* Chciałbym tylko, by nie była taka... bezbronna./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_648_0.pt-BR: 5* I just wish she wasn't so... defenseless./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_648_0.ru: 5* Я лишь желаю, чтобы она не была столь... беззащитной./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_648_0.zh:
5* 但我希望她不要那么的... 
胆小。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_649_0.de: 1Scary movies, bugs, Santa Claus... everything scares her./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_649_0.en: 1* Scary movies, bugs, Santa Claus... everything scares her./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_649_0.es: 1* Scary movies, bugs, Santa Claus... everything scares her./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_649_0.ja:
1＊ ホラーえいがに　ムシに
　 サンタクロース…　とにかく
　 なんでもこわがって…/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_649_0.ko:
1* 공포영화, 벌레,
  산타클로스...
* 너무 많은 걸 힘들어 해./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_649_0.pl: 1* Horrory, robaki, Święty Mikołaj... wszystko ją przeraża./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_649_0.pt-BR: 1* Scary movies, bugs, Santa Claus... everything scares her./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_649_0.ru: 1* Ужастики, жуки, Санта-Клаус... всё пугает её./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_649_0.zh:
1* 恐怖电影，虫子，圣诞老人... 
什么东西都会吓到她。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_650_0.de: 5And when it happens, she freezes like a deer in headlights./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_650_0.en: 5* And when it happens, she freezes like a deer in headlights./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_650_0.es: 5* And when it happens, she freezes like a deer in headlights./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_650_0.ja:
5＊ ヘッドライトに　てらされた
　 シカみたいに
　 かたまってしまうだろう？/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_650_0.ko:
5* 무슨 일만 났다 하면
  차도에 뛰어든 사슴처럼
  얼어버리고 말이야./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_650_0.pl: 5* A wtedy paraliżuje ją jak jelenia na drodze./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_650_0.pt-BR: 5* And when it happens, she freezes like a deer in headlights./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_650_0.ru: 5* И когда это случается, она застывает, как олень в свете фар./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_650_0.zh:
5* 她被吓到的时候，就像暴露在
车灯前的小鹿一样无助。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_651_0.de: 0Remember she used to even be afraid of humans under the bed?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_651_0.en: 0* Remember she used to even be afraid of humans under the bed?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_651_0.es: 0* Remember she used to even be afraid of humans under the bed?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_651_0.ja:
0＊ ちいさいころは　ベッドの
　 したに　ニンゲンがいると
　 いって　こわがってたしな。/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_651_0.ko:
0* 그 녀석
  침대 밑의 인간 괴담에
  벌벌 떨던 것도 기억하니?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_651_0.pl: 0* Pamiętasz, jak kiedyś bała się ludzi spod łóżka?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_651_0.pt-BR: 0* Remember she used to even be afraid of humans under the bed?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_651_0.ru: 0* Помню, раньше она даже боялась людей под кроватью./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_651_0.zh:
0* 你还记得她以前总是害怕
床底下藏有人类吗？/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_652_0.de: 7(Kris, it was NOT nice of you to hide under there, by the way!)/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_652_0.en: 7* (Kris, it was NOT nice of you to hide under there, by the way!)/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_652_0.es: 7* (Kris, it was NOT nice of you to hide under there, by the way!)/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_652_0.ja:

7* (그때 네가 침대 밑에

你那次藏在床底下是
很不对的！）/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_653_0.es: 1* ... anyhow, that's what's tough about being in here, Kris./

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_653_0.zh:
1* ...总之，这地方让人十分煎熬，

4＊ じぶんの　からだのこと

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_655_0.de: 5Just that... in the meantime, I can't be there to protect her./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_655_0.en: 5* Just that... in the meantime, I can't be there to protect her./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_655_0.es: 5* Just that... in the meantime, I can't be there to protect her./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_655_0.ja:
5＊ ノエルを　ちかくで
　 まもってやれない…
　 それが　なにより　つらい。/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_655_0.ko:
5* 여기에... 있는 동안은,
  그 애를 지켜줄 수가 없으니까./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_655_0.pl: 5* Tylko o to... że nie mogę jej teraz chronić./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_655_0.pt-BR: 5* Just that... in the meantime, I can't be there to protect her./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_655_0.ru: 5* А потому... что в данный момент я не могу её защитить./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_655_0.zh:
5* 是因为... 现在我没办法
在她身边保护她。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_656_0.de: 3Keep an eye out for her, OK?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_656_0.en: 3* Keep an eye out for her, OK?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_656_0.es: 3* Keep an eye out for her, OK?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_656_0.ja:
3＊ あのコのこと
　 よろしく　たのむよ？/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_656_0.ko:
3* 녀석 좀 별일 없게
  지켜봐 다오, 
  알겠지?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_656_0.pt-BR: 3* Keep an eye out for her, OK?/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_660_0.de: 3Kris, even if we've grown apart, we still love your family./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_660_0.en: 3* Kris, even if we've grown apart, we still love your family./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_660_0.es: 3* Kris, even if we've grown apart, we still love your family./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_660_0.ja:
3＊ うちの一家は　みんな
　 いまでも　クリスのかぞくが
　 だいすきだ。/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_660_0.ko:
3* 크리스,
  우리가 떨어져 살긴 했지만, 
  너희 가족은 소중해./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_660_0.pl: 3* Kris, mimo rozłąki, twoja rodzina nadal jest nam bliska./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_660_0.pt-BR: 3* Kris, even if we've grown apart, we still love your family./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_660_0.ru: 3* Крис, хоть наши пути и разошлись, мы всё ещё любим твою семью./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_660_0.zh:
3* Kris，即使我们分道扬镳了，
我们还是很爱你们一家。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_661_0.de: 4After all, me and Asgore were college pals, right?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_661_0.en: 4* After all, me and Asgore were college pals, right?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_661_0.es: 4* After all, me and Asgore were college pals, right?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_661_0.ja:
1＊ そういえば…
　 アズ坊も　もう
　 だいがくせいか…/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_661_0.ko:
4* 어찌 됐든 너희 아빠랑 나는
  대학 친구였으니까./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_661_0.pl: 4* Co więcej, jestem najlepszym kumplem Asgore'a od studiów./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_661_0.pt-BR: 4* After all, me and Asgore were college pals, right?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_661_0.ru: 4* В конце концов, мы с твоим отцом учились вместе в колледже, так?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_661_0.zh:
1* 再怎么说，我和Asgore
在大学里就是好哥们了，对吧？/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_662_0.de: 1Oh hey... now that Asriel's off to college.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_662_0.en: 1* Oh hey... now that Asriel's off to college.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_662_0.es: 1* Oh hey... now that Asriel's off to college.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_662_0.ja:
1＊ そういえば…
　 アズ坊も　もう
　 だいがくせいか…/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_662_0.ko:
1* 아... 그러고 보면
  아스리엘도 이제
  대학에 갔으니.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_662_0.pl: 1* Hm... Asriel teraz wyjechał na studia, czyż nie?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_662_0.pt-BR: 1* Oh hey... now that Asriel's off to college.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_662_0.ru: 1* Ох, кстати... Теперь, когда Азриэль в колледже.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_662_0.zh:
1* 哦对了...
既然Asriel现在去上大学了.../

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_663_0.de: 2Y'think he's doing any CRAZY parties, like me and your dad?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_663_0.en: 2* Y'think he's doing any CRAZY parties, like me and your dad?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_663_0.es: 2* Y'think he's doing any CRAZY parties, like me and your dad?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_663_0.ja:
2＊ おじさんと　クリスのパパが
　 だいがくせいの　ころは
　 パーティざんまいだったぞ！/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_663_0.ko:
2* 나랑 네 아빠처럼
  광란의 파티라도,
  하지 않을까?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_663_0.pl: 2* Myślisz, że chodzi na takie SZALONE imprezy jak ja i twój tata?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_663_0.pt-BR: 2* Y'think he's doing any CRAZY parties, like me and your dad?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_663_0.ru: 2* Думаешь, он закатывает БЕЗУМНЫЕ вечеринки, как мы с твоим папой?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_663_0.zh:
2* 你觉得他会像我和你爸那样，
去那种疯狂的派对吗？/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_664_0.de: 3Heh, I'm just pulling your leg. Your dad was no party animal./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_664_0.en: 3* Heh, I'm just pulling your leg. Your dad was no party animal./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_664_0.es: 3* Heh, I'm just pulling your leg. Your dad was no party animal./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_664_0.ja:
3＊ …なーんてな。アズゴアは
　 パーティモンスターなんか
　 じゃ　なかったさ。/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_664_0.ko:
3* 헤, 농담이야.
  아스고어는 파티에 
  어울리는 녀석은 아니지./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_664_0.pl: 3* Heh, tylko sobie żartuję. Twój tata nie był imprezowiczem./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_664_0.pt-BR: 3* Heh, I'm just pulling your leg. Your dad was no party animal./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_664_0.ru: 3* Хех, я просто шучу. Твой отец никогда не был тусовщиком./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_664_0.zh:
3* 哈，我开玩笑的。
你爸不是个派对狂。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_665_0.de: 7Your MOTHER on the other hand...! Whoo!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_665_0.en: 7* Your MOTHER on the other hand...! Whoo!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_665_0.es: 7* Your MOTHER on the other hand...! Whoo!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_665_0.ja:
7＊ でも　クリスのママは…
　 ありゃ　すじがねいり
　 だったなあ！/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_665_0.pt-BR: 7* Your MOTHER on the other hand...! Whoo!/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_666_0.de: 4She'd alway fuss about going, but once the party started.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_666_0.en: 4* She'd alway fuss about going, but once the party started.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_666_0.es: 4* She'd alway fuss about going, but once the party started.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_666_0.ja:
4＊ いつも　でかけるまでは
　 「いきたくない」って
　 さんざん　しぶるクセに…/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_666_0.ko:
4* 가자고 하면 망설이지만,
  일단 분위기 탔다 하면.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_666_0.pl: 4* Wychodząc zawsze się ociągała, ale kiedy impra się zaczynała.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_666_0.pt-BR: 4* She'd alway fuss about going, but once the party started.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_666_0.ru: 4* Она всегда беспокоится перед походом, но стоит только вечеринке начаться.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_666_0.zh:
4* 她老是在去之前抱怨，
但派对一开始.../

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_667_0.ja:
7＊ パーティが　はじまった
　 とたん　はじけるんだから
　 なあ！/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_668_0.de: 7Once she hit me clear across the room with a key lime pie!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_668_0.en: 7* Once she hit me clear across the room with a key lime pie!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_668_0.es: 7* Once she hit me clear across the room with a key lime pie!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_668_0.ja:
7＊ パーティかいじょうで
　 とおくから　ライムパイを
　 なげつけられたこともある！/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_668_0.ko:
7* 한 번은 나한테
  파티장을 가로질러서
  라임 파이를 맞췄다니까!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_668_0.pl: 7* Raz rzuciła we mnie tartą limonkową z drugiego końca pokoju!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_668_0.pt-BR: 7* Once she hit me clear across the room with a key lime pie!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_668_0.ru: 7* Однажды она швырнула в меня лаймовый пирог! Через всё помещение!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_668_0.zh:
7* 有次她在房间的另一头
丢了个青柠派在我头上！/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_669_0.de: 2I got smashed into the snack table and toppled everything!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_669_0.en: 2* I got smashed into the snack table and toppled everything!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_669_0.es: 2* I got smashed into the snack table and toppled everything!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_669_0.ja:
2＊ おじさん　テーブルに
　 つっこんで　りょうりが
　 ぜんぶ　だいなしになった！/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_669_0.ko:
2* 난 테이블로 쓰러지면서
  소스에 과자에 엉망이 됐고!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_669_0.pl: 2* Wleciała we mnie z takim impetem, że wywróciłem stolik z przekąskami!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_669_0.pt-BR: 2* I got smashed into the snack table and toppled everything!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_669_0.ru: 2* Я врезался в стол с закусками и всё повалил!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_669_0.zh:
2* 我直接摔到零食桌上，
弄翻了所有东西！/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_670_0.ja:
7＊ ま　おいしいパイ
　 だったからね。
　 うらみっこナシさ。/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_670_0.pl: 7* I tak, tarta była wybitna. Nie miałem na co narzekać./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_670_0.ru: 7* А пирог-то был вкусный! С этим не поспоришь./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_670_0.zh:
7* 派倒是挺好吃的。
没什么好抱怨的。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_674_0.de: 1... So, why am I in here...?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_674_0.en: 1* ... So, why am I in here...?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_674_0.es: 1* ... So, why am I in here...?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_674_0.ja:
1＊ おじさんが
　 にゅういんしてる
　 りゆうかい…？/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_674_0.pt-BR: 1* ... So, why am I in here...?/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_675_0.de: 4Well, they found some crap, so it's just some tests./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_675_0.en: 4* Well, they found some crap, so it's just some tests./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_675_0.es: 4* Well, they found some crap, so it's just some tests./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_675_0.ja:
4＊ ちょっと　マズいもんが
　 みつかったんで　くわしく
　 けんさしてもらってるんだ。/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_675_0.ko:
4* 글쎄, 뭔 거지 같은 걸
  발견했대서, 그냥 검사야./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_675_0.pl: 4* Cóż, odkryli jakieś gówno, więc teraz mnie badają./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_675_0.pt-BR: 4* Well, they found some crap, so it's just some tests./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_675_0.ru: 4* Ну, они нашли какую-то дрянь и теперь гоняют по докторам./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_675_0.zh:
4* 这个嘛，他们查出了点毛病，
所以要做些检查。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_676_0.de: 3Yeah, it's no big deal. Nothing a Holiday can't handle./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_676_0.en: 3* Yeah, it's no big deal. Nothing a Holiday can't handle./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_676_0.es: 3* Yeah, it's no big deal. Nothing a Holiday can't handle./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_676_0.ja:
3＊ なあに　しんぱいないさ。
　 ホリデー家のオトコたるもの
　 これぐらい　よゆうだよ。/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_676_0.ko:
3* 별일 아니야.
  홀리데이 가문을 뭐로 보고./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_676_0.pl: 3* Ale to nic poważnego. Nic, czego Holiday nie byłby w stanie znieść./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_676_0.pt-BR: 3* Yeah, it's no big deal. Nothing a Holiday can't handle./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_676_0.ru: 3* Ага, ничего серьёзного. Нет ничего, с чем Руди не справился бы./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_676_0.zh:
3* 没错，没什么大不了的。
我们Holiday家的人两三天
就能好了滴。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_677_0.de: 4I'll be outta here in a jiff, then I can go back to, I dunno.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_677_0.en: 4* I'll be outta here in a jiff, then I can go back to, I dunno.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_677_0.es: 4* I'll be outta here in a jiff, then I can go back to, I dunno.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_677_0.ja:
4＊ あっというまに　たいいんだ。
　 すぐに　また
　 いつもみたいに…/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_677_0.ko:
4* 얼마 안 가 나갈 거다.
  하던 일은 계속 못 하겠지만.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_677_0.pl: 4* Lada chwila stąd wyjdę i będę mógł znowu, no nie wiem.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_677_0.pt-BR: 4* I'll be outta here in a jiff, then I can go back to, I dunno.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_677_0.ru: 4* Я свалю отсюда в мгновение ока, и вновь смогу, ну не знаю.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_677_0.zh:
4* 一转眼我就能出院了，
然后就可以回家，呃.../

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_678_0.de: 2Yelling at you for getting tangled in our light display./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_678_0.en: 2* Yelling at you for getting tangled in our light display./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_678_0.es: 2* Yelling at you for getting tangled in our light display./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_678_0.ja:
2＊ うちの　にわの　でんしょくの
　 コードに　からまったクリスを
　 どなりつけたり　できるさ！/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_678_0.ko:
2* 우리 집 정원 전구 줄에
  꽁꽁 묶인 너한테 구박하던
  시절로 돌아갈 순 있겠지./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_678_0.pl: 2* Nakrzyczeć na ciebie za zaplątanie się w nasze dekoracje./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_678_0.pt-BR: 2* Yelling at you for getting tangled in our light display./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_678_0.ru: 2* Кричать на тебя, когда ты опять влезешь в наши наружные гирлянды./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_678_0.zh:
2* 在你被俺家彩灯绳缠住
的时候，好好训斥训斥你。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_683_0.de: 2Then what the hell're you here for, Kris!? To gawk!?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_683_0.en: 2* Then what the hell're you here for, Kris!? To gawk!?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_683_0.es: 2* Then what the hell're you here for, Kris!? To gawk!?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_683_0.ja:
2＊ じゃあ　なにしに
　 きたんだい！？　おじさんを
　 かんさつしに　きたのかい？/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_683_0.ko:
2* 그럼 대체
  뭐 하러 온 거니, 크리스?
  쳐다보러!?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_683_0.pl: 2* To po cholerę tu jesteś, Kris!? By się na mnie gapić!?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_683_0.pt-BR: 2* Then what the hell're you here for, Kris!? To gawk!?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_683_0.ru: 2* Тогда зачем ты здесь, Крис?! Потаращиться?!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_683_0.zh:
2* 那你在这里
搞什么鬼啦，Kris！？
发呆？/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_684_0.de: 7You thought this was the zoo or something!? C'mon!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_684_0.en: 7* You thought this was the zoo or something!? C'mon!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_684_0.es: 7* You thought this was the zoo or something!? C'mon!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_684_0.ja:
7＊ まったく！　ここは
　 どうぶつえんじゃ
　 ないぞ！　ハッハッハ！/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_684_0.ko:
7* 여기가 무슨
  동물원인 줄 아니!? 좀!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_684_0.pl: 7* Myślisz, że jesteś w zoo!? No proszę cię!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_684_0.pt-BR: 7* You thought this was the zoo or something!? C'mon!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_684_0.ru: 7* По-твоему, тут зоопарк или что?! Чел!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_684_0.zh:
7* 你以为这里是动物园吗！？
别这样啦！/

* (There's an anime review.)
