scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1332_0.ko:
1* 안 돼! 안 돼!
* 날 보고 있잖아!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1332_0.pl:
1* O nie, o nie!
* Czy ja spojrzałem jej prosto w oczy?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1332_0.pt-BR:
1* Oh no, oh no!
* She's looking at ME!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1332_0.ru:
1* О нет, о нет!
* Она глядит на МЕНЯ!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1332_0.zh:
1* 噢！不好！
* 她在瞪着我呢！/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1336_0.en: * Susie's gone, so no attack./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1336_0.ja:
＊ スージィいないよ。
　 こうげきしないィ。/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1336_0.pl: * Susie z wami nie ma, więc o ataku cicho./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1336_0.ru: * Сьюзи тут нет, нас никто не побьёт./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1336_0.zh: * Susie已经离去，再也没有攻击。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1337_0.de: * Will you two pick up the slack?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1337_0.en: * Will you two pick up the slack?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1337_0.es: * Will you two pick up the slack?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1337_0.ja:
＊ キミたち２人が
　 すりゃいんじゃないィ？/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1337_0.pl: * Mamy szczerą nadzieję, że ją weźmie licho./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1337_0.pt-BR: * Will you two pick up the slack?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1337_0.ru: * Кто-то из вас ей в замену придёт?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1337_0.zh: * 你们俩还能否收拾这场残局？/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1342_0.de: * Susie's BUSTER, RUDE as may be.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1342_0.en: * Susie's BUSTER, RUDE as may be.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1342_0.es: * Susie's BUSTER, RUDE as may be.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1342_0.ja:
＊ 「ルードバスター」
　 スージィの技ァ…/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1342_0.pt-BR: * FOGO da Susie, tão BRUTAL quanto ela pode ser.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1342_0.ru: * ВЗМАХ ЯРЫЙ у Сьюзи, насилье цветёт.../

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1343_0.en: * Will deal more damage, if you just press [~1]!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1343_0.es: * Will deal more damage, if you just press [~1]!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1343_0.ja: ＊ 大ダメージ与える 　 [~1]を押せばァ！/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1343_0.ko: * [~1]을 누르기만 하면 더 큰 피해를 줄 수 있어!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1343_0.ru: * нанесёт больше урона, если ты нажмёшь [~1]!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1343_0.zh: * 只要你按下[~1]，伤害就会提高！ /

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1349_0.de:
* Susie loves, when you give us MONEY.
* She will -/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1349_0.en:
* Susie loves, when you give us MONEY.
* She will -/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1349_0.es:
* Susie loves, when you give us MONEY.
* She will -/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1349_0.ja:
＊ スージィよろこぶ　どんなときィ？
　 キミが　ボクらに　おカn…/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1349_0.ko:
* 수지는 네가 우리에게
  돈을 주면 아주 기뻐해./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1349_0.pl:
* Susie uwiebia, jak dajesz nam KASĘ.
* Ona wtedy.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1349_0.pt-BR:
* Susie loves, when you give us MONEY.
* She will -/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1349_0.ru:
* Сьюзи любит, когда вы даёте нам ДЕНЬГИ.
* Она будет.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1349_0.zh:
* Susie喜欢你给我们钱。
* 她会-/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1351_0.ja:
＊ ベツに。
　 どーでもいいな。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1353_0.ja:
1＊ ボク　なんか
　 ヘンなこと言った！？/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1353_0.zh: 1* 我说了什么好笑的话吗！？/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1356_0.en: * Susie's gone, so no facts./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1356_0.ja:
＊ スージィいないよ。
　 マメ知識も　ないよォ。/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1356_0.pl: * Susie z wami nie ma, więc i faktów brak./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1356_0.ru: * Сьюзи исчезла, значит фактам не место./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1356_0.zh: * Susie已经离去，小知识没意义。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1357_0.de: * Will you two pick up the slackts?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1357_0.en: * Will you two pick up the slackts?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1357_0.es: * Will you two pick up the slackts?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1357_0.ja:
＊ キミたち２人が
　 すりゃいんじゃないォ？/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1357_0.pl: * I tak wiecie o niej wszystko, czyż nie jest tak?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1357_0.pt-BR: * Will you two pick up the slackts?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1357_0.ru: * Может, кто-то из вас займёт её место?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1357_0.zh: * 你们俩还能否收拾这场残局？/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1361_0.de: * SUSIE seems to have changed, just a hair./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1361_0.en: * SUSIE seems to have changed, just a hair./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1361_0.es: * SUSIE seems to have changed, just a hair./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1361_0.ja: ＊ スージィ変わった　毛ほどの変化ァ。/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1361_0.pl: * Poprawa zachowania SUSIE, to niezła zagadka./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1361_0.pt-BR: * SUSIE seems to have changed, just a hair./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1361_0.ru: * Сьюзи ныне другая, перемен лишь настрой./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1361_0.zh: * 看来SUSIE总算有了，一丝丝改变。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1362_0.de: * That kind of growth is actually rare./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1362_0.en: * That kind of growth is actually rare./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1362_0.es: * That kind of growth is actually rare./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1362_0.ja: ＊ そんな成長　かなりレアァ！/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1362_0.ko: * 이런 거 살짝 드문 것 같아./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1362_0.pl: * Taka zmiana charakteru jest dziś bardzo rzadka./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1362_0.pt-BR: * That kind of growth is actually rare./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1362_0.ru: * Как мало всех тех, кто растёт над собой./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1362_0.zh: * 这样的成长还是挺罕见。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1378_0.de:
* I'm Kris Master.
* Ask me about KRIS's./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1378_0.en:
* I'm Kris Master.
* Ask me about KRIS's./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1378_0.es:
* I'm Kris Master.
* Ask me about KRIS's./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1378_0.ja:
＊ ボクは　クリス・マスター。
＊ クリスのことなら　なんでも聞いて。/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1378_0.ko:
* 나는 크리스 마스터.
* 크리스에 관한 거라면
  뭐든 물어봐./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1378_0.pl:
* Nauczam o Kris.
* Pytaj mnie o KRIS./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1378_0.pt-BR:
* I'm Kris Master.
* Ask me about KRIS's./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1378_0.zh:
* 我是Kris大师。
* 问我关于KRIS的事。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1386_0.de: * When HP goes negative, your friends fall down/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1386_0.en: * When HP goes negative, your friends fall down/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1386_0.es: * When HP goes negative, your friends fall down/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1386_0.ja:
＊ HPゼロより下がると
　 仲間は気絶ゥ。/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1386_0.pl: * Kiedy PZ zabraknie, padną na glebę twoi przyjaciele./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1386_0.pt-BR: * When HP goes negative, your friends fall down/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1386_0.ru: * Как ОЗ упадут, так ваш друг вслед за ним./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1386_0.zh: * HP变成负数时，你的朋友会倒下。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1387_0.de: * But bringing them back, is easy-town/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1387_0.en: * But bringing them back, is easy-town/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1387_0.es: * But bringing them back, is easy-town/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1387_0.ja: ＊ でもだいじょうぶゥ。すぐに復活ゥ。/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1387_0.pl: * Ale wyleczenie ich, nie kosztuje wiele./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1387_0.pt-BR: * But bringing them back, is easy-town/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1387_0.ru: * Но верни его в строй, знай секрет лишь один./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1387_0.zh: * 要让他们站起来，方法简单又廉价。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1388_0.de: * Plain foods and spells, work like a charm -/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1388_0.en: * Plain foods and spells, work like a charm -/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1388_0.es: * Plain foods and spells, work like a charm -/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1388_0.ja:
＊ 普通の食べ物…　回復まほうゥ…
　 どちらも　バッチリ効果アリィ！/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1388_0.ko:
* 그냥 음식과 마법만 있으면
  요술같이 해결돼./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1388_0.pl: * Zwykłe jedzenie i czary, działają jak marzenie.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1388_0.pt-BR: * Plain foods and spells, work like a charm -/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1388_0.zh: * 简单的食物和法术，效果响当当-/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1389_0.de: * And with a MINT, you can cure all HARM./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1389_0.en: * And with a MINT, you can cure all HARM./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1389_0.es: * And with a MINT, you can cure all HARM./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1389_0.ja:
＊ 「ミント」を使えば　一気に復活ゥ！
　 HPだってMAXにィ！/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1389_0.ko:
* 근데 부활 민트가 있으면
  완전하게 해결돼./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1389_0.pl: * A dzięki MIĘTCE, członek drużyny przejdzie pełne leczenie./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1389_0.pt-BR: * And with a MINT, you can cure all HARM./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1389_0.ru: * А ЛЕДЕНЦОМ ты можешь с нуля воскресить./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1389_0.zh: * 要是用上了薄荷糖，治疗所有伤。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1391_0.de: * Even normal items and spells can revive people, huh?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1391_0.en: * Even normal items and spells can revive people, huh?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1391_0.es: * Even normal items and spells can revive people, huh?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1391_0.ja:
＊ つまり　普通の回復アイテムや
　 まほうでも　気絶した仲間を
　 復活させられるってこと？/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1391_0.ko:
* 그러니까 평범한 음식이랑
  마법으로도 동료들을
  살릴 수 있단 말이죠?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1391_0.pl: * Wiesz, że nawet normalne jedzenie i czary są w stanie odrodzić?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1391_0.pt-BR: * Even normal items and spells can revive people, huh?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1391_0.ru: * То есть можно исцелять даже обычными вещами, да?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1391_0.zh:
* 就连一般的物品和法术
也能使人复活，对吧？/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1393_0.en: * Yeah, that's what I'm saying!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1393_0.pl: * Tak, dokładnie to miałem na myśli!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1393_0.ru: * Да, о чём я и говорю!/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1398_0.de: * If you only ACT, you might start to think -/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1398_0.en: * If you only ACT, you might start to think -/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1398_0.es: * If you only ACT, you might start to think -/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1398_0.ja:
＊ キミはきっと　こう思うゥ。
　 「自分ばっかり『こうどう』」ゥ…/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1398_0.ko:
* 행동만 할 때는
  고민할 수 있지./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1398_0.pl: * Jeśli tylko ty możesz CZYNIĆ, to pewnie ci wpadło do głowy.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1398_0.pt-BR: * If you only ACT, you might start to think -/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1398_0.ru: * Коль ДЕЙСТВУЕШЬ, то держи при уме.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1398_0.zh: * 当你采取【行动】时，可以想想看-/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1399_0.de: * What about the guy with the scarf in pink?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1399_0.en: * What about the guy with the scarf in pink?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1399_0.es: * What about the guy with the scarf in pink?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1399_0.ja:
＊ 「ピンクのマフラーのヤツは
　 なにする」ゥ？/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1399_0.ko:
* 스카프 두른 애는
  뭘 시켜야 하지?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1399_0.pl: * Po co w drużynie ten w szaliku gość młody?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1399_0.pt-BR: * What about the guy with the scarf in pink?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1399_0.ru: * Что ты не один ведёшь бой в этой тьме./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1399_0.zh: * 让那个戴粉色围巾的怎么干？/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1401_0.de: * If you know ACTing will make the enemy friendly -/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1401_0.en: * If you know ACTing will make the enemy friendly -/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1401_0.es: * If you know ACTing will make the enemy friendly -/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1401_0.ja:
＊ クリスの「こうどう」で
　 敵と仲よくなれると
　 わかっているときは…/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1401_0.ko:
* 네 행동으로 상대가
  얌전해질 것 같으면.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1401_0.pl: * Jeśli wiesz, że twój CZYN uszczęśliwi wroga,/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1401_0.pt-BR: * If you know ACTing will make the enemy friendly -/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1401_0.ru: * Если ты знаешь, что твоё ДЕЙСТВИЕ расположит врага к нам.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1401_0.zh:
* 如果你事先知道这次
【行动】会让敌人变得友好-/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1402_0.de: * Then you can ask me to SPARE on the SAME TURN./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1402_0.en: * Then you can ask me to SPARE on the SAME TURN./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1402_0.es: * Then you can ask me to SPARE on the SAME TURN./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1402_0.ja:
＊ ボクには　敵を「にがす」
　 ように指示してくれれば
　 ターンを節約できるよ。/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1402_0.ko:
* 같은 턴에 나한테
  보내주라고 지시하면 돼./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1402_0.pl: * To możesz mnie poprosić, bym go OSZCZĘDZIŁ w TEJ SAMEJ TURZE./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1402_0.pt-BR: * Then you can ask me to SPARE on the SAME TURN./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1402_0.ru: * То ты можешь попросить меня ПОЩАДИТЬ его в тот же ход./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1402_0.zh:
* 那么你就可以让我
在同一回合里使用【饶恕】。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1403_0.de: * Or, cast PACIFY if you know they'll get TIRED./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1403_0.en: * Or, cast PACIFY if you know they'll get TIRED./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1403_0.es: * Or, cast PACIFY if you know they'll get TIRED./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1403_0.ja:
＊ 敵が「くたびれ」ると
　 わかっているときは
　 「スリープ」を使えばいい。/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1403_0.ko:
* 적이 지칠 것 같으면
  진정 마법을 쓰면 돼./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1403_0.pl: * Albo mogę rzucić zaklęcie SENNIK, gdy wiesz, że będzie SENNY./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1403_0.pt-BR: * Or, cast PACIFY if you know they'll get TIRED./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1403_0.ru: * Или использовать УСМИРЕНИЕ, если знаешь, что он УСТАНЕТ./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1403_0.zh:
* 或者，在你知道他们将要【疲惫】
的时候施展【安抚】。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1404_0.de: * If you plan ahead, a lot can happen in ONE TURN!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1404_0.en: * If you plan ahead, a lot can happen in ONE TURN!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1404_0.es: * If you plan ahead, a lot can happen in ONE TURN!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1404_0.ja:
＊ うまく先を読んで動けば
　 1ターンのあいだに
　 いろんなことができるよ！/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1404_0.ko:
* 계획만 잘 세우면,
  한 턴에 많은 걸
  할 수 있어!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1404_0.pl: * Jeśli zaplanujesz swoje ruchy, to możesz wiele osiągnąć w JEDNEJ TURZE!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1404_0.pt-BR: * If you plan ahead, a lot can happen in ONE TURN!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1404_0.ru: * Если планировать всё наперёд, многое можно сделать ЗА ХОД!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1404_0.zh:
* 只要你提前规划好，
就可以在一回合里解决很多事！/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1406_0.de: 1* Hey, who's the MASTER here, me or you!?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1406_0.en: 1* Hey, who's the MASTER here, me or you!?/

  킬킬거리지./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2130_0.pl: 2* Ciągle „przypadkiem” wylewa na mnie slushie i się z tego brechta./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2130_0.pt-BR: 2* Keeps accidentally pouring slushies on me and giggling./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2130_0.ru: 2* Продолжает проливать на меня коктейли и хихикать./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2130_0.zh:
2* 老是不小心把刨冰
倒在我身上，还嘿嘿直笑。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2131_0.de: 1The Warrior - Thankfully absent due to pizza-related injuries./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2131_0.en: 1* The Warrior - Thankfully absent due to pizza-related injuries./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2131_0.es: 1* The Warrior - Thankfully absent due to pizza-related injuries./

1＊ 「ウォーリア」は　さいわい
　 ピザかんけいの　ケガで

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2131_0.zh:
1* The Warrior - 谢天谢地，
他因为披萨相关的工伤而缺席。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2132_0.en: 2* Constantly terrorizing customers with war chants./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2132_0.es: 2* Constantly terrorizing customers with war chants./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2132_0.ja:
2＊ しょっちゅう　おたけび
　 あげちゃ　きゃくを
　 こわがらせまくる。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2132_0.pt-BR: 2* Constantly terrorizing customers with war chants./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2132_0.ru: 2* Постоянно вселяет страх в клиентов боевыми криками./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2132_0.zh: 2* 每时每刻都在用战吼恐吓顾客。/

3* 보라색 셔츠 - 이 녀석은,

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2133_0.zh:
3* Purple Guy - 天啦，那家伙，

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2134_0.de: 6... actually, does that guy even work here?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2134_0.en: 6* ... actually, does that guy even work here?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2134_0.es: 6* ... actually, does that guy even work here?/

6＊ …いや　あいつ　そもそも
　 ここの　じゅうぎょういん

6* ... 잠깐, 이 자식

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2134_0.pt-BR: 6* ... actually, does that guy even work here?/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2135_0.de: 3Ah, my co-workers. Where would I be without them?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2135_0.en: 3* Ah, my co-workers. Where would I be without them?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2135_0.es: 3* Ah, my co-workers. Where would I be without them?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2135_0.ja:
3＊ ま　そんな　ゆかいな
　 なかまたちだ。こいつらが
　 いなかったら　オレは…/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2135_0.ko:
3* 아, 소중한 동료들.
  내가 얘들 없이 어떻게
  일을 할까?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2135_0.pl: 3* Ach, moi znajomi z pracy. Co ja bym bez nich zrobił?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2135_0.pt-BR: 3* Ah, my co-workers. Where would I be without them?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2135_0.ru: 3* Ах, мои коллеги. Как бы я жил без них?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2135_0.zh:
3* 啊，我的同事们。
没了他们我能去哪？/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2136_0.de: 1A happy place, little buddy. A much happier place./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2136_0.en: 1* A happy place, little buddy. A much happier place./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2136_0.es: 1* A happy place, little buddy. A much happier place./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2136_0.ja:
1＊ ここより　ずっとマシな
　 ばしょで　ずっとマシな
　 じんせい　おくってるぜ。/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2136_0.ko:
1* ... 행복하게... 지금보다 
  훨씬 더 행복하게 일하겠지./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2136_0.pl: 1* Życie bym sobie ułożył, mordeczko. Życie bym sobie ułożył./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2136_0.pt-BR: 1* A happy place, little buddy. A much happier place./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2136_0.zh:
1* 一个好地方，小家伙。
一个好得多的地方。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2141_0.de: 3It's fine, Little Buddy. You don't have to watch me suffer./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2141_0.en: 3* It's fine, Little Buddy. You don't have to watch me suffer./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2141_0.es: 3* It's fine, Little Buddy. You don't have to watch me suffer./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2141_0.ja:
3＊ かまわないぜ。オレの
　 なさけない　すがたなんて
　 みなくていい。/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2141_0.ko:
3* 괜찮아, 꼬마 친구.
  남의 고통을 굳이
  지켜보고 있을 필요는 없어./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2141_0.pl: 3* Dobrze, mordeczko. Nie musisz patrzeć jak cierpię./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2141_0.pt-BR: 3* It's fine, Little Buddy. You don't have to watch me suffer./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2141_0.ru: 3* Всё в порядке, дружище. Не стоит смотреть на мои страдания./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2141_0.zh:
3* 没事，小家伙。
你不用看着我遭受苦难。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2142_0.de: 1Just enjoy your freedom... While it lasts.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2142_0.en: 1* Just enjoy your freedom... While it lasts.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2142_0.es: 1* Just enjoy your freedom... While it lasts.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2142_0.ja:
1＊ アンタは　じゆうを
　 たのしみな。それができる
　 いまのうちにな…/

1* 자유를 즐겨...
  즐길 수 있을 때.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2142_0.pt-BR: 1* Just enjoy your freedom... While it lasts.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2142_0.ru: 1* Просто... Наслаждайся свободой... Пока ещё можешь.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2142_0.zh:
1* 好好享受自由吧...
趁你还没失去它.../

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2147_0.ja:
ジュース
ください

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2151_0.de:
* Kris... What a pleasant surprise to see you here.
* And on a school day./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2151_0.en:
* Kris... What a pleasant surprise to see you here.
* And on a school day./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2151_0.es:
* Kris... What a pleasant surprise to see you here.
* And on a school day./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2151_0.ja:
＊ おやおや　クリス…　めずらしい。
　 でも　うれしいですね。へいじつに
　 きょうかいへ　きてくれるとは。/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2151_0.ko:
* 크리스... 혼자서도
  교회에 오다니 기쁘구나.
* 그것도 평일에 말이야./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2151_0.pl:
* Kris... Twoja dzisiejsza wizyta jest miłą niespodzianką.
* I to w dzień powszedni./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2151_0.pt-BR:
* Kris... What a pleasant surprise to see you here.
* And on a school day./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2151_0.ru:
* Крис... Как приятно видеть тебя здесь.
* Особенно в учебный день./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2151_0.zh:
* Kris... 
能在这儿遇到你还真是个惊喜。
* 况且还是上学的日子。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2152_0.de: * There must be a reason that you came here at such a time./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2152_0.en: * There must be a reason that you came here at such a time./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2152_0.es: * There must be a reason that you came here at such a time./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2152_0.ja:
＊ わざわざ　たずねてきたのには
　 なにか　わけが　あるのでしょう。/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2152_0.ko:
* 이런 시간에 찾아온 데에는
  분명 뭔가 이유가 있겠지./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2152_0.pl: * Musisz mieć jakiś bardzo ważny powód./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2152_0.pt-BR: * There must be a reason that you came here at such a time./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2152_0.ru: * Интересно, что привело тебя ко мне в такое время./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2152_0.zh:
* 你现在这个时候过来
肯定有什么原因吧。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2153_0.de:
* I, Father Alvin, implore you.
* If you have anything weighing on your mind, please, speak./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2153_0.en:
* I, Father Alvin, implore you.
* If you have anything weighing on your mind, please, speak./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2153_0.es:
* I, Father Alvin, implore you.
* If you have anything weighing on your mind, please, speak./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2153_0.ja:
＊ さあ　このアルビン師に
　 はなしてごらんなさい。
＊ なやみごとが　あるのですか？/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2153_0.ko:
* 나, 앨빈 신부가 청하니, 
* 마음속에 짐이 있다면,
  털어놓아도 좋단다./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2153_0.pl:
* Ja, ojciec Alvin, nalegam.
* Przemów, jeśli coś ci leży na sercu./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2153_0.pt-BR:
* I, Father Alvin, implore you.
* If you have anything weighing on your mind, please, speak./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2153_0.ru:
* Я, отец Элвин, прошу тебя.
* Если тебя что-то тяготит, поделись этим со мной./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2153_0.zh:
* 我，Alvin神父，殷切地希望... 
* 如果你有任何精神负担的话，
请一定要，向我倾诉。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2160_0.de: * Kris, if you want some of our "sick" Fruit Juice, you should come to our service./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2160_0.en: * Kris, if you want some of our "sick" Fruit Juice, you should come to our service./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2160_0.es: * Kris, if you want some of our "sick" Fruit Juice, you should come to our service./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2160_0.ja:
＊ クリス　きょうかいの　「ヤバい」
　 ジュースが　のみたいのなら
　 れいはいに　くることですよ。/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2160_0.ko:
* 크리스, 우리 교회의 
  과일 주스가 그렇게 좋다면
  우리와 함께하는 건 어떠니./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2160_0.pl: * Kris, jeśli chcesz napić się naszego „fajowego” soku owocowego, przyjdź na mszę./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2160_0.pt-BR: * Kris, if you want some of our "sick" Fruit Juice, you should come to our service./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2160_0.ru: * Крис, если ты хочешь нашего «крутого» сока, тебе стоит прийти на службу./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2160_0.zh:
* Kris，想喝我们“奇葩”的果汁
的话，你就应该来参加礼拜。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2161_0.de: * Our choir sounds a bit thinner since your brother went away./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2161_0.en: * Our choir sounds a bit thinner since your brother went away./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2161_0.es: * Our choir sounds a bit thinner since your brother went away./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2161_0.ja:
＊ クリスのおにいさんが　ぬけて
　 コーラスたいの　うたごえにも
　 はりが　なくなってしまいました。/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2161_0.ko:
* 아스리엘이 떠난 뒤로
  합창단의 화음이 많이
  약해졌단다./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2161_0.pl: * Nasz chór jest niekompletny, odkąd twój brat wyjechał na studia./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2161_0.pt-BR: * Our choir sounds a bit thinner since your brother went away./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2161_0.ru: * Наш хор стал звучать чуть тоньше с тех пор, как твой брат уехал./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2161_0.zh:
* 我们的唱诗班自从你哥哥离开后
音色就稍显不够丰满了。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2162_0.de: * Kris, it would be wonderful if you would sing with us./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2162_0.en: * Kris, it would be wonderful if you would sing with us./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2162_0.es: * Kris, it would be wonderful if you would sing with us./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2162_0.ja:
＊ かわりに　クリスが
　 はいってくれたら
　 だいかんげいですよ。/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2162_0.ko:
* 크리스, 네가 우리와 함께
  노래해 준다면 정말 기쁠 거야./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2162_0.pl: * Kris, byłoby cudownie, jakby twój głos zasilił nasze szeregi./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2162_0.pt-BR: * Kris, it would be wonderful if you would sing with us./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2162_0.ru: * Крис, было бы чудесно услышать твой голос в нашем хоре./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2162_0.zh:
* Kris，如果你能来和我们一起唱
就再好不过了。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2163_0.de: * Or even participated to any extent,/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2163_0.en: * Or even participated to any extent,/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2163_0.es: * Or even participated to any extent,/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2163_0.ja:
＊ せめて　きょうかいの　かつどうに
　 さんかしてくれるだけでも
　 いいのです。/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2163_0.ko:
* 노래가 아니더라도, 
  어떤 역할이든 기여해 주면
  고마울 거야./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2163_0.pl: * Lecz nie pogardzimy samą twoją obecnością,/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2163_0.pt-BR: * Or even participated to any extent,/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2163_0.ru: * Или получить хоть какую-то помощь от тебя,/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2163_0.zh: * 哪怕只是随便参与一下。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2164_0.de: * Instead of just trying to drink the Fruit Juice./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2164_0.en: * Instead of just trying to drink the Fruit Juice./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2164_0.es: * Instead of just trying to drink the Fruit Juice./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2164_0.ja:
＊ ジュースだけ　もらおうと
　 するのではなくてね。/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2164_0.ko: * 그냥 과일 주스만 마시려 하지 말고./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2164_0.pl: * Jeśli nie rzucisz się od razu na sok owocowy./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2164_0.pt-BR: * Instead of just trying to drink the Fruit Juice./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2164_0.ru: * Вместо постоянных попыток выпить нашего сока./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2164_0.zh:
* 也总比一门心思
就想喝那果汁来得好。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2168_0.de:
* I understand.
* I hope in time you may find the words you seek./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2168_0.en:
* I understand.
* I hope in time you may find the words you seek./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2168_0.es:
* I understand.
* I hope in time you may find the words you seek./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2168_0.ja:
＊ わかりました。
＊ じきに　じぶんでも　はなしたい
　 ことが　わかってくるでしょう。/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2168_0.ko:
* 이해한단다.
* 진정 원하는 것을
  찾는 날이 금방 오길 바라마./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2168_0.pl:
* Rozumiem.
* Wierzę, że niedługo objawią ci się słowa, których szukasz./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2168_0.pt-BR:
* I understand.
* I hope in time you may find the words you seek./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2168_0.ru:
* Понимаю.
* Надеюсь, ты найдёшь слова, которые ищешь./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2168_0.zh:
* 我明白了。
* 希望终有一天你能寻找到
想要倾诉的话语。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2169_0.de: * Let the Angel's power light your way./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2169_0.en: * Let the Angel's power light your way./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2169_0.es: * Let the Angel's power light your way./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2169_0.ja:
＊ てんしさまの　みちからが
　 クリスの　ゆくてを
　 てらしますよう。/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2169_0.ko:
* 너의 앞길을 천사의 힘이
  밝혀 주기를./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2169_0.pl: * Niech moc Anioła oświetli ci drogę./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2169_0.pt-BR: * Let the Angel's power light your way./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2169_0.zh: * 愿天使之力照亮你的前路。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3142_0.de:
* Marga riba!
* That cake!
* It's seething with power!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3142_0.en:
* Marga riba!
* That cake!
* It's seething with power!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3142_0.es:
* Marga riba!
* That cake!
* It's seething with power!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3142_0.ja:
＊ マーマ　レード！
＊ そのケーキ！
＊ すさまじい気を　発しているヨ！/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3142_0.pl:
* Marga riba!
* To ciasto!
* Wypełnia je moc!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3142_0.pt-BR:
* Marga riba!
* Aquele bolo!
* Está fervendo com poder!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3142_0.ru:
* Марга риба!
* Этот торт!
* Он кипит силой!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3142_0.zh:
* 嘛噶里叭！
* 那个蛋糕！
* 它里面翻腾着力量！/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3143_0.de:
* It's my cake, isn't it!?
* Did you repair it!?
* Will you return it!?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3143_0.en:
* It's my cake, isn't it!?
* Did you repair it!?
* Will you return it!?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3143_0.es:
* It's my cake, isn't it!?
* Did you repair it!?
* Will you return it!?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3143_0.ja:
＊ それ　ワタシのケーキですネ？
＊ 修理したのですネ？
＊ 返してくれますネ！？/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3143_0.ko:
* 내 케이크, 맞지!?
* 자네들이 고쳤군!?
* 돌려주지 않겠나!?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3143_0.pl:
* To moje ciasto, prawda!?
* Naprawiliście je!?
* Mogę je odzyskać!?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3143_0.pt-BR:
* É meu bolo, não é?!
* Você reparou ele?!
* Você irá retornar ele a mim?!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3143_0.ru:
* Это ж мой торт, да?!
* Вы его починили?!
* Вернёте?!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3143_0.zh:
* 这是我的蛋糕，对不对！？
* 你把它修好了！？
* 你能还给我吗！？/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3152_0.de: * Edamame! My old cake! I'm so happy I could spin!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3152_0.en: * Edamame! My old cake! I'm so happy I could spin!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3152_0.es: * Edamame! My old cake! I'm so happy I could spin!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3152_0.ja:
＊ エーダマーメ！
　 ワタシの傑作ケーキ！　うれしくって
　 クルクル回っちゃいそうネ！/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3152_0.ko:
* 에다마-메! 나의 오랜 케이크!
  행복해서 돌아버리겠네!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3152_0.pl: * Edamame! Moje stare ciasto! Z radości mógłbym zacząć się kręcić!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3152_0.pt-BR: * Edamame! Meu velho bolo! Eu estou tão feliz que poderia girar!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3152_0.ru: * Эдамаме! Мой старый торт! Я так счастлив, что аж верчусь!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3152_0.zh:
* 俺哒妈咩！我的旧蛋糕！
我高兴得都快要转起来了！/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3153_0.de: * My friend, share in my riches! I have many worse cakes I do not want!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3153_0.en: * My friend, share in my riches! I have many worse cakes I do not want!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3153_0.es: * My friend, share in my riches! I have many worse cakes I do not want!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3153_0.ja:
＊ あなたたちに　お礼がしたいヨ！
　 失敗作ケーキ　たくさんあるヨ！/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3153_0.ko:
* 친구들, 보답하고 싶네!
  내겐 원치 않는
   저급 케이크가 많이 있네!!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3153_0.pl: * Moi przyjaciele, podzielę się swym bogactwem! Mam mnóstwo ciast, których nie chcę!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3153_0.pt-BR: * Meu amigo, divido as minhas riquezas! Eu tenho muitos bolos piores que não quero!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3153_0.ru: * Друзья, я поделюсь богатствами! У меня есть ненужные мне торты похуже!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3153_0.zh:
* 我的朋友们，来分享我的财富吧！
我还存着很多不那么好的蛋糕，
都不想要了！/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3154_0.de: * If you're not carrying a Cake, come here and I'll give you one! Forever!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3154_0.en: * If you're not carrying a Cake, come here and I'll give you one! Forever!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3154_0.es: * If you're not carrying a Cake, come here and I'll give you one! Forever!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3154_0.ja:
＊ ケーキ　1つも持っていないなら
　 ワタシのところへ来てヨ！
　 ケーキあげるヨ！　何度でも！/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3154_0.ko:
* 케이크가 없을 때,
  여기로 오면 하나 주지!
  영원히!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3154_0.pl: * Jeśli nie macie żadnego mojego ciasta, to wam jakieś dam! Tylko poproście!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3154_0.pt-BR: * Se não estiver carregando um bolo, venha aqui e vou te dar um! Pra sempre!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3154_0.ru: * Если у вас нет с собой торта, возвращайтесь, и я вам его дам! Навсегда!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3154_0.zh:
* 如果你身上没有蛋糕，就来我这里！
我会送你一个，多少次都行！/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3157_0.de: * Now, I'm going to continue to spin and cry! Spin and cry!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3157_0.en: * Now, I'm going to continue to spin and cry! Spin and cry!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3157_0.es: * Now, I'm going to continue to spin and cry! Spin and cry!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3157_0.ja:
＊ それじゃあ　ワタシは　ここで
　 クルクル涙を　流すヨ！/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3157_0.ko:
* 자, 이제 다시
  돌면서! 울고! 돌고! 울고!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3157_0.pl: * A teraz wracam do piruetów i krzyków! Piruetów i krzyków./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3157_0.pt-BR: * Agora, eu vou continuar a girar e chorar! Girar e chorar!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3157_0.ru: * Теперь я продолжу вертеться и плакать! Вертеться и плакать!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3157_0.zh:
* 现在，我要继续旋转着喜极而泣了！
边转边落泪！/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3162_0.de: * Sweet in cake, but not in character! A tragedy!!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3162_0.en: * Sweet in cake, but not in character! A tragedy!!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3162_0.es: * Sweet in cake, but not in character! A tragedy!!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3162_0.ja:
＊ ケーキは　こんなに甘～いのに
　 せち“辛い”世の中だヨ！/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3162_0.pl: * Słodcy od ciasta, ale o gorzkim charakterze! Tragedia!!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3162_0.pt-BR: * Doce em bolo, mas não em caráter! Que tragédia!!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3162_0.ru: * Сладок торт, но не характер! Трагедия!!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3162_0.zh: * 蛋糕甜美，性格非也！悲剧啊！！/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3174_0.de: * Mama miba! How are you enjoying my rejected pastries?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3174_0.en: * Mama miba! How are you enjoying my rejected pastries?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3174_0.es: * Mama miba! How are you enjoying my rejected pastries?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3174_0.ja:
＊ マーマ　ミーバ！
　 返品された菓子パン　どうデスカ？
　 おいしいでショウ？/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3174_0.ko:
* 맘마미-바!
  내가 거부한 빵은
  잘 먹고 있나?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3174_0.pl: * Mama miba! Jak wam smakują moje odrzucone wypieki?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3174_0.pt-BR: * Mama miba! Como estão meus doces rejeitados?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3174_0.ru: * Мама-шиба! Как вам моя отвергнутая выпечка?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3174_0.zh: * 妈妈咪叭！你喜欢我的淘汰甜品吗？/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3178_0.de: * Mom amiga! You want an inferior cake, my friend?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3178_0.en: * Mom amiga! You want an inferior cake, my friend?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3178_0.es: * Mom amiga! You want an inferior cake, my friend?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3178_0.ja:
＊ マア　アミーゴ！
　 三流ケーキを　もらいにきたのカナ？/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3178_0.ko:
* 맘～마미가!
  저급 케이크를
  먹고 싶나, 친구?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3178_0.pl: * Mom amiga! Chcecie gorszej jakości ciasto, moi przyjaciele?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3178_0.pt-BR: * Mom amiga! Você quer um bolo inferior, meu amigo?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3178_0.ru: * Мам амига! Хочешь худший торт, мой друг?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3178_0.zh:
* 麦啊咪勾！你想要一份次品蛋糕吗，
我的朋友？/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3187_0.de: * Please take this cake! It's worthless, my dear friend!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3187_0.en: * Please take this cake! It's worthless, my dear friend!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3187_0.es: * Please take this cake! It's worthless, my dear friend!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3187_0.ja:
＊ このケーキ　受け取ってヨ！
　 どうせクズケーキだヨ！/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3187_0.ko:
* 이 케이크를 받게!
  가치없는 거라네, 나의 친구!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3187_0.pl: * Weźcie to ciasto! Jest bezwartościowe, moi przyjaciele!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3187_0.pt-BR: * Por favor, pegue esse bolo! É inútil, meu caro amigo!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3187_0.ru: * Возьми этот!! Он недостоин, мой дорогой друг!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3187_0.zh:
* 请拿着这个蛋糕！
它一文不值，我亲爱的朋友！/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3189_0.ja: 0＊ (スピンロールを　手に入れた)/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3192_0.de: * Mama shiba! You're carrying too many things that aren't cakes!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3192_0.en: * Mama shiba! You're carrying too many things that aren't cakes!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3192_0.es: * Mama shiba! You're carrying too many things that aren't cakes!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3192_0.ja:
＊ マーメシーバ！　あなた
　 ケーキじゃない持ち物で
　 いっぱいだヨ！/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3192_0.ko:
* 맘마시-바!
  케이크가 아닌 걸
  너무 많이 들고 있군!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3192_0.pl: * Mama shiba! Macie w kieszeniach zbyt dużo rzeczy, które nie są ciastem!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3192_0.pt-BR: * Mama shiba! Você está carregando muitas coisas que não são bolos!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3192_0.ru: * Мама-шиба! Вы тащите слишком много не-тортов!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3192_0.zh:
* 妈妈西叭！你身上太多
不是蛋糕的东西了！/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3197_0.de: * I understand!! Too much cake will make you spin and cry!!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3197_0.en: * I understand!! Too much cake will make you spin and cry!!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3197_0.es: * I understand!! Too much cake will make you spin and cry!!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3197_0.ja:
＊ わかったヨ！　ケーキ食べ過ぎると
　 クルクル涙が　出ちゃうしネ！/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3197_0.ko:
* 이해하네!!
  케이크를 너무 먹으면
  돌면서 울부짖게 되지!!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3197_0.pl: * Rozumiem!! Jak zjecie zbyt dużo ciasta, to zaczniecie się kręcić i krzyczeć!!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3197_0.pt-BR: * Eu entendo!! Muito bolo vai te fazer girar e chorar!!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3197_0.ru: * Я понимаю!! Много тортов вас закружат и заставят плакать!!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3197_0.zh:
* 我知道！
太多蛋糕会让你边转边落泪！！/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3206_0.en: * (Well, there is a man here.)/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3207_0.ja: ＊ (男は　なにかを差し出した)/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3221_0.ja:

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3421_0.es: 6* I... don't actually know!! I haven't met her in real life!!/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3421_0.pt-BR: 6* Eu... na verdade não sei!! Eu não conheci ela na vida real!!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3421_0.ru: 6* Я... на самом деле не знаю!! Я не встречал её в реальной жизни!!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3421_0.zh:
6* 我... 我其实也不知道！！
我们还没在现实里见过面！/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3422_0.en: 5* But from the way she TEXTS?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3422_0.es: 5* But from the way she TEXTS?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3422_0.ja:

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3422_0.pl: 5* Ale po sposobie w jaki pisze?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3422_0.pt-BR: 5* Mas só pelo jeito que ela DIGITA?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3422_0.zh:
5* 不过通过她打的字，
我能感受的到。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3423_0.de: 1God, Little Buddy. She must be STACKED./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3423_0.en: 1* God, Little Buddy. She must be STACKED./

　 グラマーそうな
　 かんじだよ。/

  진짜 분명 장난 아닐거라고./

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3428_0.de: 3Little buddy!! Here to hear about my, heh, GIRLFRIEND!?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3428_0.en: 3* Little buddy!! Here to hear about my, heh, GIRLFRIEND!?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3428_0.es: 3* Little buddy!! Here to hear about my, heh, GIRLFRIEND!?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3428_0.ja:
3＊ お！　ききたいか！？　
　 オレの…　ヘヘッ…
　 カノジョの　はなしをさ！/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3428_0.ko:
3* 꼬마 친구!! 내, 히히,
  내 여친 얘기 들으러 온 거야!?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3428_0.pl: 3* Mordunio!! Chcesz posłuchać o mojej, heh, DZIEWCZYNIE?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3428_0.pt-BR: 3* Carinha!! Veio ouvir sobre a minha, heh, NAMORADA?!/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3437_0.de: 1So far, she's the perfect girl, little buddy./

　 ピザが　すきで…/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3439_0.ja:

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3440_0.de: 5And to top it off... she sent me a picture./

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3440_0.es: 5* And to top it off... she sent me a picture./

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3440_0.zh:

她给我发了一张照片。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3441_0.es: 1* Of herself. Wearing a pizza bikini./

  좀 낯간지러울지도
  모르겠는데 말이다.../

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3442_0.zh:

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3450_0.es: 6* This is what love looks like, Little Buddy./

　 あいのすがた　そのものさ。/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3450_0.ko:
6* 이것이야말로 사랑 그 자체의
  모습이란다, 꼬마 친구야./

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3450_0.zh:

小家伙。/

　 いうことはない！！/

3* 그래, 맞아!!
  더 얘기할 필요도 없지!!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3455_0.pl: 3* Dokładnie tak!! Zakończmy już tę rozmowę!!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3455_0.pt-BR: 3* É isso aí!! A gente não precisa dizer mais nada!!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3455_0.ru: 3* Верно!! Нам больше не о чем говорить!!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3455_0.zh:
