scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_4949_0.de: * Mama Miba!! I wanted to run the Bakery, but.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_4949_0.en: * Mama Miba!! I wanted to run the Bakery, but.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_4949_0.es: * Mama Miba!! I wanted to run the Bakery, but.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_4949_0.ja:
＊ マーマ　ミーバ！
　 ワタシは　ベーカリーを
　 やりたかったヨ…/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_4949_0.pl: * Mama Miba!! Chciałem prowadzić tę piekarnię obok, ale.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_4949_0.pt-BR: * Mama Miba!! Eu queria ser dono da Padaria, mas.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_4949_0.ru: * Мама-миба!! Я хотел открыть здесь пекарню, но.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_4949_0.zh:
* 妈妈咪叭！
我想开一家糕点房，但是.../

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_4950_0.en: * Someone is already working there!!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_4950_0.ja:
＊ でも　モウ　ベツの　だれかが
　 ベーカリーで働いてたヨ！！/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_4951_0.de: * A cafe that serves pastries... What a disgrace.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_4951_0.en: * A cafe that serves pastries... What a disgrace.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_4951_0.es: * A cafe that serves pastries... What a disgrace.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_4951_0.ja:
＊ カフェで菓子パン売るなんて…
　 アリエマセーン…/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_4951_0.pl: * Kawiarnia, serwująca wypieki... Cóż za zniewaga.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_4951_0.pt-BR: * Um café que serve doces... Mah que desgraça.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_4951_0.ru: * Кафе, в котором подают выпечку... Варварство.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_4951_0.zh: * 在咖啡馆里卖点心... 太羞耻了.../

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_4952_0.de: * What sort of humiliating thing will happen next!?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_4952_0.en: * What sort of humiliating thing will happen next!?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_4952_0.es: * What sort of humiliating thing will happen next!?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_4952_0.ja:
＊ 次はどんな屈辱に
　 耐えねばならないのデショウ！？/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_4952_0.pl: * Jakie upokorzenia jeszcze na mnie czekają!?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_4952_0.pt-BR: * Que tipo de coisa humilhante vai acontecer agora?!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_4952_0.ru: * Как ещё будет унижено кулинарное искусство?!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_4952_0.zh: * 我以后还要忍受什么样的屈辱！？/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_4957_0.de: * Mon amigas! Welcome to the bakery... I wish./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_4957_0.en: * Mon amigas! Welcome to the bakery... I wish./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_4957_0.es: * Mon amigas! Welcome to the bakery... I wish./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_4957_0.ja:
＊ マァ　アミーゴス！
　 ベーカリーへ　ようこそ…　って
　 言えたら　どんなにいいデショウ…/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_4957_0.ko:
* 몬 아미가스!
  제과점에 어서 오게... 
  라고 하고 싶군./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_4957_0.pl: * Mon amigas! Witam w piekarni... A przynajmniej tak chciałbym powiedzieć./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_4957_0.pt-BR: * Mon amigas! Bem-vindos à padaria... quem dera./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_4957_0.ru: * Мон-амигас! Добро пожаловать в пекарню... ах, если б./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_4957_0.zh:
* 麦啊咪勾！欢迎光临糕点房... 
要是我能这样说就好了。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_4965_0.de: * Mama miba!! I was rejected from the cafe!! What can I do now.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_4965_0.en: * Mama miba!! I was rejected from the cafe!! What can I do now.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_4965_0.es: * Mama miba!! I was rejected from the cafe!! What can I do now.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_4965_0.ja:
＊ マーマ　ミーバ！！
　 カフェを追い出されまシタ！！
　 ワタシ　これからどうすれば…/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_4965_0.ko:
* 맘마미-바!!
  카페에서 쫓겨났다네!!
  이제 어떡해야 하지.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_4965_0.pl: * Mama miba!! Wyrzucili mnie z kawiarni!! Cóż ja teraz pocznę.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_4965_0.pt-BR: * Mama miba!! Eu fui rejeitado do café!! O que posso fazer agora.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_4965_0.ru: * Мама-миба!! Меня выгнали из кафе!! И что мне теперь делать.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_4965_0.zh:
* 妈妈咪叭！！
我被咖啡馆开除了！！
这该如何是好.../

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_4994_0.de: * Mama miba!  You returned my cake to me.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_4994_0.en: * Mama miba! You returned my cake to me.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_4994_0.es: * Mama miba!  You returned my cake to me.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_4994_0.ja:
＊ マーマ　ミーバ！
　 アナタたち　ワタシに
　 ケーキ　返してくれマシタ…/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_4994_0.pl: * Mama miba! Zwracasz mi moje ciasto...?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_4994_0.pt-BR: * Mama miba! Vocês devolveram meu bolo a mim.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_4994_0.ru: * Мама-миба! Вы вернули мне мой торт.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_4994_0.zh: * 妈妈咪叭！你帮我找回了蛋糕.../

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_4995_0.de: * Mwah! I will never forget your kindness!!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_4995_0.en: * Mwah! I will never forget your kindness!!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_4995_0.es: * Mwah! I will never forget your kindness!!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_4995_0.ja:
＊ アナタたちの心づかい
　 ワタシは　決して忘れまセーン！/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_4995_0.pl: * Cmok! Nigdy ci tego nie zapomnę!!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_4995_0.pt-BR: * Mwah! Eu nunca esquecerei a bondade de vocês!!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_4995_0.ru: * Вхах! Я никогда не забуду вашу доброту!!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_4995_0.zh: * 么么！你的恩情我永世难忘！！/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_4996_0.de: * Every day, I will give you dizzying flavors!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_4996_0.en: * Every day, I will give you dizzying flavors!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_4996_0.es: * Every day, I will give you dizzying flavors!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_4996_0.ja:
＊ 目が回るホドの　ステキフレーバー
　 毎日　お届けしマース！/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_4996_0.ko:
* 매일 매일, 어질어질한 맛의
  먹거리를, 전해주지!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_4996_0.pl: * Każdego dnia, uraczę cię zawrotnymi smakami!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_4996_0.pt-BR: * Todo dia, eu lhes darei sabores estonteantes!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_4996_0.ru: * Ежедневно... я буду преподносить вам головокружительные вкусы!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_4996_0.zh:
* 每一天，我都会给你做出
头晕目眩的美味！/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_4997_0.de: * Every day, the flavors will become stronger!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_4997_0.en: * Every day, the flavors will become stronger!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_4997_0.es: * Every day, the flavors will become stronger!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_4997_0.ja:
＊ ステキフレーバー
　 毎日　パワーアップしマース！/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_4997_0.ko:
* 매일 매일, 맛은 점점 더
  강렬해질 거라네!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_4997_0.pl: * Każdego dnia, smaki będą stawały się intensywniejsze!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_4997_0.pt-BR: * Todo dia, os sabores ficarão mais fortes!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_4997_0.ru: * С каждым днём... вкусы будут становиться всё сильнее!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_4997_0.zh: * 每一天，我都会做得越来越美味！/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_4998_0.en: * That's the power of [Baker's Arms]!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_4998_0.ja:
＊ それが　プロの職人の
　 ウデというものデース！/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_4998_0.pt-BR: * Esse é o poder de [Braços de Padeiro]!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_4998_0.zh: * 这就是“职业糕点师的力量”！/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_4999_0.ja: ＊ (スピンロールを　手に入れた)/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5007_0.de: * Would you like to take my cake for a spin?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5007_0.en: * Would you like to take my cake for a spin?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5007_0.es: * Would you like to take my cake for a spin?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5007_0.ja:
＊ ウチの菓子パン
　 連れ回してくれまスカ？/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5007_0.ko:
* 내 케이크를 데리고
  한 바퀴 산보라도 돌아보겠나?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5007_0.pl: * Chcesz wziąć moje ciasto na wycieczkę?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5007_0.pt-BR: * Gostaria de rodo-pião com meu Bolo Pião?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5007_0.ru: * Не хотите повертеть на языке сладкий вкус моего торта?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5007_0.zh: * 你想带着我的蛋糕去转转吗？/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5008_0.de: * Like night and day, the cake and the world revolve!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5008_0.en: * Like night and day, the cake and the world revolve!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5008_0.es: * Like night and day, the cake and the world revolve!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5008_0.ja:
＊ 昼と夜の　サイクルのように
　 ケーキも　世界も　回るのデース！/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5008_0.ko:
* 낮과 밤처럼,
  케이크도 세계도 모두 돌고 돌지!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5008_0.pl: * Wiedz, że od rana do wieczora, ciasto rozkręca imprezy!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5008_0.pt-BR: * Como dia e noite, o bolo e o mundo giram!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5008_0.ru: * Как день и ночь... торт и мир вращаются!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5008_0.zh:
* 就像白昼和黑夜交替，
蛋糕和地球都在旋转！/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5009_0.ja: ＊ (スピンロールを　手に入れた)/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5010_0.de: * Come again another day! Haha hiha!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5010_0.en: * Come again another day! Haha hiha!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5010_0.es: * Come again another day! Haha hiha!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5010_0.ja:
＊ また　ベツの日に
　 また　来てくだサーイ！
　 ハハ　ヒーハ！/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5010_0.ko:
* 다음 날에 또 오시게!
  하하 히-하!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5010_0.pt-BR: * Venha de novo outro dia! Haha hiha!/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5015_0.de: * Mozzarella! You are carrying too many items! No cake for you!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5015_0.en: * Mozzarella! You are carrying too many items! No cake for you!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5015_0.es: * Mozzarella! You are carrying too many items! No cake for you!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5015_0.ja:
＊ モッツァレーラ！
　 もちもの　多すぎ！
　 菓子パン　あげられまセーン！/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5015_0.ko:
* 모짜렐-라!
  너무 많이 들고 있군!
  케이크는 줄 수 없네!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5015_0.pl: * Mozzarella! Masz przy sobie za dużo przedmiotów! Ciasta nie otrzymasz!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5015_0.pt-BR: * Mozzarella! Vocês estão carregando muitos itens! Sem bolo pra vocês!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5015_0.ru: * Моцарелла! У вас слишком много вещей! Пока без торта!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5015_0.zh:
* 莫扎瑞啦！
你身上的物品太多了！
不能给你蛋糕！/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5023_0.de: * I can only generate one Spincake at a time./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5023_0.en: * I can only generate one Spincake at a time./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5023_0.es: * I can only generate one Spincake at a time./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5023_0.ja:
＊ スピンロールは　一度に１つしか
　 つくり出せまセーン。/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5023_0.ko:
* 나는 한 번에 한 개의
  스핀케이크만을 만든다네./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5023_0.pl: * Jednocześnie może istnieć tylko jeden ObroTort./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5023_0.pt-BR: * Eu só consigo gerar um Bolo Pião de cada vez./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5023_0.ru: * Я могу выдать лишь один вертьторт за раз./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5023_0.zh: * 我每次只能做一个旋转蛋糕。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5024_0.de: * Please finish your cake and I will give you another!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5024_0.en: * Please finish your cake and I will give you another!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5024_0.es: * Please finish your cake and I will give you another!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5024_0.ja:
＊ もう１つ　欲しければ
　 いま持ってるのを　食べてから
　 また来てくだサーイ！/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5024_0.ko:
* 있는 케이크를 먹고 나면
  하나 더 만들어주지!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5024_0.pl: * Zjedz swój, a wtedy dam ci następny!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5024_0.pt-BR: * Por favor, terminem o bolo de vocês e eu lhes darei outro!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5024_0.ru: * Прошу, съешьте свой торт, и я приготовлю для вас новый!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5024_0.zh:
* 吃完你身上的那个蛋糕，
我就再给你一个！/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5031_0.de: * Mama mina! As long as ze purple girl is by your side!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5031_0.en: * Mama mina! As long as ze purple girl is by your side!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5031_0.es: * Mama mina! As long as ze purple girl is by your side!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5031_0.ja:
＊ マーマ　ミーナ！
　 ムラサキの　おんなのコが
　 いるあいだは…/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5031_0.ko:
* 맘마미-나!
  그 보라색 여자 아이가
  같이 있다면!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5031_0.pl: * Mama mina! Tak długo, jak ta fioletowa dziewczyna jest po twojej stronie,/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5031_0.pt-BR: * Mama mina! Enquanto a garota roxa esteja ao zeu lado!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5031_0.ru: * Мама-мина! Пока сия фиолетовая девочка с вами!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5031_0.zh:
* 妈妈咪呐！
那紫色的女孩在你旁边！/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5032_0.de: * There will be no prizes from moi... ma-mia!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5032_0.en: * There will be no prizes from moi... ma-mia!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5032_0.es: * There will be no prizes from moi... ma-mia!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5032_0.ja:
＊ ワタシ　アナタに　プレゼント
　 絶対わたさないヨ…！/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5032_0.pl: * To o moich wypiekach możesz sobie tylko pomarzyć... baj-baj!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5032_0.pt-BR: * Não terá prêmios de moi... ma-mia!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5032_0.ru: * От меня вы не увидите никаких подарков... ма-мия!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5032_0.zh:
* 我这里可没有给你的奖励... 
妈咪呀！/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5034_0.de: 0Who cares? Ralsei can make me a cake./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5034_0.en: 0* Who cares? Ralsei can make me a cake./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5034_0.es: 0* Who cares? Ralsei can make me a cake./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5034_0.ja:
0＊ フン。勝手にしろよ。
　 ケーキなら　ラルセイだって
　 焼けるしな。/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5034_0.ko:
0* 뭔 상관이람?
  랄세이가 케이크
  만들어주면 되는데./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5034_0.pl: 0* Kogo to obchodzi? Przecież Ralsei może mi upiec ciasto./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5034_0.pt-BR: 0* Quem liga? Ralsei pode me fazer um bolo./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5034_0.ru: 0* Кого это волнует? Торт я могу получить и от Ральзея./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5034_0.zh:
0* 谁管你啊，Ralsei可以
给我做蛋糕。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5036_0.de: * B... But my uniqueness... as a baker...!!!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5036_0.en: * B... But my uniqueness... as a baker...!!!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5036_0.es: * B... But my uniqueness... as a baker...!!!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5036_0.ja:
＊ デデデ…デモ…
　 ワタシは　プロの職人デス！
　 シロートとは　違いマース…！！/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5036_0.pl: * A... Ale co z moim... artystycznym sznytem...!?!!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5036_0.pt-BR: * M... Mas mia especialidade... como padeiro...!!!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5036_0.ru: * Н... Но как же мои уникальные... навыки!!!.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5036_0.zh:
* 但... 
但我可是职业糕点师...！！！/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5037_0.de: * (Sniff) D-don't mind my pastries, are a little extra salty today, everyone!!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5037_0.en: * (Sniff) D-don't mind my pastries, are a little extra salty today, everyone!!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5037_0.es: * (Sniff) D-don't mind my pastries, are a little extra salty today, everyone!!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5037_0.ja:
＊ (シクシク)今日の菓子パン
　 いつもより　しょっぱいケド
　 許してクダサーイ！！/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5037_0.ko:
* (훌쩍) 오늘의 패스츄리는
  평소보다 짜다는 점,
  양해해주게, 모두들!!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5037_0.pl: * (Smark) Drodzy klienci, moje wyroby będą dziś bardziej słone niż zwykle!!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5037_0.pt-BR: * (Snif) N-não liguem para meus bolos, estão meio salgados hoje, pessoal!!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5037_0.ru: * (Хнык) Н-не обращайте внимания, сегодня особо подсоленные булочки, для всех!!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5037_0.zh:
* （抽泣）大-大伙别在意， 
今天的点心可能会有点偏咸！！/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5062_0.de: * Well, well. Welcome to TOP BAKERY./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5062_0.en: * Well, well. Welcome to TOP BAKERY./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5062_0.es: * Well, well. Welcome to TOP BAKERY./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5062_0.ja:
＊ トップ・ベーカリーへ
　 よくぞ参った。/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5062_0.pl: * Proszę, proszę. Witam was w CUD PIEKARNI./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5062_0.pt-BR: * Pois, pois. Bem-vindos à PADARIA TOP./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5062_0.ru: * Что ж, что ж. Добро пожаловать в ПЕКАРНЮ «КРУТЬ»./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5062_0.zh:
* 欢迎，欢迎。
欢迎光临顶尖糕点房。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5063_0.de: * I am this bakery's smith, MALIUS./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5063_0.en: * I am this bakery's smith, MALIUS./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5063_0.es: * I am this bakery's smith, MALIUS./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5063_0.ja:
＊ わが名はマリウス。
　 本ベーカリーにて
　 鍛冶をつとめる者。/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5063_0.pl: * Jestem kowalem tej piekarni, a zwę się KOWALSKI./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5063_0.pt-BR: * Eu sou o ferreiro da padaria, MALIUS./

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5064_0.de: * I do not know what any of these STRANGE TOOLS are for./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5064_0.en: * I do not know what any of these STRANGE TOOLS are for./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5064_0.es: * I do not know what any of these STRANGE TOOLS are for./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5064_0.ja:
＊ ここに並ぶ不可思議な道具の
　 使い道はわからぬが…/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5064_0.ko:
* 이 기묘한 도구들은
  무엇에 쓰는 물건인지
  전혀 모르겠소만./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5064_0.pl: * Nie znam zastosowania tychże DZIWNYCH NARZĘDZI./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5064_0.pt-BR: * Eu não sei para que servem essas FERRAMENTAS ESTRANHAS./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5064_0.ru: * Я не знаю, для чего предназначены все эти СТРАННЫЕ ИНСТРУМЕНТЫ./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5064_0.zh:
* 我不清楚这些奇奇怪怪的工具
是干嘛用的。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5065_0.de: * But using my skills, I can FUSE ITEMs to create NEW ONES./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5065_0.en: * But using my skills, I can FUSE ITEMs to create NEW ONES./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5065_0.es: * But using my skills, I can FUSE ITEMs to create NEW ONES./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5065_0.ja:
＊ わが究極の技により
　 複数のアイテムを合成し
　 新たな品を生み出すことが可能。/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5065_0.ko:
* 나의 기술을 이용하여, 
  아이템을 합성하여
  새 아이템을 만들 순 있소../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5065_0.pl: * Ale dzięki moim umiejętnościom, mogę POŁĄCZYĆ kilka RZECZY w coś NOWEGO./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5065_0.pt-BR: * Mas usando minhas habilidades, eu posso FUNDIR ITENS para criar ITENS NOVOS./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5065_0.ru: * Но мои навыки позволяют мне ОБЪЕДИНЯТЬ ВЕЩИ для СОЗДАНИЯ НОВЫХ./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5065_0.zh:
* 但是凭我高超的技术，
可以把现有物品合成为新的物品。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5070_0.ja:
＊ トップ・ベーカリーへ
　 よくぞ参った。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5085_0.de: * Your body is a weapon, too. You must take care of it from time to time./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5085_0.en: * Your body is a weapon, too. You must take care of it from time to time./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5085_0.es: * Your body is a weapon, too. You must take care of it from time to time./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5085_0.ja:
＊ おぬしの体もまた　武器である。
　 こまめに手入れを　せねばならぬぞ。/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5085_0.ko:
* 그대들의 육신 역시 무기이니.
  때때로 손봐줘야만
  하는 것이지./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5085_0.pl: * Wasze ciała to też broń. Musicie zadbać o nie od czasu do czasu./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5085_0.pt-BR: * Seu corpo é uma arma também. Você tem que cuidar dele de tempo em tempo./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5085_0.ru: * Ваше тело — тоже оружие. Время от времени ему тоже нужен уход./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5085_0.zh:
* 你的身体，也是武器。
你们必须要时刻注意维护好它。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5086_0.en: * Huh-hah! Let's feel my technique./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5086_0.ja:
＊ フッ！　ハッ！
　 わが究極の技　とくと見よ！/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5086_0.pl: * Hih-hah! Pokażę wam, na co mnie stać./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5086_0.zh: * 嗬-哈！来感受我的技术吧。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5093_0.de: * BREAD...? What is this technique you speak of?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5093_0.en: * BREAD...? What is this technique you speak of?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5093_0.es: * BREAD...? What is this technique you speak of?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5093_0.ja:
＊ 「パン」…？
　 それは　いかなる技であるか？/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5093_0.ko:
* 빵...?
  그것은 어떤 기술을
  말하는 것이오?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5093_0.pl: * CHLEB...? Pierwszy raz słyszę o tej technice!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5093_0.pt-BR: * PÃO...? Qual é essa técnica da qual você fala?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5093_0.ru: * ХЛЕБ?.. Что за технику вы упомянули сейчас?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5093_0.zh:
* 面包...？
你说的是哪种技术？/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5107_0.de: * As your journey continues, I will learn new RECIPES, so please visit again./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5107_0.en: * As your journey continues, I will learn new RECIPES, so please visit again./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5107_0.es: * As your journey continues, I will learn new RECIPES, so please visit again./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5107_0.ja:
＊ おぬしが旅を続けるうちに　わたしも
　 新たな「レシピ」を学ぶだろう。
　 また立ち寄るがよい。/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5107_0.ko:
* 그대들이 여정을 이어가는 동안,
  나 역시 새로운 제조법을 배워보겠소,
  그럼 다시 만나지./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5107_0.pl: * Kiedy was nie będzie, ja będę poznawał nowe PRZEPISY, więc często wpadajcie./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5107_0.pt-BR: * Conforme sua jornada continua, eu vou aprender novas RECEITAS, então, por favor, visite de novo./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5107_0.ru: * В течение вашего приключения я буду изучать новые РЕЦЕПТЫ, так что возвращайтесь./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5107_0.zh:
* 随着你们旅途的继续，
我会习得新的配方，记得再次光临。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5111_0.ko:
* 그래...
  즐거운 여행 되게나, 나의 친구들./

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5137_0.en: D* Hoho! I am Chef Lancer!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5137_0.es: D* Hoho! I am Chef Lancer!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5137_0.ja:
D＊ ホッホッホ！
　 ボクさまは
　 シェフ・ランサー！/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5137_0.pl: D* Hoho! Nazywam się Lancer Kucharski!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5137_0.pt-BR: D* Hoho! Eu sou Chef Lancer!/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5138_0.en: D* Try my delicious hand-formed cookies!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5138_0.es: D* Try my delicious hand-formed cookies!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5138_0.ja:
D＊ ボクさまの
　 お手成形クッキー
　 ぜひお試しください！/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5138_0.ko:
D* 내가 만든 맛 좋은
  수제 쿠키 좀 먹어봐!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5138_0.pl: D* Spróbujcie moich ręcznie lepionych ciasteczek!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5138_0.pt-BR: D* Experimente meus deliciosos cookies feitos à mão!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5138_0.ru: D* Попробуйте мои восхитительные печеньки ручной работы!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5138_0.zh: D* 尝尝我美味的手工饼干吧！/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5139_0.de: EThey are free... for a price.01/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5139_0.en: E* They are free... for a price.01/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5139_0.zh: E* 它的价格是... 免费。01/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5144_0.ja:
E＊ ランサークッキー
　 おひとつ　いかが？/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5144_0.ko:
E* 랜서 쿠키!
  한 번 먹어볼래?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5144_0.pl: E* Macie ochotę na... Lancer ciacho?/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5156_0.en: D* You already tookie a cookie!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5156_0.es: D* You already tookie a cookie!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5156_0.ja:

　 あげたッキー！/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5156_0.pl: D* Jedno ciacho na jedną drużynę!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5156_0.pt-BR: D* Você já pegookie um cookie!/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5157_0.de: DWait! I'm still regenerating from the last one./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5157_0.en: D* Wait! I'm still regenerating from the last one./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5157_0.es: D* Wait! I'm still regenerating from the last one./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5157_0.ja:
D＊ まだ自動回復中だから！
　 ちょっと　お待ちなさい！/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5157_0.pl: D* Nadal regeneruję siły po poprzednim./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5157_0.pt-BR: D* Pera! Eu ainda estou regenerando desde o último./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5157_0.ru: D* Ждите! Я ещё не восстановился после прошлой./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5157_0.zh:
D* 再等等！
我的体力还在恢复中。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5165_0.de: EI now pronounce you... cookie and wife./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5165_0.en: E* I now pronounce you... cookie and wife./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5165_0.es: E* I now pronounce you... cookie and wife./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5165_0.ja:
E＊ これで　あなたとクッキーは
　 めでたく
　 オヤツ縁関係です。/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5165_0.ko:
E* 이제 당신이 쿠키와
  부부가 되었음을 선언합니다./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5165_0.pl: E* Mianuję was... ciastkiem i żoną./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5165_0.pt-BR: E* Eu agora lhes declaro... cookie e mulher./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5165_0.ru: E* Нарекаю вас... печенькой и муженой./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5165_0.zh:
E* 我现在宣布... 
你同饼干喜结连理。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5172_0.de: DNo room! Your pockets are full of un-cookie./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5172_0.en: D* No room! Your pockets are full of un-cookie./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5172_0.es: D* No room! Your pockets are full of un-cookie./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5172_0.ja:
D＊ 持ち物いっぱい！
　 非クッキーアイテム
　 多すぎ！/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5172_0.ko:
D* 공간이 없어!
  주머니가 안 쿠키인 걸로
  가득하다구./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5172_0.pl: D* Brak miejsca! Twoje kieszenie pełne są nie-ciastek./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5172_0.pt-BR: D* Sem espaço! Seus bolsos estão cheios de não-cookie./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5172_0.ru: D* Нет места! Карманы заполнены не-печеньем./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5172_0.zh:
D* 装不下啦！
你的口袋里装满了
不是饼干的东西！/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5174_0.de: PThe hell'd you let that happen, Kris?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5174_0.en: P* The hell'd you let that happen, Kris?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5174_0.es: P* The hell'd you let that happen, Kris?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5174_0.ja:
P＊ は？
　 どーゆーことだよ　クリス！/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5174_0.pl: P* Jak do tego doszło, Kris?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5174_0.pt-BR: P* Por que você deixou isso acontecer, Kris?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5174_0.zh:
P* 你怎么能做出这种事，
Kris？/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5182_0.de: DEven if you get stronger, Lancer Cookies never falter!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5182_0.en: D* Even if you get stronger, Lancer Cookies never falter!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5182_0.es: D* Even if you get stronger, Lancer Cookies never falter!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5182_0.ja:
D＊ キミが　どんなに
　 強くなろうとも…/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5182_0.ko:
D* 네가 아무리 강해지더라도,
  랜서 쿠키는 결코
  굴복하지 않아!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5182_0.pl: D* Gdy stajecie się silniejsi, Lancer ciacha nie słabną!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5182_0.pt-BR: D* Mesmo se ficar mais forte, Cookies Lancer nunca vacilam!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5182_0.ru: D* В какой беде не окажись, печенья Лансера не подведут!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5182_0.zh:
D* 就算你会变得更强，
Lancer饼干决不动摇！/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5183_0.de: EAlways reliable, they will heal you in times of need!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5183_0.en: E* Always reliable, they will heal you in times of need!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5183_0.es: E* Always reliable, they will heal you in times of need!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5183_0.ja:
E＊ ここぞというとき
　 すかさず回復！　それが
　 ランサークッキーです！/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5183_0.ko:
E* 언제나 믿음직하게, 필요할 때
  너희를 회복해줄 테니까!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5183_0.pl: E* Są niezawodne, uleczą was w nagłej potrzebie!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5183_0.pt-BR: E* Sempre de confiança, eles te curam em tempos de necessidade!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5183_0.ru: E* Абсолютно надёжны, гарантированно вылечат в любой момент!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5183_0.zh:
E* 只要你有需要，就能让你回复，
Lancer饼干，永远值得信赖！/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5185_0.de: K(Maybe if you need to be healed 1 HP...)/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5185_0.en: K* (Maybe if you need to be healed 1 HP...)/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5185_0.ru: K* (Ну, в том случае, если нужно вылечить 1 ОЗ...)/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5196_0.de: * I'm Battle's Master. Ask me about Battles./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5196_0.en: * I'm Battle's Master. Ask me about Battles./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5196_0.es: * I'm Battle's Master. Ask me about Battles./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5196_0.ja:
＊ ボクはバトルマスター。
　 バトルのことなら
　 なんでも聞いて。/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5196_0.ko:
* 나는 전투 마스터야.
  전투에 관한 거라면
  뭐든 물어봐./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5196_0.pl: * Nauczam o walkach. Pytaj mnie o walki./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5196_0.pt-BR: * Eu sou Mestre Batalhas. Me pergunte sobre Batalhas./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5196_0.ru: * Я мастер сражений. Задавайте свои вопросы./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5196_0.zh:
* 我是战斗大师，
问我关于战斗的事。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5205_0.de: * When shots aim directly, try to move SLOW./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5205_0.en: * When shots aim directly, try to move SLOW./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5205_0.es: * When shots aim directly, try to move SLOW./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5205_0.ja:
＊ 弾が直撃しそうなら
　 あわてず騒がず
　 ゆっくり　かわすゥ。/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5205_0.ko:
* 총알이 너를 조준할 때,
  조금씩만 움직여 봐./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5205_0.pl: * Gdy pocisk w ciebie mierzy, śpieszyć się nie należy./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5205_0.pt-BR: * Quando balas mirarem em você, tente mover DEVAGAR./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5205_0.ru: * Когда летят в вас снаряды, уходите от них НЕ СПЕША./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5205_0.zh:
* 被瞄准了不用愁，
可以试着慢点走。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5206_0.de: * They aim where you WERE, not where you GO./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5206_0.en: * They aim where you WERE, not where you GO./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5206_0.es: * They aim where you WERE, not where you GO./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5206_0.ja:
＊ そしたら弾は追ってこずゥ
　 さっき　いたとこ　かすめてくゥ。/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5206_0.ko:
* 발사돼서 날아올 때,
  총알은 널 안 따라와./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5206_0.pl: * To gdzie się uda nie od aktualnej, lecz od dawnej pozycji zależy./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5206_0.pt-BR: * Elas miram onde ESTAVA, não aonde você IRÁ./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5206_0.ru: * Летят они ровно ТУДА, где была ваша ДУША./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5206_0.zh:
* 子弹全在你身后，
只管前进莫回头。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5207_0.de: * Take the advantage and move BIT BY BIT./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5207_0.en: * Take the advantage and move BIT BY BIT./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5207_0.es: * Take the advantage and move BIT BY BIT./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5207_0.ja: ＊ 動くときは　ちょっとずつゥ。/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5207_0.pl: * Wykorzystaj tę radę i ruszaj się POWOLI./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5207_0.pt-BR: * Ganhe vantagem e se mova DE POUCO EM POUCO./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5207_0.zh:
* 若是碰上好时机，
一步一停别客气。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5208_0.de: * You'll gain TP but you won't get HIT./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5208_0.en: * You'll gain TP but you won't get HIT./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5208_0.es: * You'll gain TP but you won't get HIT./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5208_0.ja: ＊ ギリギリかわせば　TPたまるゥ。/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5208_0.pl: * Zdobędziesz PA i nic cię NIE ZABOLI./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5208_0.pt-BR: * Você vai ganhar PA sem levar nem um SOCO./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5208_0.ru: * Набирая ПН, урон вам не грозит НИЧУТЬ./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5208_0.zh:
* 安全躲避无压力，
还能顺便蹭TP。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5214_0.de: * Shots aren't always AS THEY APPEAR./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5214_0.en: * Shots aren't always AS THEY APPEAR./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5214_0.es: * Shots aren't always AS THEY APPEAR./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5214_0.ja: ＊ 弾の見た目は　関係ないィ。/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5214_0.pt-BR: * Nem sempre as balas são COMO PARECEM SER./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5214_0.ru: * Как говорят — у страха ГЛАЗА ВЕЛИКИ./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5214_0.zh:
* 子弹虽然看着大，
实际尺寸有偏差。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5215_0.de: * The bigger they are, the LESS TO FEAR./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5215_0.en: * The bigger they are, the LESS TO FEAR./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5215_0.es: * The bigger they are, the LESS TO FEAR./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5215_0.ja: ＊ サイズ　デカいほど怖くないィ。/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5215_0.pl: * Im większe są, tym MNIEJ ZAGROŻEŃ SKRYWAJĄ./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5215_0.pt-BR: * Quanto maior forem, MENOS tem a temer./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5215_0.ru: * Снаряды чем БОЛЬШЕ, тем МЕНЬШЕ внутри./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5215_0.zh:
* 越是那些巨无霸，
越是缩水不用怕。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5216_0.de: * You'll only get hurt a LITTLE INSIDE./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5216_0.en: * You'll only get hurt a LITTLE INSIDE./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5216_0.es: * You'll only get hurt a LITTLE INSIDE./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5216_0.ja: ＊ 痛いのは　内側　ちょっとの範囲ィ。/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5216_0.ko:
* 진짜로 아픈 건 
  안에 든 알맹이./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5216_0.pl: * Zranią cię dopiero, jak będziesz TROCHĘ W NICH./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5216_0.pt-BR: * Você só vai se machucar chegando PERTO DO CENTRO./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5216_0.ru: * А чем МЕНЬШЕ они, тем и ближе к РЕАЛУ./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5216_0.zh:
* 边缘轮廓皆为虚，
稍有接触也不惧。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5217_0.de: * Take your pride and LEARN THE SIZE./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5217_0.en: * Take your pride and LEARN THE SIZE./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5217_0.es: * Take your pride and LEARN THE SIZE./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5217_0.ja: ＊ 範囲の見極め　とっても大事ィ。/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5217_0.pl: * Pokaż swą dumę i POZNAJ JE W MIG./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5217_0.pt-BR: * APRENDA O TAMANHO com orgulho e treinamento./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5217_0.zh:
* 盲目自信不可取，
认真了解判定域。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5225_0.de: * We failed to hit our FUNDING GOAL./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5225_0.en: * We failed to hit our FUNDING GOAL./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5225_0.es: * We failed to hit our FUNDING GOAL./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5225_0.ja: ＊ 目標額は　未達成ィ。/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5225_0.pt-BR: * Nossa META DE FINANCIAMENTO nós falhamos em atingir./

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5226_0.de: * I will not talk about OUR HOLE./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5226_0.en: * I will not talk about OUR HOLE./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5226_0.es: * I will not talk about OUR HOLE./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5226_0.ja:
＊ だから　しないよ
　 募金ホールの話ィ。/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5226_0.ko:
* 모금 구멍 얘기는
  안 하기로 했어./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5226_0.pl: * Na opowieść o NASZEJ DZIURZE się nie skuszę./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5226_0.pt-BR: * Sobre o NOSSO BURACO eu não vou discutir./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5226_0.ru: * Про НАШУ НОРУ не хочу говорить./

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5230_0.de: * We reached our monthly FUNDING GOAL./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5230_0.en: * We reached our monthly FUNDING GOAL./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5230_0.es: * We reached our monthly FUNDING GOAL./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5230_0.ja: ＊ 今月の目標額　達成済みィ。/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5230_0.pt-BR: * Alcançamos nossa META DE FINANCIAMENTO mensal./

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5231_0.de: * I will now talk about OUR HOLE./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5231_0.en: * I will now talk about OUR HOLE./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5231_0.es: * I will now talk about OUR HOLE./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5231_0.ja:
＊ 聞かせてあげるよ
　 募金ホールの話ィ。/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5231_0.pl: * Na opowieść o NASZEJ DZIURZE się skuszę./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5231_0.pt-BR: * Sobre o NOSSO BURACO eu vou discutir, afinal./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5231_0.ru: * Теперь я могу о НОРЕ рассказать./

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5232_0.de: * It was dark, filled with darker dollawers/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5232_0.en: * It was dark, filled with darker dollawers/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5232_0.es: * It was dark, filled with darker dollawers/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5232_0.ja:
＊ ダークドルで　満たされたァ
　 暗い暗い　穴だったァ。/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5232_0.ko:
* 어두웠던 구멍 속엔 
  다크 달러가 가득 가득/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5232_0.ru: * Она темна и наполнена кучей тёмных ирисок./

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5233_0.de: * Fed from subscription by our followers/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5233_0.en: * Fed from subscription by our followers/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5233_0.es: * Fed from subscription by our followers/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5233_0.ja:
＊ フォロワーたちの　サブスクでェ
　 しぼり取ってきた　おカネェ。/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5233_0.ko:
* 팔로워 여러분의
  구독과 마음이 가득 가득/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5233_0.pt-BR: * Alimentado pela inscrição de nossos seguidores/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5234_0.de: * Working hard no bank no lender/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5234_0.en: * Working hard no bank no lender/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5234_0.es: * Working hard no bank no lender/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5234_0.ja:
＊ 銀行からも　カネ貸しからも
　 ぜんぜん融資　受けれないィ。/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5234_0.ko:
* 은행도 사금융도 없이
  일만 열심히 했다네/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5234_0.pl: * Praca cieżka, czy dzień, czy noc,/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5234_0.pt-BR: * Trabalhando duro, sem dinheiro, sem credores/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5235_0.de: * We received one unit of legal tender/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5235_0.en: * We received one unit of legal tender/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5235_0.es: * We received one unit of legal tender/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5235_0.ja:
＊ 貯まった資金の　合計額ゥ
　 1…　…　…
　 ダークドルゥ。/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5235_0.ko:
* 법정 통화 단 하나
  확실히 받았다네/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5235_0.ru: * В кармане лежит лишь банкнота одна./

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5237_0.ja: ＊ 募金　ありがとうございました。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5279_0.de: * Hey, boss! How can I help ya!?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5279_0.en: * Hey, boss! How can I help ya!?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5279_0.es: * Hey, boss! How can I help ya!?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5279_0.ja:
＊ よう　ボス！
　 今日はどんなご用で！？/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5279_0.pl: * Hej, szefie! W czymś mogę ci pomóc?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5279_0.pt-BR: * Ei, chefia! Como posso te ajudar?!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5279_0.zh:
* 嘿，老板！
有什么我能为您效劳的吗！？/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5263_0.ja: ＊ よう　ボス！　ボスじゃねえか！/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5265_0.de: 1* Heh, I'm so glad to have a nice boss, I could shed a tear.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5265_0.en: 1* Heh, I'm so glad to have a nice boss, I could shed a tear.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5265_0.es: 1* Heh, I'm so glad to have a nice boss, I could shed a tear.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5265_0.ja:
1＊ オレはうれしいぜ…　うれしくて
　 泣けてくる…　アンタみたいな
　 いいヤツを　ボスに持ててよ…/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5265_0.ko:
1* 헤헷,
  보스를 만나서 너무 반갑네,
  눈물이 날 정도야.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5265_0.pl: 1* Heh, cieszy mnie, że mam tak dobrego pracodawcę, mógłbym aż uronić łezkę.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5265_0.pt-BR: 1* Heh, fico tão feliz de ter um chefe legal, dá até vontade de chorar./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5265_0.ru: 1* Хе, я так рад иметь хорошего босса, что готов заплакать от радости.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5265_0.zh:
1* 嘿嘿，有您这么好的老板，
我高兴得眼泪都要流出来了.../

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5267_0.de: 2* BUT I WON'T!! I'm on the job!! I'll cry at home!! With the kids!!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5267_0.en: 2* BUT I WON'T!! I'm on the job!! I'll cry at home!! With the kids!!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5267_0.es: 2* BUT I WON'T!! I'm on the job!! I'll cry at home!! With the kids!!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5267_0.ja:
2＊ でも　オレは泣かないぜ！
　 仕事中だからな！　泣くのは家で！
　 子どもらと　いっしょに！/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5267_0.ko:
2* 하지만 울지 않아!! 프로니까!!
  집에서 애들이랑 같이!!
  펑펑 울 거라네!!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5267_0.pl: 2* ALE TEGO NIE ZROBIĘ!! Bo jestem w pracy!! Będę płakał w domu!! Z dzieciakami!!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5267_0.pt-BR: 2* MAS EU NÃO VOU!! Eu estou no trabalho!! Eu vou chorar em casa!! Com as crianças!!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5267_0.ru: 2* НО Я НЕ БУДУ!! Я на работе!! Я буду плакать дома!! С детьми!!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5267_0.zh:
2* 但我才不会哭！！这可是在工作中！！
等回家我再哭！！
和我的孩子们一起哭！！/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5269_0.de: 0* Boss! You're strong, but there's always time to learn!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5269_0.en: 0* Boss! You're strong, but there's always time to learn!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5269_0.es: 0* Boss! You're strong, but there's always time to learn!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5269_0.ja:
0＊ ボス！　アンタは強い！
　 だけどな　どんなときでも
　 学びの心を忘れちゃいけないぜ！/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5269_0.ko:
0* 보스! 보스는 강하지만,
  배움의 기회는 아직 많다네!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5269_0.pl: 0* Szefie! Masz silną drużynę, ale musisz się jeszcze wiele nauczyć!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5269_0.pt-BR: 0* Chefia! Você é forte, mas tem sempre tempo para aprender!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5269_0.ru: 0* Босс! Вы сильны, но учиться можно бесконечно!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5269_0.zh:
0* 老板！虽然您已经很厉害了，
但是学无止境嘛！/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5270_0.de: * The next step after tutorials, is TRAINING!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5270_0.en: * The next step after tutorials, is TRAINING!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5270_0.es: * The next step after tutorials, is TRAINING!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5270_0.ja:
＊ チュートリアルがすんだら
　 次は修行だ！/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5270_0.pl: * Po poznaniu teorii, nadszedł czas na PRAKTYKĘ!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5270_0.pt-BR: * O próximo passo depois de tutoriais, é o TREINAMENTO!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5270_0.zh: * 教程后的下一步，那就是训练！/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5271_0.de: * So, me and the boys got you together a DOJO!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5271_0.en: * So, me and the boys got you together a DOJO!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5271_0.es: * So, me and the boys got you together a DOJO!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5271_0.ja:
＊ てことで　オレたちみんなで
　 力を合わせて　ボスのために
　 道場をつくったぜ！/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5271_0.ko:
* 그래서, 다들 보스를 위해
  힘을 합쳐 도장을 만들었다네!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5271_0.pl: * Jak widzisz, razem z chłopakami wybudowaliśmy ci DOJO!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5271_0.pt-BR: * Então, eu e os caras construímos um DOJÔ!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5271_0.ru: * Итак, мы с парнями основали ДОДЗЁ для вас!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5271_0.zh:
* 所以啊，我和大伙一起开设了
这个道场！/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5272_0.de: * Complete our BATTLE CHALLENGES, and get some fabulous prizes!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5272_0.en: * Complete our BATTLE CHALLENGES, and get some fabulous prizes!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5272_0.es: * Complete our BATTLE CHALLENGES, and get some fabulous prizes!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5272_0.ja:
＊ バトルチャレンジをクリアすると
　 豪華賞品をゲットできちまう！/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5272_0.ko:
* 우리 전투 챌린지를 완수하고,
  멋진 상을 받아 가게나!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5272_0.pl: * Ukończ nasze WYZWANIA, a dostaniesz cudowne nagrody!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5272_0.pt-BR: * Complete nossos DESAFIOS DE BATALHA e ganhe uns prêmios fabulosos!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5272_0.ru: * Пройдите наши ИСПЫТАНИЯ и получите несколько крутых призов!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5272_0.zh:
* 完成战斗挑战，
就能获得豪华的奖励！/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5273_0.de: * Meanwhile, ya might get a little bit tougher!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5273_0.en: * Meanwhile, ya might get a little bit tougher!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5273_0.es: * Meanwhile, ya might get a little bit tougher!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5273_0.ja:
＊ そんでもって
　 もっともっと強くもなれちまう…
　 ってわけだ！/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5273_0.ko:
* 그러다 보면, 조금 더
  강해질 수 있을 걸세!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5273_0.pl: * Robiąc to, będziesz szlifować swoje umiejętności!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5273_0.pt-BR: * Enquanto isso, cê talvez queira ficar um pouco mais forte!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5273_0.zh: * 同时，也会让您变得更强！/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5274_0.de: * We're gonna make you the strongest, Boss!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5274_0.en: * We're gonna make you the strongest, Boss!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5274_0.es: * We're gonna make you the strongest, Boss!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5274_0.ja:
＊ オレらがアンタを
　 最強のボスに育ててやるぜ！/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5274_0.pl: * Zrobimy wszystko, by pomóc ci się rozwijać, Szefie!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5274_0.pt-BR: * Vamos te fazer ser a pessoa mais forte, chefia!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5274_0.zh:
* 我们会让您成为世界第一强的，
老板！/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5227_0.de: * Congratulations Boss! You defeated all the challenges!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5227_0.en: * Congratulations Boss! You defeated all the challenges!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5227_0.es: * Congratulations Boss! You defeated all the challenges!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5227_0.ja:
＊ やったなボス！
　 全チャレンジ制覇だ！/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5227_0.pl: * Gratulacje, Szefie! Wszystkie wyzwania już za tobą!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5227_0.pt-BR: * Parabéns Chefia! Você derrotou todos os desafios!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5227_0.ru: * Поздравляю, босс! Вы прошли все испытания!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5227_0.zh:
* 恭喜老板！
您完成了所有挑战！/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5228_0.de: * I have nothing more to teach or give you. But you're welcome to get some practice in!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5228_0.en: * I have nothing more to teach or give you. But you're welcome to get some practice in!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5228_0.es: * I have nothing more to teach or give you. But you're welcome to get some practice in!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5228_0.ja:
＊ もう　オレから教えることはないし
　 追加賞品もない。でも　ウデを
　 みがきたきゃ　いつでも歓迎だ！/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5228_0.ko:
* 더 이상 보스에게 가르치거나
  줄 건 없지만, 트레이닝은
  언제나 환영이라네!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5228_0.pl: * Nie mogę cię już niczego nauczyć, ani nic ci dać. Ale nie krępuj się trenować!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5228_0.pt-BR: * Eu não tenho mais nada para te ensinar ou dar. Mas sinta-se livre para praticar um pouco!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5228_0.ru: * Больше нечего вам дать и нечему учить. Но, если будет нужна практика, наши двери открыты!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5228_0.zh:
* 我没有什么能传授或给予您的了。
不过欢迎您随时来练习！/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5296_0.de: * We'll be working on NEW CHALLENGES, so check back in, Boss!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5296_0.en: * We'll be working on NEW CHALLENGES, so check back in, Boss!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5296_0.es: * We'll be working on NEW CHALLENGES, so check back in, Boss!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5296_0.ja:
＊ いま　新しいチャレンジを
　 準備中だ。また　のぞきに
　 来てくれよな！/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5296_0.ko:
* 새 챌린지를 만들고 있으니,
  다음에 또 와 주게, 보스!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5296_0.pl: * Ciągle pracujemy nad NOWYMI WYZWANIAMI, więc wróć tu za jakiś czas, Szefie!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5296_0.pt-BR: * Estamos trabalhando em NOVOS DESAFIOS, então checa mais tarde, Chefia!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5296_0.ru: * Работа над НОВЫМИ ИСПЫТАНИЯМИ уже ведётся, так что возвращайтесь, босс!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5296_0.zh:
* 我们会不断添加更多的新挑战，
记得随时回来看看，老板！/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5252_0_b.de: * No worries, Boss! We'll always be here./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5252_0_b.en: * No worries, Boss! We'll always be here./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5252_0_b.es: * No worries, Boss! We'll always be here./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5252_0_b.ja:
＊ 大丈夫　オレたちは
　 どこへも行きやしない。
　 ずっと　ここにいるからな。/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5252_0_b.ko:
* 걱정 마, 보스!
  우린 늘 여기 있으니까./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5252_0_b.pl: * Nie martw się, Szefie! Zawsze tu będę./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5252_0_b.pt-BR: * Não se preocupa, Chefia! Sempre estaremos aqui./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5252_0_b.ru: * Не беспокойся, босс! Мы будем тут, в случае чего./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5252_0_b.zh:
* 别担心，老板！
我们会一直在这里。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5307_0.ja:
1＊ クリス！
　 よく聞きたまえ！/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5308_0.de: 5I must admit, I feel pity for you./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5308_0.en: 5* I must admit, I feel pity for you./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5308_0.es: 5* I must admit, I feel pity for you./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5308_0.ja:
5＊ ボクも正直　キミに
　 同情する気持ちが
　 ないわけじゃない。/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5308_0.pl: 5* Muszę przyznać, że jest mi cię szkoda./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5308_0.pt-BR: 5* Eu devo admitir, eu sinto pena de você./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5308_0.zh: 5* 不得不说，我为你感到遗憾。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5309_0.de: EUnlike Susie, I always saw some potential in you./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5309_0.en: E* Unlike Susie, I always saw some potential in you./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5309_0.es: E* Unlike Susie, I always saw some potential in you./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5309_0.ja:
E＊ スージィは　さておき
　 キミには　以前から
　 可能性を感じていた。/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5309_0.ko:
E* 수지와는 달리, 네게선
  항상 가능성이 보였거든./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5309_0.pl: E* W przeciwieństwie do Susie, ty masz w sobie jakiś potencjał./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5309_0.pt-BR: E* Diferente da Susie, eu sempre vi um potencial em você./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5309_0.ru: E* В отличие от Сьюзи, в тебе я всегда видел нечто большее./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5309_0.zh:
E* 你和Susie不一样，
我在你的身上看到了潜能。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5310_0.de: 6Join our side, and I might let you scrub our royal toilet!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5310_0.en: 6* Join our side, and I might let you scrub our royal toilet!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5310_0.es: 6* Join our side, and I might let you scrub our royal toilet!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5310_0.ja:
6＊ こちらにつけば　館の
　 トイレそうじ係ぐらいには
　 してやってもいいぞ！/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5310_0.ko:
6* 우리 편으로 들어와라,
  그럼 왕실 변기 정도는
  닦게 해주지!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5310_0.pl: 6* Dołącz do nas, a może pozwolę ci pucować królewskie sedesy!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5310_0.pt-BR: 6* Junte-se ao nosso lado e eu talvez deixe você limpar o banheiro real!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5310_0.ru: 6* Присоединяйся к нам, и я разрешу тебе чистить наш королевский туалет!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5310_0.zh:
6* 加入我们这边，
说不定我会让你当我们的
御用洁厕工！/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5318_0.de: BWhat!? Don't say it so incredulously!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5318_0.en: B* What!? Don't say it so incredulously!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5318_0.es: B* What!? Don't say it so incredulously!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5318_0.ja:
B＊ なっ！？
　 なんだ　その
　 疑うような口調は！/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5318_0.ko:
B* 뭐!? 대답이
  왜 그렇게 회의적이야!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5318_0.pl: B* Co!? Nie mów tego z takim niedowierzaniem!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5318_0.pt-BR: B* O quê?! Não diga isso tão incredulamente!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5318_0.ru: B* Что?! Не говори так скептически!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5318_0.zh:
B* 什么！？
别用那么怀疑的语气回答！/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5319_0.de: CWell, if you're dead-set on proving your inferiority.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5319_0.en: C* Well, if you're dead-set on proving your inferiority.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5319_0.es: C* Well, if you're dead-set on proving your inferiority.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5319_0.ja:
C＊ フン　そんなに
　 自分の下等性を
　 証明したいのなら…/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5319_0.ko:

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5633_0.pt-BR: * (O DisqtVazio foi adicionado aos seus ITENs CHAVE.)/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5633_0.ru: * (Пустой диск был добавлен в ваши КЛЮЧЕВЫЕ ВЕЩИ.)/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5633_0.zh:
* （空磁盘被放进了
你的【重要物品】中。）/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5653_0.de: * (There's a slot for a disk here.)/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5653_0.en: * (There's a slot for a disk here.)/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5653_0.es: * (There's a slot for a disk here.)/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5653_0.ja: ＊ (ディスクを入れる　スロットがある)/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5653_0.pt-BR: * (Tem um slot para um disquete aqui.)/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5662_0.de: * (You put the disk into the broken down mechanism.)/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5662_0.en: * (You put the disk into the broken down mechanism.)/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5662_0.es: * (You put the disk into the broken down mechanism.)/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5662_0.ja: ＊ (壊れた機械に　ディスクを入れた)/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5662_0.pt-BR: * (Você insere o disquete no mecanismo quebrado.)/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5662_0.zh: * （你把磁盘插入了坏掉的机器中。）/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5700_0.ja: ＊ お帰りなさいませ　ご主人さま。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5701_0.de: * We found a strange hooligan trying to turn the cafe.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5701_0.en: * We found a strange hooligan trying to turn the cafe.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5701_0.es: * We found a strange hooligan trying to turn the cafe.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5701_0.ja:
＊ 先ほど　怪しい輩が　おりまして。
　 どうやら　このカフェを…/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5701_0.ko:
* 아까 수상한 자가 나타나서
  이 카페를.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5701_0.pl: * Zastaliśmy tu dziwnego jegomościa, który próbował przekształcić tę kawiarnię.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5701_0.pt-BR: * Nós encontramos um estranho vândalo tentando transformar o Café.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5701_0.ru: * Мы обнаружили странного хулигана, пытающегося превратить кафе.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5701_0.zh:
* 我们遇到一位怪客，
他想要把这间咖啡馆.../

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5702_0.ja:
＊ ２軒目のベーカリーにしようと
　 企んでいたようです。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5703_0.de: * He was spinning and crying as my men carried him out./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5703_0.en: * He was spinning and crying as my men carried him out./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5703_0.es: * He was spinning and crying as my men carried him out./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5703_0.ja:
＊ パレットラーたちに追い出させ
　 ましたが　その間ずっと　クルクル
　 回りながら　泣いておりました。/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5703_0.ko:
* 빙빙 돌며 눈물을 흘려대면서
  제 부하들에게 끌려나갔습니다./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5703_0.pl: * Kręcił się i płakał, gdy moi chłopcy wynosili go na zewnątrz./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5703_0.pt-BR: * Ele estava girando e chorando quando meus homens levaram ele pra fora./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5703_0.ru: * Он вертелся и плакал, когда мои подручные выносили его./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5703_0.zh:
* 我的伙计把他请出去的时候
他还一边哭一边打转。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5704_0.de: * We do not predict any further difficulties./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5704_0.en: * We do not predict any further difficulties./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5704_0.es: * We do not predict any further difficulties./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5704_0.ja:
＊ 今後は　そういったトラブルの心配は
　 ございませんので　ご安心を。/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5704_0.ko:
* 더 이상 그 자로 인해
  문제가 일어나진 않을 겁니다./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5704_0.pl: * Nie będzie już nam sprawiał więcej problemów./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5704_0.pt-BR: * Nós não prevemos mais nenhuma dificuldade futura./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5704_0.zh: * 我们真的不想再有更多的麻烦了。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5705_0.de: * Now, please. You've worked hard, boss. Relax and enjoy yourself.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5705_0.en: * Now, please. You've worked hard, boss. Relax and enjoy yourself.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5705_0.es: * Now, please. You've worked hard, boss. Relax and enjoy yourself.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5705_0.ja:
＊ 本日はもう　お疲れでしょう。
　 どうぞゆっくり
　 おくつろぎくださいませ…/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5705_0.ko:
* 자, 그럼 부디. 주인님께서는
  열심히 일하셨으니,
  편안히 쉬시기 바랍니다.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5705_0.pl: * Ciężka wyprawa za wami, szefie. Odpocznijcie sobie trochę.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5705_0.pt-BR: * Agora, por favor. Você trabalhou duro, chefia. Relaxe e divirta-se.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5705_0.ru: * А пока, прошу. Вы хорошо поработали, босс. Расслабьтесь и получайте удовольствие.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5705_0.zh:
* 老板请坐。
您那么努力工作，
快放松休息一下吧.../

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5710_0.ja: ＊ お帰りなさいませ　ご主人さま。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5711_0.de: * I found a strange hooligan trying to turn the cafe.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5711_0.en: * I found a strange hooligan trying to turn the cafe.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5711_0.es: * I found a strange hooligan trying to turn the cafe.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5711_0.ja:
＊ 先ほど　怪しい輩が　おりまして。
　 どうやら　このカフェを…/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5711_0.ko:
* 아까 수상한 자가 나타나서
  이 카페를.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5711_0.pl: * Zastałem tu dziwnego jegomościa, który próbował przekształcić tę kawiarnię.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5711_0.pt-BR: * Eu encontrei um estranho vândalo tentando transformar o café.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5711_0.ru: * Я обнаружил странного хулигана, пытающегося превратить кафе.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5711_0.zh:
* 我遇到一位怪客，
想要把这间咖啡馆.../

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5712_0.ja:
＊ ２軒目のベーカリーにしようと
　 企んでいたようです。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5713_0.de: * It was a cruel struggle, but I managed to remove him./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5713_0.en: * It was a cruel struggle, but I managed to remove him./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5713_0.es: * It was a cruel struggle, but I managed to remove him./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5713_0.ja:
＊ なかなか手こずりましたが
　 ワタクシが　じきじきに対処し
　 なんとかお引き取りいただきました。/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5713_0.pl: * Doszło do szarpaniny, ale udało mi się go stąd usunąć./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5713_0.pt-BR: * Foi uma luta cruel, mas eu consegui removê-lo./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5713_0.ru: * Пришлось серьёзно попотеть, но я смог его выпроводить./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5713_0.zh:
* 虽然过程很是挣扎，
但我最后还是把他请出去了。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5714_0.de: * ... If only my men were here.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5714_0.en: * ... If only my men were here.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5714_0.es: * ... If only my men were here.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5714_0.ja:
＊ …パレットラーたちがいれば
　 難なく対応できたのですが…/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5714_0.pl: * Gdyby tylko moi chłopcy tu byli.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5714_0.pt-BR: * ... Se pelo menos meus homens estivessem aqui.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5714_0.ru: * ...Если бы здесь было больше моих ребят.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5714_0.zh:
* ...要是我的伙计们也在这里
就好了.../

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5715_0.de: * My apologies. This is no time to reminisce./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5715_0.en: * My apologies. This is no time to reminisce./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5715_0.es: * My apologies. This is no time to reminisce./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5715_0.ja:
＊ …そのようなことを申しても
　 しかたがございませんね。/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5715_0.pl: * Przepraszam. To nie czas na wspominki./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5715_0.pt-BR: * Desculpe-me. Isso não é hora de relembrar./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5715_0.ru: * Примите мои извинения. Сейчас не время предаваться ностальгии./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5715_0.zh:
* 失礼了。
现在可不是回忆的时间。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5716_0.de: * Now, please. You've worked hard, boss. Relax and enjoy yourself.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5716_0.en: * Now, please. You've worked hard, boss. Relax and enjoy yourself.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5716_0.es: * Now, please. You've worked hard, boss. Relax and enjoy yourself.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5716_0.ja:
＊ 本日はもう　お疲れでしょう。
　 どうぞゆっくり
　 おくつろぎくださいませ…/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5716_0.ko:
* 자, 그럼 부디. 주인님께서는
  열심히 일하고 오셨으니,
  편히 쉬시기 바랍니다.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5716_0.pl: * Ciężka wyprawa za wami, szefie. Odpocznijcie sobie trochę.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5716_0.pt-BR: * Agora, por favor. Você trabalhou duro, chefia. Relaxe e divirta-se.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5716_0.ru: * А пока, прошу. Вы хорошо поработали, босс. Расслабьтесь и получайте удовольствие.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5716_0.zh:
* 老板请坐。
您那么努力工作，
快放松休息一下吧.../

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5722_0.de: * Good evening, boss. Please, relax and enjoy yourself.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5722_0.en: * Good evening, boss. Please, relax and enjoy yourself.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5722_0.es: * Good evening, boss. Please, relax and enjoy yourself.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5722_0.ja:
＊ ごきげんよう。
　 どうぞゆっくり
　 おくつろぎくださいませ…/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5722_0.ko:
* 멋진 저녁입니다, 주인님.
  부디, 편히 쉬시길.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5722_0.pl: * Dobry wieczór, szefie. Proszę, odpocznijcie sobie trochę.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5722_0.pt-BR: * Boa tarde, chefia. Por favor, relaxe e divirta-se.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5722_0.ru: * Добрый вечер, босс. Пожалуйста, расслабьтесь и получайте удовольствие.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5722_0.zh:
* 晚上好，老板。
请放松休息一下吧.../

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5765_0.de: * For the young human, we recommend a chocolate blueberry latte.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5765_0.en: * For the young human, we recommend a chocolate blueberry latte.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5765_0.es: * For the young human, we recommend a chocolate blueberry latte.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5765_0.ja:
＊ ニンゲンの　お客さまには
　 チョコレートブルーベリーラテが
　 おすすめでございます…/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5765_0.ko:
* 젊은 인간 분에게는,
  초콜릿 블루베리 라떼를
  추천드립니다.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5765_0.pl: * Młodemu człowiekowi polecamy czekoladowe latte z syropem jagodowym.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5765_0.pt-BR: * Para tal jovem ser humano, nós recomendamos um latte de mirtilo com chocolate.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5765_0.ru: * Молодым людям мы рекомендуем шоколадно-черничный латте.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5765_0.zh:
* 我们为这位年轻的人类
推荐巧克力蓝莓拿铁.../

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5766_0.de: * Boss, please try not to use all of the sugar./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5766_0.en: * Boss, please try not to use all of the sugar./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5766_0.es: * Boss, please try not to use all of the sugar./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5766_0.ja:
＊ ご主人さまには　そなえつけの
　 お砂糖を　全部お入れにならぬよう
　 くれぐれも　お願い申し上げます。/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5766_0.ko:
* 주인님, 설탕은
  다 넣지 말아 주십시오./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5766_0.pl: * Szefie, postaraj się nie zużyć całego cukru./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5766_0.pt-BR: * Chefe, por favor, tente não usar todo o açúcar./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5766_0.ru: * Босс, пожалуйста, постарайтесь не истратить весь сахар./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5766_0.zh: * 老板，请不要把所有的糖都加进来哦。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5770_0.de: * For the young monster, we recommend the blackberry tart.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5770_0.en: * For the young monster, we recommend the blackberry tart.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5770_0.es: * For the young monster, we recommend the blackberry tart.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5770_0.ja:
＊ モンスターの　お客さまには
　 ブラックベリータルトが
　 おすすめでございます…/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5770_0.ko:
* 젊은 괴물 분에게는,
  블랙베리 타르트를
  추천합니다.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5770_0.pl: * Młodemu potworowi polecamy tartę z jeżynami.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5770_0.pt-BR: * Para a jovem monstra, nós recomendamos a torta de amora.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5770_0.zh:
* 我们为这位年轻的怪物
推荐黑莓果馅饼.../

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5771_0_b.de: * This way, even if you eat it quickly, you won't notice the stains./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5771_0_b.en: * This way, even if you eat it quickly, you won't notice the stains./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5771_0_b.es: * This way, even if you eat it quickly, you won't notice the stains./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5771_0_b.ja:
＊ これでしたら　一気食いをなさっても
　 食べこぼしのシミが
　 気にならないかと。/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5771_0_b.ko:
* 이거라면, 아무리 빨리 먹어도,
  얼룩이 눈에 띄진 않을 테니까요./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5771_0_b.pl: * Nawet jak będziesz jeść w pośpiechu, plamy nie będą widoczne na twoim stroju./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5771_0_b.pt-BR: * Dessa forma, mesmo se comer rápido, você não irá perceber as manchas./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5771_0_b.ru: * Таким образом, на вас не будут видны пятна от еды./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5771_0_b.zh:
* 这样的话，就算你吃得特别快，
也不会注意到身上的污渍。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5775_0.de: * For the young prince, we recommend the vanilla green tea./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5775_0.en: * For the young prince, we recommend the vanilla green tea./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5775_0.es: * For the young prince, we recommend the vanilla green tea./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5775_0.ja:
＊ 王子の　お客さまには
　 バニラグリーンティーが
　 おすすめでございます。/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5775_0.pl: * Młodemu księciu polecamy zieloną herbatę z wanilią./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5775_0.pt-BR: * Para o jovem príncipe, nós recomendamos o chá verde de baunilha./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5775_0.ru: * Юному принцу мы готовы порекомендовать зелёный чай с ванилью./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5775_0.zh:
* 我们为这位年轻的王子
推荐香草绿茶。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5776_0.de: * ... There's not much to go off besides your color./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5776_0.en: * ... There's not much to go off besides your color./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5776_0.es: * ... There's not much to go off besides your color./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5776_0.ja:
＊ …お体の色味以外に
　 参考になる情報が
　 ございませんでしたので…/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5776_0.ko:
* ... 전체적인 색 이외에는
  참고할 게 많지 않군요./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5776_0.pt-BR: * ... Não tenho muito a dizer além de que é sua cor./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5776_0.ru: * ...Он ни на что особенное не повлияет, кроме цвета./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5776_0.zh:
* ...除了和你的颜色很搭配，
没有什么特别的说法。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5780_0.de: * For the young deer, we recommend the cinnamon eggnog./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5780_0.en: * For the young deer, we recommend the cinnamon eggnog./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5780_0.es: * For the young deer, we recommend the cinnamon eggnog./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5780_0.ja:
＊ トナカイの　お客さまには
　 シナモンエッグノグが
　 おすすめでございます。/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5780_0.ko:
* 젊은 사슴 분께는,
  시나몬 에그노그를 추천합니다./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5780_0.pl: * Dla młodej łani polecamy cynamonowy kogel-mogel./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5780_0.pt-BR: * Para a jovem rena, nós recomendamos gemada de canela./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5780_0.ru: * Для молодых оленей мы рекомендуем гоголь-моголь с корицей./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5780_0.zh:
* 我们为这位年轻的小鹿
推荐肉桂蛋奶酒。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5781_0.de: * We've shaved candy cane on top for extra flavor./

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7513_0.es: * You can check the area's RECRUIT status at SAVE POINTS. Certain BOSSES are excluded./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7513_0.ja:
＊ なかまになる敵の情報は　各エリアの
　 セーブポイントで確認できます。
　 (一部のボスは除きます)/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7513_0.ko:
* 영입 상태는 각 지역의
  세이브 포인트에서 확인합니다.
  특정 보스는 제외됩니다./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7513_0.pl: * Możesz sprawdzić status REKRUTACJI przy PUNKCIE ZAPISU. BOSSOWIE zwykle nie są liczeni./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7513_0.pt-BR: * Você olha o status dos RECRUTAs da área em PONTOS SALVOS. Certos CHEFES não contam./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7513_0.ru: * Вы можете проверять ЖИТЕЛЕЙ на ТОЧКАХ СОХРАНЕНИЯ. Часть БОССОВ вне списка./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7513_0.zh:
* 你可以在存档点查看该区域的招揽状态。
部分BOSS无法被招揽。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7519_0.de: * You will now have access to a STORAGE menu at SAVE POINTS./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7519_0.en: * You will now have access to a STORAGE menu at SAVE POINTS./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7519_0.es: * You will now have access to a STORAGE menu at SAVE POINTS./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7519_0.ja:
＊ セーブポイントで
　「そうこ」メニューを
　 使えるようになりました。/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7519_0.ko:
* 세이브 포인트에서
  창고 메뉴를 쓸 수 있습니다./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7519_0.pl: * Przy PUNKCIE ZAPISU masz dostęp do SCHOWKA./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7519_0.pt-BR: * Você agora terá acesso a um menu de ARMAZENAMENTO nos PONTOS SALVOS./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7519_0.ru: * На ТОЧКАХ СОХРАНЕНИЯ вы можете получить доступ к СКЛАДУ./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7519_0.zh: * 你现在可以从存档点进入【库存】菜单。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7520_0.de: * When you're out of space, ITEMs you find or BUY will be sent to your STORAGE./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7520_0.en: * When you're out of space, ITEMs you find or BUY will be sent to your STORAGE./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7520_0.es: * When you're out of space, ITEMs you find or BUY will be sent to your STORAGE./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7520_0.ja:
＊ 「アイテム」を持ちきれなくなると
　 以降　拾ったり買ったりしたものは
　 「そうこ」に送られます。/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7520_0.ko:
* 현재 공간이 부족하면,
  사거나 획득한 아이템을
  창고로 보냅니다./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7520_0.pl: * Gdy zabraknie ci miejsca, znalezione lub kupione RZECZY zostaną wysłane do SCHOWKA./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7520_0.pt-BR: * Quando estiver sem espaço, ITENS que achar ou COMPRAR são enviados ao ARMAZENAMENTO./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7520_0.ru: * Если не осталось места, купленные или найденные вами ВЕЩИ отправятся туда./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7520_0.zh:
* 如果你身上的空间不够了，
你找到或购买的【物品】
会被放进你的【库存】里。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7521_0.de: * Feel free to put things inside you might not be able to use yet./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7521_0.en: * Feel free to put things inside you might not be able to use yet./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7521_0.es: * Feel free to put things inside you might not be able to use yet./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7521_0.ja:
＊ しばらく使わなそうなアイテムは
　 「そうこ」に入れておくと
　 よいでしょう。/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7521_0.ko:
* 아직 사용하지 않을
  아이템은 창고에 넣어두도록
  하세요./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7521_0.pl: * Nie krępuj się wsadzić do niego rzeczy, które mogą się przydać w przyszłości./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7521_0.pt-BR: * Sinta-se livre para colocar coisas dentro que talvez não possa usar ainda./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7521_0.ru: * Не стесняйтесь класть туда вещи, которым ещё не нашлось применения./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7521_0.zh: * 把你目前用不到的东西都放进去吧。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7527_0.de: * Here is a reminder of the controls. Change them in the config menu./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7527_0.en: * Here is a reminder of the controls. Change them in the config menu./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7527_0.es: * Here is a reminder of the controls. Change them in the config menu./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7527_0.ja:
＊ 操作のおさらいです。
　 (設定メニューで　変更もできます)/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7527_0.ko:
* 조작법 복습입니다.
  설정 메뉴에서 바꿀 수 있습니다./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7527_0.pl: * Przypomnijmy sobie sterowanie. Pamiętaj, że możesz je zmienić w zakładce OPCJE./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7527_0.pt-BR: * Aqui está uma lembrança dos controles. Mude eles no menu de configuração./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7527_0.ru: * Напоминание о системе управления. Можете изменить её в НАСТРОЙКАХ./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7527_0.zh:
* 这里是对控制设置的提示。
可以在配置菜单里更改。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7536_0.en: * (There's no time to read books.)/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7554_0.de: * Oh, Kris! It's a free editable CYBERPEDIA! I'll add an entry...!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7554_0.en: * Oh, Kris! It's a free editable CYBERPEDIA! I'll add an entry...!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7554_0.es: * Oh, Kris! It's a free editable CYBERPEDIA! I'll add an entry...!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7554_0.ja:
＊ あ…　サイバーペディアだ！
　 だれでも編集できるんだよ！
　 ボク　記事を書くね…/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7554_0.ko:
* 아, 크리스! 자유롭게
  수정 가능한 사이버위키야!
  나도 하나 추가해야지...!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7554_0.pl: * Ach, Kris! To darmowa, fanowska CYBERPEDIA! Dodam wpis...!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7554_0.pt-BR: * Ah, Kris! É uma CYBERPÉDIA livre! Eu vou colocar uma entrada...!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7554_0.ru: * О, Крис! Это же свободно редактируемая КИБЕРПЕДИЯ! Я добавлю статью!../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7554_0.zh:
* 啊，Kris！
这是可以自由编写的赛博百科！
我要写上一个词条...！/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7556_0.de: * (Ralsei wrote an article about LOSING RECRUITS. Read it?)/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7556_0.en: * (Ralsei wrote an article about LOSING RECRUITS. Read it?)/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7556_0.es: * (Ralsei wrote an article about LOSING RECRUITS. Read it?)/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7556_0.ja:
＊ (ラルセイは
　 「なかまを失うこと」という
　 記事を書いた。読む？)/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7556_0.ko:
* (랄세이가 영입한 동료를
  잃는 것에 대한 글을 썼다.
  읽을까?)/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7556_0.pl: * (Ralsei napisał artykuł o TRACENIU REKRUTÓW. Przeczytać go?)/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7556_0.pt-BR: * (Ralsei escreveu um artigo sobre PERDER RECRUTAS. Ler?)/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7556_0.ru: * (Ральзей написал статью о СБЕГАЮЩИХ ВРАГАХ. Прочитать её?)/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7556_0.zh:
* （Ralsei写了一项关于
【失去伙伴】的词条。要读一读吗？）/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7582_0.de: * From now on, defeating enemies with violence will make them LOST./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7582_0.en: * From now on, defeating enemies with violence will make them LOST./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7582_0.es: * From now on, defeating enemies with violence will make them LOST./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7582_0.ja:
＊ 今回の冒険以降では
　 敵をこうげきして倒すと　「LOST」
　 つまり　失われてしまいます。/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7582_0.ko:
* 지금부터, 공격해 쓰러뜨린 적은
  잃어버리게 됩니다./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7582_0.pl: * Od teraz każdy pokonany przemocą wróg zostanie UTRACONY./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7582_0.pt-BR: * De agora em diante, derrotar inimigos com violência os tornarão PERDIDOS./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7582_0.ru: * С этого момента враги, побеждённые насилием, СБЕГАЮТ./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7582_0.zh:
* 从今往后，当你以暴力击败敌人时，
你将会【失去】它们。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7583_0.de: * LOST enemies cannot become RECRUITs ever again./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7583_0.en: * LOST enemies cannot become RECRUITs ever again./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7583_0.es: * LOST enemies cannot become RECRUITs ever again./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7583_0.ja:
＊ 「LOST」した敵は
　 その後二度と「なかま」にすることは
　 できません。/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7583_0.ko:
* 잃은 적들은
  다시는 영입할 수 없습니다./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7583_0.pl: * UTRACENI wrogowie nie mogą już stać się REKRUTAMI./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7583_0.pt-BR: * Inimigos PERDIDOS nunca mais poderão ser RECRUTAdos./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7583_0.ru: * СБЕЖАВШИЕ враги больше никогда не ПОСЕЛЯТСЯ к нам./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7583_0.zh:
* 已【失去】的敌人无法被
【招揽】为伙伴。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7584_0.de: * But, the bonds you break may make you stronger.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7584_0.en: * But, the bonds you break may make you stronger.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7584_0.es: * But, the bonds you break may make you stronger.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7584_0.ja:
＊ ただし　失ったきずなと引きかえに
　 自分が　強くは　なれるでしょう…/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7584_0.ko:
* 하지만, 인연을 부술수록,
  더 강해질 수도 있으니.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7584_0.pl: * Lecz zniszczone więzi mogą wzmocnić twoją drużynę.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7584_0.pt-BR: * Mas, os laços que você quebra podem te deixar mais forte.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7584_0.ru: * Но такие действия делают вас сильнее.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7584_0.zh:
* 然而，有失必有得。
那些失去的羁绊，
或许会让你变得更强.../

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7590_0.de: * (Who has time to read a book in the Cyber World?)/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7590_0.en: * (Who has time to read a book in the Cyber World?)/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7590_0.es: * (Who has time to read a book in the Cyber World?)/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7590_0.pt-BR: * (Quem tem tempo para ler um livro no Cyber Mundo?)/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7590_0.zh: * （在赛博世界谁会有时间读书呢？）/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7607_0.en: * (The LoadedDisk squirmed and won't fit!)/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7607_0.ru: * (Загрузочный диск извивается и не помещается в приёмник!)/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7625_0.en: * (Something is glimmering in the hole.)/

＊ (穴のなかで
　 なにかが　かすかに光を発している)/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7625_0.zh: * （洞里有什么东西在闪闪发光。）/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7648_0.de: * (You reached inside and found something alongside a strange piece of glass...)/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7648_0.en: * (You reached inside and found something alongside a strange piece of glass...)/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7648_0.es: * (You reached inside and found something alongside a strange piece of glass...)/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7648_0.ja:
＊ (穴のなかに　手を伸ばした。
　 不思議なガラスの欠片と…
　 なにかがある…)/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7648_0.ko:
* (당신은 안으로 손을 뻗었다가,
  이상한 유리 조각과 무언가를
  발견했다...)/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7648_0.pl: * (Zaglądasz do środka i znajdujesz dziwny odłamek szkła i coś jeszcze...)/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7648_0.pt-BR: * (Você enfiou o braço dentro e achou algo junto com um pedaço estranho de vidro...)/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7648_0.ru: * (Вы залезли внутрь и нашли странный кусок стекла...)/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7648_0.zh:
* （你把手伸进去，
发现了一块奇怪的玻璃碎片
以及某样东西...）/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7658_0.ja: ＊ (シャドウジェムを手に入れた)/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_8672_0.de: * Da hat der alte Tenna mal wenigstens IRGENDWEN gefunden, denen's gefällt.../

少了点什么对吧？/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_8793_0.zh: * 诚实，那我将把你带去某处。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_8805_0.ru: * Тогда мне до вас нет никакого дела!/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_8825_0.de: * Der Eingang...? Dasch kriegen wa' hin./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_8825_0.en: * The entrance...? That can be arranged./

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_8825_0.pt-BR: * A entrada...? Isso pode ser resolvido./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_8825_0.zh:
* 你要去入口...？
如你所愿。/

＊ 入り口か…？　いまはパズルで
　 ふさがってるから　そいつを
　 解いてから左へ進め。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_8829_0.pt-BR: * The entrance...? Well, it's blocked by a puzzle. Solve it and head left./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_8829_0.ru: * Вход?.. Ну, там головоломка всё загородила. Решите её и идите влево./

噢，那里被谜题堵住了。

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_8840_0.ru: * Всё равно ж туды ты и идёшь./

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_8862_0.en: * Too bad... naw, too good./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_8862_0.ja: ＊ それは残念…いや　よかった。/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_8862_0.pl: * To źle... a nie, to dobrze./

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_8864_0.en: * Too good... naw, too bad./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_8864_0.ja: ＊ それはよかった…いや　残念だ。/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_8864_0.pl: * To dobrze... a nie, to źle./

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_8867_0.de: * Was der -- sach das im Käfisch!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_8867_0.en: * What the -- say it in da cage!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_8867_0.ja:
＊ なっ…　おしおきケージに
　 入ってろ！/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_8867_0.pl: * Co tu się... powiesz to w klatce!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_8867_0.pt-BR: * É o quê -- fala isso atrás das grades!/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_8884_0.ja: ＊ クリス。用は　すんだか？/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_8890_0.de: * Kris, wasch dasch für'n TICKET? Egal, beeil disch oder Tenna wird sauer./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_8890_0.en: * Kris, what's that TICKET? Nevermind, hurry or Mr. Tenna's gonna get mad./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_8890_0.es: * Kris, ¿qué es ese CHICKET? No impourcha, dache prisa o Doun Chenna se enfadará./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_8890_0.ja:
＊ クリス　その切符は　なんだ？
　 まあいい。急がないと　ミスター・
　 テナに　どやされる。行くぞ。/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_8890_0.ko:
* 크리스, 그 티켓은 뭐고? 아이 됐다,
  사장님 화내기 전에 얼렁 가자./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_8890_0.pl: * Kris, co to za BILET? Nieważne, szybko, bo Pan Tenna się wścieknie./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_8890_0.pt-BR: * Kris, o que é esse TÍQUETE? Esquece, se apresse ou o Sr. Tenna vai ficar bravo./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_8890_0.ru: * Крис, что это за ПУТЁВКА у тебя? Не суть, поспеши, или мистер Тенна опять расшумится./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_8890_0.zh:
* Kris，你那张票是怎么回事？
算了，快走吧，
不然Tenna先生要发飙了。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_8907_0.de: * Gut. Der Wesch zurück ischt auch noch nischt fertisch./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_8907_0.en: * Good. I hadn't arranged the way back yet./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_8907_0.es: * Me alegrou. Aún nou he geschionadou el caminou de vuelcha./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_8907_0.ja:
＊ よかった。まだ帰り道の準備を
　 してないからな。/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_8907_0.ko:
* 마침 다행이구마.
  아직 돌려보내줄 수가 없었거든./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_8907_0.pl: * Dobrze. Jeszcze nie stworzyłem drogi powrotnej./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_8907_0.pt-BR: * Bom. Eu ainda não tinha organizado o caminho de volta./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_8907_0.ru: * Хорошо. Я пока и не подготовил нам путь обратно./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_8907_0.zh:
* 很好。
我还没安排好返程的路线。/
