obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_353_0.ja:
＊ 町長は　いま
　 おまつりの　じゅんびで
　 たいへん　おいそがしいのです。/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_353_0.ko:
* 시장님은 축제 준비로
  아주, 아주 바쁘셔./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_353_0.pl: * W tym momencie jest zajęta przygotowaniami do festiwalu./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_353_0.pt-BR: * Ela está muito, muito ocupada preparando o festival./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_353_0.ru: * Она очень, очень занята подготовкой к фестивалю./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_353_0.zh:
* 因为要准备庆典，
她现在非常非常的忙。/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_409_0_b.de: * Wie? Sucht ihr hier nach etwas Wichtigem?/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_409_0_b.en: * What? Are you looking here for something important?/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_409_0_b.ja:
＊ はい？　「じゅうようなもの」を
　 さがしている…？/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_409_0_b.pt-BR: * O que foi? Estão procurando por algo importante?/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_409_0_b.zh:
* 什么？
你在找什么重要的东西吗？/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_410_0.de: * Zur Sicherheit verstaut die Bürgermeisterin alles Wichtige bei sich zuhause./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_410_0.en: * The mayor keeps everything important at her own house for extra security./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_410_0.es: * La alcadesa lo guarda todo en su casa para mayor seguridad./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_410_0.ja:
＊ ちょうちょうは　じゅうようなものは
　 みんな　ごじたくに　ほかんされて
　 います。/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_410_0.ko:
* 시장님은 중요한 것들은
  전부 특별히 안전을 위해
  자택에 보관하셔./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_410_0.pl: * Pani burmistrz przechowuje wszystkie ważne rzeczy w swoim domu, by były bezpieczniejsze./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_410_0.pt-BR: * A prefeita deixa tudo de importante na casa dela por questões de segurança./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_410_0.ru: * Для пущей безопасности мэр хранит всё самое важное дома./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_410_0.zh:
* 市长把所有重要的东西都存放在
自己家里，这样才最保险。/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_413_0.de: * ... Verzeihung, das sollte ich garnicht sagen./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_413_0.en: * ... Sorry, I wasn't supposed to say that./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_413_0.es: * ... Lo siento, no debí haber dicho eso./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_413_0.ja:
＊ …というのは　ホントは
　 ヒミツなんでした…/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_413_0.pt-BR: * ... Perdão, eu não deveria ter dito isso./

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_360_0.de: * Well well. If it isn't the teens. Our beloved "rats of the city."/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_360_0.en: * Well well. If it isn't the teens. Our beloved "rats of the city."/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_360_0.es: * Well well. If it isn't the teens. Our beloved "rats of the city."/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_360_0.ja:
＊ これはこれは。ティーンエイジャー
　 どもの　おでましだ。あいすべき
　 「まちのドブネズミ」どもだ。/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_360_0.ko:
* 이런 이런. 우리 마을의
  사랑하는 들쥐들.
  십대 친구들 아니신가./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_360_0.pl: * No, no. Czy to nie nastolatki. Nasze kochane „miejskie szczury”./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_360_0.pt-BR: * Ora, ora. Se não são os adolescentes. Nossos amados "ratos da cidade"./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_360_0.ru: * Так-так. Уж не наши ли это подростки. Любимые «крысы города»./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_360_0.zh:
* 哎哟喂。这不是镇上的小青年吗，
我们亲爱的“城市祸害”。/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_361_0.de: * You wanna get into Politics? Heh./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_361_0.en: * You wanna get into Politics? Heh./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_361_0.es: * You wanna get into Politics? Heh./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_361_0.ja:
＊ おまえら
　 せいじかに　なりたいのか？
　 フン！/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_361_0.pl: * Chcecie wejść w świat polityki? Heh./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_361_0.pt-BR: * Você quer entrar na política? Heh./

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_362_0.de: * You better graduate from Diaper School first./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_362_0.en: * You better graduate from Diaper School first./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_362_0.es: * You better graduate from Diaper School first./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_362_0.ja:
＊ だったら　まずは
　 オムツがっこうを
　 そつぎょうすることだな。/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_362_0.ko:
* 일단 기저귀 학교부터
  졸업하는 게 좋을 거다./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_362_0.pl: * Najpierw nauczcie się zmieniać sobie pieluchę./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_362_0.pt-BR: * Você deveria se formar na Escola da Fralda antes./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_362_0.zh: * 那你最好还是先从尿布学校毕业吧。/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_363_0.de: * That's what I did. And look at me now./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_363_0.en: * That's what I did. And look at me now./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_363_0.es: * That's what I did. And look at me now./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_363_0.ja:
＊ オレは　そつぎょうしたぜ。
　 おかげで　いまじゃ…/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_363_0.ko:
* 내가 그랬거든.
  그리고 지금의 날 봐./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_363_0.pl: * Ja się nauczyłem. I spójrzcie na mnie./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_363_0.pt-BR: * Foi o que eu fiz. E olhe pra mim agora./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_363_0.ru: * Это то, что я сделал. И теперь посмотри на меня./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_363_0.zh:
* 我就是从那儿毕业的。
瞧我现在多风光。/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_364_0.en: * I don't even work here./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_364_0.ja: ＊ ここで　はたらいてもいない。/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_366_0.de: * This Briefscase, is full of Diapers. Or, to the Pro's, "Diaps."/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_366_0.en: * This Briefscase, is full of Diapers. Or, to the Pro's, "Diaps."/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_366_0.es: * This Briefscase, is full of Diapers. Or, to the Pro's, "Diaps."/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_366_0.ja:
＊ このブリーフケースには
　 オムツが　やまほど　はいってる。
　 ギョーカイようごじゃ　「OMT」だ。/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_366_0.ko:
* 이 서류 가방에는, 기저귀가
  가득 들어 있어, 전문용어로,
  "기적의 가방"이라고도 하지./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_366_0.pl: * Ta waliza pełna jest pieluszek. A dla profesjonalistów: „piechl”./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_366_0.pt-BR: * Esta maleta, está cheia de Fraldas. Ou, para os profissionais, "Fraldz"./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_366_0.ru: * Этот дипломат полон подгузников. Или, говоря профессионально, «памперсов»./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_366_0.zh:
* 我这个公文包里面，装的全都是尿布。
或者，用专业术语讲，叫“尿不湿”。/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_367_0.de: * You're gonna have to level up to understand a Man's World./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_367_0.en: * You're gonna have to level up to understand a Man's World./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_367_0.es: * You're gonna have to level up to understand a Man's World./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_367_0.ja:
＊ オトナの　せかいを　りかいするには
　 おまえら　まだまだ
　 レベルが　たりてないぜ。/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_367_0.ko:
* 어른들의 세계를 이해하려면
  레벨을 더 올려야 할 거야./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_367_0.pl: * Musicie się bardziej postarać, by zrozumieć męski świat./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_367_0.pt-BR: * Você vai ter que subir de nível para entender o Mundo de um Homem./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_367_0.ru: * Вам нужно развиваться, чтобы понять Взрослый мир./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_367_0.zh:
* 要想理解成年人的世界，
你还需要提高自己的知识水平。/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_373_0.de: * That bald guy keeps trying to show me something from his briefcase./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_373_0.en: * That bald guy keeps trying to show me something from his briefcase./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_373_0.es: * That bald guy keeps trying to show me something from his briefcase./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_373_0.ja:
＊ そこの　あたまがツルッとしたひと…
　 ブリーフケースの　なかみを
　 しつこく　みせようとするんだ。/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_373_0.ko:
* 저 대머리가 계속
  서류 가방 속에 있는 걸
  보여주려고 해./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_373_0.pl: * Ten łysy gostek próbuje pokazać mi wnętrze swojej walizki./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_373_0.pt-BR: * Aquele cara careca fica tentando me mostrar algo de sua maleta./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_373_0.ru: * Этот лысый парень пытается показать мне содержимое своего портфеля./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_373_0.zh:
* 那个秃子老是想给我看他公文包
里面的东西。/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_374_0.de: * Is it a bribe...? I'm really deep into politics now.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_374_0.en: * Is it a bribe...? I'm really deep into politics now.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_374_0.es: * Is it a bribe...? I'm really deep into politics now.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_374_0.ja:
＊ ワイロなのか…？
　 ああ…　オレは　すっかり
　 せいじに　そまってしまった…/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_374_0.ko:
* 혹시 뇌물일까...?
  나도 이젠 정치에 완전히
  입문해버렸구나.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_374_0.pl: * Czy to ma być łapówka...? Brutalna jest ta polityka.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_374_0.pt-BR: * Isso é um suborno...? Estou realmente muito fundo na política agora.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_374_0.ru: * Это и есть взятка?.. Я так далеко ушёл в политику.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_374_0.zh:
* 这算是贿赂吗...？
我现在真的身陷政治了.../

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_443_0_b.de: * Bisher, aus politischer Sicht, habe ich nichts getan au€er rumstehen und wichtig aussehen./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_443_0_b.en: * So far, politically, all I've really done is stand here and look important./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_443_0_b.es: * Por ahora, políticamente, todo lo que he hecho es quedarme aquí y parecer importante./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_443_0_b.ja:
＊ いまのところ　オレが
　 せいじてきに　こなした　しごとは
　 エラソーに　たってることだけだ。/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_443_0_b.ko:
* 지금까지 정치적으로 한 거라곤,
  여기 서서 중요하게 보이는 것 뿐이야./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_443_0_b.pl: * W mojej politycznej karierze jak na razie tylko stoję i sprawiam pozory bycia ważnym./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_443_0_b.pt-BR: * Até agora, politicamente, tudo que fiz foi ficar parado aqui dando uma de importante./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_443_0_b.ru: * Пока что всё, что я делаю политически — стою здесь и кажусь важным./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_443_0_b.zh:
* 到目前为止，
我在政治上的作为就只有站在这里，
装出一副很重要的样子罢了。/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_444_0_b.de: * Ich werde so langsam vom politischen System desillusioniert./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_444_0_b.en: * I'm starting to get disillusioned with the political system./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_444_0_b.es: * Estoy empezando a desilusionarme con el sistema político./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_444_0_b.ja:
＊ せいじには　ほとほと
　 げんめつしそうだよ。/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_444_0_b.ko:
* 정치 체제에 대해 품었던
  기대가 깨져가고 있어./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_444_0_b.pl: * Moje złudzenia, co do stanu dzisiejszej polityki, zaczynają się rozwiewać./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_444_0_b.pt-BR: * Estou começando a ficar desiludido com o sistema político./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_444_0_b.ru: * Я начинаю терять веру в политическую систему./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_444_0_b.zh: * 我开始对政治体制感到失望了。/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_447_0.de: * Würde mich die Bürgermeisterin doch irgendwas anderes hier machen lassen.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_447_0.en: * If only the mayor let me do something else around here.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_447_0.es: * Ojalá la alcaldesa me dejara hacer algo más por aquí.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_447_0.ja:
＊ ちょうちょうから　べつの　しごとを
　 たのまれたいなぁ…/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_447_0.ko:
* 시장님이
  뭔가 좀 다른 일을 시켜주신다면.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_447_0.pl: * Gdyby tylko pani burmistrz znalazła mi jakieś zajęcie.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_447_0.pt-BR: * Se ao menos a prefeita me deixasse fazer alguma outra coisa por aqui.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_447_0.ru: * Вот бы мэр поручила мне что-нибудь ещё.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_447_0.zh:
* 要是市长能给我安排点
别的事情做就好了... /

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_457_0.de: * Die Bürgermeisterin hat meine Untertasche mit einem riesigen Katana geschlachtet./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_457_0.en: * The mayor killed my briefscase with a giant katana./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_457_0.es: * La alcadesa se ha cargado mi maletín con una katana gigante./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_457_0.ja:
＊ ちょうちょうが
　 オレのブリーフケースを
　 デカいカタナで　ブッころした。/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_457_0.ko:
* 시장님이 커다란 카타나로
  내 서류 가방을 죽였어./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_457_0.pl: * Pani burmistrz unicestwiła moją walizkę wielgachną kataną./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_457_0.pt-BR: * A prefeita matou a minha maleta com uma katana gigante./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_457_0.ru: * Мэр разрубила мой чемоданчик гигантской катаной./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_457_0.zh:
* 市长用一把大武士刀
杀死了我的供闻包。/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_458_0.de: * Kann mich nicht beschweren. Da hab ich für gewählt./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_458_0.en: * I can't complain. I voted for this./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_458_0.es: * No me puedo quejar. He votado por esto./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_458_0.ja:
＊ そういう　しうちを
　 とうひょうで　えらんだのは
　 オレだ。/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_458_0.ko:
* 불평은 못 하지.
  그러라고 뽑은 거니까./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_458_0.pl: * Nie mogę narzekać. Przecież na nią głosowałem./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_458_0.pt-BR: * Não posso reclamar. Eu votei nela./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_458_0.ru: * Не мне жаловаться. Я голосовал за это./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_458_0.zh:
* 我没理由抱怨。
毕竟是当初投票的是我自己。/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_461_0.de: * Ich brauche keine Meinungen von Knirpsen wie euch./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_461_0.en: * I don't need opinions from a little pigsqueak like you./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_461_0.es: * No necesito la opinión de alguien insignificante./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_461_0.ja:
＊ オマエみたいなチビの　いけんは
　 きいてない。/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_461_0.ko:
* 너 같은 애송이한테 받을
  의견은 없다고./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_461_0.pl: * Nie interesuje mnie twoja opinia, gnojaku./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_461_0.pt-BR: * Eu não preciso da opinião de bananinhas como você./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_461_0.ru: * Мне не нужно мнение такой шмакозявки, как ты./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_461_0.zh: * 我可不需要你这种小崽子的意见。/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_462_0.de: * Geht euch Milch anschauen oder so damit eure Sehknochen wachsen!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_462_0.en: * Go look at some milk and grow your eye bones!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_462_0.es: * ¡Ve a mirar leche para que te crezcan los huesos de los ojos!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_462_0.ja:
＊ ぎゅうにゅうでも　ジィーっとみて
　 めの　ほねを　きたえてこい！/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_462_0.pl: * Idź popatrzeć na mleko i wzmocnij kości powiek!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_462_0.pt-BR: * Vai olhar pra um leite pra ver se cresce osso nesse olho!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_462_0.ru: * Вали смотреть на молоко, может зоркость укрепишь!/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_424_0.en: * You and your family would come in and order the special./

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_427_0.de: * But every Sunday, you and your brother'd still come in./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_427_0.en: * But every Sunday, you and your brother'd still come in./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_427_0.es: * But every Sunday, you and your brother'd still come in./

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_483_0.en: * YOU were fine, but I almost had to repeat the year 'cause of it.../

  난 그것 때문에 
  학교 1년 더 다닐 뻔했다고.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_483_0.pl: * TOBIE to nie zaszkodziło, ale ja prawie nie zdałam.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_483_0.pt-BR: * YOU were fine, but I almost had to repeat the year 'cause of it.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_483_0.ru: * ТЕБЯ-то пронесло, а я потом весь учебный год отрабатывала.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_483_0.zh:
* 你是没什么事，
可差点害我留了一级.../

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_484_0.de: * Those crepes were MAD worth, though! Delinquency is the best condiment!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_484_0.en: * Those crepes were MAD worth, though! Delinquency is the best condiment!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_484_0.es: * Those crepes were MAD worth, though! Delinquency is the best condiment!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_484_0.ja:
＊ んでも　しょーがなくない！？
　 ここのクレープ　ぜっぴんだもん！
　 わるいことは　ミツのあじ！/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_484_0.ko:
* 물론 그 크레페는
  그럴 가치가 있었지만!
  땡땡이는 최고의 조미료지!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_484_0.pl: * Ale te naleśniki były PRZEPYSZNE! Dreszczyk emocji jest najlepszą przyprawą!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_484_0.pt-BR: * Those crepes were MAD worth, though! Delinquency is the best condiment!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_484_0.ru: * Хотя эти блинчики ТОЧНО того стоили! Преступление — лучшая приправа!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_484_0.zh:
* 不过，这里的可丽饼
值得为之疯狂！
犯点小错更能使美食增色！/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_487_0.de: * Dude, if we didn't bring Gerson our leftovers, I bet I would have failed HARD.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_487_0.en: * Dude, if we didn't bring Gerson our leftovers, I bet I would have failed HARD.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_487_0.es: * Dude, if we didn't bring Gerson our leftovers, I bet I would have failed HARD.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_487_0.ja:
＊ たべきれなかったぶんを　ガーソンに
　 もってってやったおかげで　なんとか
　 そつぎょうできたけどさー…/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_487_0.ko:
* 남은 과제를 들고
  거슨 선생님한테 가지 않았으면,
  우린 분명 낙제했을 거야.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_487_0.pl: * Laska, gdybyśmy nie przynosiły Gersonowi resztek, to by na pewno mnie uwalił.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_487_0.pt-BR: * Mano, se não fosse as sobras que nós damos pro Gerson, a gente ia reprovar BONITO.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_487_0.ru: * Чувак, если бы мы не принесли Герсону остатки блинов, клянусь, досталось бы ЗНАТНО.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_487_0.zh:
* 我说，当时要不是咱俩
拿剩下的食物收买Gerson，
我绝对死得要多惨有多惨.../

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_496_0.de: * Looking at my rugged body, you must wonder what kind of secrets I hold.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_496_0.en: * Looking at my rugged body, you must wonder what kind of secrets I hold.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_496_0.es: * Looking at my rugged body, you must wonder what kind of secrets I hold.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_496_0.ja:
＊ ボクの　このたくましいカラダには
　 どんなヒミツが　かくされているか
　 きになるでしょ…？/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_496_0.ko:
* 내 다부진 몸을 보고 
  운동을 어떻게 하나
  궁금해하고 있겠지.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_496_0.pl: * Podziwiając moje napakowane ciało, zastanawia cię pewnie, jakie sekrety skrywam.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_496_0.pt-BR: * Looking at my rugged body, you must wonder what kind of secrets I hold.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_496_0.ru: * Глядя на моё мужественное тело, тебе наверняка стало интересно, что за секрет я храню.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_496_0.zh:
* 见到我这高耸入云的身躯，
你一定很好奇我隐藏着什么秘密.../

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_497_0.de: * My secret is, I put all my leftover pancakes in this giant hat./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_497_0.en: * My secret is, I put all my leftover pancakes in this giant hat./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_497_0.es: * My secret is, I put all my leftover pancakes in this giant hat./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_497_0.ja:
＊ ボク　じつはね…　たべのこしの
　 パンケーキを　このでっかいぼうしに
　 いれてるんだ。/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_497_0.ko:
* 비결은,
  먹고 남은 팬케이크를
  다 모자에 넣어두는 거야./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_497_0.pl: * Otóż skrywam w tym wielkim kapeluszu niezjedzone naleśniki./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_497_0.pt-BR: * My secret is, I put all my leftover pancakes in this giant hat./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_497_0.ru: * Он в том, что я кладу все недоеденные блины в эту шляпу./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_497_0.zh:
* 我的秘密就是，
我把吃剩的煎饼全塞进这顶大帽子里了。/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_501_0.en:
* Whew!
* I sure love PANCAKE!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_501_0.ja: ＊ ボク　パンケーキ　だあいすき！/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_501_0.zh:
* 呼！
* 我可爱死煎饼了！/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_507_0.de: * Ice Wolf does not like ice in drink./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_507_0.en: * Ice Wolf does not like ice in drink./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_507_0.es: * Ice Wolf does not like ice in drink./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_507_0.ja:
＊ アイスウルフ　のみものに
　 こおり　いれる　すきじゃない。/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_507_0.ko:
* 아이스 울프는 음료수에
  얼음이 들어간 걸
  좋아하지 않는다./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_507_0.pl: * Lodny wilk nie lubi lodu w swoich napojach./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_507_0.pt-BR: * Jão Gelão gosta não gelo em bebida./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_507_0.ru: * Ледяной Волк не любит напитки со льдом./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_507_0.zh: * Ice Wolf不喜欢把冰加在饮料里。/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_508_0.ja:
＊ アイスウルフ　すきなの
　 こおり…/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_513_0.de: * Ice Wolf also like ice-themed mascots./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_513_0.en: * Ice Wolf also like ice-themed mascots./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_513_0.es: * Ice Wolf also like ice-themed mascots./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_513_0.ja:
＊ アイスウルフ
　 こおりの　ゆるキャラも　すき。/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_513_0.ko:
* 아이스 울프는
  얼음을 주제로 한
  마스코트도 좋아한다./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_513_0.pl: * Lodny wilk także lubi lodowe maskotki./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_513_0.pt-BR: * Jão Gelão gosta mascote gelo tumém./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_513_0.ru: * Ледяной Волк ещё любит талисманы на тему льда./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_513_0.zh:
* Ice Wolf也喜欢
以冰块为原型的吉祥物。/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_633_0.de: * Was meinst du? Ihr wollt Nachschlag? Naja, der Kunde ist König.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_633_0.en: * How was that? You want seconds? Well, the customer is always right.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_633_0.es: * ¿Cómo? ¿Queréis repetir? Bueno, el cliente siempre lleva la razón.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_633_0.ja:
＊ おいしかったかい？　え？　
　 おかわり？　おきゃくさまは
　 かみさまとは　いうけれど…/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_633_0.ko:
* 좀 어때? 한 잔 더 하고 싶다고?
  뭐, 손님은 언제나 옳지.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_633_0.pl: * Smakowało? Chcesz dokładkę, Kris? Cóż, klient ma zawsze rację.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_633_0.pt-BR: * O quê? Você quer mais? Bom, cliente sempre tem razão.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_633_0.ru: * Ну как вам? Хотите добавки? Ну, пожелание клиента — закон.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_633_0.zh:
* 怎么？还想再来一份？
好吧，顾客就是上帝.../

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_634_0.de: * Doch ich glaube deine Mutter wäre sauer wenn ihr so viel ohne sie esst./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_634_0.en: * But I'm sure your mother'd be mad if you ate so much without her./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_634_0.es: * Pero a tu madre no le haría mucha gracia enterarse de que comiste tanto sin ella./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_634_0.ja:
＊ そんなに　たくさんたべたら
　 ママに　しかられるよ？/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_634_0.ko:
* 하지만 너희 엄마 없이
  너무 많이 먹으면
  분명 화내실 거야./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_634_0.pl: * Ale twoja mama się zdenerwuje, jak zjesz za dużo, gdy jej tu nie ma./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_634_0.pt-BR: * Tenho certeza de que sua mãe ficaria brava se você comesse muito sem ela./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_634_0.ru: * Хотя твоя мама точно не обрадуется, если будешь так объедаться./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_634_0.zh:
* 但你妈妈要是知道你吃这么多
还不带她一起，肯定会生气的。/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_542_0.de: * Catti's family is always asking when her next shift is.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_542_0.en: * Catti's family is always asking when her next shift is.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_542_0.es: * Catti's family is always asking when her next shift is.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_542_0.ja:
＊ キャッティーの　ごかぞくからは
　 いっつも　あのコの　つぎのシフトを
　 きかれるんだよ…/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_542_0.ko:
* 캐시의 가족은 늘
  캐시의 교대 타임이
  언제인지 물어봐.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_542_0.pl: * Rodzina Catti ciągle mnie pyta, jak wygląda jej grafik.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_542_0.pt-BR: * A família da Catti sempre pergunta quando vai ser o próximo turno dela.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_542_0.ru: * Семья Котти постоянно уточняет когда у неё следующая смена.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_542_0.zh:
* Catti的家人总是过来问
她什么时候上班.../

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_543_0.de: * So they can come in and cheer her on./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_543_0.en: * So they can come in and cheer her on./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_543_0.es: * So they can come in and cheer her on./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_543_0.ja:
＊ そのじかんに　みんなできて
　 キャッティーを　おうえんするのさ。/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_543_0.pl: * Żeby móc przyjść tutaj i ją dopingować w pracy./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_543_0.pt-BR: * Para que eles possam vir e torcer pra ela./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_543_0.zh:
* 这样他们就能来店里
帮Catti加油鼓劲了。/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_544_0.de: * Never seen anything like it, but it's kind of nice, isn't it?/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_544_0.en: * Never seen anything like it, but it's kind of nice, isn't it?/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_544_0.es: * Never seen anything like it, but it's kind of nice, isn't it?/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_544_0.ja:
＊ そんな　かぞくは
　 ほかに　しらないけど
　 なんだか　いいと　おもわないかい？/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_544_0.ko:
* 저런 모습은 처음 보지만,
  꽤 멋진 것 같기도 해, 안 그래?/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_544_0.pl: * Pierwszy raz się z czymś takim spotkałam, ale to miło z ich strony, co nie?/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_544_0.pt-BR: * Nunca vi nada igual, mas até que é legal, não é?/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_544_0.ru: * Никогда подобного не видела, но, как по мне, это довольно мило./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_544_0.zh:
* 这种事我也是头一回见，
不过还挺感人的，对吧？/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_548_0.ja: ＊ げんきで　やってるかい？/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_549_0.de: * ... what? Sorry, couldn't hear you over the noise./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_549_0.en: * ... what? Sorry, couldn't hear you over the noise./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_549_0.es: * ... what? Sorry, couldn't hear you over the noise./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_549_0.ja:
＊ …え？　まわりが　うるさくて
　 よくきこえなかったよ。/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_549_0.ko:
* ... 뭐라고? 미안하구나,
  시끄러워서 잘 못 들었단다./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_549_0.pl: * Możesz powtórzyć? Nie dosłyszałam cię przez ten harmider./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_549_0.pt-BR: * ... quê? Desculpa, não consegui ouvir por causa do barulho./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_549_0.ru: * ...что? Прости, не услышала тебя из-за шума./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_549_0.zh:
* ...你说什么？
不好意思，店里太吵了，
我听没听清楚你的话。/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_563_0.de: * Hey hon, how did you like the hot chocolate?/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_563_0.en: * Hey hon, how did you like the hot chocolate?/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_563_0.es: * Hey hon, how did you like the hot chocolate?/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_563_0.ja:
＊ ホットチョコレートは
　 おいしかったかい？/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_563_0.pl: * Witaj, słonko. Smakowała ci gorąca czekolada?/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_563_0.pt-BR: * Ei, filhote, o que você achou do chocolate quente?/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_563_0.ru: * Эй, дорогуша, как тебе горячий шоколад?/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_564_0.de: * ... well, I'm gonna take it that means you enjoyed it./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_564_0.en: * ... well, I'm gonna take it that means you enjoyed it./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_564_0.es: * ... well, I'm gonna take it that means you enjoyed it./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_564_0.ja:
＊ ………
　 …それは
　 「おいしかった」って　イミかな。/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_564_0.pt-BR: * ... bom, eu vou considerar isso um sim./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_564_0.ru: * ...хорошо, приму это как то, что тебе понравилось./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_564_0.zh:
* ...好吧，
我觉得那应该是喜欢的意思。/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_565_0.de: * Take it easy, okay? I'm sure your brother will be back in no time./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_565_0.en: * Take it easy, okay? I'm sure your brother will be back in no time./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_565_0.es: * Take it easy, okay? I'm sure your brother will be back in no time./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_565_0.ja:
＊ ま　ほどほどに　がんばんなさいな。
　 おにいちゃんも　きっと
　 じきに　もどってくるよ。/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_565_0.ko:
* 너무 걱정 말렴, 알겠지?
  그 애도 이제 금방
  돌아올 테니까./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_565_0.pl: * Nie martw się. Zanim się obejrzysz, twój brat będzie już w domu./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_565_0.pt-BR: * Relaxa, ok? Tenho certeza que seu irmão vai voltar logo, logo./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_565_0.ru: * Не принимай близко к сердцу, ладно? Я уверена, твой брат скоро вернётся./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_565_0.zh:
* 照顾好自己，好吗？
我想你哥哥很快就会回来的。/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_575_0.ja:
＊ キャッティー！は！
　 オレのともだち！だから！/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_575_0.pl: * Catti to moja przyjaciółka. A ja./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_575_0.pt-BR: * A Catti, É minha amiga. E./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_575_0.zh:
* Catti，是我的好朋友。
并且，/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_576_0.de: * I support my friends, through thick, and thin./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_576_0.en: * I support my friends, through thick, and thin./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_576_0.es: * I support my friends, through thick, and thin./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_576_0.ja:
＊ どんなときでも　みすては
　 しない！　たのしいときも！
　 くるしいときも！/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_576_0.ko:
* 난 언제나 친구를 도와줘,
  두꺼울 때도, 얇을 때도./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_576_0.pl: * Wspieram swoich przyjaciół, na dobre i na złe./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_576_0.pt-BR: * Eu apoio meus amigos, faça chuva, faça sol./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_576_0.ru: * Я помогаю друзьям несмотря ни на что./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_576_0.zh:
* 不管遇到什么艰难困苦，
我都会永远支持我的朋友。/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_577_0.de: * Long, and short. Cold, and hot./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_577_0.en: * Long, and short. Cold, and hot./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_577_0.es: * Long, and short. Cold, and hot./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_577_0.ja:
＊ ながいときも　みじかい
　 ときも！　さむいときも
　 あついときも！/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_577_0.ko:
* 길 때도, 짧을 때도.
  추울 때도, 더울 때도./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_577_0.pl: * Na małe i na duże. Na zimne i na ciepłe./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_577_0.pt-BR: * Nublado, e neve. Frio, e quente./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_577_0.ru: * В жару и холод. Как бы долго они не длились./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_577_0.zh: * 无论光阴荏苒，春去秋来。/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_578_0.de: * Whatever shape, the world takes, I'll be there./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_578_0.en: * Whatever shape, the world takes, I'll be there./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_578_0.es: * Whatever shape, the world takes, I'll be there./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_578_0.ja:
＊ このせかいが　どんな
　 すがたに　なったとしても！
　 オレは　いつもそばにいる！/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_578_0.ko:
* 이 세상이, 어떻게 변해도,
  나는 늘 곁에 있을거야./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_578_0.pl: * Nieważne jakie kłody jej pod nogi świat rzuci, ja będę przy niej./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_578_0.pt-BR: * Com qualquer clima, que tiver no mundo, eu estarei lá./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_578_0.ru: * Какую бы форму ни принял мир, я буду здесь./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_578_0.zh:
* 纵世间沧海桑田，
唯友情始终如一。/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_582_0.en: * Life is a big, ballgame,/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_582_0.ja:
＊ じんせいは　せいだいな
　 バスケの　しあいだ！/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_582_0.pt-BR: * A vida é um grande, jogo de bola,/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_582_0.ru: * Жизнь — это большая игра в мяч,/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_582_0.zh: * 人生，如同一场盛大的球赛，/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_583_0.de: * And when the man is on the field./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_583_0.en: * And when the man is on the field./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_583_0.es: * And when the man is on the field./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_583_0.pl: * Nigdy nie wiesz, co cię spotka./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_583_0.pt-BR: * E quando o homem está no campo./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_583_0.ru: * И когда игрок выходит на поле./

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_584_0.en: * He does a big dunk./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_584_0.ja:
＊ せいだいに
　 ダンクシュートを　きめる！/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_584_0.zh: * 就必须完成一记精彩的扣篮。/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_585_0.en: * Try, to be that dunk./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_585_0.ja:
＊ そういう　ダンクシュートに
　 なることだ！/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_585_0.ko:
* 그 덩크슛이 되기 위해,
  노력하는 거지./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_585_0.zh: * 努力吧，成就那一记扣篮。/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_595_0.de: * Our little Catti, she's doin' us proud./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_595_0.en: * Our little Catti, she's doin' us proud./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_595_0.es: * Our little Catti, she's doin' us proud./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_595_0.ja:
＊ うちの　キャッティーは
　 じまんの　むすめでねえ。/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_595_0.pl: * Nasza malutka Catti, jesteśmy z niej dumni./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_595_0.pt-BR: * Nossa pequena Catti, ela nos deixa orgulhosos./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_595_0.ru: * Наша маленькая Котти, наша маленькая гордость./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_595_0.zh:
* 我们的小Catti，
她真是我们的骄傲。/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_596_0.ja:
＊ せっせと　はたらいて
　 かけいを　たすけてくれてる。/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_596_0.zh:
* 努力工作。
养家糊口。/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_597_0.de: * Servin' us pickles, terrifyin' us with their shape,/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_597_0.en: * Servin' us pickles, terrifyin' us with their shape,/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_597_0.es: * Servin' us pickles, terrifyin' us with their shape,/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_597_0.ja:
＊ ピクルスを　はこんできては
　 わたしらを　ふるえあがらせてね…/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_597_0.ko:
* 일부러 징그럽게 생긴
  피클을 서빙해서는,
  우릴 공포에 질리게도 하고,/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_597_0.pl: * Pokazuje nam ogórki kiszone, których kształt nas przeraża,/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_597_0.pt-BR: * Nos servindo picles, nos aterrorizando com seus formatos,/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_597_0.zh: * 上了份腌黄瓜吓唬我们，/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_598_0.de: * Tryin' to get us to leave./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_598_0.en: * Tryin' to get us to leave./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_598_0.es: * Tryin' to get us to leave./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_598_0.ja: ＊ わたしらを　おいだそうとするんだ。/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_598_0.pl: * Próbując nas wygonić ze swojego pokoju./

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_599_0.ja: ＊ ほんとうに　じまんのむすめだよ。/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_602_0.de: * My favorite meal? Gotta be the catfood pancakes!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_602_0.en: * My favorite meal? Gotta be the catfood pancakes!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_602_0.es: * My favorite meal? Gotta be the catfood pancakes!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_602_0.ja:
＊ おじさんの　こうぶつかい？
　 そりゃあ
　 キャットフード・パンケーキさ！/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_602_0.ko:
* 내가 좋아하는 음식?
  그야 고양이 사료 케이크지!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_602_0.pl: * Moje ulubione danie? Niewątpliwie naleśniki z kociej karmy!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_602_0.pt-BR: * Meu prato preferido? É claro que são as panquecas de comida de gato!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_602_0.ru: * Моя любимая еда? Блины из кошачьей еды!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_602_0.zh:
* 我最喜欢的一道菜？
那必须得是猫粮煎饼了！/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_603_0.de: * And the fish with bones that looks like it's from a cartoon./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_603_0.en: * And the fish with bones that looks like it's from a cartoon./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_603_0.es: * And the fish with bones that looks like it's from a cartoon./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_603_0.ja:
＊ それと　マンガに　でてくるみたいな
　 ホネつきの　おさかなだね。/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_603_0.ko:
* 만화에 나오는 것처럼 생긴
  뼈가 있는 생선도 좋아./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_603_0.pl: * I ryba z ośćmi, wyglądająca jak danie z kreskówki./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_603_0.pt-BR: * E o peixe com os ossos que parece de um desenho animado./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_603_0.ru: * И рыба с костями, прям как из мультфильма./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_603_0.zh:
* 还有就是像动画片里那种
带骨头的鱼。/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_611_0.de: * To tell you the truth, I thought this was the post office.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_611_0.en: * To tell you the truth, I thought this was the post office.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_611_0.es: * To tell you the truth, I thought this was the post office.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_611_0.ja:
＊ じつは　ゆうびんきょくと
　 まちがえて　はいってきちゃってさ…/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_611_0.ko:
* 실은, 여기가 우체국인 줄
  알고 들어와버렸는데.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_611_0.pl: * Przyznam szczerze, myślałem, że to jest poczta.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_611_0.pt-BR: * Pra falar a verdade, eu achei que esse lugar era o correio.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_611_0.ru: * Сказать по правде, я думал, что это почта.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_611_0.zh:
* 和你说个事，
我原本还以为这里是邮局.../

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_612_0.de: * But by the time I realized... I'd already sat down.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_612_0.en: * But by the time I realized... I'd already sat down.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_612_0.es: * But by the time I realized... I'd already sat down.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_612_0.ja:
＊ でも　まちがいに　きづいたときには
　 もう　せきに　すわっちゃってて…/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_612_0.ko:
* 그 사실을 깨달았을 땐...
  이미 자리에 앉은
  상태였습니다.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_612_0.pl: * Zanim to do mnie doszło... zdążyłem już usiąść przy stoliku.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_612_0.pt-BR: * Mas quando eu percebi... eu já tinha sentado.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_612_0.ru: * Но к тому времени, когда я понял... я уже сел за столик.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_612_0.zh:
* 可是等我回过神来... 
我就已经坐在位置上了.../

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_613_0.de: * I'm not hungry, so I've just been telling the waitress I'm still deciding for.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_613_0.en: * I'm not hungry, so I've just been telling the waitress I'm still deciding for.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_613_0.es: * I'm not hungry, so I've just been telling the waitress I'm still deciding for.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_613_0.ja:
＊ おなかへってないから
　 てんいんさんが　くるたびに
　 「まだ　きまってません」って…/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_613_0.ko:
* 배가 고프진 않아서,
  직원이 올 때마다
  결정 중이라고만 말하고 있습니다.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_613_0.pl: * Nie jestem głodny, więc cały czas mówię kelnerce, że nadal wybieram danie.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_613_0.pt-BR: * Eu não tô com fome, aí fiquei falando pra garçonete que ainda estou decidindo e já faz.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_613_0.ru: * Я не голоден, поэтому я говорю официантке, что всё ещё выбираю.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_613_0.zh:
* 我一点都不饿，所以我跟服务员说
还没想好要点什么吃.../

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_614_0.de: * ... a few hours now. How am I supposed to get out of this one!?/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_614_0.en: * ... a few hours now. How am I supposed to get out of this one!?/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_614_0.es: * ... a few hours now. How am I supposed to get out of this one!?/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_614_0.ja:
＊ …もう　かれこれ　すうじかん
　 いいつづけてる。
　 ボクは　どうしたらいいんだ！？/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_614_0.ko:
* ... 벌써 몇 시간째인데.
  어떻게 빠져나가야 할까요!?/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_614_0.pl: * Trwa to już kilka godzin. Jak mam wyjść z twarzą z tej sytuacji!?/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_614_0.pt-BR: * ... algumas horas. Como é que vou sair dessa?!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_614_0.ru: * ...уже несколько часов подряд. Как мне выбраться отсюда?!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_614_0.zh:
* ...已经好几个小时了。
我要怎么从这里脱身啊！？/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_630_0.de: * I don't know if you noticed, but I've been getting stronger./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_630_0.en: * I don't know if you noticed, but I've been getting stronger./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_630_0.es: * I don't know if you noticed, but I've been getting stronger./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_630_0.ja:
＊ ねえ　きづいた？
　 ボク　だいぶ　つよくなってきたよ。/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_630_0.pl: * Nie wiem, czy to widać, ale pracuję nad masą./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_630_0.pt-BR: * Eu não sei se você percebeu, mas estou ficando mais forte./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_630_0.ru: * Не знаю, заметно ли тебе, но я становлюсь сильнее./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_630_0.zh:
* 不知道你注意到没有，
我最近越来越壮实了。/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_631_0.de: * You could say I'm bulking up for the winter./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_631_0.en: * You could say I'm bulking up for the winter./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_631_0.es: * You could say I'm bulking up for the winter./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_631_0.ja:
＊ ふゆに　そなえて
　 キンニクを　そだててるってわけ。/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_631_0.ko:
* 겨울을 대비해서
  근육을 키우고 있다고
  할 수 있으려나./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_631_0.pt-BR: * Pode-se dizer que estou ficando maromba pro inverno./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_631_0.zh: * 其实我是在为过冬而增肥。/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_635_0.en: * Oh boy! I love BULKING./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_635_0.ja:
＊ ボク　キンニクそだてるの
　 だあいすき！/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_635_0.pt-BR: * Ah cara! Eu amo ficar MAROMBA./

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_730_0.de: * Sieht etwas an mir anders aus...? Hah./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_730_0.en: * Notice anything different about me...? Heh./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_730_0.ja:
＊ ねえ　きづいた？
　 ボク　まえとくらべて
　 かわったでしょ…？/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_730_0.ko:
* 나 오늘 뭔가 다른 점 눈치챘니...?
  후후./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_730_0.pl: * Czy wyglądam dziś jakoś inaczej...? Heh./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_730_0.pt-BR: * Notou algo diferente em mim...? Heh./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_730_0.ru: * Ничего нового во мне не замечаете?.. Хех./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_730_0.zh:
* 注意到我有什么特别之处吗...？
呵。/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_734_0_b.de: * Jetzt wo ich darüber nachdenke, mir ist auch nie was an dir aufgefallen./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_734_0_b.en: * Now that I think about it, I never noticed anything about you, either./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_734_0_b.es: * Ahora que lo pienso, yo tampoco he notado nunca nada sobre ti./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_734_0_b.ja:
＊ でも　ボク…キミのことで
　 きづいたことなんて
　 なにもないな。/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_734_0_b.ko:
* 생각해 보니까, 나도 너에 대해
  뭔가 다른 점을 눈치챈 적이 없네./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_734_0_b.pl: * Mówiąc szczerze, też nie zauważyłem w tobie żadnych zmian./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_734_0_b.pt-BR: * Agora que parei pra pensar, nunca notei nada em você, também./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_734_0_b.ru: * Вообще, я в вас, особо, тоже./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_734_0_b.zh:
* 仔细一想，其实我也从来没注意到
你身上有什么特别之处。/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_649_0.de: * This guy next to me, he's really bulked up. I admire that./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_649_0.en: * This guy next to me, he's really bulked up. I admire that./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_649_0.es: * This guy next to me, he's really bulked up. I admire that./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_649_0.ja:
＊ ボクの　となりのひと
　 すごく　キンニクが　そだってる。
　 ホレボレするよ。/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_649_0.ko:
* 내 옆 사람, 근육이 장난 아냐.
  완전 빠져버렸어./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_649_0.pl: * Ten gostek nabrał ostatnio masy. Podziwiam jego zapał./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_649_0.pt-BR: * Esse cara do meu lado, ele realmente ficou maromba. Eu admiro isso./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_649_0.ru: * Этот парень, что сидит рядом, весьма подкачан. Я ему поражаюсь./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_649_0.zh:
* 我旁边这个家伙，真的比以前壮了不少。
我挺佩服他的。/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_645_0.de: * I don't know if you do that, bulking up for the winter.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_645_0.en: * I don't know if you do that, bulking up for the winter.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_645_0.es: * I don't know if you do that, bulking up for the winter.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_645_0.ja:
＊ ふゆに　そなえて
　 キンニクを　そだてる…
　 それって　ふつうのこと？/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_645_0.ko:
* 너도 겨울을 대비해서
  근육을 키우는지는 모르겠어.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_645_0.pl: * Nie wiem, czy pracujesz nad masą, czy nad rzeźbą.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_645_0.pt-BR: * Eu não sei se você faz isso, ficar maromba pro inverno.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_645_0.ru: * Не знаешь, каково это, подкачиваться к зиме?../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_645_0.zh:
* 不知道你需不需要，
为过冬而增肥什么的.../

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_759_0.de: * Hier den ganzen Tag zu arbeiten macht mir Hunger auf Diner-Essen.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_759_0.en: * Working here all day just makes me hungry for diner food.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_759_0.es: * Trabajar aquí todo el día hace que me apetezca comida del Diner.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_759_0.ja:
＊ ここで　はたらいてると　おみせで
　 だしてる　メニューを　たべたくて
　 しょうがなくなっちゃうのよね…/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_759_0.ko:
* 식당에서 하루 종일 일하고 나면
  식당 음식이 먹고 싶어져.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_759_0.pl: * Po kilku godzinach pracy zawsze mam chrapkę na barowe jedzenie.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_759_0.pt-BR: * Trabalhar o dia inteiro aqui me deixa com fome de comida de lanchonete.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_759_0.ru: * Весь день на ногах, так и съела бы чего с работы.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_759_0.zh:
* 在这工作一整天让我更馋
餐厅里的吃的了.../

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_760_0.de: * Wie gut, dass der Neue mich eine Pause machen lässt!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_760_0.en: * Good thing the new guy's letting me take a break!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_760_0.es: * ¡Por suerte, el nuevo está dejando que me tome un descanso!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_760_0.ja:
＊ しんじんさんの　おかげで
　 こうして　きゅうけいが　とれて
　 たすかるわ！/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_760_0.ko:
* 저 신참이 잠시 내 대신 일해줘서
  참 다행이지!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_760_0.pl: * Na szczęście dzięki nowemu pracownikowi mogę zrobić sobie przerwę!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_760_0.pt-BR: * Que bom que o cara novo me deixou ter um descanso!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_760_0.ru: * Как хорошо, что новенький взял на себя часть нагрузки!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_760_0.zh: * 多亏这个新店员让我有了休息时间！/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_764_0.de: * ... WO ich darüber nachdenke, haben wir... den eingestellt? Den Neuen?/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_764_0.en: * ... Come to think of it, did we... hire? A new guy?/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_764_0.es: * ... Ahora que lo pienso, ¿hemos... contratado a alguien?/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_764_0.ja:
＊ …でも…しんじんさんなんて
　 いつ　やとったかしら…？/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_764_0.ko:
* ... 잠깐, 생각해 보니,
  우리가 새 알바를... 뽑았던가?/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_764_0.pl: * Chwilunia, czy my w ogóle... zatrudniliśmy? Kogoś nowego?/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_764_0.pt-BR: * ... Parando pra pensar, a gente... contratou? Um cara novo?/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_764_0.zh:
* ...仔细想想，
我们到底雇没雇过他啊？/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_773_0.de: * Garcon! Mineralwasser, bitte! ... aber bitte ohne Wasser./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_773_0.en: * Garcon! Some mineral water, please! ... and hold the water./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_773_0.es: * ¡Garçon! ¡Un poco de agua mineral, por favor! ... Pero sin el agua./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_773_0.ja:
＊ ボーイさん！　ミネラルウォーターを
　 もってきて！　もってきたら
　 それを　ずっと　もっていて！/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_773_0.ko:
* 갈쏜! 미네랄 워터 부탁해요!
  ... 그리고 들고 있어 주세요./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_773_0.pl: * Garcon! Poproszę wodę mineralną! ... i paragon./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_773_0.pt-BR: * Garçom! Água mineral, por favor! ... mas sem a água./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_773_0.ru: * Гарсон! Минеральной воды, пожалуйста!.. Только воду в стакан не кладите./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_773_0.zh:
* 服务生！来杯矿泉水！
...记得不加水。/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_777_0.ja:
＊ ボーイさん！　ボーイさん！
　 ボーイさん！　ボーイさん！/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_777_0.zh:
* 来个服务生！来个服务生！
来葛服务森！来个服务生！/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_786_0.de: * Ribbit. (Es ist eine Fliege in meiner Suppe.)/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_786_0.en: * Ribbit. (There's a fly in my soup.)/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_786_0.es: * Ribbit. (Hay una mosca en mi sopa.)/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_786_0.ja:
＊ ケロケロ。
　 (スープに　ムシが　はいってる…)/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_786_0.pl: * Kum kum. (W mojej zupie jest mucha.)/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_786_0.pt-BR: * Ribbit. (Tem uma mosca na minha sopa.)/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_786_0.zh: * 呱呱。（我的汤里面有只苍蝇。）/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_790_0.de: * Ribbit. (Dieser Kerl nahm eine Handvoll Schmetterlinge aus seinem... Beutel?)/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_790_0.en: * Ribbit. (That guy took a fistful of butterflies from his... pouch?)/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_790_0.es: * Ribbit. (Ese tipo se sacó un puñado de mariposas de su... ¿saco?)/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_790_0.ja:
＊ ケロケロ。(となりのひとが
　 おなかの…ふくろ？　から
　 チョウチョを　なんびきもだして…)/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_790_0.ko:
* 개굴. (저 사람 지금, 파우치에서
  나비를 한 움큼 꺼내서...?)/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_790_0.pl: * Kum kum. (Ten jegomość wyciągnął ze swojego woreczka kilka... motyli?)/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_790_0.pt-BR: * Ribbit. (Aquele cara pegou um punhado de borboletas da... bolsa dele?)/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_790_0.ru: * Ква. (Этот парень вытащил горстку бабочек из своего... мешочка?)/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_790_0.zh:
* 呱呱。（那家伙从自己的口袋里...
抓了一把蝴蝶？）/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_791_0.de: * (Und tat sie in die Schale. Wie nett von ihm, aber ich hatte nicht gefragt...)/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_791_0.en: * (And put them in my bowl. It was nice of him, but I didn't ask...)/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_791_0.es: * (Y me las ha echado en el cuenco. Fue amable por su parte, pero no se lo pedí...)/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_791_0.ja:
＊ (ボクの　スープに　いれたんだ…
　 なんて　しんせつなんだろう…
　 でも　ボク　たのんでないよ…)/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_791_0.ko:
* (내 그릇에 올려 줬어.
  친절하긴 하지만, 부탁 안 했는데...)/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_791_0.pl: * (I wrzucił je do mojej miski. Miło z jego strony, ale nikt nie pytał...)/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_791_0.pt-BR: * (E colocou na minha tigela. Foi legal da parte dele, mas eu não pedi...)/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_791_0.ru: * (И насыпал мне в миску. Очень мило, конечно, но я ведь не просил...)/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_791_0.zh:
* （然后放进了我的碗里。他人是挺好，
但我也没说要啊...）/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_620_0.de:
* H-How am I supposed to get past this blue lady...!?
* I'm stuck!!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_620_0.en:
* H-How am I supposed to get past this blue lady...!?
* I'm stuck!!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_620_0.es:
* H-How am I supposed to get past this blue lady...!?
* I'm stuck!!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_620_0.ja:
＊ ど…どど…どうしよう…
　 あおい　おんなのひとが　じゃまで…
　 すすめないよ…！/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_620_0.ko: * 이-이 파란 여자를 어떻게 지나가야 하지...!? * 완전 갇혔어!!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_620_0.pl:
* J-jak mam przejechać obok tej niebieskiej pani...!?
* Blokuje całą ulicę!!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_620_0.pt-BR:
* C-Como eu deveria passar por essa moça azul...?!
* Eu tô preso!!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_620_0.ru: * К-как, по-вашему, я должен пройти через эту голубую леди?!.. Я застрял!!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_620_0.zh:
* 我-我要怎么通过那位
蓝色的女士...！？
* 我被困住了！！/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_621_0.de: * I-I guess I should just run away.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_621_0.en: * I-I guess I should just run away.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_621_0.es: * I-I guess I should just run away.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_621_0.ja:
＊ こ…ここ…これは　ひょっとして…
　 「にげろ」ってことなのか…？/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_621_0.pt-BR: * A-Acho que eu deveria só sair correndo.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_621_0.zh: * 我-我想我干脆弃车逃跑算了.../

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_625_0.de: * Police Chief Undyne is supposed to be directing traffic.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_625_0.en: * Police Chief Undyne is supposed to be directing traffic.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_625_0.es: * Police Chief Undyne is supposed to be directing traffic.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_625_0.ja:
＊ アンダインしょちょうは
　 こうつうせいりを　している
　 はずなのに…/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_625_0.ko:
* 경찰서장 언다인이 교통정리를
  하는 것 같지만.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_625_0.pl: * Komendantka policji, pani Undyne, miała kierować ruchem drogowym.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_625_0.pt-BR: * A Chefe de Polícia Undyne era pra estar sinalizando o tráfego.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_625_0.ru: * Шеф полиции Андайн сейчас должна регулировать движение.../

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_626_0.de: * But all she's doing is standing in the middle of the street yelling "GET OUT OF MY WAY!!!"/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_626_0.en: * But all she's doing is standing in the middle of the street yelling "GET OUT OF MY WAY!!!"/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_626_0.es: * But all she's doing is standing in the middle of the street yelling "GET OUT OF MY WAY!!!"/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_626_0.ja:
＊ じっさいは　どうろの　まんなかで
　 「じゃまだ！！　どけ！！」と
　 さけんでいるだけだ。/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_626_0.ko:
* 도로를 막고는
  "비켜!!!"라고
  소리 지르기만 하고 있어./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_626_0.pl: * Ale zamiast tego stoi na środku ulicy i krzyczy „ZEJDŹCIE MI Z DROGI!!!”/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_626_0.pt-BR: * Mas tudo o que ela faz é ficar parada no meio da rua gritando "SAI DA MINHA FRENTE!!!"/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_626_0.ru: * Но всё, что она делает — стоит на улице и кричит «С ДОРОГИ!!!»/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_626_0.zh:
* 但她所做的就只是站在
街道中央大喊“别挡我的路！！！！”/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_627_0.de:
* She's the best, huh!?
* I feel really directed!!!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_627_0.en:
* She's the best, huh!?
* I feel really directed!!!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_627_0.es:
* She's the best, huh!?
* I feel really directed!!!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_627_0.ja:
＊ すばらしいとは　おもわないかね！？
　 これぞまさに
　 せいりされている　というものだ！/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_627_0.ko:
* 정말 대단하지 않아!?
* 완전히 교통정리당하는
  기분이야!!!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_627_0.pl:
* Jest najlepsza!
* Dokładnie wiem, gdzie mam jechać!!!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_627_0.pt-BR:
* Ela é a melhor, num é não?!
* Me sinto muito sinalizado!!!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_627_0.ru:
* Она лучшая, а?!
* Я чувствую себя в надёжных руках!!!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_627_0.zh:
* 她是最棒的，是吧！？
* 我的方向立刻就明确了！/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_826_0_b.en: 3* The twin beasts approach. Leave now./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_826_0_b.es: 3* Las bestias gemelas se acercan. Marcháos ahora mismo./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_826_0_b.ja:
3＊ ２とうのケモノが
　 あらわれた。
　 たちされ。/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_826_0_b.pt-BR: 3* As bestas gêmeas se aproximam. Saiam agora./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_826_0_b.ru: 3* Чудовищные близнецы приближаются. Уходите сейчас же./

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_827_0_b.de: 4Und ich werde euch verfluchen. Nur leicht./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_827_0_b.en: 4* And I will curse you. Only lightly./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_827_0_b.es: 4* Y os maldeciré. Tan solo un poco./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_827_0_b.ja:
4＊ たちされば　ほんのすこし
　 のろうだけで
　 すませてやる。/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_827_0_b.pl: 4* Rzucę na was klątwę. Taką lekką./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_827_0_b.pt-BR: 4* E eu vou lhes amaldiçoar. Levemente./

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_828_0.ja:
6＊ ただし　ノエルに
　 なにか　したら…/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_829_0.de: 3Und du wirst schmecken. Die krasseste Verhexung. Der Unterwelt./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_829_0.en: 3* And you will taste. The underworld's. Sickest hex./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_829_0.es: 3* Y saborearéis. El maleficio más brutal. Del inframundo./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_829_0.ja:
3＊ しかと　あじわわせてやる。
　 じごくの　じゅじゅつを。/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_829_0.ko:
3* 맛보게 될 거야.
  황천의 가장 끔찍한 주술들을./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_829_0.pl: 3* To doświadczycie. Najokrutniejszych czarów. Z podziemi./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_829_0.pt-BR: 3* E sentirão o gosto. Da maldição mais irada. Do submundo./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_829_0.ru: 3* И я нашлю на вас. Злейшую порчу. Преисподней./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_829_0.zh:
3* 你将会品尝到。
那来自地狱的。
最为恶毒的诅咒。/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_847_0.de: Kris, ich seh dich immer, mit Susie./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_847_0.en: * Kris, I see you Always, with Susie./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_847_0.es: * Kris, te veo siempre, con Susie./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_847_0.ja:
＊ クリスは　いつも！
　 スージィと　いっしょ。/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_847_0.pl: * Kris, widzę cię Zawsze, z Susie./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_847_0.pt-BR: * Kris, eu Sempre te vejo, com a Susie./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_847_0.ru: * Крис, ты всегда шатаешься со Сьюзи./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_847_0.zh:
* Kris，我看见你一直，
和Susie走在一起。/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_848_0_b.de: Vielleicht ist Susie, wie Catti, für mich ist./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_848_0_b.en: * Maybe Susie, is like a Catti, too you to./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_848_0_b.es: * Quizá Susie, sea como Catti, también para ti./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_848_0_b.ja:
＊ スージィは！　クリスに
　 とって　キャッティー
　 みたいな　もの？/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_848_0_b.ko:
* 어쩌면 수지가,
  너의 캣티 갇은 걸 수도./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_848_0_b.pl: * Może Susie, jest jak Catti, ciebie dla też./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_848_0_b.pt-BR: * Talvez a Susie, seja tipo uma Catti, também pra você./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_848_0_b.ru: * Может, Сьюзи для тебя, как Котти для меня./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_848_0_b.zh:
* 或许Susie对于你的意义，
就如同Catti对于我的意义。/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_849_0_b.de: Ihr zwei, teilt euch ein, Reptilienhirn.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_849_0_b.en: * You to, share one lizards', brain.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_849_0_b.es: * Vosotros también, compartís un cerebro de, lagartija.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_849_0_b.ja:
＊ にたもの　どうし。
　 おなじ　アナの　トカゲ…/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_849_0_b.pl: * Też wy, mózg jeden dzielicie, jaszczurki.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_849_0_b.pt-BR: * Vocês, têm o mesmo cérebro de, lagarto.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_849_0_b.ru: * Вы тож, делите одну рептильскую, извилину.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_849_0_b.zh:
* 你们两个，
也共用同一颗蜥蜴脑.../

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_850_0_b.de: Das mag ich, das mag ich!/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_854_0_b.de: Welcher von, euch, kann seinen, Kiefer aushängen?/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_854_0_b.en: * Which one of, you, can un, hinge your jaw?/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_854_0_b.es: * ¿Es Susie quien puede des, encajar la mandíbula? ¿O eres, tú?/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_854_0_b.ja:
＊ クリスと　スージィ。
　 アゴの　かんせつ
　 はずせるのは　どっち？/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_854_0_b.ko:
* 먹이를 통, 채로, 삼키는 건,
  둘 중 어느 쪽이, 하냐?/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_854_0_b.pl: * Które z was, może od, czepić swą szczękę?/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_854_0_b.pt-BR: * Quem de, vocês, consegue des, locar a mandíbula?/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_854_0_b.ru: * Кто из вас, может, от, весить челюсть?/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_854_0_b.zh:
* 你们两人中，有谁能，
把自己的下巴，卸下来？/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_861_0.de: Kris, wir waren uns nie nahe, doch nun, sind wir ferne./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_861_0.en: * Kris, we were never Close, but now, we are Far./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_861_0.es: * Kris, no éramos cercanos, pero ahora, somos lejanos./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_861_0.ja:
＊ クリス！　オレたち
　 したしくはなかったけど
　 いまは　もっと　とおい！/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_861_0.ko:
* 크리스,
  우리가 가까웠던 적은 업지만,
  이제, 우린 멀어./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_861_0.pl: * Kris, nigdy nie byliśmy Blisko, ale teraz, jesteśmy Daleko./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_861_0.pt-BR: * Kris, nunca fomos Próximos, mas agora, estamos Longe./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_861_0.ru: * Крис, близки мы никогда не были, но теперь, мы совсем отдалились./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_861_0.zh:
* Kris，我们从来不曾亲密，
但现在，你我形同陌路。/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_862_0_b.de: Mit Susies befreundet sein, ist so wie, der Welt den Krieg, zu erklären./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_862_0_b.en: * To be Susies' friend, is to be, the World's Enemy./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_862_0_b.es: * Tener a Susie de amiga, es tener, al mundo de enemigo./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_862_0_b.ja:
＊ スージィの　ともだちに
　 なると　せかいを
　 てきに　まわす。/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_862_0_b.ko:
* 수지의 친구가, 되는 건,
  세상의 적이 된단 거지./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_862_0_b.pl: * Przyjaźnić ze Susie się, to być, Świata Wrogiem./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_862_0_b.pt-BR: * Fazer amizade com a Susie, é fazer, Inimizade com o Mundo./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_862_0_b.zh:
* 成为Susie的朋友，就犹如，
成为世界的敌人。/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_863_0_b.de: Was, ziemlich krass ist. Ich respektiere, deine Art, Kris./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_863_0_b.en: * Which, is sick. I respect, your Game, Kris./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_863_0_b.es: * Lo cuál, mola mazo. Respeto, tu jugada, Kris./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_863_0_b.ja:
＊ ヤバいね　クリス！
　 マジ　リスペだぜ。/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_863_0_b.pl: * Co, jest czadowe. Doceniam, jak Grasz, Kris./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_863_0_b.pt-BR: * O que é, bem maneiro. Eu respeito, seu Jogo, Kris./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_863_0_b.ru: * Что, просто, люто. Уважуха, тебе, Крис./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_863_0_b.zh:
* 这招，够狠。
我佩服，你这场球，Kris。/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_864_0.de: Doch verletzt du, Catti, oder, Cattis Gefühle,/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_864_0.en: * But if you hurt, Catti, or, Catti's feelings,/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_864_0.es: * Pero si haces daño a, Catti, o a sus, sentimientos,/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_864_0.ja:
＊ ただし！　キャッティーを
　 きずつけたり！
　 おこらせたり！　したら…/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_864_0.ko:
* 그치만
  캣티를 다치게 하거나,
  캣티 마음에, 상처를 준다면,/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_864_0.pl: * Ale jeśli zranisz, Catti, lub, Catti uczucia,/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_864_0.pt-BR: * Mas se você machucar, Catti, ou, os sentimentos da Catti,/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_864_0.ru: * Но, если ты обидишь, Котти, или, её чувства,/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_864_0.zh:
* 但如果你伤害了，Catti，
或者，Catti的心，/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_865_0.de: Dann hast du den Ball ohne ein Tor./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_865_0.en: * You will be up a Ball without a Court./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_865_0.es: * Tendrás que prepararte para jugar, un Partido sin cancha./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_865_0.ja:
＊ バスケのない　せかいに
　 バスケットボールとして
　 うまれかわらせてやるぜ。/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_865_0.ko:
* 경기장 바깥의 공 신세가
  될 줄 알아./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_865_0.pt-BR: * Você vai ser uma Bola sem Quadra./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_865_0.ru: * То почувствуешь себя как мяч за пределами поля./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_865_0.zh:
* 你就等着打一场
没有球场的球赛吧。/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_869_0.de: Sag es Catti nicht, aber ich werde erlösen, euch, von ihrem Fluch,/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_869_0.en: * Don't tell Catti, but I will neutralize, her hex,/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_869_0.es: * No se lo digas a Catti, pero neutralizaré, su maleficio,/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_869_0.ja:
＊ キャッティーには
　 ナイショな…　のろいは
　 オレが　といてやるよ…/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_869_0.ko:
* 캣티한텐 비밀이야,
  내가 캣티의,
  주술을 해제해줄게,/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_869_0.pl: * Nie mów Catti, ale zniweluję, jej czar,/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_869_0.pt-BR: * Não conta pra Catti, mas eu vou neutralizar, a maldição dela,/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_869_0.ru: * Не рассказывай Котти, но я отменю, её проклятие,/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_869_0.zh:
* 不要告诉Catti，
我会破解，她的诅咒，/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_870_0.de: Mit der Gunst meines Sportes. Aus Gnade./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_870_0.en: * With my Sports's Blessing. As a mercy./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_870_0.es: * Con mis bendiciones deportivas. Como acto de piedad./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_870_0.ja:
＊ …オレの　スポォーツの
　 ひかりで。
　 とくべつに。/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_870_0.pl: * Moim Sportu Błogosławieństwem. Jako akt litości./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_870_0.pt-BR: * Com a minha Benção dos Esportes. Como misericórdia./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_870_0.ru: * Моим спортивным благословением. В знак пощады./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_870_0.zh:
* 以运动之神的名义。
赐予你仁慈。/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_871_0_b.de: Lauf, Kris! Solange du noch hast, Beine!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_871_0_b.en: * Run, Kris! While you still have, legs!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_871_0_b.ja:
＊ にげろ　クリス！
　 まだ　あしが　あるうちに！/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_871_0_b.ko:
* 도망치라구, 크리스!
  아직 다리가, 남아있을 때!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_871_0_b.pl: * Biegnij, Kris! Biegnij póki masz, nogi!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_871_0_b.pt-BR: * Corra, Kris! Enquanto ainda tem, pernas!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_871_0_b.ru: * Беги, Крис! Пока у тебя всё ещё есть ноги!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_871_0_b.zh:
* 快跑吧，Kris！
趁你双腿还在！/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_881_0.de: * Kris? Kennst du mich noch? Ich habe früher immer dich und Noelle gebabysittet./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_881_0.en: * Kris? Remember me...? Sorry if I was too strict when I babysat you and Noelle./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_881_0.es: * ¿Kris? ¿Me recuerdas?... Perdona si fui muy dura cuando os cuidaba a ti y a Noelle./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_881_0.ja:
＊ クリス？　おぼえてる？
　 わたし　むかし　ノエルとクリスの
　 ベビーシッターをしてあげたでしょ？/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_881_0.ko:
* 크리스? 나 기억나니...?
  너랑 노엘 애봐주기 하던 시절에
  내가 너무 엄하게 굴어서 미안해./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_881_0.pl: * Kris? Pamiętasz mnie? Wybacz, że byłem taki surowy, jak opiekowałem się tobą i Noelle./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_881_0.pt-BR: * Kris? Lembra de mim...? Perdão se eu era muito rígida quando fui babá sua e da Noelle./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_881_0.ru: * Крис? Помнишь меня?.. Прости уж, если я был слишком строг, когда присматривал за вами с Ноэлль./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_881_0.zh:
* Kris？你还记得我吗...？
当初照顾你和Noelle的时候
我有点太严厉了，抱歉啊。/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_882_0.de: * Ich war wohl zu streng zu euch. Seitdem war Noelle immer so nervös um mich herum.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_882_0.en: * Since then, Noelle's always seemed so nervous around me.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_882_0.es: * Desde entonces, Noelle siempre parecía nerviosa cerca de mí.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_882_0.ja:
＊ あのとき　きびしく　しすぎたせいで
　 ノエルは　いまだに　わたしに
　 あうと　ビクビクして…/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_882_0.ko:
* ...그 후로, 노엘은 내 근처에선 늘
  긴장하는 분위기였어.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_882_0.pl: * Noelle zawsze bardzo stresowała się w mojej obecności.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_882_0.pt-BR: * Desde aquela época, a Noelle sempre parecia tão nervosa perto de mim.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_882_0.ru: * С тех пор Ноэлль всегда так нервничает при мне.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_882_0.zh:
* 从那以后，Noelle在我面前
就总是显得很紧张.../

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_883_0.de: * ... bis heute. Sie hat sogar mein Outfit gelobt! Was sich wohl verändert hat...?/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_883_0.en: * ... until today. She even complimented my outfit! I wonder what changed...?/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_883_0.es: * ... Hasta hoy. ¡Incluso me ha hecho un cumplido! ¿Qué habrá cambiado?.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_883_0.ja:
＊ …でも　きょうは　ちがった！
　 このふくを　ほめてくれて…
　 いったい　なにが　あったんだろう…/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_883_0.ko:
* ... 오늘까지는 말이야.
  오늘은 심지어 내 옷도 칭찬해 주더라!
  뭐가 달라진 걸까...?/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_883_0.pl: * Ale dziś przestała. Nawet skomplementowała moje ubrania! Ciekawe co się zmieniło...?/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_883_0.pt-BR: * ... até hoje. Ela até elogiou a minha roupa! O que será que mudou...?/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_883_0.ru: * ...до сегодняшнего дня. Она даже похвалила мой наряд! Интересно, что изменилось?../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_883_0.zh:
* ...但是今天的她有点不一样。
她还夸我的穿搭好看呢！
她是怎么了呢...？/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_891_0.de: * Und... sie flüsterte etwas wie... "Mäuse sind sü€"...?/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_891_0.en: * And... she was muttering something like... "Mice are cute"...?/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_891_0.es: * Y... murmuraba algo como... ¿"los ratones son monos"?.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_891_0.ja:
＊ …ちいさいこえで
　 「ネズミは　カワイイ」って
　 いってた…/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_891_0.ko:
* 그리고... 뭔가 중얼거리기도 했어...
  "쥐는 귀엽지"... 랬던가?/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_891_0.pl: * I... mamrotała pod nosem coś w stylu... „Myszy są słodkie”...?/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_891_0.pt-BR: * E... ela tava sussurrando algo como... "Ratinhos são fofos"...?/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_891_0.ru: * И... она бормотала что-то вроде... «Мышки такие милые»?../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_891_0.zh:
* 而且... 她还嘀咕着什么...
“老鼠真可爱”...？/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_895_0_b.de: * Und... sie flüsterte etwas wie... "Du machst mir keine Angst"...?/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_895_0_b.en: * And... she was muttering something like... "You don't scare me"...?/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_895_0_b.es: * Y... murmuraba algo como... ¿"no me asustas"?.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_895_0_b.ja:
＊ …ちいさいこえで
　 「あなたなんか　こわくない」って
　 いってた…/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_895_0_b.ko:
* 그리고... 뭔가 중얼거리기도 했어...
  "너 따윈 두렵지 않아"... 랬던가?/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_895_0_b.pl: * I... mamrotała pod nosem coś w stylu... „Nie boję się ciebie”...?/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_895_0_b.pt-BR: * E... ela tava sussurrando algo como... "Você não me assusta"...?/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_895_0_b.ru: * И... она бормотала что-то вроде... «Я вас не боюсь»?../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_895_0_b.zh:
* 而且... 她当时还嘀咕着什么...
“你吓不到我的”...？/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_691_0.de:
* Yo, Kris!
* You survived Susie, haha!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_691_0.en:
* Yo, Kris!
* You survived Susie, haha!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_691_0.es:
* Yo, Kris!
* You survived Susie, haha!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_691_0.ja:
＊ オッス！
＊ スージィに
　 ころされなかったんだな！　ハハハ！/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_691_0.pl:
* Joł, Kris!
* Susie cię nie zamordowała, haha!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_691_0.pt-BR:
* Opa, Kris!
* Você sobreviveu à Susie, haha!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_691_0.ru:
* Йо, Крис!
* У тебя вышло пережить Сьюзи, ха-ха!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_691_0.zh:
* 哟，Kris！
* 你逃出Susie的魔爪啦，哈哈！/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_692_0.de: * I mean, I never saw her beat anyone up, but, uh, I'd be careful./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_692_0.en: * I mean, I never saw her beat anyone up, but, uh, I'd be careful./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_692_0.es: * I mean, I never saw her beat anyone up, but, uh, I'd be careful./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_692_0.ja:
＊ スージィが　ホントに　だれかを
　 ブッとばすとこ　みたわけじゃない
　 けどさ　きをつけたほうがいーぜ！/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_692_0.ko:
* 사실, 걔가 진짜로
  누굴 때리는 건 못 봤지만, 
  그래도 조심해야지./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_692_0.pl: * W sumie nie ma dowodu, że kogokolwiek pobiła, ale lepiej na nią uważać./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_692_0.pt-BR: * Quer dizer, I never saw her beat anyone up, but, uh, I'd be careful./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_692_0.ru: * Имею в виду, мне не доводилось видеть, как она кого-нибудь била, но, э-э, будь настороже./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_692_0.zh:
* 我是说，我从没见她揍翻过谁，
不过，呃，是我的话会留点神。/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_693_0.de: * Like, one time me, Snowy, and Jockington were playing handball,/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_693_0.en: * Like, one time me, Snowy, and Jockington were playing handball,/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_693_0.es: * Like, one time me, Snowy, and Jockington were playing handball,/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_693_0.ja:
＊ まえにさ　オレと　ライちゃんと
　 ジョッキントンで　ハンドボール
　 してたら…/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_693_0.ko:
* 전에 나랑, 스노위랑,
  조킹턴이 핸드볼을 하는데,/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_693_0.pl: * Pewnego dnia graliśmy ze Snowym i Jockingtonem w piłkę ręczną,/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_693_0.pt-BR: * Like, one time me, Snowy, and Jockington were playing handball,/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_693_0.ru: * Типа, однажды я, Снежик и Джокингтон играли в гандбол,/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_693_0.zh:
* 比如说，有一次我，Snowy，
还有Jockington正在玩手球，/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_694_0.de: * And she just kept creepily watching us from the corner./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_694_0.en: * And she just kept creepily watching us from the corner./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_694_0.es: * And she just kept creepily watching us from the corner./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_694_0.ja:
＊ スージィが　ずーっと　すみっこで
　 こっち　みてたことがあってさ。
　 すっげーブキミでさ！　んで…/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_694_0.ko:
* 걔가 구석에 가만히 서서
  계속 소름 끼치게
  쳐다보는 거야./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_694_0.pl: * A ona się na nas upiornie patrzyła z krańca boiska./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_694_0.pt-BR: * And she just kept creepily watching us from the corner./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_694_0.ru: * А она просто продолжала жутко наблюдать за нами из-за угла./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_694_0.zh:
* 而她就一直待在角落里
阴森森地盯着我们看。/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_695_0.de: * Then, when the ball rolled over to her she just, uh, froze solid.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_695_0.en: * Then, when the ball rolled over to her she just, uh, froze solid.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_695_0.es: * Then, when the ball rolled over to her she just, uh, froze solid.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_695_0.ja:
＊ ボールが　スージィのほうへ
　 ころがっても　あいつ　なーんも
　 せずに　つったったままで。したら…/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_695_0.ko:
* 그러다 공이, 수지 쪽으로
  굴러갔는데, 걔가 가만히
  서 있다가.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_695_0.pl: * Kiedy piłka potoczyła się w jej kierunku, to ją, no, zmroziło.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_695_0.pt-BR: * Then, when the ball rolled over to her she just, uh, froze solid.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_695_0.ru: * Затем, когда мячик подкатился к ней, она, э-э, застыла.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_695_0.zh:
* 后来，当球滚向她的时候她却，
呃，直愣愣地站在原地.../

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_696_0.de: * ... and kicked the ball as hard as she could, right into Officer Undyne's car!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_696_0.en: * ... and kicked the ball as hard as she could, right into Officer Undyne's car!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_696_0.es: * ... and kicked the ball as hard as she could, right into Officer Undyne's car!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_696_0.ja:
＊ …スージィのやつ　きゅうにボールを
　 おもいっきりけって　それがパトカー
　 ちょくげきして　アンダインさんが…/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_696_0.ko:
* ... 공을 있는 힘껏 차서,
  경찰서장 언다인네 차에
  부딪혀 버린 거야!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_696_0.pl: * ...a potem kopnęła ją tak mocno, że wylądowała prosto na samochodzie pani Undyne!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_696_0.pt-BR: * ... and kicked the ball as hard as she could, right into Officer Undyne's car!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_696_0.ru: * ...и пнула мяч так сильно, что попала прямо в машину Офицера Андайн!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_696_0.zh:
* ...紧接着卯足了劲一脚踢在球上，
球精准地飞进了Undyne警官的车！/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_697_0.de: * Then, Undyne came out, smiling, cracked her knuckles, and totally wiped us at handball.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_697_0.en: * Then, Undyne came out, smiling, cracked her knuckles, and totally wiped us at handball.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_697_0.es: * Then, Undyne came out, smiling, cracked her knuckles, and totally wiped us at handball.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_697_0.ja:
＊ ニコニコしながら　こぶしをボキボキ
　 ならして　おりてきて　ハンドボール
　 やって　オレたち　ボロまけしてさ！/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_697_0.ko:
* 그리곤, 언다인이 웃는 얼굴로 
  손가락을 우두둑 꺾더니,
  우리를 핸드볼로 발라버렸어.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_697_0.pl: * Ta zaś wyszła z auta, strzeliła palcami i zmiażdżyła nas w meczu piłki ręcznej.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_697_0.pt-BR: * Then, Undyne came out, smiling, cracked her knuckles, and totally wiped us at handball.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_697_0.ru: * Она вышла из машины, улыбаясь, сжимая кулаки, и просто всухую порвала нас.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_697_0.zh:
* 接着，Undyne从车里走出来，
她微笑着，拳头攥得嘎嘎作响，
然后用手球把我们全教训了一顿。/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_698_0.en: * Anyway, Susie sucks, Kris, haha. /
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_698_0.ja:
＊ よーするに　スージィは
　 サイテーだってことだな！
　 ハハハ！ /
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_698_0.pl: * Morał z tego taki: Susie jest do dupy, Kris, haha. /
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_698_0.ru: * В общем, Сьюзи отстой, Крис, ха-ха. /
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_698_0.zh:
* 总而言之，Kris，
Susie太差劲了，哈哈。 /

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_702_0.de:
* Yo, Kris, you look kind of annoyed.
* Everything OK?/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_702_0.en:
* Yo, Kris, you look kind of annoyed.
* Everything OK?/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_702_0.es:
* Yo, Kris, you look kind of annoyed.
* Everything OK?/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_702_0.ja:
＊ オッス！　クリス…どうした？
　 ビミョーな　かおして。
＊ なんか　イラついてんのか？/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_702_0.ko:
* 요, 크리스,
  괜찮은 거야?
* 화가 나 보이는데?/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_702_0.pl:
* Joł, Kris, wyglądasz jakby cię to wkurzyło.
* Dobrze się czujesz?/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_702_0.pt-BR:
* Yo, Kris, you look kind of annoyed.
* Everything OK?/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_702_0.ru:
* Йо, Крис, выглядишь расстроенно.
* Всё путём?/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_702_0.zh:
* 哟，Kris，你好像心情不太好。
* 出什么事了吗？/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_703_0.de: * You can calm down now, dude! Susie's not here, haha!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_703_0.en: * You can calm down now, dude! Susie's not here, haha!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_703_0.es: * You can calm down now, dude! Susie's not here, haha!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_703_0.ja:
＊ おちつけって！
　 ここには　もう　スージィは
　 いないんだからさ！　ハハハ！/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_703_0.ko:
* 안심해도 된다구, 친구!
  수지는 여기 없으니까, 하하!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_703_0.pl: * Spokojnie, ziom! Susie tu z nami nie ma, haha!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_703_0.pt-BR: * You can calm down now, dude! Susie's not here, haha!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_703_0.ru: * Можешь расслабиться! Сьюзи здесь нет, ха-ха!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_703_0.zh:
* 你现在可以放心了，伙计！
Susie可不在这里，哈哈！/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_704_0.de:
* ... Huh?
* You look even more annoyed.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_704_0.en:
* ... Huh?
* You look even more annoyed.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_704_0.es:
* ... Huh?
* You look even more annoyed.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_704_0.ja:
＊ …あれ？
＊ なんだよ　もっとイラついたみたいな
　 かおして…/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_704_0.pl:
* Cooo?
* Jakimś cudem te słowa jeszcze bardziej cię rozdrażniły.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_704_0.pt-BR:
* ... Huh?
* You look even more annoyed.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_704_0.zh:
* ...啊？
* 你好像心情更不好了.../

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_710_0.en:
* HOOH!!
* You're lucky, Kris!! /
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_710_0.ja:
＊ いやぁ～！
＊ クリスはん　あんた
　 ラッキーやったなあ！/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_710_0.zh:
* 呀呼！！
* 你也太走运了，Kris！！/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_711_0.de: * You got to miss class with Alphys! It's not fair! Ha ha ha!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_711_0.en: * You got to miss class with Alphys! It's not fair! Ha ha ha!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_711_0.es: * You got to miss class with Alphys! It's not fair! Ha ha ha!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_711_0.ja:
＊ アルフィーせんせの　じゅぎょう
　 うけずに　すんだやないか！
　 ワーッハッハ！/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_711_0.ko:
* 너만 알피스의 수업을
  빠지고 말이야!
  불공평해! 하 하 하!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_711_0.pl: * Udało ci się ominąć lekcje z panią Alphys! To nieuczciwe! Ha ha ha!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_711_0.pt-BR: * You got to miss class with Alphys! It's not fair! Ha ha ha!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_711_0.ru: * Тебя опять не было на уроках Альфис! Так нечестно! Ха-ха-ха!/
