obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_711_0.zh:
* 你居然成功翘掉了Alphys的课！
这不公平！哈哈哈！/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_712_0.de: * If I skipped class, my dad'd never let me hear the end of it!!! Ha ha ha!!!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_712_0.en: * If I skipped class, my dad'd never let me hear the end of it!!! Ha ha ha!!!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_712_0.es: * If I skipped class, my dad'd never let me hear the end of it!!! Ha ha ha!!!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_712_0.ja:
＊ ワテが　じゅぎょう　サボったら
　 オトンに　えんえん　せっきょう
　 されますわ！　ワーッハッハ！/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_712_0.ko:
* 내가 수업을 빠지면,
  아빠가 날 가만두지 않을 거야!!!
  하하하!!!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_712_0.pl: * Jakbym ja poszedł na wagary, to mój tata chyba by mnie wydziedziczył!!! Ha ha ha!!!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_712_0.pt-BR: * If I skipped class, my dad'd never let me hear the end of it!!! Ha ha ha!!!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_712_0.ru: * Если бы я что-то пропустил, мой отец не дал бы мне и слова сказать!!! Ха-ха-ха!!!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_712_0.zh:
* 要是我敢翘课，
那我爸给我上的“课”
可就没完没了了！哈哈哈！！！/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_713_0.de: * ... That's actually not even remotely funny./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_713_0.en: * ... That's actually not even remotely funny./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_713_0.es: * ... That's actually not even remotely funny./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_713_0.ja:
＊ …いや　ぜんぜん
　 わらえまへんがな。/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_713_0.pt-BR: * ... That's actually not even remotely funny./

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_765_0.de: * This is a great parking place!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_765_0.en: * This is a great parking place!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_765_0.es: * This is a great parking place!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_765_0.ja:
＊ ここは　クルマを　とめるには
　 さいこうの　スポットだ！/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_765_0.pt-BR: * Este é um ótimo lugar pra estacionar!/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_766_0.de: * I can see myself settling down here.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_766_0.en: * I can see myself settling down here.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_766_0.es: * I can see myself settling down here.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_766_0.ja:
＊ ここなら
　 みを　おちつけられそうだ…/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_766_0.pt-BR: * Posso imaginar me estabelecendo por aqui.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_766_0.ru: * Я уже вижу себя основывающим здесь свой новый дом.../

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_770_0.de: * Home is where the car is!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_770_0.en: * Home is where the car is!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_770_0.es: * Home is where the car is!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_770_0.ja:
＊ クルマを　とめておけるばしょ…
　 それこそが
　 “わがや”というものだ！/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_770_0.ko:
* 차를 세워둘 수 있는 곳이
  집이지 뭐!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_770_0.pl: * Tam dom mój, gdzie auto me!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_770_0.pt-BR: * A casa é onde o carro está!/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_779_0.de: * I just wanna go home, but I'm still stuck in a traffic jam.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_779_0.en: * I just wanna go home, but I'm still stuck in a traffic jam.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_779_0.es: * I just wanna go home, but I'm still stuck in a traffic jam.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_779_0.ja:
＊ もう　うちに　かえりたいのに…
　 まだ　じゅうたいから
　 ぬけだせない…/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_779_0.ko:
* 난 그냥 집에 가고 싶은데,
  아직도 길이 막혀 있어.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_779_0.pl: * Chciałem wrócić do domu, ale utknąłem w korku.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_779_0.pt-BR: * Eu só quero ir pra casa, mas ainda estou preso em um engarrafamento.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_779_0.ru: * Я просто хочу домой, но пробка.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_779_0.zh:
* 我是很想回家，
可我依然被堵在这里.../

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_780_0.de: * ... even though it's only one other person.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_780_0.en: * ... even though it's only one other person.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_780_0.es: * ... even though it's only one other person.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_780_0.ja:
＊ …つまってる　クルマは
　 １だい　だけだけど。/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_780_0.pl: * Tak, jest w nim tylko jeden samochód.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_780_0.pt-BR: * ... mesmo que seja apenas uma única outra pessoa.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_780_0.zh: * ...虽说只有一辆车堵在我前头.../

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_784_0.en: * That's the trouble with cars./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_784_0.ja: ＊ クルマってのは　やっかいだよ。/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_784_0.pl: * Wszystko byłoby dobrze, gdyby nie te przeklęte samochody./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_784_0.pt-BR: * Esse é o problema dos carros./

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_785_0.de: * If you wanna do donuts, you have to be prepared for jam!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_785_0.en: * If you wanna do donuts, you have to be prepared for jam!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_785_0.es: * If you wanna do donuts, you have to be prepared for jam!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_785_0.ja:
＊ どうろじょうきょうの　よみが
　 “あまい”と　ドーナッても
　 みうごきが　とれなくなる。/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_785_0.ko:
* 도넛이 먹고 싶다면,
  반죽이 "밀려야" 하는 법이거든!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_785_0.pl: * Jeśli chcesz robić bączki, to bądź gotowy na zawroty głowy!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_785_0.pt-BR: * Se você quer fazer donuts, você tem que estar preparado para engarrafamentos!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_785_0.ru: * Если хочешь пончиков, будь готов к варенью в пробках!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_785_0.zh:
* 想做甜甜圈，你就得做好
堵成酱紫的心理准备！/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_794_0.de: * You kids came out of the library, didn't you? Studying... How wonderful./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_794_0.en: * You kids came out of the library, didn't you? Studying... How wonderful./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_794_0.es: * You kids came out of the library, didn't you? Studying... How wonderful./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_794_0.ja:
＊ あなたたち　としょかんから
　 でてきたでしょう？　おべんきょう
　 してたのね。かんしんだわ。/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_794_0.ko:
* 너희 도서관에서 나온 거지, 응?
  공부라니... 대단하구나./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_794_0.pl: * Byliście dziś w bibliotece, tak? Wspólna nauka... Wspaniale./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_794_0.pt-BR: * Crianças, vocês saíram da biblioteca, não é? Estudando... Que maravilhoso./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_794_0.ru: * Вы, дети, пришли из библиотеки, да? Учёба... это прекрасно./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_794_0.zh:
* 孩子们，你们刚从图书馆里出来吗？
... 学习... 多美妙的事啊。/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_795_0.en: * Personally, I hate libraries, but.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_795_0.ja:
＊ こじんてきには　としょかんって
　 すきじゃないけれど。/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_795_0.pl: * Powiem wam szczerze. Nienawidzę bibliotek, bo.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_795_0.zh:
* 我个人不是太喜欢那地方，
不过.../

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_799_0.de: * Libraries are outdated. We have things like newspapers now./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_799_0.en: * Libraries are outdated. We have things like newspapers now./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_799_0.es: * Libraries are outdated. We have things like newspapers now./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_799_0.ja:
＊ としょかんなんて
　 じだいおくれよ。だって　いまは
　 しんぶんなんかが　あるじゃない。/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_799_0.ko:
* 도서관은 시대에 뒤떨어지잖아.
  지금은 신문 같은 게 있는데./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_799_0.pl: * Są takie przestarzałe. Mamy już coś takiego jak gazety./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_799_0.pt-BR: * Bibliotecas estão ultrapassadas. Agora nós temos coisas como jornais./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_799_0.ru: * Библиотеки устарели. Теперь у нас есть такие вещи, как газеты./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_799_0.zh:
* 图书馆什么的早就过时了。
现在我们可以坐在家里看报纸。/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1002_0.de: * Yesterday, I ended up dining and dashing out of embarrassment./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1002_0.en: * Yesterday, I ended up dining and dashing out of embarrassment./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1002_0.es: * Yesterday, I ended up dining and dashing out of embarrassment./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1002_0.ja:
＊ きのう　うっかり　くいにげ
　 しちゃったんだ。はずかしかったから
　 ダッシュで　にげただけなんだけど。/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1002_0.pl: * Wczoraj, skończyło się tak, że zjadłem i wybiegłem z baru zawstydzony./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1002_0.pt-BR: * Ontem, eu acabei lanchando e saindo rápido demais, por vergonha./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1002_0.ru: * Вчера я поужинал — и удрал, не выдержав смущения./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1002_0.zh: * 昨天，我吃完饭就尴尬地跑了。/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1003_0.de: * So I'm here to pay the waitress, but she's not working! She's... over there!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1003_0.en: * So I'm here to pay the waitress, but she's not working! She's... over there!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1003_0.es: * So I'm here to pay the waitress, but she's not working! She's... over there!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1003_0.ja:
＊ おカネを　はらいにきたけど
　 きょうは　ウェイターさんが
　 おやすみで…あそこに　いるんだ！/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1003_0.ko:
* 그래서 돈을 내려고 점원을 기다리는 중이야.
  근데 지금 일하는 게 아니라... 저기 있잖아!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1003_0.pl: * Więc przyszedłem dać napiwek kelnerce, ale dziś nie pracuje! Ona... stoi tam!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1003_0.pt-BR:
* Então eu vim pagar a garçonete, mas ela não tá trabalhando!
Ela tá... bem ali!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1003_0.ru: * Так что я вернулся заплатить официантке, но она не на работе! Она... вон там!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1003_0.zh:
* 我是来给女服务生结账的，
可她居然不在岗！
她... 在那边摸鱼呢！/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1007_0.de: * Now I have to stay perfectly still... In case she notices me if I move./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1007_0.en: * Now I have to stay perfectly still... In case she notices me if I move./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1007_0.es: * Now I have to stay perfectly still... In case she notices me if I move./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1007_0.ja:
＊ だから　じっとしてる…
　 うごいたら　きづかれるかも
　 しれないから。/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1007_0.ko:
* 그래서 그냥 바짝 가만히 서 있어...
  날 알아채지 못하게./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1007_0.pl: * Teraz muszę stać nieruchomo... W razie jakbym mnie dostrzegła, gdy się ruszę./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1007_0.pt-BR: * Agora eu tenho que ficar completamente parado... Vai que ela me nota se eu me mexer./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1007_0.ru: * И поэтому я тут застыл... Если двинусь, она может заметить./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1007_0.zh:
* 现在我得保持绝对静止... 
免得一动就被她发现。/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_731_0.de: * Hey neighbor-beighbor! When's yah brother Doug gonna come by? Huh huh huh!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_731_0.en: * Hey neighbor-beighbor! When's yah brother Doug gonna come by? Huh huh huh!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_731_0.es: * Hey neighbor-beighbor! When's yah brother Doug gonna come by? Huh huh huh!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_731_0.ja:
＊ こりゃ　どうも　ゴキンジョさん！
　 おにいちゃんの　ジョンくんは
　 いつ　あそびにくるのかな？/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_731_0.ko:
* 안녕하신가, 꼬마 이웃!
  너희 집 맏이 더그는 언제 들른다니?
  허허허!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_731_0.pl: * Hej, sąsiadku-niedźwiadku! Kiedy twój brat Stefan wpadnie? Huh huh huh!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_731_0.pt-BR: * Ei vizinho-zinha! Quando teu irmão Doug vai aparecer por aqui? Huh huh huh!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_731_0.ru: * Приветики, соседик! Когда тама твой братец Дуг собирается заскочить? Ха-ха-ха!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_731_0.zh:
* 嘿邻居！你家的大兄弟什么时候
来俺家串串门呀？呵呵呵！/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_732_0.de: * My girls'd love to see him! He's a sweet little man!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_732_0.en: * My girls'd love to see him! He's a sweet little man!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_732_0.es: * My girls'd love to see him! He's a sweet little man!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_732_0.ja:
＊ むすめたちも　よろこぶからねえ！
　 ジョンくん　やさしくて
　 いいコだから！/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_732_0.ko:
* 우리 딸이 보고 싶어 하더라고!
  참 싹싹한 청년이라니까!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_732_0.pl: * Moje dziewczyny bardzo ucieszyłaby jego wizyta! Jest takim słodziakiem!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_732_0.pt-BR: * Minhas meninas iriam amar ver ele! Ele é um homenzinho bacana!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_732_0.ru: * Мои девоньки были б рады его увидеть! Он славный малый!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_732_0.zh:
* 俺家的女孩们可喜欢他了！
他是个惹人喜爱的小大人！/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_733_0.de:
* He's just got one problem...
* He doesn't like my wife's cookin'!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_733_0.en:
* He's just got one problem...
* He doesn't like my wife's cookin'!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_733_0.es:
* He's just got one problem...
* He doesn't like my wife's cookin'!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_733_0.ja:
＊ ま　ひとつ　なんてんを　あげる
　 なら…　カミさんの　てりょうりが
　 くちに　あわないところかな！/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_733_0.ko:
* 딱 하나 문제가 있다면...
* 우리 와이프 요리를 별로
  안 좋아한다는 거야./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_733_0.pl:
* Ma tylko jedną wadę...
* Nie przepada za kuchnią mojej żony!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_733_0.pt-BR:
* Ele só tem um problema...
* Ele não gosta da comida da minha mulher!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_733_0.ru:
* С ним лишь одна загвоздка...
* Ему не нравится стряпня моей жены!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_733_0.zh:
* 他只有一点不好... 
* 他不喜欢俺老婆做的饭！/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_734_0.de:
* What's wrong, Douglas?
* You don't like frozen cat food? Huh huh huh!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_734_0.en:
* What's wrong, Douglas?
* You don't like frozen cat food? Huh huh huh!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_734_0.es:
* What's wrong, Douglas?
* You don't like frozen cat food? Huh huh huh!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_734_0.ja:
＊ ジョンくん　れいとうキャット
　 フードの　よさが　わからないとは！
＊ はは！　ははは！　ははははは！/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_734_0.ko:
* 더글러스, 그 녀석 참...
* 냉동 캣푸드가 왜 싫은 걸까?
  허허허!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_734_0.pl:
* W czym problem, Stefanie?
* Nie lubisz mrożonego jedzenia dla kotów? Huh huh huh!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_734_0.pt-BR:
* Qualé, Douglas?
* Não curte comida de gato congelada? Huh huh huh!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_734_0.ru:
* В чём дело, Дуглас?
* Не нравится замороженная кошачья еда? Ха-ха-ха!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_734_0.zh:
* 有什么问题吗，大兄弟？
* 你不喜欢冷冻猫粮吗？呵呵呵！/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_738_0.de: * Can't blame yah brother for leavin' town./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_738_0.en: * Can't blame yah brother for leavin' town./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_738_0.es: * Can't blame yah brother for leavin' town./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_738_0.ja:
＊ きみの　おにいちゃんが　まちを
　 でたのも　ムリないよねえ。/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_738_0.ko:
* 더그 녀석,
  여길 떠나버렸지만
  나무랄 수는 없지./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_738_0.pl: * Nie mam do twojego brata pretensji, że wyjechał z tego miasta./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_738_0.pt-BR: * Não dá pra culpar seu irmão por sair da cidade./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_738_0.ru: * Не могу винить твоегошнего брата за то, что свалил из города./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_738_0.zh: * 你可别怪你哥哥离开小镇啊。/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_739_0.de: * He's out there, gettin' a big brain in the big school./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_739_0.en: * He's out there, gettin' a big brain in the big school./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_739_0.es: * He's out there, gettin' a big brain in the big school./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_739_0.ja:
＊ いまごろ　「おおきい　がっこう」で
　 おおきい　のうミソを　てにいれてる
　 ところでしょう。/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_739_0.ko:
* 머리가 굵은 녀석이니,
  큰 학교를 가야지./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_739_0.pl: * Jest teraz w wielkiej szkole i powiększa swój mózg./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_739_0.pt-BR: * Ele tá por aí, ficando com um cérebro grande na escola grande./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_739_0.ru: * Он где-то там, прокачивает большие мозги в большой школе./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_739_0.zh:
* 他正在外面，
在大学里头学文化呢。/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_740_0.de: * Hope when he becomes a big shot, he remembers us little guys down the street./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_740_0.en: * Hope when he becomes a big shot, he remembers us little guys down the street./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_740_0.es: * Hope when he becomes a big shot, he remembers us little guys down the street./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_740_0.ja:
＊ しょうらい　おおモノに　なっても
　 ごきんじょに　すんでた　わたしらを
　 わすれないで　ほしいよねえ。/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_740_0.ko:
* 밖에서 대박 친 다음에도 
  우리 마을 친구들을
  기억해줬으면 좋겠어./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_740_0.pl: * Mam nadzieję, że jak zostanie grubą rybą, to nie zapomni o nas, szarakach z sąsiedztwa./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_740_0.pt-BR: * Espero que quando se tornar mandachuva, ele se lembre de nós, os carinhas da rua de baixo./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_740_0.ru: * Надеюсь, когда он станет большой шишкой, он вспомнит о нас, мелких ребятах с улицы./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_740_0.zh:
* 希望当他成为大人物的时候，
还记得俺们这些街上的小家伙们。/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_741_0.de: * Eatin' oranges and gettin' our stomachs pumped./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_741_0.en: * Eatin' oranges and gettin' our stomachs pumped./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_741_0.es: * Eatin' oranges and gettin' our stomachs pumped./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_741_0.ja:
＊ オレンジをたべては　胃をせんじょう
　 してもらってた　ネコ一家として
　 おぼえといて　ほしいよねえ。/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_741_0.ko:
* 오렌지 잔뜩 먹고
  배탈이 났던 친구들을./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_741_0.pl: * Będzie jadł pomarańcze i płukał nam żołądki./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_741_0.pt-BR: * Comendo laranjas e deixando nossos estômagos animados./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_741_0.ru: * Как мы лопали апельсины и набивали животы до отвала./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_741_0.zh:
* 可别忘了俺们这些吃橘子吃到
洗胃的土猫哟。/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_848_0.ja: ＊ ケロケロ　ケロケロ。/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_849_0.de: * (I sometimes hear beautiful singing from that house over there.)/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_849_0.en: * (I sometimes hear beautiful singing from that house over there.)/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_849_0.es: * (I sometimes hear beautiful singing from that house over there.)/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_849_0.ja:
＊ (そこの　いえから
　 ときどき　きれいな
　 うたごえが　きこえてくるケロ)/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_849_0.ko:
* (이따금씩 저 쪽 집에서
  아름다운 노랫소리가 들려와.)/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_849_0.pl: * (Czasem słyszę piękny śpiew z tego domu na górze.)/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_849_0.pt-BR: * (Às vezes eu ouço lindas cantorias vindo daquela casa logo ali.)/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_849_0.ru: * (Иногда я слышу красивое пение из того дома.)/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_849_0.zh:
* （那边的房子，
时不时会传出美妙的歌声。）/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_850_0.de: * (How eerie... could it be a ghost?)/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_850_0.en: * (How eerie... could it be a ghost?)/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_850_0.es: * (How eerie... could it be a ghost?)/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_850_0.ja:
＊ (すごく　きみが　わるいケロ。
　 ひょっとしたら　オバケケロ？)/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_850_0.pl: * (Trochę niepokojące... może to miejsce jest nawiedzone?)/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_850_0.zh: * （好诡异啊... 会不会是闹鬼？）/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_855_0.de: * (That would make sense. A ghost lives there.)/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_855_0.en: * (That would make sense. A ghost lives there.)/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_855_0.es: * (That would make sense. A ghost lives there.)/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_855_0.ja:
＊ (そのいえに
　 オバケが　すんでるなら
　 なっとくケロ)/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_855_0.ko:
* (그거 말 되네.
  유령이 살고 있는 거야.)/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_855_0.pl: * (Miałoby to sens. W końcu żyje tam rodzinka duchów.)/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_855_0.pt-BR: * (Isso faria sentido. Um fantasma mora ali.)/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_855_0.ru: * (В этом был бы смысл. Там живёт призрак.)/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_855_0.zh:
* （肯定有只幽灵住在里面，
不会错的。）/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_862_0.de: * My brother's too old to take for a walk anymore... hm.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_862_0.en: * My brother's too old to take for a walk anymore... hm.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_862_0.es: * My brother's too old to take for a walk anymore... hm.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_862_0.ja:
＊ おとうとは　おおきくなってしまって
　 もう　おさんぽには
　 つれていけない…/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_862_0.ko:
* 우리 남동생은 이제 훌쩍 커서
  더는 산책에 데려갈 수 없어... 
  흐음.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_862_0.pl: * Nie muszę już wyprowadzać mojego brata na spacer... hm.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_862_0.pt-BR: * Meu irmão é muito velho hoje em dia pra fazer caminhadas... hm.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_862_0.ru: * Мой брат слишком стар для долгих прогулок... эх.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_862_0.zh:
* 我的弟弟已经长大了，
我没法再带他去散步了... 唔.../

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_863_0.de: * I'm aimless... wish I had someone to whip me into shape./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_863_0.en: * I'm aimless... wish I had someone to whip me into shape./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_863_0.es: * I'm aimless... wish I had someone to whip me into shape./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_863_0.ja:
＊ いきる　もくてきを　うしなって
　 しまったわ…　だれか　わたしを
　 ムチで　たたきなおして…/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_863_0.ko:
* 삶의 목적을 잃어버렸어...
  누가 이 태도를 채찍질로 고쳐줬으면./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_863_0.pl: * Moje życie straciło sens... Niech ktoś mi pokaże moje miejsce w społeczeństwie./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_863_0.pt-BR: * Estou sem direção... queria ter alguém que me obrigasse a ficar em forma./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_863_0.ru: * У меня нет цели... хочу, чтобы кто-нибудь привёл меня в форму./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_863_0.zh:
* 感觉自己失去了人生目标... 
真希望有谁能来鞭策我一下。/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_871_0.de: * I wanted to buy flowers, but the store's closed./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_871_0.en: * I wanted to buy flowers, but the store's closed./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_871_0.es: * I wanted to buy flowers, but the store's closed./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_871_0.ja:
＊ おはなを　かいたいのに
　 おみせが　しまってるの。/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_871_0.ko:
* 꽃을 사고 싶었는데,
  가게가 문을 닫았어./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_871_0.pl: * Chciałam kupić bukiet kwiatów, ale kwiaciarnia jest zamknięta./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_871_0.pt-BR: * Eu queria comprar flores, mas a loja tá fechada./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_871_0.ru: * Я хотела купить цветы, но магазин закрылся./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_871_0.zh:
* 我想买点花来着，
可是这家店已经关门了。/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_872_0.de: * The door around back's unlocked, but I don't think I should go in.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_872_0.en: * The door around back's unlocked, but I don't think I should go in.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_872_0.es: * The door around back's unlocked, but I don't think I should go in.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_872_0.ja:
＊ うらぐちのドアは
　 カギが　あいてるんだけど…
　 かってにはいっちゃ　ダメだよね…/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_872_0.ko:
* 뒤쪽의 문은 열려있는데,
  들어가면 안 되겠지.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_872_0.pl: * Tylne drzwi są otwarte, ale chyba nie powinnam tam wchodzić.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_872_0.pt-BR: * A porta dos fundos tá destrancada, mas acho que eu não deveria entrar.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_872_0.ru: * Задняя дверь открыта, но я не думаю, что туда стоит входить.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_872_0.zh:
* 后门是开着的，
但我感觉擅自进去不太好.../

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_876_0.de: * I saw a bed through the back window... Wonder what the deal is./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_876_0.en: * I saw a bed through the back window... Wonder what the deal is./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_876_0.es: * He visto una cama por la ventana de atrás... Me pregunto qué se trae entre manos./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_876_0.ja:
＊ うらのまどから
　 ベッドが　みえたの…
　 どういうこと…？/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_876_0.ko:
* 뒷 창문으로 침대가 보였었어...
  무슨 일일까./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_876_0.pl: * Dostrzegłam łóżko przez tylne okno... Ciekawe o co chodzi./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_876_0.pt-BR: * Eu vi uma cama pela janela dos fundos... Do que será que se trata?/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_876_0.ru: * Я видела кровать через заднее окно... Интересно, в чём там дело./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_876_0.zh:
* 我透过屋后的窗户看到了一张床... 
真叫人摸不着头脑。/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1107_0.de: * Dieser Asgore Typ... Wie schade dass er alles verloren hat nachdem... Wei€t schon./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1107_0.en: * That Asgore guy... It's a shame he lost everything after he... You know./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1107_0.es: * Ese tal Asgore... Es una lástima que lo perdiera todo después de que él... Ya sabes./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1107_0.ja:
＊ このみせの　アズゴア…
　 あんなことが　あって…なにもかもを
　 うしなって…きのどくに。/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1107_0.ko:
* 저 아스고어라는 사람...
  그 일 이후로,
  모든 걸 잃은 게 참 안타깝지./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1107_0.pl: * Biedny Asgore... Wielka szkoda, że stracił wszystko... Wiadomo dlaczego./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1107_0.pt-BR: * Aquele tal de Asgore... É uma pena que ele tenha perdido tudo depois que ele... você sabe./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1107_0.ru: * Этот парень, Азгор... Очень жаль, что он всё потерял после... и так понятно, чего./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1107_0.zh:
* 那个叫Asgore的家伙...
那件事发生以后，他就失去了一切...
实在是太可怜了。/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1108_0_b.de: * Jetzt muss er Blumen verkaufen um sich über Wasser zu halten, aber... Was? Er ist dein Vater?/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1108_0_b.en: * Now he has to sell flowers to make ends meet, but... What? He's your father? Sorry./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1108_0_b.es: * Ahora vende flores para llegar a fin de mes, pero... ¿Qué? ¿Que es tu padre? Perdón./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1108_0_b.ja:
＊ いまじゃ　せいかつの　ために
　 ほそぼそと　はなを　うって…
　 え？　キミのパパなの？　ごめん。/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1108_0_b.ko:
* 이젠 꽃을 팔아서 마감 세일 식재료나
  사다 먹는 처지잖아, 하지만...
  응? 너희 아버지라고? 미안해./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1108_0_b.pl: * Teraz musi sprzedawać kwiaty, by związać koniec z końcem, ale... Hmm? To twój tata?/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1108_0_b.pt-BR: * Agora ele vende flores pra conseguir se sustentar, mas... Hã? Ele é seu pai? Desculpa./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1108_0_b.ru: * Теперь он продаёт цветы, чтобы сводить концы с концами, но... что? Он — твой отец? Мне жаль./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1108_0_b.zh:
* 现在他只能靠卖花勉强糊口，不过...
等等？他是你父亲吗？不好意思。/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1112_0_b.de: * Verzeihung, ich hoffe dass er aufhört sich so... in dieser Sache zu verlaufen./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1112_0_b.en: * Well, I hope for your sake he quits being so... obsessed with that stuff./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1112_0_b.es: * Bueno, por vuestro bien espero que deje de estar tan... obsesionado con eso./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1112_0_b.ja:
＊ キミのためにも　あんまり
　 ああいうことに　むちゅうになるのは
　 やめてほしいよね。/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1112_0_b.ko:
* 뭐, 너를 위해서라도 너희 아빠가,
  음... 그거에 그만 집착하길 바랄게./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1112_0_b.pl: * Cóż, miejmy nadzieję, że dla twojego dobra... będzie trzymał w ryzach swoją obsesję./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1112_0_b.pt-BR: * Bem, espero que, pelo seu bem, ele pare de ser tão... obcecado com essas coisas./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1112_0_b.ru: * Ну, я надеюсь, он бросит... это дело. Ради твоего блага./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1112_0_b.zh:
* 好吧，我希望他至少能为了你，
别再如此... 沉迷于那种事了。/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_895_0.en: * I'm not Jerry. I'm Terry./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_895_0.ja:
＊ オレ　ジェリーじゃねーし？
　 テリーだし？/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_895_0.pl: * Jestem Terry. Nie myl mnie z Jerrym./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_895_0.pt-BR: * Eu não sou o Jerry. Sou o Terry./

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_896_0.ja: ＊ オレ　チョーゼツ　イケてるし？/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_897_0.de: * I totally DON'T have to go to the bathroom./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_897_0.en: * I totally DON'T have to go to the bathroom./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_897_0.es: * I totally DON'T have to go to the bathroom./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_897_0.ja:
＊ オレ　ベンジョとか　いかなくて
　 ぜんぜんヘーキだし？/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_897_0.ko: * 난 화장실 같은 거 안 가./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_897_0.pl: * I WCALE nie muszę iść teraz do łazienki./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_897_0.pt-BR: * Eu absolutamente NÃO preciso ir ao banheiro./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_897_0.ru: * И мне ТОЧНО не нужно принимать ванну./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_897_0.zh: * 我完全就不需要上厕所。/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_903_0.en: * Oh!!! Terry!! Say it again!!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_903_0.ja:
＊ すげぇー！　テリーすげぇー！
　 いまの　もっかい　いって！！/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_903_0.ko:
* 오!!! 테리!!
  다시 한 번 말해줘!!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_903_0.pl: * O!!! Terry!! Powiedz to jeszcze raz!!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_903_0.zh:
* 哇哦！！！Terry！！
你能再表演一下那个吗！？/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_904_0.de: * Say you don't have to go to the bathroom again!!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_904_0.en: * Say you don't have to go to the bathroom again!!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_904_0.es: * Say you don't have to go to the bathroom again!!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_904_0.ja:
＊ 「ベンジョとか　いかなくて
　 ぜんぜんヘーキだし？」って
　 もっかい　いって！！/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_904_0.ko:
* 화장실 같은 거 안 간다고
  다시 한 번 말해줘!!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_904_0.pl: * Powiedz jeszcze raz, że nie musisz iść do łazienki!!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_904_0.pt-BR: * Fala de novo que você não precisa ir ao banheiro!!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_904_0.ru: * Скажи, что тебе не нужно принимать ванну!!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_904_0.zh: * 说那句，你完全不需要上厕所！？/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_910_0.de: * Nothing like admiring the great paint job, me and my bro did on our church./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_910_0.en: * Nothing like admiring the great paint job, me and my bro did on our church./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_910_0.es: * Nothing like admiring the great paint job, me and my bro did on our church./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_910_0.ja:
＊ この　きょうかい　あいぼうと
　 ふたりで　ペンキぬったんだぜ？
　 なかなかの　しあがりだろ？/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_910_0.ko:
* 페인트칠이 아주
  훌륭하지 않니,
  나랑 브로가 같이 교회를 칠했어./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_910_0.pl: * Razem z moim druhem pomalowaliśmy kościół i teraz podziwiamy rezultaty./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_910_0.pt-BR: * Nada como admirar um belo trabalho de pintura, que eu e meu mano fizemos na igreja./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_910_0.ru: * Нет ничего лучше восхищения великолепной покраской церкви, которой занимались мы с бро./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_910_0.zh:
* 站在这里欣赏我和我兄弟
刚给教堂刷好的油漆，
天底下还有比这更棒的事吗？/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_924_0.de: * We tried to play baseball, but that kid kept dancing in the middle of the lot./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_924_0.en: * We tried to play baseball, but that kid kept dancing in the middle of the lot./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_924_0.es: * We tried to play baseball, but that kid kept dancing in the middle of the lot./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_924_0.ja:
＊ やきゅうを　しようとしたんだけど…
　 こいつが　フィールドの　まんなかで
　 ずーっと　おどってて…/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_924_0.ko:
* 야구를 하려고 했는데,
  저 꼬맹이가 중간에서 계속 춤을 춰./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_924_0.pl: * Chcieliśmy pograć w baseballa, ale ten dzieciak tańczy na środku naszego boiska./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_924_0.pt-BR: * Nós tentamos jogar beisebol, mas aquela criança ficou dançando sem parar ali./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_924_0.ru: * Мы хотели сыграть в бейсбол, но этот ребёнок не перестаёт танцевать посреди площадки./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_924_0.zh:
* 我们原本想来打棒球，
但那孩子老是在场地中央跳舞。/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_925_0.de: * I... don't feel like there's any way to stop him.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_925_0.en: * I... don't feel like there's any way to stop him.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_925_0.es: * I... don't feel like there's any way to stop him.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_925_0.ja:
＊ たぶん…　おどるの　やめさせるのは
　 ムリなんじゃないかな…/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_925_0.ko:
* 아마... 쟤를 막을 방법은
  없을 거야.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_925_0.pl: * Chyba... nie da się go już powstrzymać.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_925_0.pt-BR: * Desse jeito... se ficar assim ela não vai parar mais.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_925_0.ru: * Я... не думаю, что есть способ остановить его.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_925_0.zh:
* 我... 我想不到有什么办法
能让他停下来.../

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_929_0.de: * If I can't stop him... Should I join him? No... no./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_929_0.en: * If I can't stop him... Should I join him? No... no./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_929_0.es: * If I can't stop him... Should I join him? No... no./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_929_0.ja:
＊ おどるの　やめさせるのがムリなら…
　 ボクもいっしょに…
　 いや…　それはダメだな…/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_929_0.ko:
* 막을 수 없다면...
  같이 춰야 할까?
  아니... 안 돼./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_929_0.pl: * Jeśli nie jestem w stanie go powstrzymać... to może do niego dołączę? Nie... nie./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_929_0.pt-BR: * Se não dá pra parar... Melhor eu me juntar, né? Não... não./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_929_0.ru: * Если я не могу его остановить... Стоит ли мне присоединиться? Нет... нет./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_929_0.zh:
* 如果我没法让他停下来... 
是不是该陪他一起跳呢？
不... 还是算了。/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1176_0.ja:
＊ う～～～～わ

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_797_0.en: * The patients can't hear it well from here, but I personally enjoy it./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_797_0.es: * The patients can't hear it well from here, but I personally enjoy it./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_797_0.ja:
＊ かんじゃさんたちには　あんまり
　 きこえないけど　わたしは
　 たのしく　きかせてもらってるわ。/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_797_0.ko:
* 환자들에겐 잘 안 들리지만,
  나는 네 연주 좋아해./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_797_0.pl: * Pacjenci są zbyt daleko, by cię usłyszeć, ale ja lubię jak grasz./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_797_0.pt-BR: * Os pacientes não conseguem escutar direito daqui, mas pessoalmente eu gosto./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_797_0.ru: * Пациенты тебя отсюда не услышат, но лично мне нравится./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_797_0.zh:
* 病人们不太能听到这里的声音，
但我自己还挺享受的。/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_801_0.de: * Sometimes the police chief comes in to play the piano./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_801_0.en: * Sometimes the police chief comes in to play the piano./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_801_0.es: * Sometimes the police chief comes in to play the piano./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_801_0.ja:
＊ ときどき　けいさつしょの
　 しょちょうさんも　きて
　 ピアノを　ひいていくの。/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_801_0.pl: * Czasami komendantka policji też przychodzi pograć na pianinie./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_801_0.pt-BR: * Às vezes, a Chefe de Polícia aparece pra tocar também./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_801_0.ru: * Шеф полиции иногда приходит сыграть на пианино./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_801_0.zh: * 有时候那位警长会来这里弹钢琴。/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_802_0.de: * Her playing is nice, but when she starts singing.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_802_0.en: * Her playing is nice, but when she starts singing.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_802_0.es: * Her playing is nice, but when she starts singing.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_802_0.ja:
＊ あのひと　ピアノは
　 じょうずなんだけど
　 うたいはじめると…/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_802_0.ko:
* 잘 치긴 하는데,
  노래를 부를 때 쯤이면.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_802_0.pl: * Potrafi grać zaskakująco dobrze, ale kiedy zaczyna śpiewać.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_802_0.pt-BR: * Ela toca bem legal, mas quando começa a cantar.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_802_0.ru: * Её игра хороша, но когда она начинает петь.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_802_0.zh:
* 她琴弹得很好，
但她要是唱起来了.../

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_803_0.de: * We have to ask her to leave./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_803_0.en: * We have to ask her to leave./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_803_0.es: * We have to ask her to leave./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_803_0.ja:
＊ おかえりいただくしか
　 なくなっちゃうのよね。/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_803_0.pt-BR: * Nós temos que pedir para que vá embora./

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_809_0.de: * Hmmm... you usually play the piano a bit more... beautifully./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_809_0.en: * Hmmm... you usually play the piano a bit more... beautifully./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_809_0.es: * Hmmm... you usually play the piano a bit more... beautifully./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_809_0.ja:
＊ うーん…　あなた　いつもはもっと…
　 きれいな　ねいろを
　 かなでるのにね。/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_809_0.ko:
* 흠... 평소엔 좀 더...
  아름답게 치지 않았니?/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_809_0.pt-BR: * Hmmm... normalmente você toca o piano um pouco mais... lindamente./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_809_0.ru: * Хм-м-м... обычно твоя игра не так... ужасна./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_809_0.zh:
* 嗯... 你钢琴通常弹得比这... 
好听点的。/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_810_0.de:
* Is everything OK?
* You DO seem a little sick.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_810_0.en:
* Is everything OK?
* You DO seem a little sick.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_810_0.es:
* Is everything OK?
* You DO seem a little sick.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_810_0.ja:
＊ きょうは　どうしたの？
＊ そういえば　ちょっと
　 ぐあいが　わるそうね…/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_810_0.ko:
* 별일 없는 거지?
* 좀 아파 보이는구나.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_810_0.pl:
* Wszystko dobrze?
* Wyglądasz jakoś tak niewyraźnie.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_810_0.pt-BR:
* Está bem?
* Você PARECE estar um pouco doente.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_810_0.ru:
* Всё в порядке?
* На тебе лица нет.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_810_0.zh:
* 一切都好吗？
* 你看起来有点不舒服.../

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_962_0.en: * Here to make an appointment...?/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_962_0.ja: ＊ ごよやくを　ごきぼうですか…？/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_964_0.en: 0* Nah, just here to hang out./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_964_0.es: 0* Nah, just here to hang out./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_964_0.ja:
0＊ いや　ちょっと
　 プラプラしに
　 きただけだ。/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_964_0.pl: 0* Nie, po prostu błądzimy bez celu po mieście./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_964_0.pt-BR: 0* Nem, só tô aqui pra passar o tempo./

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_970_0.de: * Should I pencil you in for hanging out?/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_970_0.en: * Should I pencil you in for hanging out?/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_970_0.es: * Should I pencil you in for hanging out?/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_970_0.ja:
＊ では　プラプラする　ごよやくを
　 ごきぼうでしょうか？/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_970_0.pt-BR: * Você quer que eu agende um horário pra você passar o tempo?/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_970_0.zh:
* “转转”这事，
要帮你们预约一下吗？/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1247_0.de: * Ah, euer Freund? Er ist immer noch.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1247_0.en: * Ah, your friend? He's still.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1247_0.ja:
＊ ああ　おともだちでしたら　
　 まだ…/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1247_0.pt-BR: * Ah, o seu amigo? Ele ainda está.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1247_0.ru: * А, твой друг? Он всё ещё.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1247_0.zh:
* 啊，来看你的朋友吗？
他现在还是.../

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1248_0.de: * So oder so, vielen Dank, dass ihr ihn gestern rein gebracht habt./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1248_0.en: * In any case, thank you for bringing him in yesterday./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1248_0.es: * En cualquier caso, gracias por traerlo ayer./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1248_0.ja:
＊ いずれにせよ　きのう
　 ここへ　つれてきてくれて
　 せいかいでしたね。/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1248_0.ko:
* 어쨌든, 어제 그 애를
  데려와 줘서 고마워./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1248_0.pl: * Dziękuję za przyniesienie go tutaj wczoraj./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1248_0.pt-BR: * De qualquer forma, agradecemos por trazê-lo aqui ontem./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1248_0.ru: * Спасибо, в любом случае. Что было бы, не принеси ты его вчера сюда?../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1248_0.zh: * 总之，谢谢你昨天带他过来。/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1259_0.de: * Ah, euer Freund ist hier. Irgendwas, irgendwas, sein Arm./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1259_0.en: * Ah, your friend is in here. Something, something, his arm./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1259_0.es: * Ah, tu amigo está aquí. Nosequé, nosecuantos, su brazo./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1259_0.ja:
＊ ああ　おともだちでしたら
　 にゅういんされていますよ。
　 ウデが　どうしたこうした…って。/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1259_0.ko:
* 아, 네 친구도 입원해 있어.
  팔에 어떤 일이 있었다던데./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1259_0.pl: * Ach, twój przyjaciel nadal tu jest. Ma coś tam, coś tam z ramieniem./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1259_0.pt-BR: * Ah, o seu amigo está aqui. Não sei o quê, não sei o quê, o braço dele./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1259_0.ru: * А, твой друг сейчас у нас. У него... с крылом там что-то./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1259_0.zh:
* 啊，你的朋友就在这里。
他的胳膊，出了点毛病。/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1263_0.de: * Er kann nicht mal mehr Bücher tragen!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1263_0.en: * He can't even pick up books!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1263_0.ja:
＊ ほん　すうさつすら
　 もちあげられないんですって！/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1263_0.ru: * Он даже книгу поднять не может!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1263_0.zh: * 他现在连书都拿不起来了！/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1271_0.de: * Hm, schon wieder hier? Du bist hier aber oft obwohl du nicht krank bist./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1271_0.en: * Hum, back again? You come here a lot for someone who isn't sick./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1271_0.es: * Jum, ¿otra vez por aquí? Vienes mucho para ser alguien saludable./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1271_0.ja:
＊ また　きたんですか？
　 びょうきでもないのに
　 よくきますね。/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1271_0.ko:
* 응, 또 왔니?
  안 아픈 사람 치곤
  병원에 참 자주 오는구나./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1271_0.pl: * Hum, witam ponownie? Często tu bywasz, jak na osobę, która nie jest chora./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1271_0.pt-BR: * Hmm, veio de novo? Você vem muito aqui pra alguém que não está doente./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1271_0.ru: * Хм, опять тут? Ты больно часто сюда ходишь, хотя проблем со здоровьем нет./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1271_0.zh:
* 哦，又回来了？
明明没生病，却老是往这里跑呢。/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1275_0.de: * Obwohl, deine Mutter macht sich Sorgen um deine Gesundheit.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1275_0.en: * That being said, your mother was concerned for your health.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1275_0.es: * No obstante, tu madre estaba preocupada por tu salud.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1275_0.ja:
＊ それはそうと…　あなたのママが
　 あなたの　けんこうじょうたいを
　 しんぱいしていましたよ…？/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1275_0.ko:
* 그러고 보니,  너희 어머니가
  네 몸상태를 걱정하셨어.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1275_0.pl: * Nie zmienia to faktu, że twoja mama martwi się o twoje zdrowie.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1275_0.pt-BR: * Dito isso, sua mãe estava preocupada com sua saúde.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1275_0.ru: * Кстати говоря, твоя мама переживала за твоё здоровье.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1275_0.zh:
* 话虽这么说，
但你妈妈真的很担心你的健康状况.../

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_821_0.de: * Nothin' better than hangin' at the lake with my best bro.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_821_0.en: * Nothin' better than hangin' at the lake with my best bro.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_821_0.es: * Nothin' better than hangin' at the lake with my best bro.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_821_0.ja:
＊ あいぼうと　みずうみで　すごす
　 ひとときに　まさるものは　ねェよ…/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_821_0.ko:
* 절친과 함께
  호숫가를 거니는 것만큼
  상쾌한 일도 없지.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_821_0.pl: * Ach, cóż za cudowny dzień na spotkanie nad jeziorem z najlepszym kumplem.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_821_0.pt-BR: * Nada como passar o tempo no lago com meu melhor mano.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_821_0.ru: * Нет ничего лучше, чем зависать у озера с моим бро.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_821_0.zh:
* 没什么能比得上
和我最好的兄弟
一起约在湖边.../

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_822_0.en: * Watchin' the waves go by.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_822_0.ja:
＊ すいめんを　わたってく　なみを
　 ただ　ながめンのさ…/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_822_0.pt-BR: * Assistindo as ondas irem e virem../

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1305_0.ja: ＊ まっても　ムダ。まっても　ムダ。/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1305_0.ko: * 기다리면 안 돼, 기다리면 안 돼./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1305_0.ru: * Не стоит ждать, не стоит ждать./

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1310_0.ja:
＊ まって…もムダ。
　 まって…もムダ！！/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1310_0.ko: * 안 돼, 기다려. 안 돼... 기다려!!!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1310_0.ru: * Не стоит, ждать. Не стоит... ждать!!!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1310_0.zh:
* 等等，不要。
等等... 不要！！！/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1031_0.de: * Wow, my co-worker seems so energetic lately!!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1031_0.en: * Wow, my co-worker seems so energetic lately!!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1031_0.es: * Wow, my co-worker seems so energetic lately!!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1031_0.ja:
＊ いやぁ～　うちの　どうりょう
　 さいきん　ずいぶん
　 はりきってるなぁ！！/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1031_0.ko:
* 와우, 내 동료 요즘
  기운이 넘치는걸!!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1031_0.pl: * Wow, mój współpracownik ostatnio ma tyle energii!!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1031_0.pt-BR: * Uau, meu colega parece tão enérgico ultimamente!!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1031_0.ru: * Вау, мой коллега в последнее время кажется таким энергичным!!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1031_0.zh:
* 哇哦，我的同事最近看起来
真的很有精神呢！！/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1032_0.de: * I don't know what's happened, but..../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1032_0.en: * I don't know what's happened, but..../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1032_0.es: * I don't know what's happened, but..../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1032_0.ja:
＊ なにが　あったのかは
　 しらないけど…/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1032_0.pl: * Nie wiem, co się stało, ale..../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1032_0.pt-BR: * Eu não sei o que aconteceu, mas.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1032_0.ru: * Не знаю, что с ним, но..../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1032_0.zh:
* 我不知道他是怎么了，
不过.../

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1033_0.de: * Seeing him happy makes me happy too!!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1033_0.en: * Seeing him happy makes me happy too!!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1033_0.es: * Seeing him happy makes me happy too!!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1033_0.ja:
＊ たのしそうな　すがたを　みてると
　 こっちまで　たのしくなるよ！！/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1033_0.pl: * Jak on się cieszy, to ja też!!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1033_0.pt-BR: * Ver ele feliz me faz feliz também!!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1033_0.ru: * Видя его счастливым, я тоже счастлив!!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1033_0.zh:
* 看到他那么开心，
也让我很开心！！/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1034_0.de: * Oh!!! A customer!! Would you like a blue soft-serve!?/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1034_0.en: * Oh!!! A customer!! Would you like a blue soft-serve!?/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1034_0.es: * Oh!!! A customer!! Would you like a blue soft-serve!?/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1034_0.ja:
＊ おッ！　おきゃくさんだ！
　 ブルーのソフトクリーム
　 いかがスかぁ！/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1034_0.ko:
* 아!!! 손님이다!!
  블루 소프트 아이스크림
  드시겠습니까!?/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1034_0.pl: * O!!! Klienci!! Podać wam niebieskiego świderka!?/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1034_0.pt-BR: * Ah!!! Clientela!! Gostaria de uma casquinha azul?!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1034_0.ru: * Ох!!! Посетитель!! Не желаете нашего голубого мороженого?!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1034_0.zh:
* 噢！！！是一位顾客！！
要不要点个蓝甜筒尝尝！？/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1042_0.ja:
＊ ダブルこおりあじの　ピザ…
　 うまい！/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1042_0.zh: * 双倍加冰披萨... 美味无比！/

* (불도저는 달라진 주변환경을 통해
  향상된 삶의 질을 체감하고 있다.)/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1550_0.pt-BR: * (A escavadeira está recebendo enriquecimento de seus arredores.)/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1550_0.ru: * (Жизнь бульдозера явно стала ярче после обогащения среды его вольера.)/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1550_0.zh:
* （推土机正在从周围环境中
汲取丰富的营养。）/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_975_0.ja: ＊ (わたしは　ゴウルデン・サムだ)/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1564_0.ja: ＊ わたしは　ゴウルデン・サムだ。/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1565_0_b.de: * Und bald, bin ich der Fortgegangene Sam./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1565_0_b.en: * I'm going to leave soon, too./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1565_0_b.ja: ＊ わたしも　じきに　ここを去る。/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1565_0_b.pt-BR: * Eu também irei partir, em breve./

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1168_0.ja: ＊ (ここは　よい　ろう屋だ！)/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1576_0.de: * Die Könige und Tiere gingen fort um ihr Glück in der Ferne zu suchen./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1576_0.en: * The kings and animals left to seek their fortune./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1576_0.es: * Los reyes y animales se han ido en busca de su fortuna./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1576_0.ja:
＊ 王と動物たちは
　 ひと旗あげるために
　 去っていった。/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1576_0.ko: * 다른 왕들과 동물들은 부를 찾아 떠났어./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1576_0.pl: * Królowie i zwierzęta odeszły, by szukać szczęścia w życiu./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1576_0.pt-BR: * Os reis e os animais partiram em busca de seus destinos./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1576_0.ru: * Короли и животные ушли отсюда в поисках счастья./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1576_0.zh: * 国王和动物们离开这里去追寻财富了。/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1577_0.en: * What a drag, what a drag./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1577_0.ja: ＊ まったく…ダルいことだ。/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1173_0.de: * We're still behind bars for some reason, but it's OK!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1173_0.en: * We're still behind bars for some reason, but it's OK!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1173_0.es: * We're still behind bars for some reason, but it's OK!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1173_0.ja:
＊ どういうわけか　われらは
　 いまだに　オリのなか…
　 だが　かまいはしない！/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1173_0.ko:
* 어째선지 우린 아직 갇혀있지만,
  그래도 괜찮네!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1173_0.pl: * Z jakiegoś powodu nadal jesteśmy za kratami, ale nic nie szkodzi!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1173_0.pt-BR: * Nós ainda estamos atrás das grades por algum motivo, mas está tudo bem!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1173_0.ru: * По какой-то причине мы всё ещё за решёткой, но всё в порядке!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1173_0.zh:
* 不知道为什么
我们还在监狱里，
不过没关系！/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1174_0.de: * We've grown to love this hellish place, where we dress as animals!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1174_0.en: * We've grown to love this hellish place, where we dress as animals!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1174_0.es: * We've grown to love this hellish place, where we dress as animals!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1174_0.ja:
＊ 動物のいでたちで過ごす
　 この劣悪な環境が
　 いまとなっては　心地よい！/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1174_0.ko:
* 동물처럼 꾸며야 하는,
  이 지옥같은 곳이
  좋아져버렸으니 말일세!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1174_0.pl: * Pokochaliśmy już to przeklęte miejsce i fakt, że musimy przebierać się za zwierzęta!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1174_0.pt-BR: * Nós passamos a amar este lugar infernal, onde nos vestimos como animais!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1174_0.ru: * Мы полюбили это адское место, где мы одеты как животные./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1174_0.zh:
* 我们开始喜欢上这个要扮成动物
过日子的鬼地方了！/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1179_0.de: * (We decided to dress as kings. It's cultural exchange.)/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1179_0.en: * (We decided to dress as kings. It's cultural exchange.)/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1179_0.es: * (We decided to dress as kings. It's cultural exchange.)/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1179_0.ja:
＊ (われらは　王のいでたちを
　 することにした。異文化交流だ)/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1179_0.ko:
* (왕들처럼 입어보기로 했어.
  문화 교류는 좋은 거야.)/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1179_0.pl: * (Przebraliśmy się za królów. Taka wymiana kulturowa.)/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1179_0.pt-BR: * (Nós decidimos nos vestir como reis. É intercâmbio cultural.)/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1179_0.ru: * (Мы решили одеться как короли. Культурный обмен.)/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1179_0.zh:
* （我们决定装扮成国王的样子。
权当是文化交流。）/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1597_0.de: * Meiner Treu! Den anderen Königen wurde klar... man kann hier einfach hinten rausgehen!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1597_0.en: * Hark! The other kings realized you can just... go out the back of this thing!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1597_0.es: * ¡Rayos! ¡Los otros reyes se han dado cuenta de que... se puede salir por detrás!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1597_0.ja:
＊ 他の王たちは…この…オリ的な
　 ヤツの裏から出られることに
　 気づいて　去ってしまった！/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1597_0.ko:
* 오호통재라! 다른 왕들은 그냥...
  이 뚫린 철창 뒤로 나가버렸다네!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1597_0.pl: * Słuchajcie! Pozostali królowie zorientowali się, że mogą... wyjść tyłem!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1597_0.pt-BR: * Ouça! Os outros reis perceberam que dá para apenas... sair por trás desta coisa!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1597_0.ru: * Послушайте! Остальные короли поняли, что можно... просто выйти сзади!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1597_0.zh:
* 瞧！其他的国王们发现... 
可以直接从笼子后面溜出去！/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1598_0.de: * Was ein Unfug! War ich der Einzige der Gefangen sein ernst genommen hat!?/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1598_0.en: * Pish and posh! Was I really the only one serious about being imprisoned!?/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1598_0.es: * ¡Retruécanos! ¿¡Soy el único que se tomaba en serio lo de estar encerrado!?/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1598_0.ja:
＊ 嘆かわしい！　マジメに囚人を
　 やっていたのは　われのみで
　 あったのか！？/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1598_0.ko:
* 이런 어처구니없는 일이! 갇혀있는 데
  진심이었던 건 나뿐이었단 말인가!?/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1598_0.pl: * Nonsens! Czy tylko ja tutaj brałem bycie uwięzionym na poważnie!?/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1598_0.pt-BR: * Ultrajante! Será que só eu levei a sério essa coisa de ficar preso?!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1598_0.ru: * Какой вздор! Я тут что, единственный, кто относится к заключению всерьёз?!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1598_0.zh:
* 荒唐至极！
难道只有我一个人在认真坐牢吗？/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1599_0.de: * Egal! Dem Güldenen Sam (du kannst mit dem Kopf des Käfigs reden) und mir geht's BESTENS!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1599_0.en: * That's fine! Goulden Sam (the cage whose head you can talk to) and I are FINE!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1599_0.es: * ¡Genial! ¡Goulden Sam (la jaula con cabeza parlante) y yo estamos BIEN!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1599_0.ja:
＊ えぇい　かまわぬ！　われと
　 ゴウルデン・サム（頭に話しかけると
　 答えるオリ）は　それでもかまわぬ！/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1599_0.ko:
* 괜찮다네! 굴든 샘
  (여기 철창 머리에게 말을 걸어보게) 과 
  난 괜찮아!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1599_0.pl: * Ale spokojnie! Ja i Mikołaj Klatka (klatka z gadającą głową) czujemy się ŚWIETNIE!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1599_0.pt-BR: * Tudo bem! Solano Doirado (a gaiola cuja cabeça você pode conversar) e eu estamos BEM!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1599_0.ru: * Но всё путём! Мы со Златым Сэмом (клетка, с чьей головой можно поговорить) В ПОЛНОМ ПОРЯДКЕ!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1599_0.zh:
* 没关系！就算这里只剩下
金泰阳（脑袋能说话的笼子）和我，
那也没关系！/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1603_0.de: * Und ich war der Einzige der das mit den Tierköstumen ernst genommen hat!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1603_0.en: * I was the only one serious about dressing up as an animal, too!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1603_0.es: * ¡También soy el único que se tomaba en serio lo de vestirse de animal!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1603_0.ja:
＊ マジメに動物のいでたちを
　 していたのも　われのみであった！/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1603_0.pl: * Tylko ja brałem przebieranie się za zwierzęta na poważnie!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1603_0.pt-BR: * Eu também fui o único que levou a sério isso de me fantasiar de animal!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1603_0.ru: * И к переодеванию в животных из нас серьёзно относился только я!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1603_0.zh: * 认真扮动物的也只有我一个人！/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1613_0.ja:
＊ (王冠が　ポツンと１つだけ
　 残っている…)/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1617_0.de: * (Es ist nicht einmal eine der besseren Kronen.)/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1617_0.en: * (It's not even one of the better crowns.)/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1617_0.es: * (Y ni siquiera es de las buenas.)/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1427_0.de: * (It's a bit scary moving to a new place. But, as a ball...)/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1427_0.en: * (It's a bit scary moving to a new place. But, as a ball...)/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1427_0.es: * (It's a bit scary moving to a new place. But, as a ball...)/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1427_0.ja:
＊ (知らない町へ引っ越して
　 とまどうこともあるけれど…)/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1427_0.pl: * (Przeprowadzka jest strasznym wydarzeniem. Ale jako piłeczka...)/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1427_0.pt-BR: * (É um pouco assustador se mudar pra um lugar novo. Mas, como uma bola...)/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1427_0.ru: * (Немного страшно переезжать на новое место. Но, говорю как мяч...)/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1427_0.zh:
* （搬家是件很可怕的事情，
但是，作为一个球...）/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1428_0.de: * (There's nothing to sphere except sphere itself.)/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1428_0.en: * (There's nothing to sphere except sphere itself.)/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1428_0.es: * (There's nothing to sphere except sphere itself.)/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1428_0.ja:
＊ (“たま”には気分を変えるのも
　 いいと思うの。
　 転がりつづけるのが人生だもの)/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1428_0.ko:
* (우리가 둥그러워해야 할 것은
  둥그러움 그 자체뿐인걸.)/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1428_0.pl: * (Nie mogę być wam kulą u nogi.)/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1428_0.pt-BR: * (Não há por que esferar o pior, apenas esferas.)/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1428_0.ru: * (В моей сфере общения нет никого кроме сфер.)/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1434_0.de: * (With this windfall, I've ceased to be spherical.)/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1434_0.en: * (With this windfall, I've ceased to be spherical.)/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1434_0.es: * (With this windfall, I've ceased to be spherical.)/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1434_0.ja:
＊ (思いがけず　もたらされた
　 この授かり物で　わたしはもう
　 球体ではなくなったの)/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1434_0.ko:
* (뜻밖의 사건 때문에,
  난 더 이상
  구체가 아니게 되었어.)/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1434_0.pl: * (Przez ten nagły przypływ dobrobytu, straciłam swoją okrągłą formę.)/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1434_0.ru: * (С этой удачей я перестал быть сферическим.)/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1434_0.zh:
* （有了这顶假发，
我就不用再做球了。）/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1435_0.ja:
＊ (ポイン…
　 あなたみたいなひとは　初めて)/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1455_0.de: * Ho ho!! Who is this guy!! He's scary!!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1455_0.en: * Ho ho!! Who is this guy!! He's scary!!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1455_0.es: * Ho ho!! Who is this guy!! He's scary!!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1455_0.ja:
＊ オホホウ！
　 このご仁は　どなた？　かな！？
　 なんとも恐ろしい！/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1455_0.ko:
* 호 호 호!!
  옆에 얜 누구에요!
  무서워!!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1455_0.pl: * Ho ho!! Kim jest ten czubek!?! Jest przerażający!!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1455_0.pt-BR: * Ho ho!! Quem é esse cara!! Ele é assustador!!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1455_0.ru: * Хо-хо!! Кто этот парень!! Он страшный!!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1455_0.zh:
* 吼吼！
这家伙是谁！他好吓人！！/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1462_0.de: * Nubert's had a wild ride. Time to settle down./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1462_0.en: * Nubert's had a wild ride. Time to settle down./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1462_0.es: * Nubert's had a wild ride. Time to settle down./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1462_0.ja:
＊ ポインは　波瀾万丈の人生を
　 送ってきてン。そろそろ
　 落ち着きたくなってン。/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1462_0.ko:
* 누버트는 파란만장한 삶을 살았어.
  슬슬 쉬어야 할 때지./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1462_0.pl: * Grzybert osiągnął sukces w życiu. Czas się ustatkować./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1462_0.pt-BR: * Nubert teve uma aventura e tanto. Hora de me estabelecer./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1462_0.ru: * Нуберт много путешествовал. Настало время осесть./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1462_0.zh:
* Nubert度过了波澜壮阔的一生。
该好好休息了。/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1463_0.de: * Give my riches to the weak.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1463_0.en: * Give my riches to the weak.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1463_0.es: * Give my riches to the weak.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1463_0.ja:
＊ 貯めた財産は
　 弱いコたちに　寄付するのねン…/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1662_0_b.en: * Things have changed again here in ~1Town!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1662_0_b.ja: ＊ ~1タウンは 　 あれから　ずいぶん変わったよ！/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1662_0_b.pt-BR: * As coisas mudaram de novo aqui na Cidade ~1!/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1666_0.de: * Die Liebe deiner Stadt ist Stark./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1666_0.en: * Your Town's love is Strong./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1666_0.es: * El amor de tu villa es fuerte./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1666_0.ja: ＊ この町には　力強い愛が 　 あふれてる。/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1666_0.pl: * Miłość w twoim mieście jest silna./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1666_0.pt-BR: * O amor da sua Cidade é Forte./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1666_0.zh: * 你的小镇之爱坚不可摧。/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1667_0_b.de: * Schönheit wächst in deinem Herzen. Lasst uns in ein gnadenreiches Leben blicken!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1667_0_b.en: * Beauty grows in your heart. Let's see to a merciful life!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1667_0_b.es: * La belleza crece en tu corazón. ¡Tengamos una vida misericordiosa!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1667_0_b.ja:
＊ キミの　心は　美しい。
　 みんなを　みのがして
　 生きていこう！/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1667_0_b.ko:
* 너의 심장 속에
  아름다움이 자라고 있어.
  계속 자비로운 삶을 살자!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1667_0_b.pl: * Piękno wypełnia twe serce. Niech żyje pokojowa egzystencja!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1667_0_b.pt-BR: * Cresce beleza em seu coração. Que tenhas uma vida piedosa!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1667_0_b.ru: * Красота прорастает в вашем сердце. Давайте жить дружно!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1667_0_b.zh:
* 美丽在你心中绽放。
让我们共赴仁慈的人生吧！/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1670_0.de: * Die Liebe deiner Stadt ist Schlicht./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1670_0.en: * Your Town's love is Plain./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1670_0.es: * El amor de tu villa es normalucho./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1670_0.ja: ＊ この町には　ありふれた愛が 　 あふれてる。/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1670_0.pl: * Miłość w twoim mieście jest zwyczajna./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1670_0.pt-BR: * O amor da sua Cidade é Simples./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1670_0.zh: * 你的小镇之爱平平无奇。/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1671_0.de: * Dies ist ein gewohnter Ort, doch siehst du aus als kämst du gerade erst her./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1671_0.en: * This is a familiar place, yet you look like you only just got here./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1671_0.es: * Este lugar debería ser familiar, pero parece que acabas de llegar./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1671_0.ja:
＊ 見覚えのある町なのに　
　 キミは　まるで　この町に
　 来たばかりみたいだ。/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1671_0.ko:
* 익숙한 곳일 텐데,
  마치 처음 온 것처럼 보이네./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1671_0.pl: * Jest to znajome miejsce, ale nie bywasz tu zbyt często./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1671_0.pt-BR: * Este é um lugar familiar, porém você dá a impressão de que acabou de chegar./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1671_0.ru: * Хоть место и знакомое, вы будто впервые тут оказались./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1671_0.zh:
* 你本该很熟悉这个地方，
可你看起来却像初来乍到一样。/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1672_0.de: * Von hier aus, lasse deine Liebe gedeihen. Alles gut./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1672_0.en: * From here, let your love grow. All right./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1672_0.es: * A partir de ahora, deja que crezca tu amor, ¿de acuerdo?/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1672_0.ja: ＊ ここから　愛を育んでいこう。/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1672_0.ko:
* 여기서 네 심장 속의 사랑이
  자라게 하자. 음, 음./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1672_0.pl: * Od teraz niech twa miłość rośnie. No dobrze./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1672_0.pt-BR: * Daqui em diante, deixe seu amor crescer. Tudo bem./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1672_0.ru: * Так пусть же взрастёт ваша любовь./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1672_0.zh: * 从这里开始，让你的爱滋长吧。/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1675_0.de: * Die Liebe deiner Stadt ist Gebrochen./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1675_0.en: * Your Town's love is Cracked./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1675_0.es: * El amor de tu villa está resquebrajado./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1675_0.ja: ＊ この町には　ひび割れた愛が 　 あふれてる。/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1675_0.pt-BR: * O amor da sua Cidade é Quebrado./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1675_0.zh: * 你的小镇之爱破损不堪。/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1676_0.de: * Vielleicht schätzt du diesen Ort nicht so sehr./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1676_0.en: * Perhaps you don't treasure this place so much./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1676_0.es: * Quizás no valores tanto este lugar./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1676_0.ja:
＊ キミは　この町を　あまり
　 大切に思っていないのかもしれない。/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1676_0.ko:
* 아마 넌 이 마을이
  그다지 소중하지 않을지도 모르겠다./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1676_0.pl: * Chyba nie cenisz zbytnio tego miejsca./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1676_0.pt-BR: * Talvez você não dê tanto valor assim a este lugar./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1676_0.ru: * Похоже, вы не особо цените это место./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1676_0.zh: * 可能你并不那么珍视这个地方。/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1677_0.de: * Doch er schätzt dich. Was auch immer du tust./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1677_0.en: * But it treasures you. Whatever you do./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1677_0.es: * Pero este lugar te valorará. Hagas lo que hagas./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1677_0.ja:
＊ それでも　キミが　なにをしようと 
　 この町は　キミを
　 大切に思っているよ。/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1677_0.ko:
* 하지만 이곳은 널 소중히 해.
  네가 뭘 하든./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1677_0.pl: * Ale ono będzie cenić ciebie. Cokolwiek zrobisz./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1677_0.pt-BR: * Mas ele dá valor a você. Independente do que faça./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1677_0.ru: * Но оно ценит вас. Что бы вы ни делали./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1677_0.zh:
* 但是，不论你做什么，
它都珍视着你。/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1682_0.de: * Ah, sehe ich anders aus? Verzeihung, ich bin's nur./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1682_0.en: * Ah, do I look different? Sorry, I'm just me./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1682_0.es: * Ah, ¿estoy distinto? No te preocupes, sigo siendo yo./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1682_0.ja: ＊ え？　ボク　見た目が変わった？/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1682_0.ko:
* 아, 내 모습이 전이랑 다른가?
  미안, 나 맞아./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1682_0.pl: * Ach, wyglądam inaczej? Wybacz, to nadal tylko ja./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1682_0.pt-BR: * Ah, pareço diferente? Desculpe-me, sou apenas eu./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1682_0.ru: * Ах, я выгляжу иначе? Прошу прощения, это всё ещё я./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1682_0.zh:
* 啊，我看起来有什么不一样吗？
抱歉，我还是我。/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1683_0.de: * Meine Farbe muss verblichen sein. Mach dir keinen Kopf darum!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1683_0.en: * My color must've faded. Pay it no mind!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1683_0.es: * Debo estar perdiendo el color. ¡No le des importancia!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1683_0.ja:
＊ 色が落ちただけだよ。
　 気にしないで！/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1683_0.ko:
* 내 색깔이 좀 바랬나 봐.
  너무 신경쓰지 마!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1683_0.pl: * Najwidoczniej trochę wyblakłem. Nie zwracaj na to uwagi!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1683_0.pt-BR: * Minha cor deve ter se esvaído. Não ligue para isso!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1683_0.ru: * Похоже, я выцвел. Не обращайте внимания!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1683_0.zh:
* 我肯定是有点褪色了。
别在意！/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1688_0.de: * Dieser Typ geht mir echt auf die Nerven. Nur weil er ein höheres Level hat.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1688_0.en: * This guy really annoys me. Just because he's a higher level.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1688_0.es: * Este tipo me toca las narices. Solo por tener un mayor nivel.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1688_0.ja:
＊ コイツ　ホント　ムカつく…
　 ちょっと自分のほうが
　 レベル高いからって…/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1688_0.ko:
* 저 녀석 영 기분 나빠.
  레벨 좀 더 높다고 해서.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1688_0.pl: * Ten gość mnie wkurza. Myśli, że skoro ma wyższy poziom.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1688_0.pt-BR: * Esse cara me enche o saco. Só porque ele tem um cargo mais alto.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1688_0.ru: * Этот парень меня раздражает. Он думает, что, благодаря высокому званию.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1688_0.zh:
* 这家伙真的很烦。
只不过比我高一级.../

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1689_0.de: * ... denkt er er könnte den Wasserkühler aufrei€en... komm mal klar./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1689_0.en: * ... he thinks he can chat up the watercooler... get real./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1689_0.es: * ... se cree que puede hablar con el enfriador de agua... Entérate./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1689_0.ja:
＊ …ウォータークーラーに
　 気安く話しかけちゃってさ。
　 バッカじゃないの？/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1689_0.ko:
* ... 정수기랑 하하호호
  말 섞는 꼴 하고는...
  정신 좀 차리시지./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1689_0.pl: * ...to może gadać przy wodopojniku... ale ma zryty beret./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1689_0.pt-BR: * ... ele acha que pode ficar cantando o bebedouro... fala sério./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1689_0.zh:
* ...他就觉得自己能和
watercooler搭讪了...
想得美。/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1695_0_b.de: * Oh, Kommandant! Ähem, welch reizende Einrichtung Sie uns zur Verfügung gestellt haben!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1695_0_b.en: * Oh, Commander! Ahem, what lovely amenities you have provided!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1695_0_b.es: * ¡Oh, Comandante! Ejem, ¡nos habéis provisto de unas maravillosas comodidades!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1695_0_b.ja:
＊ 隊長！　福利厚生を
　 充実させてくれて
　 ありがたいであります！/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1695_0_b.ko:
* 아, 대장! 으흠,
  정말 아름다운 편의 시설이야!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1695_0_b.pl: * Och, dowódco! Ahem, dzięki tobie mamy teraz takie cudowne udogodnienia!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1695_0_b.pt-BR: * Ah, Comandante! Ahem, mas que comodidades incríveis que você forneceu!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1695_0_b.ru: * Ох, командир! Кхм, какие невероятные удобства вы нам предоставили!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1695_0_b.zh:
* 哦，指挥官！
咳咳，您提供的设施
实在是太贴心了！/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1696_0_b.de: * Möchten Sie einen Schluck Wasser? Es ist köstlich, wie erwartet./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1696_0_b.en: * Would you like a sip of water? It's delicious, as expected./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1696_0_b.es: * ¿Te gustaría un sorbo de agua? Está deliciosa, como cabe esperar./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1696_0_b.ja:
＊ 隊長も　ひと口いかがでありますか？
　 思ったとおりの　おいしさで
　 ありますよ！/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1696_0_b.ko:
* 대장도 물 한 잔 마실래?
  예상한 대로, 맛있더라./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1696_0_b.pl: * Chcesz łyka? Ta woda jest przepyszna, tak jak można było się spodziewać./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1696_0_b.pt-BR: * Você gostaria de um golinho de água? É deliciosa, como esperado./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1696_0_b.ru: * Не хотите глоточек воды? Наивкуснейшей, разумеется./
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1696_0_b.zh: * 要来喝口水吗？很好喝的哟。/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1700_0.de: * Ich verspreche es! Ich trank gerade direkt aus der Leitung!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1700_0.en: * I guarantee it! I just drank directly out of the tap!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1700_0.es: * ¡Lo garantizo! ¡Acabo de beber directamente del grifo!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1700_0.ja:
＊ 注ぎ口から　直接飲んだ
　 ワタシが言うんだから　
　 まちがいありません！/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1700_0.ko:
* 맛은 보장해! 나 방금
  수도꼭지에 입 대고 마셨다니까!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1700_0.pl: * Gwarantuję to! Właśnie napiłem się bezpośrednio z kranika!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1700_0.pt-BR: * Eu te garanto! Eu acabei de beber diretamente da torneira!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1700_0.ru: * Уверяю вас в этом! Настолько, что я пил прямо из крана!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1700_0.zh:
* 我刚刚直接从水龙头那里喝的！
保证好喝！/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1705_0.ja: ＊ (見るからに　イラついている)/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1626_0.en: * Hey, boss! I'll have a Dark Candy Starfait!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1626_0.es: * ¡Oye, líder! ¡Voy a tomar un Starfait de Caramelo Oscuro!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1626_0.ja: ＊ Hey, boss! I'll have a Dark Candy Starfait!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1626_0.ko: ＊ Hey, boss! I'll have a Dark Candy Starfait!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1626_0.pl: * Hej, szefie! Poproszę Gwiazdoktail o smaku ciemnych cukierków!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1626_0.pt-BR: * Ei, chefe! Eu vou querer um Starfait de Doce Trevoso!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1626_0.ru: * Здрасьте, босс! Я буду звёздное парфе из темноконфеты!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1626_0.zh:
* 嘿，老板！
我要点个黑暗糖果星冰乐！/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1632_0.en: * (Hathy is going to order a heart-foam latte.)/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1632_0.es: * (Curazón va a pedir un latte con espuma en forma de corazón.)/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1632_0.ja: ＊ (Hathy is going to order a heart-foam latte.)/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1632_0.pl: * (Sercka zaraz zamówi latte z piankowym serduszkiem.)/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1632_0.pt-BR: * (Copação vai pedir um latte com espuma de coração.)/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1632_0.ru: * (Серция собирается заказать латте с пеной в форме сердца.)/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1632_0.zh:
* （Hathy打算点一份心形拉花的
拿铁咖啡。）/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1644_0.en: * (Looks like it wants to osmose some flavorful cubes.)/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1644_0.es: * (Looks like it wants to osmose some flavorful cubes.)/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1644_0.ja: ＊ (Looks like it wants to osmose some flavorful cubes.)/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1644_0.ko: ＊ (Looks like it wants to osmose some flavorful cubes.)/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1644_0.pt-BR: * (Parece que ele quer fazer osmose com uns cubos saborosos.)/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1644_0.ru: * (Похоже, оно хочет поглотить несколько ароматических кубиков.)/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1644_0.zh: * （看来它想要吸收一些调味块。）/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1650_0.de: * (Scheint so als wollte er mit Waschbenzin abgetupft werden.)/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1650_0.en: * (Looks like it wants to be dabbed with rubbing alcohol.)/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1650_0.es: * (Looks like it wants to be dabbed with rubbing alcohol.)/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1650_0.ja: ＊ (Looks like it wants to be dabbed with rubbing alcohol.)/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1650_0.ko: ＊ (Looks like it wants to be dabbed with rubbing alcohol.)/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1650_0.pt-BR: * (Parece que ele quer ser esfregado com álcool isopropílico.)/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1650_0.zh: * （看来它想涂上一些清洁酒精。）/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1656_0.de: * Alles schmeckt besser wenn mein Körper richtig rum ist!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1656_0.en: * Everything tastes better with a normally-shaped body!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1656_0.es: * Everything tastes better with a normally-shaped body!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1656_0.ja: ＊ Everything tastes better with a normally-shaped body!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1656_0.ko: ＊ Everything tastes better with a normally-shaped body!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1656_0.pl: * Wszystko smakuje lepiej, gdy masz uporządkowane ciało!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1656_0.pt-BR: * Tudo tem um gosto melhor com um corpo em formato normal!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1656_0.ru: * Всё вкуснее, если тело правильной формы!/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1662_0.de: * Boss...? Du gibst aus...? Ach, wär doch nicht nötig!/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1662_0.en: * Boss...? You're treating me...? Oh, you shouldn't have! (smile)/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1662_0.es: * Boss...? You're treating me...? Oh, you shouldn't have! (smile)/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1662_0.ja: ＊ Boss...? You're treating me...? Oh, you shouldn't have! (smile)/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1662_0.ko: ＊ Boss...? You're treating me...? Oh, you shouldn't have! (smile)/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1662_0.pl: * Szefie...? Ty mnie obsługujesz...? Oj, nie trzeba było! (uśmiech)/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1662_0.pt-BR: * Chefia...? Você está cuidando de mim...? Ah, não precisava! (sorriso)/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1662_0.ru: * Босс?.. Сегодня ты угощаешь?.. Ох, не стоило! (улыбнулся)/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_2076_0.de: * Ah, Kris. Es ist wirklich schön dich heute mit uns beten zu sehen.../

　 てんしさまの　ごぜんで

* 아, 크리스.
  네가 오늘 예배에 나오다니
  참 놀라운 일이구나.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_2076_0.pl: * Ach, Kris. Jakże mnie raduje, że towarzyszysz nam dziś w modlitwie.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_2076_0.pt-BR: * Ah, Kris. É uma maravilha te ver louvando aqui hoje.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_2076_0.ru: * Ах, Крис. Как чудесно видеть тебя сегодня на службе.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_2076_0.zh:
* 啊，Kris。
能看见你来这里参加礼拜，
真是太好了.../

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_2077_0.de: * Und sogar mit einer Freundin. Ersuchst du etwas von mir?/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_2077_0.en: * And with a friend, too. Did you seek something from me?/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_2077_0.es: * Y parece que tu amiga también. ¿Buscabas algo de mí?/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_2077_0.ja:
＊ ともだちも　つれてきて
　 くれるとは…
　 わたしに　なにか　ごようですか？/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_2077_0.ko:
* 게다가 친구도 데려왔네.
  내게서 찾는 것이 있니?/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_2077_0.pl: * I to z przyjaciółką. Czy pragniesz ze mną o czymś porozmawiać?/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_2077_0.pt-BR: * E com uma amiga, também. Você quer alguma coisa de mim?/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_2077_0.ru: * Да ещё и с другом. Тебе что-то нужно от меня?/
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_2077_0.zh:

找我有什么事吗？/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_2081_0.de: * Kris, möchtest du mich um etwas ersuchen?/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_2081_0.ru: * Крис, тебе что-то нужно от меня?/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_2091_0.de: * (Sie lässt schüchtern ein Glas Saft durch ihre Kiemen laufen.)/

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_2103_0.de: * Ähm... Kris, wenn du was wissen willst.../

obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_2103_0.pt-BR: * Ãmm... Kris, se você quiser saber de algo.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_2103_0.ru: * Эм-м... Крис, если хочешь что-то узнать.../
obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_2103_0.zh:
