obj_room_church_choir_slash_Step_0_gml_2.ko:
* 그래서 내가 쳐 봤어.
  뭐, 재밌겠다... 싶어서./
obj_room_church_choir_slash_Step_0_gml_2.pl: * Zaczęłam na nim grać. Myślałam, że, no wiesz, będzie fajnie./
obj_room_church_choir_slash_Step_0_gml_2.pt-BR: * Então eu comecei a tocar. Achando, cê sabe, que poderia ser divertido./
obj_room_church_choir_slash_Step_0_gml_2.ru: * И я попробовала. Решила, мало ли прикольно будет./
obj_room_church_choir_slash_Step_0_gml_2.zh:
* 我当时觉得，应该会挺有意思的。
所以，我就跑去弹了。/

obj_room_church_choir_slash_Step_0_gml_2.de: * Aber... Ich schätze.../
obj_room_church_choir_slash_Step_0_gml_2.en: * But... I guess.../
obj_room_church_choir_slash_Step_0_gml_2.es: * Pero... Supongo que.../
obj_room_church_choir_slash_Step_0_gml_2.ja: ＊ でも…/
obj_room_church_choir_slash_Step_0_gml_2.pl: * Ale... widocznie.../
obj_room_church_choir_slash_Step_0_gml_2.pt-BR: * Mas.. eu acho que.../
obj_room_church_choir_slash_Step_0_gml_2.ru: * Но... видимо.../

obj_room_church_choir_slash_Step_0_gml_2.de: * Vielleicht, weil ich... so schlecht war.../
obj_room_church_choir_slash_Step_0_gml_2.en: * Maybe because I was... so bad.../
obj_room_church_choir_slash_Step_0_gml_2.es: * Tal vez porque era... muy mala o.../
obj_room_church_choir_slash_Step_0_gml_2.ja:
＊ たぶん　オレが
　 ヘタクソすぎたからだと
　 おもうけど…/
obj_room_church_choir_slash_Step_0_gml_2.pl: * Musiałam... grać tak okropnie.../
obj_room_church_choir_slash_Step_0_gml_2.pt-BR: * Talvez porque eu era... tão ruim.../
obj_room_church_choir_slash_Step_0_gml_2.ru: * Из-за того, что у меня... так ужасно вышло.../
obj_room_church_choir_slash_Step_0_gml_2.zh:
* 可能因为我弹得...
太烂了.../

obj_room_church_choir_slash_Step_0_gml_2.de: * Oder vielleicht, weil ich nicht aussah als sollte ich spielen.../
obj_room_church_choir_slash_Step_0_gml_2.en: * Or because I just looked like I shouldn't be playing.../
obj_room_church_choir_slash_Step_0_gml_2.es: * O por las pintas que llevaba.../
obj_room_church_choir_slash_Step_0_gml_2.ja:
＊ …それか　たんに　オレが
　 ピアノとか　ひいていいヤツっぽく
　 なかったからかもだけど…/
obj_room_church_choir_slash_Step_0_gml_2.ko:
* 아니면
  연주하면 안 되는 애처럼
  보여서 그랬는지.../
obj_room_church_choir_slash_Step_0_gml_2.pl: * Albo wyglądać jak ktoś, kto nie powinien grać.../
obj_room_church_choir_slash_Step_0_gml_2.pt-BR: * Ou apenas porque parecia que eu não deveria estar tocando.../
obj_room_church_choir_slash_Step_0_gml_2.ru: * Или просто потому, что я выглядела, будто мне не стоит играть вовсе.../
obj_room_church_choir_slash_Step_0_gml_2.zh:
* 也可能是因为，我看起来
就不像是会弹钢琴的样子.../

obj_room_church_choir_slash_Step_0_gml_2.de: * Sagten sie mir, ich... darf es nicht mehr spielen./
obj_room_church_choir_slash_Step_0_gml_2.en: * They told me I wasn't... allowed to play it./
obj_room_church_choir_slash_Step_0_gml_2.es: * Me dijeron que yo... no podía usarlo./
obj_room_church_choir_slash_Step_0_gml_2.ja: ＊ …ひくなって　いわれたんだ。/
obj_room_church_choir_slash_Step_0_gml_2.ko:
* 몇 명이 와서,
  나는... 못 치게 하더라./
obj_room_church_choir_slash_Step_0_gml_2.pl: * Zakazali mi na nim grać./
obj_room_church_choir_slash_Step_0_gml_2.pt-BR: * Me disseram que eu estava... proibida de tocar./
obj_room_church_choir_slash_Step_0_gml_2.ru: * Мне сказали... что мне нельзя на нём играть./
obj_room_church_choir_slash_Step_0_gml_2.zh:
* 他们告诉我说...
我没资格弹它。/

obj_room_church_choir_slash_Step_0_gml_2.de: * Also stand ich auf./
obj_room_church_choir_slash_Step_0_gml_2.en: * So I backed off./
obj_room_church_choir_slash_Step_0_gml_2.es: * Así que me aparté./
obj_room_church_choir_slash_Step_0_gml_2.ja: ＊ だから　ピアノから　はなれた。/
obj_room_church_choir_slash_Step_0_gml_2.pl: * Więc sobie odpuściłam./
obj_room_church_choir_slash_Step_0_gml_2.pt-BR: * Então eu parei./
obj_room_church_choir_slash_Step_0_gml_2.ru: * Я встала и отошла./
obj_room_church_choir_slash_Step_0_gml_2.zh: * 我就从座位上下来了。/

obj_room_church_choir_slash_Step_0_gml_2.de: * Und dann... Dann liessen sie jemand anderes spielen./
obj_room_church_choir_slash_Step_0_gml_2.en: * And then... They let somebody else play./
obj_room_church_choir_slash_Step_0_gml_2.es: * Y entonces... dejaron que otro tocara el piano./
obj_room_church_choir_slash_Step_0_gml_2.ja:
＊ そしたら…　べつのヤツがきてさ　
　 みんな　そいつに　ひかせたんだよ。/
obj_room_church_choir_slash_Step_0_gml_2.pl: * A potem... pozwolili zagrać komuś innemu./
obj_room_church_choir_slash_Step_0_gml_2.pt-BR: * E depois... Deixaram outra pessoa tocar./
obj_room_church_choir_slash_Step_0_gml_2.ru: * А потом... пустили играть кого-то другого./
obj_room_church_choir_slash_Step_0_gml_2.zh:
* 然后... 他们却允许
另一个人上去弹琴。/

obj_room_church_choir_slash_Step_0_gml_2.de: * ... jemand Besseres./
obj_room_church_choir_slash_Step_0_gml_2.en: * ... someone better./
obj_room_church_choir_slash_Step_0_gml_2.es: * ... alguien mejor./
obj_room_church_choir_slash_Step_0_gml_2.ja: ＊ …もっと　うまいヤツな。/
obj_room_church_choir_slash_Step_0_gml_2.pl: * Komuś lepszemu./
obj_room_church_choir_slash_Step_0_gml_2.pt-BR: * ... uma pessoa melhor./
obj_room_church_choir_slash_Step_0_gml_2.ru: * ...кого-то получше./
obj_room_church_choir_slash_Step_0_gml_2.zh: * ...那个人弹得更好。/

obj_room_church_choir_slash_Step_0_gml_2.en: * .../

obj_room_church_choir_slash_Step_0_gml_2.de: * Ich wei€ nicht... Ich wei€ nicht wieso ich erwartet habe, dass ich es spielen könnte./
obj_room_church_choir_slash_Step_0_gml_2.en: * I don't know... I don't know why I expected I'd be able to play it./
obj_room_church_choir_slash_Step_0_gml_2.es: * No sé por qué esperaba que me dejarían tocar./
obj_room_church_choir_slash_Step_0_gml_2.ja:
＊ しょうじき　オレも…なんで
　 じぶんなんかが　ひけると
　 おもったんだか　わかんなかった。/
obj_room_church_choir_slash_Step_0_gml_2.ko:
* 대체 왜...
  내가 연주할 수 있을 거라고
  생각했을까./
obj_room_church_choir_slash_Step_0_gml_2.pl: * Nie wiem... Nie wiem, czemu sądziłam, że dam radę coś sensownego zagrać./
obj_room_church_choir_slash_Step_0_gml_2.pt-BR: * Eu não sei... eu não sei por que eu esperava que soubesse tocar./
obj_room_church_choir_slash_Step_0_gml_2.ru: * Не знаю... не знаю, почему я решила, что у меня на пианино хоть что-то выйдет./
obj_room_church_choir_slash_Step_0_gml_2.zh:
* 真不知道...
为什么我要抱有这种幻想，
觉得自己会弹钢琴。/

obj_room_church_choir_slash_Step_0_gml_2.de: * ... Das hatte ich mir gedacht... damals./
obj_room_church_choir_slash_Step_0_gml_2.en: * ... Is what I thought... then./
obj_room_church_choir_slash_Step_0_gml_2.es: * ... En ese entonces... eso fue lo que pensé./
obj_room_church_choir_slash_Step_0_gml_2.ja: ＊ そんときは…な。/
obj_room_church_choir_slash_Step_0_gml_2.pl: * Tak... sobie wtedy myślałam./
obj_room_church_choir_slash_Step_0_gml_2.pt-BR: * ... Foi o que eu pensei... na época./
obj_room_church_choir_slash_Step_0_gml_2.ru: * ...Так я... тогда подумала./
obj_room_church_choir_slash_Step_0_gml_2.zh:
* ...这些就是
我当时的想法了。/

obj_room_church_choir_slash_Step_0_gml_2.en: * .../

obj_room_church_choir_slash_Step_0_gml_2.de: * Bei Nacht, als niemand mehr da war.../
obj_room_church_choir_slash_Step_0_gml_2.en: * That night, when no one else was around.../
obj_room_church_choir_slash_Step_0_gml_2.es: * Esa misma noche, cuando no había nadie cerca.../
obj_room_church_choir_slash_Step_0_gml_2.ja:
＊ そのよる…
　 だれも　いないときに…/
obj_room_church_choir_slash_Step_0_gml_2.pl: * Tamtej nocy, gdy wszyscy już sobie poszli.../
obj_room_church_choir_slash_Step_0_gml_2.pt-BR: * Naquela noite, quando não tinha ninguém por perto.../
obj_room_church_choir_slash_Step_0_gml_2.ru: * Той ночью, когда все ушли.../
obj_room_church_choir_slash_Step_0_gml_2.zh:
* 那天晚上，
到了没人的时候... /

obj_room_church_choir_slash_Step_0_gml_2.de: * ... kam ich zurück./
obj_room_church_choir_slash_Step_0_gml_2.en: * ... I came back./
obj_room_church_choir_slash_Step_0_gml_2.es: * ... Volví./
obj_room_church_choir_slash_Step_0_gml_2.ja:
＊ …オレ　ピアノんところに
　 もどってさ…/
obj_room_church_choir_slash_Step_0_gml_2.pl: * Wróciłam tam./
obj_room_church_choir_slash_Step_0_gml_2.pt-BR: * ... eu voltei lá./
obj_room_church_choir_slash_Step_0_gml_2.ru: * ...я вернулась./
obj_room_church_choir_slash_Step_0_gml_2.zh: * ...我又回到了那里。/

obj_room_church_choir_slash_Step_0_gml_2.de: * Und wei€t du, was ich getan habe?/
obj_room_church_choir_slash_Step_0_gml_2.en: * And you know what I did?/
obj_room_church_choir_slash_Step_0_gml_2.es: * ¿Y sabes lo que hice?/
obj_room_church_choir_slash_Step_0_gml_2.ja: ＊ …なにしたとおもう？/
obj_room_church_choir_slash_Step_0_gml_2.pl: * I wiesz, co zrobiłam?/
obj_room_church_choir_slash_Step_0_gml_2.pt-BR: * E sabe o que eu fiz?/
obj_room_church_choir_slash_Step_0_gml_2.ru: * И знаешь, что я сделала?/
obj_room_church_choir_slash_Step_0_gml_2.zh: * 然后，你知道我干了啥吗？/

obj_room_church_choir_slash_Step_0_gml_2.de: * ... Ich hab es verdroschen./
obj_room_church_choir_slash_Step_0_gml_2.en: * ... I smashed it./
obj_room_church_choir_slash_Step_0_gml_2.es: * ... Lo reventé./
obj_room_church_choir_slash_Step_0_gml_2.ja: ＊ …ブッたたいてやった。/
obj_room_church_choir_slash_Step_0_gml_2.pl: * Rozwaliłam je./
obj_room_church_choir_slash_Step_0_gml_2.pt-BR: * ... Eu arrebentei ele./
obj_room_church_choir_slash_Step_0_gml_2.ru: * ...Я треснула по нему./
obj_room_church_choir_slash_Step_0_gml_2.zh: * ...我把它砸了。/

obj_room_church_choir_slash_Step_0_gml_2.de: * Ja... Ich hab das Klavier verdroschen./
obj_room_church_choir_slash_Step_0_gml_2.en: * Yeah... I smashed the piano./
obj_room_church_choir_slash_Step_0_gml_2.es: * Sí... Reventé el piano./
obj_room_church_choir_slash_Step_0_gml_2.ja: ＊ そう…ピアノをな。/
obj_room_church_choir_slash_Step_0_gml_2.ko:
* 그래...
  아주 세게,
  부술 듯이 말이야./
obj_room_church_choir_slash_Step_0_gml_2.pl: * Tak... Rozwaliłam pianino./
obj_room_church_choir_slash_Step_0_gml_2.pt-BR: * É... eu arrebentei o piano./
obj_room_church_choir_slash_Step_0_gml_2.ru: * Ага... двинула по пианино./
obj_room_church_choir_slash_Step_0_gml_2.zh: * 对... 我把钢琴砸了。/

obj_room_church_choir_slash_Step_0_gml_2.de: * ... Ich... wei€ nicht mal, ob ich es wirklich kaputt gemacht habe, aber.../
obj_room_church_choir_slash_Step_0_gml_2.en: * ... I... don't even really know if I broke it, but.../
obj_room_church_choir_slash_Step_0_gml_2.es: * ... La verdad... no sé si llegué a romperlo, pero.../
obj_room_church_choir_slash_Step_0_gml_2.ja:
＊ …こわれたかどうかは
　 わかんねえけど…/
obj_room_church_choir_slash_Step_0_gml_2.pl: * Nie wiem nawet... czy faktycznie je zniszczyłam, ale.../
obj_room_church_choir_slash_Step_0_gml_2.pt-BR: * ... Eu... nem sei se eu quebrei mesmo ele, mas.../
obj_room_church_choir_slash_Step_0_gml_2.ru: * ...Не знаю, сломала ли я его, но.../
obj_room_church_choir_slash_Step_0_gml_2.zh:
* ...其实我... 甚至都不知道
到底砸坏了没有.../

obj_room_church_choir_slash_Step_0_gml_2.de: * Ich hab es so hart gehauen wie ich konnte. Hart genug um Schaden zu machen./
obj_room_church_choir_slash_Step_0_gml_2.en: * I hit it as hard as I could. Hard enough to do some damage./
obj_room_church_choir_slash_Step_0_gml_2.es: * Lo golpeé tan fuerte como pude. Tan fuerte como para dañarlo./
obj_room_church_choir_slash_Step_0_gml_2.ja:
＊ …おもいっきり　ブッたたいた。
　 あんだけ　つよく　たたいたら　
　 なんともねえわけねえよ。/
obj_room_church_choir_slash_Step_0_gml_2.ko:
* 최대한 세게 쳤으니,
  분명 어딘가 문제가 생겼을 거야./
obj_room_church_choir_slash_Step_0_gml_2.pl: * Walnęłam w nie tak mocno, jak tylko potrafiłam. Na tyle mocno, by je uszkodzić.../
obj_room_church_choir_slash_Step_0_gml_2.pt-BR: * Eu bati o mais forte que eu pude. Forte o suficiente pra fazer algum estrago./
obj_room_church_choir_slash_Step_0_gml_2.ru: * Ударила я так сильно, как могла. Достаточно сильно, чтобы повредить./
obj_room_church_choir_slash_Step_0_gml_2.zh:
* 但我确实要多狠有多狠地砸了它一顿。
下手很重，肯定多少弄坏了点。/

obj_room_church_choir_slash_Step_0_gml_2.de: * ... und dann rannte ich weg./
obj_room_church_choir_slash_Step_0_gml_2.en: * ... and I ran./
obj_room_church_choir_slash_Step_0_gml_2.es: * ... y huí./
obj_room_church_choir_slash_Step_0_gml_2.ja: ＊ …で　はしって　にげた。/
obj_room_church_choir_slash_Step_0_gml_2.pl: * ...i uciekłam./
obj_room_church_choir_slash_Step_0_gml_2.pt-BR: * ... e eu fugi./
obj_room_church_choir_slash_Step_0_gml_2.ru: * ...И потом сбежала./
obj_room_church_choir_slash_Step_0_gml_2.zh: * ...然后我就逃走了。/

obj_room_church_choir_slash_Step_0_gml_2.de: * ... Vor einer Woche, hätte ich gewusst dass du Klavier spielen kannst.../
obj_room_church_choir_slash_Step_0_gml_2.en: * ... A week ago, if I knew you did piano.../
obj_room_church_choir_slash_Step_0_gml_2.es: * ... Hace una semana, si hubiera sabido que tocabas el piano.../
obj_room_church_choir_slash_Step_0_gml_2.ja:
＊ …いっしゅうかんまえに
　 おまえが　ピアノひけるって
　 しってたら…/
obj_room_church_choir_slash_Step_0_gml_2.ko:
* ... 일주일 전에,
  네가 피아노 치는 걸 알았다면.../
obj_room_church_choir_slash_Step_0_gml_2.pl: * Gdybym tydzień temu wiedziała, że grasz na pianinie.../
obj_room_church_choir_slash_Step_0_gml_2.pt-BR: * ... Uma semana atrás, se eu soubesse que você tocava piano.../
obj_room_church_choir_slash_Step_0_gml_2.ru: * ...Узнай я неделю назад, что ты умеешь играть на пианино.../
obj_room_church_choir_slash_Step_0_gml_2.zh:
* ...要是一周前，
我知道你会弹钢琴.../

obj_room_church_choir_slash_Step_0_gml_2.de: * ... hätte ich das wahrscheinlich nur an dir gehasst./
obj_room_church_choir_slash_Step_0_gml_2.en: * ... I probably would've just hated that about you./
obj_room_church_choir_slash_Step_0_gml_2.es: * ... Probablemente hubiera odiado esa parte de ti./
obj_room_church_choir_slash_Step_0_gml_2.ja: ＊ …オレ　ムカついてたとおもう。/
obj_room_church_choir_slash_Step_0_gml_2.ko:
* ... 아마 그것 때문에라도
  널 싫어했을 거야./
obj_room_church_choir_slash_Step_0_gml_2.pl: * To pewnie byłby mój kolejny powód, by cię nienawidzić./
obj_room_church_choir_slash_Step_0_gml_2.pt-BR: * ... Eu provavelmente teria odiado isso em você./
obj_room_church_choir_slash_Step_0_gml_2.ru: * ...то возненавидела бы тебя уже только за это./
obj_room_church_choir_slash_Step_0_gml_2.zh: * ...我大概会因此而讨厌你吧。/

obj_room_church_choir_slash_Step_0_gml_2.de: * Aber jetzt.../
obj_room_church_choir_slash_Step_0_gml_2.en: * But now.../
obj_room_church_choir_slash_Step_0_gml_2.es: * Pero ahora mismo.../
obj_room_church_choir_slash_Step_0_gml_2.ja: ＊ でも　いまは…/
obj_room_church_choir_slash_Step_0_gml_2.pl: * Ale teraz.../
obj_room_church_choir_slash_Step_0_gml_2.pt-BR: * Mas agora.../
obj_room_church_choir_slash_Step_0_gml_2.ru: * Но теперь.../
obj_room_church_choir_slash_Step_0_gml_2.zh: * 但是，现在呢.../

obj_room_church_choir_slash_Step_0_gml_2.de: * Jetzt möchte ich... dich eigentlich nur spielen hören./
obj_room_church_choir_slash_Step_0_gml_2.en: * I kinda... just wanna hear you play./
obj_room_church_choir_slash_Step_0_gml_2.es: * Solo... me apetece oírte tocar./
obj_room_church_choir_slash_Step_0_gml_2.ja:
＊ おまえが　ひくの…
　 ききたいと　おもうんだよ。/
obj_room_church_choir_slash_Step_0_gml_2.ko: * 그냥... 네가 연주하는 걸 듣고 싶어./
obj_room_church_choir_slash_Step_0_gml_2.pl: * No wiesz... chcę posłuchać, jak grasz./
obj_room_church_choir_slash_Step_0_gml_2.pt-BR: * Eu meio... que quero ouvir você tocar./
obj_room_church_choir_slash_Step_0_gml_2.ru: * Я, типа... просто хочу слушать, как ты играешь./
obj_room_church_choir_slash_Step_0_gml_2.zh:
* 我有点儿想...
就这么听你弹。/

obj_room_church_choir_slash_Step_0_gml_2.de: D... Alter... Ich wurde da kurz komisch./
obj_room_church_choir_slash_Step_0_gml_2.en: D* ... Damn... I got weird there for a second./
obj_room_church_choir_slash_Step_0_gml_2.es: D* ... Vaya... ¿ha sido muy raro?/
obj_room_church_choir_slash_Step_0_gml_2.ja:
D＊ …なんか　ヘンな　はなし
　 しちまったな。/
obj_room_church_choir_slash_Step_0_gml_2.pl: D* Cholera... nie wiem, co mnie napadło./
obj_room_church_choir_slash_Step_0_gml_2.pt-BR: D* ... Caraca... Eu pareci estranha por um momento./

Y＊ …オレが

obj_room_church_choir_slash_Step_0_gml_3.zh: Y* ...我会去帮你把他们揍扁。/

obj_room_church_choir_slash_Step_0_gml_4.zh:

知道扑克牌对电视机说了什么吗！？/

obj_room_dungeon_2f_slash_Step_0_gml_232.de: * Ah. Er, äh, hat er wohl, wie!/
obj_room_dungeon_2f_slash_Step_0_gml_232.en: * Ah. He, uh, he did, huh!/
obj_room_dungeon_2f_slash_Step_0_gml_232.ja: ＊ あー…　はい。正解でーす！/
obj_room_dungeon_2f_slash_Step_0_gml_232.pl: * Ach. No tak, tak było, heh.../
obj_room_dungeon_2f_slash_Step_0_gml_232.pt-BR: * Ah. Ele, é, ele falou mesmo, hein!/
obj_room_dungeon_2f_slash_Step_0_gml_232.ru: * А. Она, э-э, и правда, ох!/
obj_room_dungeon_2f_slash_Step_0_gml_232.zh: * 啊哈。他，呃，他确实说了这句！/

obj_room_dungeon_2f_slash_Step_0_gml_239.de: * Haha, hartes Publikum heute, äh, Leute!/
obj_room_dungeon_2f_slash_Step_0_gml_239.en: * Haha, tough audience today, uh, folks!/
obj_room_dungeon_2f_slash_Step_0_gml_239.es: * Ja, ja, ¡hoy tenemos un público exigente, eh, amigos!/
obj_room_dungeon_2f_slash_Step_0_gml_239.ja:
＊ ハハッ…　今日のお客さんは
　 なかなか　手ごわいですねぇ！/
obj_room_dungeon_2f_slash_Step_0_gml_239.ko:
* 하하, 오늘 객석 분위기가 싸한데요,
  시청자 여러분...!/
obj_room_dungeon_2f_slash_Step_0_gml_239.pl: * Haha, trafiła się wymagająca widownia, moi drodzy!/
obj_room_dungeon_2f_slash_Step_0_gml_239.pt-BR: * Haha, público difícil hoje, hein, pessoal!/
obj_room_dungeon_2f_slash_Step_0_gml_239.ru: * Ха-ха, народ, а у нас сегодня, эм-м, трудная публика!/
obj_room_dungeon_2f_slash_Step_0_gml_239.zh:
* 哈哈，今天的观众
有点难取悦啊，朋友们！/

obj_room_dungeon_2f_slash_Step_0_gml_249.de: * Vielleicht war das zu modern, zu relevant.../
obj_room_dungeon_2f_slash_Step_0_gml_249.en: * Maybe I was too modern, too relevant.../
obj_room_dungeon_2f_slash_Step_0_gml_249.es: * Quizás he sido demasiado moderno, demasiado relevante.../
obj_room_dungeon_2f_slash_Step_0_gml_249.ja:
＊ きっとワタクシが　最先端すぎて
　 存在意義がありすぎるせいでしょう…/
obj_room_dungeon_2f_slash_Step_0_gml_249.pl: * Widocznie byłem zbyt nowoczesny, zbyt na czasie.../
obj_room_dungeon_2f_slash_Step_0_gml_249.pt-BR: * Talvez eu tenha sido moderno demais, muito relevante.../
obj_room_dungeon_2f_slash_Step_0_gml_249.ru: * Видимо, я для них слишком современный, слишком передовой.../
obj_room_dungeon_2f_slash_Step_0_gml_249.zh:
* 可能是我的笑话太过前卫，
太让人感同身受了吧.../

obj_room_dungeon_2f_slash_Step_0_gml_314.ja:
＊ おっと！
　 つまずいて転んでしまいました！！/

obj_room_dungeon_2f_slash_Step_0_gml_373.de: * HEY!!! Lacht doch nicht über mein Leid!!! Ich..!!/
obj_room_dungeon_2f_slash_Step_0_gml_373.en: * HEY!!! Don't laugh at my misfortune!!! I..!!/
obj_room_dungeon_2f_slash_Step_0_gml_373.ja:
＊ なっ…！！
　 ヒトの不幸を　笑うな…ッ！/
obj_room_dungeon_2f_slash_Step_0_gml_373.ko:
* 이봐요!!! 남의 불행에
  그렇게 크게 웃지 마세요!! 이..!!/
obj_room_dungeon_2f_slash_Step_0_gml_373.pl: * EJ!!! Nie śmiejcie się z mego nieszczęścia!!! Ja...!!/
obj_room_dungeon_2f_slash_Step_0_gml_373.pt-BR: * EI!!! Não riam da minha desgraça!!! Eu..!!/
obj_room_dungeon_2f_slash_Step_0_gml_373.ru: * ЭЙ!!! Хорош смеяться над моей неудачей!!! Я!!../
obj_room_dungeon_2f_slash_Step_0_gml_373.zh:
* 嘿！！！我都这么倒霉了你还笑！！！
我...！！/

obj_room_dungeon_2f_slash_Step_0_gml_274.en: 4* Good work, son. I LIKE this one./
obj_room_dungeon_2f_slash_Step_0_gml_274.es: 4* Buen trabajo, hijo. Este me GUSTA./
obj_room_dungeon_2f_slash_Step_0_gml_274.ja:
4＊ でかしたぞ　息子よ。
　 こやつ…気に入った。/
obj_room_dungeon_2f_slash_Step_0_gml_274.ko:
4* 잘했다, 아들아.
  이 녀석 마음에 드는군./
obj_room_dungeon_2f_slash_Step_0_gml_274.pl: 4* Dobra robota, synu. TEN mi się podoba./
obj_room_dungeon_2f_slash_Step_0_gml_274.pt-BR: 4* Bom trabalho, filho. Eu GOSTEI desse aí./
obj_room_dungeon_2f_slash_Step_0_gml_274.ru: 4* Отличная работа, сын. Этот мне НРАВИТСЯ./
obj_room_dungeon_2f_slash_Step_0_gml_274.zh:
4* 不错嘛，儿子。
我挺喜欢这家伙。/

obj_room_dungeon_2f_slash_Step_0_gml_401.de: * Ä-häh! Ich meine, äh, ich gefalle ihnen! Ich gefalle ihnen wirklich!/
obj_room_dungeon_2f_slash_Step_0_gml_401.en: * A-heh! I mean, uh, they like me! They really like me!/
obj_room_dungeon_2f_slash_Step_0_gml_401.es: * ¡A-je! Esto, eh, ¡les gusto! ¡Les gusto de verdad!/
obj_room_dungeon_2f_slash_Step_0_gml_401.ja:
＊ …じゃなくて…
　 いやー　オイシイなぁ！！
　 持ってるなぁ！！/
obj_room_dungeon_2f_slash_Step_0_gml_401.ko:
* 어...헤! 제 말은, 어,
  저를 좋아하시는군요!
  저를 정말 좋아하세요!/
obj_room_dungeon_2f_slash_Step_0_gml_401.pl: * A-heh! Znaczy, eee, podobam się im! Serio się im podobam!/
obj_room_dungeon_2f_slash_Step_0_gml_401.pt-BR: * A-hah! Quer dizer... eles gostam de mim! Eles me adoram!/
obj_room_dungeon_2f_slash_Step_0_gml_401.ru: * Э-хех! В смысле, э-э, я им нравлюсь! Очень нравлюсь!/
obj_room_dungeon_2f_slash_Step_0_gml_401.zh:
* 咳咳！哎呀，他们很喜欢我！
真的超喜欢我！！/

obj_room_schooldoor_slash_Step_0_gml_73_.de: 7Kris! Warte kurz! Lass uns Tenna holen!/
obj_room_schooldoor_slash_Step_0_gml_73_.en: 7* Kris! Wait a sec! Let's go get Tenna!/
obj_room_schooldoor_slash_Step_0_gml_73_.ja:
7＊ まった！
　 テナも　つれてこようぜ！/
obj_room_schooldoor_slash_Step_0_gml_73_.pl: 7* Kris! Czekaj chwilę! Chodźmy po Tennę!/
obj_room_schooldoor_slash_Step_0_gml_73_.pt-BR: 7* Kris! Pera aí! Vamo lá pegar o Tenna!/
obj_room_schooldoor_slash_Step_0_gml_73_.ru: 7* Крис! Погоди! Захватим с собой Тенну!/
obj_room_schooldoor_slash_Step_0_gml_73_.zh:
7* Kris！等等！
我们把Tenna也带上！/

obj_room_torhouse_slash_Step_0_gml_77_0.de: 1Nebenbei, ich muss gleich los zum Chor./
obj_room_torhouse_slash_Step_0_gml_77_0.en: 1* By the way, I am leaving for choir practice in a little while./
obj_room_torhouse_slash_Step_0_gml_77_0.es: 1* Por cierto, ya mismo me iré a la práctica de coro./
obj_room_torhouse_slash_Step_0_gml_77_0.ja:
1＊ そうそう。もうすこししたら
　 おうたの　れんしゅうに
　 いかなきゃいけないの。/
obj_room_torhouse_slash_Step_0_gml_77_0.ko:
1* 그나저나, 엄마는 조금 있다
  성가대 연습하러 갈 거야./
obj_room_torhouse_slash_Step_0_gml_77_0.pl: 1* A i tak w ogóle, niedługo wybieram się na próbę chóru./
obj_room_torhouse_slash_Step_0_gml_77_0.pt-BR: 1* A propósito, vou sair para o ensaio do coral daqui a pouco./
obj_room_torhouse_slash_Step_0_gml_77_0.ru: 1* К слову, я скоро пойду на репетицию хора./
obj_room_torhouse_slash_Step_0_gml_77_0.zh:
1* 对了，我待会儿还要去
参加唱诗班排练。/

obj_room_torhouse_slash_Step_0_gml_78_0.de: 0Falls ihr was braucht, kommt einfach zur Kirche, ja, Schatz?/
obj_room_torhouse_slash_Step_0_gml_78_0.en: 0* If you need anything, just come by the church, okay, honey?/
obj_room_torhouse_slash_Step_0_gml_78_0.es: 0* Si necesitáis algo, pasáos por la iglesia, ¿vale, cariño?/
obj_room_torhouse_slash_Step_0_gml_78_0.ja:
0＊ ようが　あったら　
　 きょうかいまで
　 きてちょうだいね。/
obj_room_torhouse_slash_Step_0_gml_78_0.ko:
0* 뭐 필요한 거 있으면,
  교회 쪽에 들러 줘,
  알겠지, 아가?/
obj_room_torhouse_slash_Step_0_gml_78_0.pl: 0* Jeśli coś się stanie, to znajdziesz mnie w kościele, kochanie./
obj_room_torhouse_slash_Step_0_gml_78_0.pt-BR: 0* Se precisar de algo, dê uma passadinha na igreja, ok, meu bem?/
obj_room_torhouse_slash_Step_0_gml_78_0.ru: 0* Если что-то понадобится, приходи в церковь, хорошо, солнышко?/
obj_room_torhouse_slash_Step_0_gml_78_0.zh:
0* 如果有事的话，就来教堂找我，
好吗，亲爱的？/

obj_room_town_hospital_hallway_slash_Ste.de: D(... kacke. Sein Arm wurde in der Dunklen Welt gebraten, und jetzt...)/
obj_room_town_hospital_hallway_slash_Ste.en: D* (... damn. His arm got toasted in the Dark World, and now...)/
obj_room_town_hospital_hallway_slash_Ste.es: D* (... Se tostó el brazo en el Mundo Oscuro y ahora...)/
obj_room_town_hospital_hallway_slash_Ste.ja:
D＊ (クソッ…　やみのせかいで
　 ウデが　やられちまった
　 せいで　アイツ…)/
obj_room_town_hospital_hallway_slash_Ste.ko:
D* (... 젠장.
  저 녀석 어둠의 세계에서
  팔이 타버린 게...)/
obj_room_town_hospital_hallway_slash_Ste.pl: D* (Cholera. Nieźle sobie zjarał tę rękę w Ciemnym Świecie...)/
obj_room_town_hospital_hallway_slash_Ste.pt-BR: D* (... pô. O braço dele queimou no Mundo das Trevas, e agora...)/
obj_room_town_hospital_hallway_slash_Ste.ru: D* (...ох, чёрт. Его крыло поджарило в Тёмном мире, а теперь...)/
obj_room_town_hospital_hallway_slash_Ste.zh:
D* （...靠。他在暗世界里
胳膊烧成这样，
现在又...）/

obj_room_town_hospital_hallway_slash_Ste.de: V(Kris, was sollen wir jetzt machen?)/
obj_room_town_hospital_hallway_slash_Ste.en: V* (Kris, what are we gonna do?)/

obj_room_town_hospital_hallway_slash_Ste.de: V(Hätten wir ihn vielleicht in der Dunklen Welt geheilt, dann würde sein Arm...)/
obj_room_town_hospital_hallway_slash_Ste.en: V* (Maybe if we healed him him in the Dark World, his arm would...)/
obj_room_town_hospital_hallway_slash_Ste.es: V* (Igual si le curamos en nuestro Mundo Oscuro, su brazo...)/
obj_room_town_hospital_hallway_slash_Ste.ja:
V＊ (やみのせかいで
　 ウデを　かいふくしてやれば
　 こっちの　せかいでも…)/
obj_room_town_hospital_hallway_slash_Ste.ko:
V* (어쩌면 우리가 그때
  어둠의 세계에서 치료해줬다면,
  팔도...)/
obj_room_town_hospital_hallway_slash_Ste.pl: V* (Może gdybyśmy go wyleczyli w Ciemnym Świecie, to jego ręka...)/
obj_room_town_hospital_hallway_slash_Ste.pt-BR: V* (Talvez se a gente curasse ele no Mundo das Trevas, o braço dele iria...)/
obj_room_town_hospital_hallway_slash_Ste.ru: V* (Может, если мы подлечим его в Тёмном мире, его крыло...)/
obj_room_town_hospital_hallway_slash_Ste.zh:
V* （如果我们在暗世界治疗他，
也许就能让他的胳膊...）/

obj_room_town_hospital_hallway_slash_Ste.de: 6(Warte! Wir können nicht BERDLY unsere Dunkle Welt zeigen... oder?)/
obj_room_town_hospital_hallway_slash_Ste.en: 6* (Wait! We can't show BERDLY our Dark World... can we?)/
obj_room_town_hospital_hallway_slash_Ste.ja:
6＊ (いや…　オレらの　やみの
　 せかいを　アイツにみせたら
　 ダメなんだよな？)/
obj_room_town_hospital_hallway_slash_Ste.ko:
6* (잠깐! 버들리한테 학교의
  우리 어둠의 세계를...
  보여줄 순, 없나?)/
obj_room_town_hospital_hallway_slash_Ste.pl: 6* (Chwila! Nie możemy MU pokazać naszego Ciemnego Świata... co?)/
obj_room_town_hospital_hallway_slash_Ste.pt-BR: 6* (Perai! A gente não pode mostrar nosso Mundo das Trevas pro BERDLY... podemos?)/
obj_room_town_hospital_hallway_slash_Ste.ru: 6* (Стоп! Вот кому-кому, а ЕМУ о нашем Тёмном мире знать НЕЛЬЗЯ!..)/
obj_room_town_hospital_hallway_slash_Ste.zh:
6* （等等！不能让Berdly知道
我们的暗世界... 对吧？）/

obj_room_town_hospital_hallway_slash_Ste.de: 0(... lass uns einfach... schauen ob er wieder gesund wird. Erstmal.)/
obj_room_town_hospital_hallway_slash_Ste.en: 0* (... let's just... see if he gets better. For now.)/
obj_room_town_hospital_hallway_slash_Ste.es: 0* (... mejor... veamos si se mejora. Por ahora.)/
obj_room_town_hospital_hallway_slash_Ste.ja:
0＊ (…なにも　できねーな…
　 とりあえず　よくなるのを
　 まつしかねえ)/
obj_room_town_hospital_hallway_slash_Ste.ko:
0* (... 일단은... 
  낫길 바라며 기다려 보자.
  일단은.)/
obj_room_town_hospital_hallway_slash_Ste.pl: 0* (Poczekajmy... może mu się poprawi. Nie ma pośpiechu.)/
obj_room_town_hospital_hallway_slash_Ste.pt-BR: 0* (... vamos só... esperar pra ver se ele melhora. Por enquanto.)/
obj_room_town_hospital_hallway_slash_Ste.ru: 0* (...давай... посмотрим, станет ли ему лучше. Пока что.)/
obj_room_town_hospital_hallway_slash_Ste.zh:
0* （...我们现在还是先...
看他能不能自愈吧。）/

obj_room_town_hospital_hallway_slash_Ste.de: 1Was? Du willst alleine da rein? ... Was auch immer./
obj_room_town_hospital_hallway_slash_Ste.en: 1* What? You wanna go in by yourself? ... whatever./
obj_room_town_hospital_hallway_slash_Ste.ja:
1＊ あ？　ひとりで
　 びょうしつに　はいる？　
　 …すきにしろよ。/
obj_room_town_hospital_hallway_slash_Ste.pl: 1* Co? Mam tu zostać? ... No spoko./
obj_room_town_hospital_hallway_slash_Ste.pt-BR: 1* Quê? Cê quer entrar a sós? ... tanto faz./
obj_room_town_hospital_hallway_slash_Ste.ru: 1* Что? Ты хочешь в одиночку войти? ...ну ладно./
obj_room_town_hospital_hallway_slash_Ste.zh:
1* 什么？你想自己一个人进去？
... 随便吧。/

obj_room_town_hospital_hallway_slash_Ste.ja:
0＊ …なかには　バードリーが
　 いるんだよな？/

obj_room_town_hospital_hallway_slash_Ste.de: 2Hah. Steck mich nicht mit der Vogelgrippe an oder was auch immer er hat./
obj_room_town_hospital_hallway_slash_Ste.en: 2* Heh. Don't give me bird flu or whatever he has./
obj_room_town_hospital_hallway_slash_Ste.es: 2* Je. No me pegues la gripe aviar o lo que tenga./
obj_room_town_hospital_hallway_slash_Ste.ja:
2＊ ヘッ…トリインフルとか
　 もらってくるんじゃねーぞ。/
obj_room_town_hospital_hallway_slash_Ste.ko:
2* 헤, 조류독감인지 뭔지,
  나한테 옮기지 말라구./
obj_room_town_hospital_hallway_slash_Ste.pl: 2* Heh. Tylko mnie teraz nie zaraź ptasią grypą, czy co on tam ma./
obj_room_town_hospital_hallway_slash_Ste.pt-BR: 2* Heh. Não passa gripe aviária pra mim ou seja lá o que ele tiver./
obj_room_town_hospital_hallway_slash_Ste.ru: 2* Заразишься от него птичьим гриппом — ко мне не подходи! Ха-ха!/
obj_room_town_hospital_hallway_slash_Ste.zh:
2* 呵。我可不想被传染上
什么禽流感之类的。/

obj_room_town_hospital_room2_slash_Step_.de: * (Du wechselst die Wärmflasche auf seiner Stirn.)/
obj_room_town_hospital_room2_slash_Step_.en: * (You changed the hot water bottle on his head.)/
obj_room_town_hospital_room2_slash_Step_.es: * (Cambias la botella de agua caliente de su cabeza.)/
obj_room_town_hospital_room2_slash_Step_.ja:
＊ (バードリーの　あたまにのっている
　 おゆの　はいったボトルを
　 あたらしいボトルに　かえた)/
obj_room_town_hospital_room2_slash_Step_.pt-BR: * (Você trocou a bolsa de água quente na cabeça dele.)/
obj_room_town_hospital_room2_slash_Step_.ru: * (Вы сменили горячую бутылку с водой на его голове.)/
obj_room_town_hospital_room2_slash_Step_.zh: * （你给他头上的热水袋换了热水。）/

obj_room_town_mid_slash_Step_0_gml_77_0.de: * Hey! Mensch! Machen Monster dir keinen Bammel? Was wenn das Mädel dich beissen würde!/
obj_room_town_mid_slash_Step_0_gml_77_0.en: * Hey! Human! Doesn't monsters scare you? Like if that girl bited you!/
obj_room_town_mid_slash_Step_0_gml_77_0.es: * ¡Oye! ¿No te asustan los monstruos? ¡Y si esa chica te pegase un mordisco!/
obj_room_town_mid_slash_Step_0_gml_77_0.ja:
＊ おい　ニンゲン！　モンスターが
　 こわくないのか？　そいつに
　 くわれたら　どうするんだ！/
obj_room_town_mid_slash_Step_0_gml_77_0.ko:
* 저기요! 인간! 괴물은 안 무서워요?
  옆의 여자애가 물지도 모르는데!/
obj_room_town_mid_slash_Step_0_gml_77_0.pl: * Hej! Człowieku! Nie boisz się potworów? A co jakby ta dziewczyna cię ugryzła?!/
obj_room_town_mid_slash_Step_0_gml_77_0.pt-BR: * Ei! Humano! Os monstros não te assustam? Tipo se aquela garota te mordesse!/
obj_room_town_mid_slash_Step_0_gml_77_0.ru: * Эй! Человек! Ты что, монстров не боишься? А вдруг та девчонка кусается!/
obj_room_town_mid_slash_Step_0_gml_77_0.zh:
* 嘿！人类！你不怕怪物吗？比方说，
要是那边的女孩咬你一口怎么办！/

obj_room_town_mid_slash_Step_0_gml_79_0.de: 9Nee, Kris braucht sich keine Sorgen zu machen./
obj_room_town_mid_slash_Step_0_gml_79_0.en: 9* Nah, Kris's got nothing to worry about./
obj_room_town_mid_slash_Step_0_gml_79_0.es: 9* Na, Kris no tiene de qué preocuparse./
obj_room_town_mid_slash_Step_0_gml_79_0.ja: 9＊ クリスは　しんぱいないぜ。/
obj_room_town_mid_slash_Step_0_gml_79_0.pl: 9* Nie no, Kris nie ma się o co martwić./
obj_room_town_mid_slash_Step_0_gml_79_0.pt-BR: 9* Que nada, Kris não tem com o que se preocupar./
obj_room_town_mid_slash_Step_0_gml_79_0.ru: 9* Не-е, людям тут волноваться не о чем./

obj_room_town_mid_slash_Step_0_gml_80_0.de: YIch fress' nur gern kleine Häschen./
obj_room_town_mid_slash_Step_0_gml_80_0.en: Y* I only like to eat little rabbits./
obj_room_town_mid_slash_Step_0_gml_80_0.es: Y* Solo me gusta comer conejitos./
obj_room_town_mid_slash_Step_0_gml_80_0.ja:
Y＊ オレが　くうのは
　 ウサギのコだけだ。/
obj_room_town_mid_slash_Step_0_gml_80_0.pl: Y* Bo ja gustuje głównie w małych króliczkach./

obj_titan_enemy_slash_Other_10_gml_16_0.es: * La oscuridad fija en ti su mirada serpentina.

* Você sentiu o seu coração sendo agarrado.
obj_titan_enemy_slash_Other_10_gml_17_0.ru:

obj_titan_enemy_slash_Other_10_gml_17_0.zh:
* 有那么一瞬间，
* 你感到自己的心脏被攥住了。

obj_titan_enemy_slash_Other_10_gml_24_0.de: IVerdammt! Sein Schild ist zurück... Kris, bring es wieder runter!

Kris，再把护盾破坏掉！

obj_titan_enemy_slash_Other_10_gml_39_0.ja:
J＊ あと少しだ！

J* 거의 다 왔어! 계속해서

obj_titan_enemy_slash_Other_10_gml_39_0.pt-BR: J* A gente quase conseguiu! Continua derrubando o escudo dele, Kris!
obj_titan_enemy_slash_Other_10_gml_39_0.ru: J* Осталось всего ничего! Продолжай сбивать ему щит, Крис!

obj_titan_spawn_enemy_slash_Step_0_gml_1.en: * When did you start being yourself?

obj_titan_spawn_enemy_slash_Step_0_gml_1.ru: * И когда вы снова стали собой?

obj_titan_spawn_enemy_slash_Step_0_gml_1.de: * Es knirscht in einer Stimme wie gemahlenes Glas.
obj_titan_spawn_enemy_slash_Step_0_gml_1.en: * It sputtered in a voice like crushed glass.
obj_titan_spawn_enemy_slash_Step_0_gml_1.es: * Balbucea con una voz parecida a vidrio triturado.

　 まくしたてた。

  중얼거렸다.

obj_titan_spawn_enemy_slash_Step_0_gml_1.ru: * Оно прошипело голосом, подобным битому стеклу.
obj_titan_spawn_enemy_slash_Step_0_gml_1.zh: * 它断断续续地发出碎玻璃般的声响。

obj_titan_spawn_enemy_slash_Step_0_gml_1.de: * Ralsei flüstert zu sich selbst um sich zu beruhigen.
obj_titan_spawn_enemy_slash_Step_0_gml_1.en: * Ralsei mutters to himself to stay calm.
obj_titan_spawn_enemy_slash_Step_0_gml_1.es: * Ralsei murmura para sus adentros que debe mantener la calma.

＊ ラルセイは　自身に向けて
　 「落ち着いて」と　つぶやいた。

obj_titan_spawn_enemy_slash_Step_0_gml_1.pt-BR: * Ralsei murmura a si mesmo para se manter calmo.
obj_titan_spawn_enemy_slash_Step_0_gml_1.ru: * Ральзей шепчет себе под нос: «Держи себя в руках».

obj_titan_spawn_enemy_slash_Step_0_gml_1.ja: ＊ アドレナリンのニオイがする。
obj_titan_spawn_enemy_slash_Step_0_gml_1.pl: * W powietrzu unosi się zapach adrenaliny.

Shackle that ironically increases

盗っ人にはめる“スティール”製のかせ。

Eine goldene Münze mit einer Gravierung

scr_armorinfo_slash_scr_armorinfo_gml_15.zh: ...这是从家庭娱乐中心拿来的吗？

Ein J-förmiger Schwanz der dir
Teufelsenergie gibt.

Ogon w kształcie podobnym do litery J.

Ein quadratischer Anszecker

A square charm that increases

Un amuleto rectángular que aumenta

Grazing bullets affects

스치기하면

Szpiczasty nos służy za rożek do lodów.

Refeição pré-pronta em forma de TV. O nariz
pontudo da TV é usado como cone no sorvete.
scr_itemdesc_single_slash_scr_itemdesc_s.ru:
Готовое блюдо в форме телевизора. Его острый
нос служит как рожок для мороженого.
scr_itemdesc_single_slash_scr_itemdesc_s.zh:
电视造型的预制餐。
锥形的尖鼻子被用来装冰激凌。

scr_itemdesc_single_slash_scr_itemdesc_s.de:
Eine TV-förmige Fertigmahlzeit. Leider
hat das vegane Steak seine übliche Form.
scr_itemdesc_single_slash_scr_itemdesc_s.en:
A TV-shaped premade meal. Unfortunately,
the vegan steak seems to be a normal shape.

Una fiambrera con forma de tele. Por desgracia,
el bistec vegano tiene forma normal.
scr_itemdesc_single_slash_scr_itemdesc_s.ja:
テレビの形をしたレンチンフード。
ヴィーガンステーキは顔の形じゃない。
scr_itemdesc_single_slash_scr_itemdesc_s.ko:
TV 모양을 한 미리 만들어진 음식이다. 안타깝게도,
비건 스테이크는 평범한 모양이다.
scr_itemdesc_single_slash_scr_itemdesc_s.pl:
Gotowy posiłek w kształcie telewizora.
Wegański kotlet ma normalny kształt.
scr_itemdesc_single_slash_scr_itemdesc_s.pt-BR:
Refeição pré-pronta em forma de TV. O bife
vegano parece ter forma normal, infelizmente.
scr_itemdesc_single_slash_scr_itemdesc_s.ru:
Готовое блюдо в форме телевизора. Жаль,
веганский стейк совершенно обычной формы.
scr_itemdesc_single_slash_scr_itemdesc_s.zh:
一份电视造型的预制餐。
可惜里面素牛排的造型很普通。

scr_itemdesc_single_slash_scr_itemdesc_s.de:
Jemandes besonderes "???"
Kann nicht im Kampf genutzt werden.
scr_itemdesc_single_slash_scr_itemdesc_s.en:
A certain person's special "???"
Cannot be used in battle.
scr_itemdesc_single_slash_scr_itemdesc_s.es:
El "???" especila de cierto individuo.
No puede ser utilizado en batalla.
scr_itemdesc_single_slash_scr_itemdesc_s.ja:
とある　だれかのXXX。
バトルでは使えない。
scr_itemdesc_single_slash_scr_itemdesc_s.ko:
누군가의 특별한 "???"
전투에는 쓸 수 없다.
scr_itemdesc_single_slash_scr_itemdesc_s.pl:
Specjalne „???” pewnej osoby.
Nie można użyć w walce.
scr_itemdesc_single_slash_scr_itemdesc_s.pt-BR:
"???" especial de uma certa pessoa
Não pode ser usado em batalha.
scr_itemdesc_single_slash_scr_itemdesc_s.ru:
Особое «???» некой личности.
Нельзя использовать в битве.
scr_itemdesc_single_slash_scr_itemdesc_s.zh:
某个人的特殊“？？？”
无法在战斗中使用。

scr_itemdesc_single_slash_scr_itemdesc_s.de:
Eine abgestandene, halbleere Limo. Nein, keine
Schale voll Limo. Das Adjektiv. Heilt 20 HP
scr_itemdesc_single_slash_scr_itemdesc_s.en:
Flat soda someone already took
a big sip from. Recovers 20HP
scr_itemdesc_single_slash_scr_itemdesc_s.es:
Cola sin gas a la que alguien ya le
ha dado un buen sorbo. Cura 20PV
scr_itemdesc_single_slash_scr_itemdesc_s.ja:
だれかが開けて　ガッツリ飲んで
気が抜けたソーダ。HPを20回復。
scr_itemdesc_single_slash_scr_itemdesc_s.ko:
누군가가 이미 많이 마셔버린
김빠진 소다. 20HP를 회복한다
scr_itemdesc_single_slash_scr_itemdesc_s.pl:
Wygazowany napój, z którego ktoś już wziął
duży łyk. Odnawia 20PZ.
scr_itemdesc_single_slash_scr_itemdesc_s.pt-BR:
Refri sem gás que alguém já tomou
um grande gole. Recupera 20 PV
scr_itemdesc_single_slash_scr_itemdesc_s.ru:
Почти допитая газировка. Полное
безгазочарование. Лечит 20 ОЗ
scr_itemdesc_single_slash_scr_itemdesc_s.zh:
跑气的汽水，已经被喝了一大口。
回复20HP

scr_itemdesc_single_slash_scr_itemdesc_s.de:
Eine Art sämiger Kantinenfra€.
Die Eiswaffel ist matschig und hängt runter.
scr_itemdesc_single_slash_scr_itemdesc_s.en:
Some sort of bland cafeteria food.
The ice cream cone is soggy and saggy.
scr_itemdesc_single_slash_scr_itemdesc_s.es:
Comida de cafetería del montón. El cono de
helado está blandurrio y medio derretido.
scr_itemdesc_single_slash_scr_itemdesc_s.ja:
パッとしない味の　食堂フード。
アイスクリームのコーンは　ふやけてブヨブヨ。
scr_itemdesc_single_slash_scr_itemdesc_s.ko:
구내식당에서 줄법한 음식 같다.
아이스크림 콘이 눅눅해서 맛없다.
scr_itemdesc_single_slash_scr_itemdesc_s.pl:
Mdłe jedzenie ze stołówki.
Rożek do lodów oklapł i rozmókł.
scr_itemdesc_single_slash_scr_itemdesc_s.pt-BR:
Algum tipo de comida de refeitório sem graça.
O sorvete está passado e requentado.
scr_itemdesc_single_slash_scr_itemdesc_s.ru:
Похоже на пресную еду из буфета.
Рожок для мороженого размяк и обмяк.
scr_itemdesc_single_slash_scr_itemdesc_s.zh:
味道非常一般的食堂餐。
里面冰激凌的甜筒软趴趴的。

scr_itemdesc_single_slash_scr_itemdesc_s.de:
Ein Dinner für bequemliche TV-Chefs.
Der blaue "Kaviar" ist unvergesslich.
scr_itemdesc_single_slash_scr_itemdesc_s.en:
A dinner for cushy TV executives.
The blue "caviar" is unforgettable.
scr_itemdesc_single_slash_scr_itemdesc_s.es:
Un almuerzo para ejecutivos de televisión
comodones. El "caviar" azul es inolvidable.
scr_itemdesc_single_slash_scr_itemdesc_s.ja:
ギョーカイのお偉いさん向けディナー。
ブルーの“キャビア”は　忘れられない味。
scr_itemdesc_single_slash_scr_itemdesc_s.ko:
편안한 TV 임원들 전용 TV 디너.
파란 "캐비어"의 맛은 잊을 수 없다.
scr_itemdesc_single_slash_scr_itemdesc_s.pl:
Kolacja dla wygodnickich prezesów telewizji.
Niebieski „kawior” jest bajeczny.
scr_itemdesc_single_slash_scr_itemdesc_s.pt-BR:
Um jantar para confortáveis executivos de TV.
O "caviar" azul é inesquecível.
scr_itemdesc_single_slash_scr_itemdesc_s.ru:
Роскошный ужин для телепродюсеров.
Синяя «икра» незабываема.
scr_itemdesc_single_slash_scr_itemdesc_s.zh:
给悠闲的电视台高管们准备的餐品。
蓝色的“鱼子酱”令人回味无穷。

scr_itemdesc_single_slash_scr_itemdesc_s.de:
Ein TV-Dinner für gut abschneidende Kandidaten.
Mit abnehmbaren Antennen. +140 HP.
scr_itemdesc_single_slash_scr_itemdesc_s.en:
A TV Dinner for high-ranking contestants.
Comes with detachable antennas. +140 HP.
scr_itemdesc_single_slash_scr_itemdesc_s.es:
Un Almuerzo TV para concursantes de élite.
Viene con antenas de quita y pon. +140 HP.
scr_itemdesc_single_slash_scr_itemdesc_s.ja:
高ランクの挑戦者にふるまわれるTVディナー。
取り外し可能なアンテナつき。HPを140回復。
scr_itemdesc_single_slash_scr_itemdesc_s.ko:
높은 랭크를 받은 참가자들 전용 TV 디너.
탈부착 안테나도 딸려온다. +140 HP.
scr_itemdesc_single_slash_scr_itemdesc_s.pl:
TeleObiad dla zawodników wagi ciężkiej.
W zestawie są odczepiane anteny. +140PZ.
scr_itemdesc_single_slash_scr_itemdesc_s.pt-BR:
Um JanTV para competidores de altos ranks.
Vem com antenas destacáveis. +140 PV.
scr_itemdesc_single_slash_scr_itemdesc_s.ru:
ТВ-ужин для высокоранговых участников.
В комплекте идут съёмные антеннки. +140 ОЗ.
scr_itemdesc_single_slash_scr_itemdesc_s.zh:
给高级参赛选手们准备的电视餐。
配有可以拆卸的天线。+140HP。

scr_itemdesc_single_slash_scr_itemdesc_s.de:
Ein Schokoladenkegel mit esoterischen Glyphen.
Nur Kris kann sie essen. +400 HP.
scr_itemdesc_single_slash_scr_itemdesc_s.en:
A chocolatey cone etched with arcane
glyphs. Only Kris can eat it. +400 HP.
scr_itemdesc_single_slash_scr_itemdesc_s.es:
Un cono chocolateado con glifos arcanos.
Solo Kris puede comérselo. +400 PV.
scr_itemdesc_single_slash_scr_itemdesc_s.ja:
チョコ味のコーンに　まほうのシンボルが
彫り込まれている。クリス専用。HP+400
scr_itemdesc_single_slash_scr_itemdesc_s.ko:
고대의 문양이 새겨진 초콜릿 콘.

scr_itemdesc_single_slash_scr_itemdesc_s.pl:
Czekoladopodobny rożek pokryty tajemnymi

Um guarda-chuva de chocolate gravado com glifos
arcanos. Apenas Kris pode comê-lo. +400 PV.

Шоколадный рожок, покрытый причудливыми
рунами. Может есть только Крис. +400 ОЗ.
scr_itemdesc_single_slash_scr_itemdesc_s.zh:
一只刻有奥术雕纹的巧克力味锥筒。
只有Kris可以吃。+400 HP

scr_itemdesc_single_slash_scr_itemdesc_s.de:
Ein mildes, silbriges Getränk. Es einzugie€en

A smooth, silvery drink. It sounds like
whispered singing as it's poured. +115 HP.

Una suave bebida argéntea. Suena a cánticos

軽い口当たりの銀色ドリンク。注ぐと

부드러운 맛의 은색 차. 잔에 담을 때
노래를 속삭이는 듯한 소리가 난다. +115 HP.
scr_itemdesc_single_slash_scr_itemdesc_s.pl:
Jednorodny, srebrny napój. Podczas nalewania

scr_itemdesc_single_slash_scr_itemdesc_s.pt-BR:
Uma bebida prateada e suave. Soa como
cantoria sussurrada ao ser servido. +115 PV.
scr_itemdesc_single_slash_scr_itemdesc_s.ru:
Мягкий серебристый напиток. Когда его

scr_itemdesc_single_slash_scr_itemdesc_s.zh:
一杯柔滑的银色饮品。

scr_itemdesc_single_slash_scr_itemdesc_s.de:
Ein rotes Gebräu mit einem strengen
Fruchtgeschmack. Heilt 160 HP.
scr_itemdesc_single_slash_scr_itemdesc_s.en:
A red brew with a sickeningly fruity taste.
Recovers 160 HP.
scr_itemdesc_single_slash_scr_itemdesc_s.es:
Un brebaje rojo con un sabor
enfermizamente frutal. +160 PV.
scr_itemdesc_single_slash_scr_itemdesc_s.ja:
真っ赤なドリンク。甘ったるい

scr_itemdesc_single_slash_scr_itemdesc_s.ko:
메슥거릴 정도로 과일 향이 진한 빨간색 음료.

scr_itemdesc_single_slash_scr_itemdesc_s.pl:
Czerwony napar o odurzająco

scr_itemdesc_single_slash_scr_itemdesc_s.pt-BR:
Um bebida fermentada vermelha com um gosto

scr_itemdesc_single_slash_scr_itemdesc_s.ru:
Красный отвар с приторным фруктовым вкусом.
Восстанавливает 160 ОЗ.
scr_itemdesc_single_slash_scr_itemdesc_s.zh:
一杯红色饮品，水果味浓烈发腻。
回复160HP。

Bitteres Wasser, dass als Tropfen vom Himmel fiel.
Heilt alle HP.

Bitter water that fell in droplets from the sky.

Agua amarga formada de gotas caídas

空から降ってきた　苦い水の滴。

하늘에서 빗방울처럼 떨어진 쓰디쓴 물.

scr_itemdesc_single_slash_scr_itemdesc_s.pl:
Gorzka woda, która spada z nieba

scr_itemdesc_single_slash_scr_itemdesc_s.pt-BR:
Água amarga que caiu em gotículas do céu.
Recupera todos os PV.
scr_itemdesc_single_slash_scr_itemdesc_s.ru:
Горькая вода, каплями упавшая с неба.
Восстанавливает все ОЗ.
scr_itemdesc_single_slash_scr_itemdesc_s.zh:
以液滴形式从天空落下的苦水。
回复HP至全满。

LA PROFECÍA, SUSURRADA
ENTRE LAS SOMBRAS.
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.ja: 影たちの ささやく予言
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.pt-BR:
A PROFECIA, QUE É SUSPIRADA
ENTRE AS SOMBRAS.
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.zh:
预言，于暗影之间，
    低语绵延。

scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.de:
DIE LEGENDE DIESER WELT.
<DELTARUNE.>
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.en:
THE LEGEND OF THIS WORLD.
<DELTARUNE.>
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.es:
LA LEYENDA DE ESTE MUNDO.
<DELTARUNE>.
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.ja:
この世界の伝説
<DELTARUNE>
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.pt-BR:
A LENDA DESTE MUNDO.
<DELTARUNE>.
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.zh:
此世之传说，
    <三角符文>。

scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.de:
EINE WELT GEHÜLLT IN REINSTES LICHT.
UNTER IHR WÄCHST DIE EWIGE NACHT.
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.en:
A WORLD BASKED IN PUREST LIGHT.
BENEATH IT, GREW ETERNAL NIGHT.
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.es:
UN MUNDO BAÑADO EN LA LUZ MÁS PURA.
BAJO ÉL, CRECÍA UNA NOCHE ETERNA.
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.ja:
清らかな光の満ちる世界
その下に広がる 永遠の夜
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.ko:
순수한 빛에 놓인 세계.
그 아래, 끝없는 밤이 자랐다.
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.pl:
ŚWIAT POKRYTY PRZEZ ŚWIATŁA MOC.
ZAŚ POD NIM ROZCIĄGA SIĘ WIECZNA NOC.
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.pt-BR:
UM MUNDO COBERTO DE LUZ TÃO LIMPA.
DEBAIXO DE TAL, CRESCEU NOITE INFINDA.
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.ru:
НАПОЛНЕН ЯРКИМ СВЕТОМ МИР.
ПОД НИМ ЖЕ — ТЁМНОЙ НОЧИ ПИР.
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.zh:
世间普照，至纯之光。
    下有永夜，日益滋长。

scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.de:
DIE QUELLEN BEFREIT, DAS BRÜLLEN ERSCHREIT.
TITANEN WERDEN AUS GESCHWÄRZTEN AUGEN BEREIT.
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.en:
IF FOUNTAINS FREED, THE ROARING CRIES.
AND TITANS SHAPE FROM DARKENED EYES.
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.es:
SI NACEN FUENTES, EL RUGIR AULLARÁ
Y DE OJOS OSCURECIDOS TITANES NACERÁN.
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.ja:
泉の解き放たれしとき 咆哮は響き
暗き瞳より 巨人は現れる
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.ko:
샘들이 풀려나면, 포효가 울려퍼지고.
어두워진 눈으로부터 거신들이 형체를 갖추리라.
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.pl:
FONTANNY WOLNE, RYKU POWODEM.
TYTANI ŚLEPSK MROKU PÓJDĄ PRZODEM.
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.pt-BR:
SE AS FONTES LIBERTAS, BRADARÁ O RUGIDO.
TITÃS SE FORMARÃO DE OLHOS ESCURECIDOS.
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.ru:
СУЛЯТ ФОНТАНЫ РОКА ГЛАС —
ТИТАНЫ ВЗЫДУТ С ТЁМНЫХ ГЛАЗ.
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.zh:
若诸泉获释，呼啸响彻世间。
     遂泰坦成形，自那黑暗之眼。

scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.de:
DUNKEL UND HELL, BEIDE BRENNEN SIE GRELL.
DER TOD DER ERDE NAHET SCHNELL.
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.en:
THE LIGHT AND DARK, BOTH BURNING DIRE.
A COUNTDOWN TO THE EARTH'S EXPIRE.
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.es:
LA LUZ Y LA SOMBRA, ARDIENDO A LA PAR
MARCAN LA HORA DEL FIN TERRENAL.
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.ja:
光も闇も やがて燃え尽きる
大地の終焉への秒読み
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.ko:
빛과 어둠이 매섭게 타오르고.
대지가 죽음을 맞이하려 할 때.
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.pl:
ŚWIATŁO I CIEMNOŚĆ, DWIE KONFLIKTU STRONY.
ZIEMI KOŃCA WKRÓTCE WYBRZMIĄ TONY.
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.pt-BR:
QUEIMANDO COMO BRASA, A LUZ E A TREVA.
CONTAGEM REGRESSIVA AO EXPIRAR DA TERRA.
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.ru:
И СВЕТ, И ТЬМА ВЕДУТ ОТСЧЁТ
КАК МИР В НЕБЫТИЕ УЙДЁТ.
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.zh:
光暗两界，烈火正狂。
    灾期已定，大地将亡。

scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.de:
DOCH TRAUM UND HOFFNUNG HABEN IHREN WEG ERHELLT.
DREI HELDEN STEHEN AM ENDE DER WELT.
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.en:
BUT LO, ON HOPES AND DREAMS THEY SEND.
THREE HEROES AT THE WORLD'S END.
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.es:
PERO CON SUEÑOS Y ESPERANZAS ENVIARÁN
A TRES HÉROES CUANDO EL MUNDO LLEGUE A SU FINAL.
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.ja:
やよ 夢と希望のもと
この世の果てに 送り込まれし３人の勇者
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.ko:
보라, 꿈과 희망을 따라 보내진
세 영웅이 세상의 끝에 나타나니.
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.pl:
LECZ WTEM NADZIEI I MARZEŃ OZNAKA.
TRZECH BOHATERÓW NA RUBIEŻACH ŚWIATKA.
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.pt-BR:
MAS EIS QUE EM ESPERANÇAS E SONHOS ENVIAM.
TRÊS HERÓIS, NO FIM DO MUNDO, SURGIRAM.
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.ru:
НО С ВЕРОЙ И МЕЧТОЙ В СЕРДЦАХ.
ПРИДУТ ГЕРОИ В ЧАС КОНЦА.
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.zh:
但请看，藉由希望梦想之信念，
    三英雄，现身世界寰宇之边沿。

scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.de: DAS MÄDCHEN, DAS HOFFNUNG IN IHREM HERZEN TRÄGT.
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.en: THE GIRL, WITH HOPE CROSSED ON HER HEART.
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.es: LA CHICA, CON LA ESPERANZA CRUZADA EN SU CORAZÓN.
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.ja: 胸に希望を刻みし娘
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.pl: DZIEWCZYNA, KTÓREJ NADZIEJA Z SERCA PŁYNIE.
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.pt-BR: A GAROTA, COM ESPERANÇA ENTALHADA NO CORAÇÃO.
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.ru: ДЕВА С НАДЕЖДОЙ, ХРАНИМОЙ В ДУШЕ.
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.zh:
少女，
满怀希望，心中坚定。

scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.de:
DER HELDEN ZWEIT.
DAS MÄDCHEN, DAS HOFFNUNG IN IHREM HERZEN TRÄGT.
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.en:
THE SECOND HERO.
THE GIRL, WITH HOPE CROSSED ON HER HEART.
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.es:
LA SEGUNDA HEROÍNA.
LA CHICA, CON LA ESPERANZA CRUZADA EN SU CORAZÓN.
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.ja:
２人めの勇者
胸に希望を刻みし娘
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.ko:
두 번째 영웅.
마음에 희망을 새긴 소녀.
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.pl:
DRUGI BOHATER.
DZIEWCZYNA, KTÓREJ NADZIEJA Z SERCA PŁYNIE.
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.pt-BR:
DENTRE OS HERÓIS, A SEGUNDA.
A GAROTA, COM ESPERANÇA ENTALHADA NO CORAÇÃO.
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.ru:
ВТОРОЙ ГЕРОЙ.
ДЕВА С НАДЕЖДОЙ, ХРАНИМОЙ В ДУШЕ.
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.zh:
第二位英雄，少女。
    满怀希望，心中坚定。

scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.de: DER PRINZ, ALLEIN IM TIEFSTEN DUNKEL...
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.en: THE PRINCE, ALONE IN DEEPEST DARK...
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.es: EL PRÍNCIPE, SOLO EN LA OSCURIDAD MÁS PROFUNDA...
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.ja: 暗き闇の淵に在る 孤独な王子
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.ko: 깊디 깊은 어둠 속의 고독한 왕자...
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.pt-BR: O PRÍNCIPE, NAS PROFUNDAS TREVAS EM SOLIDÃO...
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.ru: ПРИНЦ, ЧТО ОСТАВЛЕН БЫЛ ВСЕМИ ВО ТЬМЕ...
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.zh:
王子，
置身黑暗，孤苦伶仃...

scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.de:
DER HELDEN DRITT.
DER PRINZ, ALLEIN IM TIEFSTEN DUNKEL.
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.en:
THE THIRD HERO.
THE PRINCE, ALONE IN DEEPEST DARK
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.es:
EL TERCER HÉROE.
EL PRÍNCIPE, SOLO EN LA OSCURIDAD MÁS PROFUNDA
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.ja:
３人めの勇者
暗き闇の淵に在る 孤独な王子
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.ko:
세 번째 영웅.
깊디 깊은 어둠 속의 고독한 왕자
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.pl:
TRZECI BOHATER.
KSIĄŻE, SAMOTNY W ODMĘTACH CIEMNOŚCI.
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.pt-BR:
DENTRE OS HERÓIS, O TERCEIRO.
O PRÍNCIPE, NAS PROFUNDAS TREVAS EM SOLIDÃO
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.ru:
ТРЕТИЙ ГЕРОЙ
ПРИНЦ, ЧТО ОСТАВЛЕН БЫЛ ВСЕМИ ВО ТЬМЕ
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.zh:
第三位英雄，王子。
  置身黑暗，孤苦伶仃

scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.de: DER KÄFIG, MIT MENSCHENSEEL UND TEILEN!
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.en: THE CAGE, WITH HUMAN SOUL AND PARTS!
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.es: LA JAULA, ¡CON ALMA Y PARTES HUMANAS!
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.ja: 人間の魂と部位を収めた籠
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.pl: KLATKA, Z LUDZKĄ DUSZĄ I CIAŁEM!
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.pt-BR: A JAULA, COM ALMA HUMANA EM SUA MÃO!
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.ru: КЛЕТКА С ДУШОЙ ЧЕЛОВЕКА В СЕБЕ!
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.zh:
囚笼，承载人之灵魂，
驾驭人之躯形！

scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.de:
DER HELDEN ERST.
DER KÄFIG, MIT MENSCHENSEEL UND TEILEN!
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.en:
THE FIRST HERO.
THE CAGE, WITH HUMAN SOUL AND PARTS!
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.es:
UN PRIMER HÉROE.
LA JAULA, ¡CON ALMA Y PARTES HUMANAS!
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.ja:
１人めの勇者
人間の魂と部位を収めた籠
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.ko:
첫 번째 영웅.
인간의 영혼과 육신으로 만들어진 철창!
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.pl:
PIERWSZY BOHATER.
KLATKA, Z LUDZKĄ DUSZĄ I CIAŁEM!
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.pt-BR:
DENTRE OS HERÓIS, QUEM INICIA.
A JAULA, COM ALMA HUMANA EM SUA MÃO!
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.ru:
ПЕРВЫЙ ГЕРОЙ.
КЛЕТКА С ДУШОЙ ЧЕЛОВЕКА В СЕБЕ!
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.zh:
第一位英雄，囚笼。
    承载人之灵魂，驾驭人之躯形！

scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.de: SIE HÖREN DEN REIF DES HIMMELS KLINGEN.
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.en: THEY'LL HEAR THE RING OF HEAVEN'S CALL.
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.es: ESCUCHARÁN EL LLAMADO DEL CIELO.
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.ja:
彼らは聞く
天の呼ぶ音を
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.pt-BR: OUVIRÃO O ANEL DO CÉU CHAMAR.
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.zh:
他们，将闻天国之钟，
  猝然长鸣。

scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.de: SIE SEHEN DEN SCHWEIF DER HÖLLE SICH SCHLINGEN.
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.en: THEY'LL SEE THE TAIL OF HELL TAKE CRAWL.
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.es: VERÁN ARRASAR A LA COLA DEL INFIERNO.
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.ja:
彼らは見る
這い回る地獄の尾を
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.ko:
지옥의 꼬리가 기어오는 모습이
널리 보여질 것이다.
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.pt-BR: VERÃO A CAUDA DO INFERNO RASTEJAR.
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.zh:
他们，将逢地狱之尾，
  匍匐而行。

scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.de:
DER RITTER, DER SCHAFFT
MIT DEM MESSER AUS DER NACHT.
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.en:
THE KNIGHT WHICH MAKES
WITH BLACKENED KNIFE.
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.es:
EL CABALLERO QUE CREA
CON CUCHILLO NEGRO.
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.ja: 黒き刃にて生み出す騎士は
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.pl:
RYCERZ, TWÓRCA ZE
SWYM CZARNYM OSTRZEM.
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.pt-BR:
O CAVALEIRO QUE FÁ-LAS
COM A FACA ENEGRECIDA.
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.ru:
С КЛИНКОМ В РУКАХ,
ЧТО ТЬМУ ТВОРИТ.
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.zh:
手执黑刃，
   骑士来袭。

scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.de:
SOLL RINGEN MIT DEN HELDEN
SCHLACHT UM SCHLACHT.
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.en:
SHALL DUEL WITH HEROES
STRIFE BY STRIFE.
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.es:
SE ENFRENTARÁ A LOS HÉROES.
SE BATIRÁN EN DUELO.
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.ja: 勇者たちと 決闘せん
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.pl:
ZAWALCZY Z HEROSAMI
CIOS ZA CIOSEM.
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.pt-BR:
IRÁ DUELAR COM HERÓIS,
BRIGA APÓS BRIGA.
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.zh:
对阵英雄，
   干戈不息。

scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.de:
DER WAGEN DER KÖNIGIN
IST UNAUFHALTBAR.
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.en:
THE QUEEN'S CHARIOT
CANNOT BE STOPPED.
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.es:
NADA PODRÁ DETENER
AL CARRUAJE DE LA REINA.
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.ja: クイーンの車は 停車せず
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.pt-BR:
A CARRUAGEM DA RAINHA
NÃO PODE SER PARADA.
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.zh:
女王战车，
   势不可挡。

scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.de:
DER HERR DER BILDER
VON DER KLINGE ROT ZERTEILT.
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.en:
THE LORD OF SCREENS
CLEAVED RED BY BLADE.
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.es:
EL SEÑOR DE LAS PANTALLAS
PARTIDO EN LA BATALLA.
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.ja: 画面公は 紅き刃に切り裂かれん
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.pt-BR:
O LORDE DAS TELAS
TALHADO EM VERMELHO PELA LÂMINA.
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.zh:
荧幕之主，
   利刃加身红满裳。

scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.de:
DER BLUMENMANN, 
IN SEINEM ASYL GEFANGEN.
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.en:
THE FLOWER MAN, 
TRAPPED IN ASYLUM.
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.es:
EL HOMBRE FLORAL, ATRAPADO
EN UN MANICOMIO INFERNAL.
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.ja: 花男は 施設に囚われん
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.pt-BR:
O HOMEM DAS FLORES,
PRESO EM SEU ASILO.
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.ru:
ЦВЕТОЧНЫЙ МУЖЧИНА, В
УКРОМНОМ ОН МЕСТЕ ПЛЕНЁН.
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.zh:
爱花之郎，
   其身陷于庇护房。

scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.de: JOCKINGTON LÄSST STEHEN DEN BART.
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.en: JOCKINGTON GROWS THE BEARD.
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.es: A JOCKINGTON LE CRECE BARBA.
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.ja: ジョッキントンは 髭を生やさん
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.pt-BR: JOCKINGTON CRESCE A BARBA.
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.zh: JOCKINGTON蓄起胡须。

scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.de:
SO SAGE DER SPITZKÖPFIGE
"ZAHNPASTA", UND DANN "BUBI".
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.en:
THE POINTY-HEADED WILL SAY
"TOOTHPASTE," AND THEN  "BOY."
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.es:
EL CABEZA TRIANGULAR DIRÁ
"CHICO", Y LUEGO "PASTA DE DIENTES".
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.ja:
とんがり頭は 「キレイキレイ」
「ボーイ」と 口にせん
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.ko:
뾰족한 머리를 가진 자가
"치약머리" 그리고 "소년."이라 놀리리라.
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.pt-BR:
O DE CRÂNIO PONTUDO FALARÁ
"PASTINHA"; LOGO APÓS, "DE DENTE".
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.zh:
头顶尖尖之人，将言
  “牙膏”，与“小子”。

scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.de: EINES RÄTSELS ERSTEN TÖNE VIER.
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.en: A CONUNDRUM'S FIRST FOUR TONES.
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.es: LOS PRIMEROS CUATRO TONOS DE UN ENIGMA.
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.ja: 判じ物の 最初の４音
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.pt-BR: AS QUATRO PRIMEIRAS NOTAS DE UMA INCÓGNITA.
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.zh: 谜题奏响前四音。

scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.de: EINES RÄTSELS LETZTEN TÖNE VIER.
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.en: A CONUNDRUM'S LAST FOUR TONES.
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.es: LOS ÚLTIMOS CUATRO TONOS DE UN ENIGMA.
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.ja: 判じ物の 最後の４音
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.pt-BR: AS QUATRO ÚLTIMAS NOTAS DE UMA INCÓGNITA.
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.zh: 谜题收束末四音。

scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.de: EINES RÄTSELS VIELE TÖNE.
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.en: A CONUNDRUM'S MULTITUDE TONES.
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.es: MULTITUD DE TONOS DE UN ENIGMA.
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.ja: 判じ物の 多数の音
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.pt-BR: AS MÚLTIPLAS NOTAS DE UMA INCÓGNITA.
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.zh: 谜题万声齐回响。

scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.de:
DER ENGEL, VERBANNT, TRIFFT
ENDLICH AUF SEIN VERLANGEN.
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.en:
THE ANGEL, BANISHED, WILL
FINALLY MEET WITH ITS DESIRE.
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.es:
EL ÁNGEL, DESTERRADO,
VERÁ CUMPLIDO SU DESEO.
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.ja:
追放されし天使は
ついにその 希望に まみえん
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.pl:
ANIOŁ, WYGNANY, WRESZCIE
ZASPOKOI SWE PRAGNIENIE.
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.pt-BR:
O ANJO, BANIDO, FINALMENTE
ENCONTRARÁ COM SEU DESEJO.
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.ru:
ТОТ ИЗГНАННЫЙ АНГЕЛ
ИСПОЛНИТ ЖЕЛАНЬЕ СВОЁ.
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.zh:
天使，虽遭流放，
终将实现愿望。

scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.de:
UND DANN. WENN ALLE HOFFNUNG
VERLOREN IST
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.en:
AND THEN. WHEN ALL HOPE
IS LOST FOR THE TALE
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.es:
Y ENTONCES, CUANDO EL CUENTO
CAREZCA DE ESPERANZA...
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.ja:
やがて 伝説の希望の
すべて失われしとき
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.ko:
그리고, 이야기의
모든 희망이 사라졌을 때
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.pl:
A WTEDY. KIEDY NADZIEI
ZABRAKNIE W TEJ HISTORII
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.pt-BR:
E QUANDO TODA ESPERANÇA
PELO CONTO SE PERDE
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.ru:
И ВОТ. КОГДА
НАДЕЖДЫ СВЕТ ПОГАС
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.zh: 当希望尽数破灭

scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.de: ENTHÜLLT SICH DAS LETZTE UNHEIL.
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.en: THE FINAL TRAGEDY UNVEILS.
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.es: UNA ÚLTIMA TRAGEDIA SE RELATA.
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.ja: 最後の悲劇 明かされん
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.pt-BR: A CALAMIDADE FINAL TRANSPARECE.
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.zh: 最终悲剧，也将揭开面纱。

scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.de:
UM DIE WELTEN ZU WAHREN,
SO SPRECHEN WIR ZULETZT,
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.en:
FOR TO SAVE THE WORLDS,
WE LAST OF ALL SAY,
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.es:
PARA SALVAR LOS MUNDOS,
ESTO PODEMOS DECIR
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.ja: 世界を救わんとするならば
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.ko:
최후의 생존자들이 말하리라
세계를 구하기 위해선,
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.pl:
BY OCALIĆ ŚWIATY OBA,
RZEC MUSIMY NA KONIEC,
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.pt-BR:
PARA SALVAR OS MUNDOS,
POR FIM DE TUDO FALAMOS:
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.zh:
为拯救诸世，
我们一齐发声：

scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.de:
NUR DANN ERLANGEN
DIE WELTEN IHRE RETTUNG.
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.en:
ONLY THEN,
WILL THE WORLDS BE SAVED.
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.es:
Y ENTONCES,
LOS MUNDOS SE SALVARÁN AL FIN.
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.ja:
そが なされれば
世界は 救われん
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.pt-BR:
SÓ ENTÃO,
OS MUNDOS SERÃO SALVOS.
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.zh:
唯有如此，
   世界方可留存。

scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.de:
DIE AXT GESCHMIEDET VOM
HAMMER DER SCHOÖDKRÖTE.
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.en:
AXE CARVED BY THE

HACHA TALLADA POR
EL GRAN MARTILLO DE LA TORTUGA.

亀の大いなる槌より
生まれいでし斧
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.ko:
거북의 큰 망치로

TOPÓR WYKUTY PRZEZ
WIELKI ŻÓŁWIA MŁOT.

MACHADO FORJADO PELO
GRANDE MARTELO DO JABUTI.
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.zh:
龟之巨锤，经由雕刻，
铸成那斧。

scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.es:

scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.ja:
最後に 娘が
ついに その娘が

그리고 마지막은, 소녀였다.
마침내, 그 소녀였다.
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.pl:
OSTATNIA BYŁA DZIEWCZYNA.
NA KOŃCU BYŁA DZIEWCZYNA.
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.pt-BR:
POR FIM, A GAROTA.
ENFIM, A GAROTA.
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.ru:
И НАКОНЕЦ, ДЕВА.
В КОНЦЕ БЫЛА ДЕВА.
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.zh:
最后，是那少女。
  终究，是那少女。

scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.de:
KALTWASSER FIEL AUS
DER SPITZE DES HIMMELS.
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.en:
COLDWATER FELL FROM THE
TOP OF THE SKY.
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.es:
AGUA FRÍA CAYÓ DESDE LO
MÁS ALTO DEL CIELO.
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.ja: 冷たき水が 空より降り注がん
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.pl:
ZIMNA WODA Z NIEBA
SZCZYTU SPADNIE.
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.pt-BR:
ÁGUA FRIA DESCENDE DO
TOPO DO CÉU.
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.zh:
冰冷之水，
自天边倾泻而下。

scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.pt-BR: GALERIA

scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.es: EL AMOR ENCUENTRA SU CAMINO HACIA LA CHICA.
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.ja: 娘は愛の 真の意味を知る
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.pt-BR: AMOR ACHA SEU CAMINHO ATÉ A GAROTA.
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.zh: 少女，体悟爱之真意。

scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.de:
DIE LETZTE PROPHEZEIUNG.
DER GESCHICHTE IHR END.
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.en:
THE LAST PROPHECY.
THE STORY'S END.
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.es:
LA ÚLTIMA PROFECÍA.
EL FIN DE LA HISTORIA.
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.ja:
最後の予言
物語の終わり
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.pt-BR:
A ÚLTIMA PROFECIA.
O FIM DA HISTÓRIA.
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.zh:
预言之终章：
   故事之尾声。

scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.de:
UM DIE WELTEN ZU RETTEN,
GIBT ES NUR EINEN WEG.
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.en:
TO SAVE THE WORLDS,
THERE IS ONLY ONE WAY.
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.es:
PARA SALVAR LOS MUNDOS,
SOLO HAY UNA ALTERNATIVA.
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.ja:
世界を救うすべは
ただ１つ
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.ko:
두 세계를 구할
방법은 단 한 가지.
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.pl:
BY OCALIĆ OBA ŚWIATY,
SPOSÓB JEST TYLKO JEDEN.
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.pt-BR:
PARA SALVAR OS MUNDOS,
HÁ APENAS UM JEITO.
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.zh:
欲拯救世界，
   唯有一法。
