scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_981_0.es: 6* Do you remember when me and him went to the dance?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_981_0.ja:
6＊ てか　あたしとアズにゃん
　 いっしょにダンスパーティ
　 いったじゃん？/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_981_0.ko:
6* 걔랑 나랑 같이 무도회
  간 거 기억나?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_981_0.pl: 6* Czy pamiętasz, jak byłam z nim na dyskotece?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_981_0.pt-BR: 6* Do you remember when me and him went to the dance?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_981_0.ru: 6* Помнишь, как мы с ним ходили на танцы?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_981_0.zh:
6* 你还记得我和他
去跳舞那次吗？/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_982_0.de:
2That was like...
* The best night EVER!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_982_0.en:
2* That was like...
* The best night EVER!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_982_0.es:
2* That was like...
* The best night EVER!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_982_0.ja:
2＊ も～…
＊ サイッコーだった～！/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_982_0.pl:
2* To była...
* Najlepsza noc W ŻYCIU!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_982_0.pt-BR:
2* That was like...
* The best night EVER!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_982_0.ru:
2* Это была, типа...
* Лучшая ночь на СВЕТЕ!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_982_0.zh:
2* 那真是... 
* 有史以来最棒的一晚！/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_983_0.de: 4Even though I spilled the entire punch bowl all over him.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_983_0.en: 4* Even though I spilled the entire punch bowl all over him.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_983_0.es: 4* Even though I spilled the entire punch bowl all over him.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_983_0.ja:
4＊ あたしが　アズにゃんに
　 あたまから　フルーツパンチ
　 ブッかけちゃって…/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_983_0.ko:
4* 내가 실수로 
  펀치보울을 걔한테
  다 쏟았지만 말이야.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_983_0.pl: 4* Mimo że wylałam na niego cały dzbanek ponczu.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_983_0.pt-BR: 4* Even though I spilled the entire punch bowl all over him.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_983_0.ru: 4* Даже после того, как я пролила на него весь пунш.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_983_0.zh:
4* 虽然我把一大杯酒
洒在他身上.../

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_984_0.de: 6And danced inappropriately in front of your mom.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_984_0.en: 6* And danced inappropriately in front of your mom.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_984_0.es: 6* And danced inappropriately in front of your mom.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_984_0.ja:
6＊ アズにゃんの　ママのまえで
　 おイロけ　ぜんかいで
　 おどっちゃったりして…/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_984_0.ko:
6* 그리고 너희 엄마 앞에서
  ...부적절한 춤도 췄고.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_984_0.pl: 6* I tańczyłam prowokacyjnie obok twojej mamy.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_984_0.pt-BR: 6* And danced inappropriately in front of your mom.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_984_0.ru: 6* И непристойно танцевала на глазах у твоей мамы.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_984_0.zh:
6* 还在你妈妈面前
跳了不合适的舞.../

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_985_0.de: 5And got arrested in the parking lot for making a scene.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_985_0.en: 5* And got arrested in the parking lot for making a scene.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_985_0.es: 5* And got arrested in the parking lot for making a scene.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_985_0.ja:
5＊ そんで　ちゅうしゃじょうで
　 おおさわぎして　けいさつに
　 つかまって…/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_985_0.ko:
5* 주차장에서 일으킨
  소동 때문에
  체포도 당했지만.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_985_0.pl: 5* I aresztowali mnie na parkingu za zakłócanie ciszy nocnej.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_985_0.pt-BR: 5* And got arrested in the parking lot for making a scene.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_985_0.ru: 5* И меня арестовали на парковке за устроенную сцену.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_985_0.zh:
5* 还因为在停车场大吵大闹
被逮捕了.../

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_986_0.de:
2Hahaha! That was SO much fun!
* Tell him I said hi!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_986_0.en:
2* Hahaha! That was SO much fun!
* Tell him I said hi!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_986_0.es:
2* Hahaha! That was SO much fun!
* Tell him I said hi!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_986_0.ja:
2＊ あはは！　も～
　 チョーゼツたのしかった～！
＊ ヨロシクいっといてね！/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_986_0.ko:
2* 냐하하! 너무 재미있었어!
* 만나면 인사 전해 줘!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_986_0.pl:
2* Hahaha! Było GENIALNIE!
* Pozdrów go ode mnie!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_986_0.pt-BR:
2* Hahaha! That was SO much fun!
* Tell him I said hi!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_986_0.ru:
2* Ха-ха-ха! Это было ТАК весело!
* Передавай ему привет!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_986_0.zh:
2* 哈哈哈！那真是太有意思了！
* 替我向他问好！/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_990_0.en: 1* Like, that green girl next door?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_990_0.es: 1* Like, that green girl next door?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_990_0.ja:
1＊ つか　となりにすんでる
　 みどりのコのこと～？/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_990_0.pl: 1* Masz na myśli, no wiesz, tę zieloną kobietę z sąsiedztwa?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_990_0.pt-BR: 1* Like, that green girl next door?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_990_0.ru: 1* Типа, та зелёная девочка по соседству?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_990_0.zh: 1* 那个，隔壁的那位绿色女孩？/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_991_0.de:
5Oh my god, Krissy.
* She's like... my LIFE VILLAIN./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_991_0.en:
5* Oh my god, Krissy.
* She's like... my LIFE VILLAIN./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_991_0.es:
5* Oh my god, Krissy.
* She's like... my LIFE VILLAIN./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_991_0.ja:
5＊ あのコって～　マジメに～
＊ あたしの　「しゅくてき」
　 だから～！/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_991_0.ko:
5* 크리시, 그 여자 어쩜 좋니.
* 완전 내 인생의 숙적이야./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_991_0.pl:
5* Rany, Krissy.
* Ona jest, no wiesz... moją NEMEZIS./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_991_0.pt-BR:
5* Oh my god, Krissy.
* She's like... my LIFE VILLAIN./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_991_0.ru:
5* Божечки, Крисси.
* Она, типа... мой ЗАКЛЯТЫЙ ВРАГ./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_991_0.zh:
5* 噢我的天哪，Krissy。
* 她就像，那个... 
我生活中的反派。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_992_0.de: 6Like, the other day, I went to see Cat Petters 2.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_992_0.en: 6* Like, the other day, I went to see Cat Petters 2.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_992_0.es: 6* Like, the other day, I went to see Cat Petters 2.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_992_0.ja:
6＊ てか　このまえも
　 「キャット・ナデラー２」を
　 みにいったら～…/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_992_0.pl: 6* No wiesz, któregoś dnia, poszłam do kina na „Miziaczy Kotów 2”.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_992_0.pt-BR: 6* Like, the other day, I went to see Cat Petters 2.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_992_0.ru: 6* Типа, на днях, я ходила посмотреть «Котогладильщики 2».../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_992_0.zh:
6* 那个，有一天，
我去看电子猫奴2.../

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_993_0.de: 3And the only other person in the theater was her!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_993_0.en: 3* And the only other person in the theater was her!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_993_0.es: 3* And the only other person in the theater was her!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_993_0.ja:
3＊ えいがかんに　あたしと
　 あのコ　２人っきりで～！/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_993_0.pl: 3* I tylko ona była ze mną na sali!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_993_0.pt-BR: 3* And the only other person in the theater was her!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_993_0.ru: 3* И единственным, кто ещё был в зале, оказалась она!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_993_0.zh:
3* 电影院里除了我
就只剩下她了！/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_994_0.de: 1Then I went to QC's and ordered a Catpuccino.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_994_0.en: 1* Then I went to QC's and ordered a Catpuccino.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_994_0.es: 1* Then I went to QC's and ordered a Catpuccino.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_994_0.ja:
1＊ そのあと「QCダイナー」で
　 キャットプチーノ
　 たのんだら～/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_994_0.pl: 1* A potem poszłam do baru QC i zamówiłam Kotpuccino.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_994_0.pt-BR: 1* Then I went to QC's and ordered a Catpuccino.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_994_0.ru: 1* Затем я пошла в QC заказать Котпучино.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_994_0.zh:
1* 然后我去QC餐厅
点了一杯卡布奇诺.../

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_995_0.de: 5And she, like, was already drinking one!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_995_0.en: 5* And she, like, was already drinking one!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_995_0.es: 5* And she, like, was already drinking one!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_995_0.ja:
5＊ あのコ　さきにきて
　 もう　キャットプチーノ
　 のんでてぇ～！/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_995_0.ko:
5* 어쩜, 걔가,
  이미 똑같은 걸
  마시고 있는 거야!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_995_0.pl: 5* A ona, no wiesz, już takie piła!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_995_0.pt-BR: 5* And she, like, was already drinking one!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_995_0.ru: 5* А она, типа, уже пила такой же!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_995_0.zh: 5* 然后她，那个，已经喝起来了！/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_996_0.en:
3* She's SUCH a copycat!
* ... uhh, copygator?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_996_0.es:
3* She's SUCH a copycat!
* ... uhh, copygator?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_996_0.ja:
3＊ マネすんなっつの！
　 サルかよ！
＊ …あ　ワニか。/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_996_0.pl:
3* Ale z niej naśladowca!
* Lub, no, naślaligator?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_996_0.pt-BR:
3* She's SUCH a copycat!
* ... uhh, copygator?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_996_0.zh:
3* 她就是这么个复读猫！
* ...呃，复读鳄？/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_997_0.ja:
5＊ てか　キョウリュウ？
＊ ハチュウルイ？
＊ とにかく　ムカツク～！/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_997_0.pl:
5* Naśladozaur?
* Naślakodyl?
* NWM, nie cierpię jej!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_997_0.ru:
5* Копизавр?
* Копидил?
* Без понятия, она отстой!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_997_0.zh:
5* 复读蜥？
* 鳄读鱼？
* 我不懂，反正她糟透了！/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1001_0.de:
6Ooo, how's Catti doing?
* I have no idea./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1001_0.en:
6* Ooo, how's Catti doing?
* I have no idea./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1001_0.es:
6* Ooo, how's Catti doing?
* I have no idea./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1001_0.ja:
6＊ え～　キャッティーが
　 どうしてるかって～？
＊ しらな～い。/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1001_0.ko:
6* 아아, 캐시는 어떻게 지내?
* 난 잘 모르겠네./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1001_0.pl:
6* Ooo, co tam u Catti?
* Nie mam pojęcia./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1001_0.pt-BR:
6* Ooo, how's Catti doing?
* I have no idea./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1001_0.ru:
6* О-о-о, как дела у Котти?
* Я не в курсе./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1001_0.zh:
6* 噢噢噢，Catti过得怎样？
* 我不知道。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1002_0.de: 5We, like, totally can't connect at all!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1002_0.en: 5* We, like, totally can't connect at all!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1002_0.es: 5* We, like, totally can't connect at all!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1002_0.ja:
5＊ てか　あのコとは
　 ぜんっぜん
　 きが　あわないし～！/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1002_0.ko:
5* 우린, 뭐랄까,
  거의 안 맞는
  사이인걸!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1002_0.pl: 5* My, no wiesz, totalnie nie spędzamy ze sobą czasu!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1002_0.pt-BR: 5* We, like, totally can't connect at all!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1002_0.ru: 5* Мы, типа, вообще не можем сблизиться!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1002_0.zh:
5* 我们，那个，
完全聊不到一块去！/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1003_0.de: 1Yesterday, I asked if she wanted to hear me play the ukelele.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1003_0.en: 1* Yesterday, I asked if she wanted to hear me play the ukelele.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1003_0.es: 1* Yesterday, I asked if she wanted to hear me play the ukelele.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1003_0.ja:
1＊ きのうも～　キャッティーに
　 「ウクレレ　ひいてあげる」
　 っつったら～…/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1003_0.ko:
1* 어제는, 
  내가 우쿨렐레 연주를
  들려주려고 했는데.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1003_0.pl: 1* Wczoraj spytałam, czy chce posłuchać, jak gram na ukulele.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1003_0.pt-BR: 1* Yesterday, I asked if she wanted to hear me play the ukelele.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1003_0.ru: 1* Вчера я спросила, не хочет ли она послушать мою игру на укулеле.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1003_0.zh:
1* 昨天，我问她想不想
听我弹尤克里里.../

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1004_0.de:
5She said no!
* And then she, like, told me.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1004_0.en:
5* She said no!
* And then she, like, told me.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1004_0.es:
5* She said no!
* And then she, like, told me.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1004_0.ja:
5＊ 「やめて」とかいうの～！
＊ しかも～…/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1004_0.ko:
5* 싫다지 뭐야!
* 게다가 막, 하는 말이.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1004_0.pl:
5* Powiedziała, że nie!
* A potem, no wiesz, dodała.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1004_0.pt-BR:
5* She said no!
* And then she, like, told me.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1004_0.ru:
5* Она отказалась!
* А потом она, типа, сказала мне.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1004_0.zh:
5* 她拒绝了！
* 然后她，那个，和我说.../

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1005_0.de: 3My playing is "an anti-blessing from Planet Hell."/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1005_0.en: 3* My playing is "an anti-blessing from Planet Hell."/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1005_0.es: 3* My playing is "an anti-blessing from Planet Hell."/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1005_0.ja:
3＊ 「アネキの　えんそうは
　 ヘル星から　ふりそそぐ
　 あんこくの　のろい」って。/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1005_0.ko:
3* 내 연주가 지옥
  밑바닥에서 새어나온 죄수의
  신음 같다는 거야./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1005_0.pl: 3* Że gram jak „głuchy perkusista na cymbałkach”./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1005_0.pt-BR: 3* My playing is "an anti-blessing from Planet Hell."/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1005_0.ru: 3* Что моя игра — «антиблагословение с планеты Ад»./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1005_0.zh:
3* 我弹得像是
“来自地狱星的反向祈祷”。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1006_0.ja:
5＊ はぁ～～～！？
　 って　かんじ～！/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1007_0.de:
2That's SOOO cute!
* I love my fricked-up lil sis!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1007_0.en:
2* That's SOOO cute!
* I love my fricked-up lil sis!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1007_0.es:
2* That's SOOO cute!
* I love my fricked-up lil sis!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1007_0.ja:
2＊ それって　チョーゼツ
　 カワイイんですけど～！
＊ キャッティー　マジラブ～！/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1007_0.ko:
2* 너어어무 귀엽잖아!
* 우리 사춘기 여동생 
  완전 최고라니까!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1007_0.pl:
2* To było TAKIEEE słodkie!
* Kocham moją małą, zrytą siostrzyczkę!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1007_0.pt-BR:
2* That's SOOO cute!
* I love my fricked-up lil sis!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1007_0.ru:
2* Это ТА-А-А-А-АК мило!

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1207_0.de:

* Ask me about TP's./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1207_0.ja:
＊ ボクは　TPマスター。
＊ TPのことなら　なんでも聞いて。/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1207_0.ko:
* 나는 TP 마스터.
* TP에 관한 거라면 뭐든 물어봐./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1207_0.pl:

* I'm TP Master.

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1207_0.zh:

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1215_0.de:
* TP? What's TP?
* That's what lets you cast SPELLS, see!?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1215_0.en:
* TP? What's TP?
* That's what lets you cast SPELLS, see!?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1215_0.es:
* TP? What's TP?
* That's what lets you cast SPELLS, see!?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1215_0.ja:
＊ TP？　ってなぁにィ？
＊ 必要なんだよ
　 「まほう」使うのにィ！/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1215_0.ko:
* TP? TP가 뭐냐?
* 마법을 쓸 때 필요한 숫자야!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1215_0.pl:
* PA? Czym jest PA?
* Pozwala ci rzucać CZARY waluta ta!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1215_0.pt-BR:
* TP? What's TP?
* That's what lets you cast SPELLS, see!?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1215_0.ru:
* ПН что такое, узнать вы хотите?
* С ним ЗАКЛИНАНИЕ в жизнь воплотите!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1215_0.zh:
* TP？什么是TP？
* 那是用来让你施展【法术】的东西！/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1216_0.de:
* When you see that orange bar,
* Cast some SPELLS when it's filled up far./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1216_0.en:
* When you see that orange bar,
* Cast some SPELLS when it's filled up far./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1216_0.es:
* When you see that orange bar,
* Cast some SPELLS when it's filled up far./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1216_0.ja:
＊ 見えるだろ　オレンジのメータァー。
＊ 「まほう」使えよ
　 上まで　たまったらァ。/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1216_0.ko:
* 주황색 막대를 봐.
* 꽉 차 있으면 마법을 써 봐./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1216_0.pl:
* Gdy ujrzysz pomarańczowy pasek,
* Wiedz, że wypełniony pozwoli ci zaklęć rzucić masę./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1216_0.pt-BR:
* When you see that orange bar,
* Cast some SPELLS when it's filled up far./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1216_0.ru: * Как только полоска заполнится слева — использовать МАГИЮ можете смело./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1216_0.zh:
* 盯着那根橙色光柱，
* 快满了就赶紧用些【法术】。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1217_0.de:

* ... Toilet Paper!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1217_0.en:
* TP...! It's quite a caper!
* TP! Stands for...
* ... Toilet Paper!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1217_0.es:
* TP...! It's quite a caper!
* TP! Stands for...
* ... Toilet Paper!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1217_0.ja:
＊ TP！　ってなぁにィ？
＊ TP！　
　 「トイレットペーパー」って意味ィ！/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1217_0.ko:
* TP...! 정말 대단하지!
* TP! 이것은 바로...
* ... 토핑의 약자지!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1217_0.pl:
* PA...! To jest ciekawa sprawa!
* Rozwinięcie PA to...
* Pełna Autonaprawa!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1217_0.pt-BR:
* TP...! It's quite a caper!
* TP! Stands for...
* ... Toilet Paper!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1217_0.ru:
* ПН! Не подумать о нём без тоски.
* А значит ПН... Порванные носки!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1217_0.zh:
* TP...！它可了不起！
* TP！它表示...
* ...调皮！/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1219_0.de: * ... no, it stands for Tension Points./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1219_0.en: * ... no, it stands for Tension Points./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1219_0.es: * ... no, it stands for Tension Points./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1219_0.ja:
＊ …じゃなくて
　 「テンションポイント」の
　 略です。/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1219_0.pl: * Nieprawda, rozwinięcie skrótu PA to Punkty Adrenaliny./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1219_0.pt-BR: * ... no, it stands for Tension Points./

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1221_0.ja: 1＊ えええぇ！　そうなの！？/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1225_0.de:
* TP only lasts, inside a fight.
* Once you win, it's out of sight./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1225_0.en:
* TP only lasts, inside a fight.
* Once you win, it's out of sight./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1225_0.es:
* TP only lasts, inside a fight.
* Once you win, it's out of sight./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1225_0.ja:
＊ TP！　バトル終わると
　 もどるよ　ゼロ！
＊ バトル勝ったら　消えるよ　ドロン！/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1225_0.ko:
* TP는 전투가 끝나면 사라져.
* 네가 이기면 쓸데없어져./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1225_0.pl:
* PA tylko w walce się znajduje.
* Zanim wygracie, zużyjcie je, bo się zmarnuje./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1225_0.pt-BR:
* TP only lasts, inside a fight.
* Once you win, it's out of sight./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1225_0.ru:
* ПН существует в СРАЖЕНИИ лишь.
* Исчезнет оно, хоть и ты победишь./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1225_0.zh:
* TP只会持续，一整场战斗。
* 一旦取得胜利，它就会溜走。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1226_0.de:
* Having extra, feels unbearable.
* No point in saving, it's straight-up terrible./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1226_0.en:
* Having extra, feels unbearable.
* No point in saving, it's straight-up terrible./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1226_0.es:
* Having extra, feels unbearable.
* No point in saving, it's straight-up terrible./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1226_0.ja:
＊ 余分に　あっても「だからなにィ？」
＊ 使わずためても　意味ないしィ。/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1226_0.ko:
* 안 쓰고 남겨봤자 신경만 거슬리지.
* 아끼고 모아봤자 뭣도 안 되지./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1226_0.pl:
* W oszczędzaniu go sensu brak.
* Po walce i tak znika, sam nie wiem jak./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1226_0.pt-BR:
* Having extra, feels unbearable.
* No point in saving, it's straight-up terrible./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1226_0.ru:
* Копить выше меры его толку нет.
* Хранить невозможно, исчезнет в момент./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1226_0.zh:
* 拥有多余点数，令人难以忍受。
* 点数存不下来，情况简直糟透。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1228_0.de: * But leftover TP turns into extra money at the end of battle.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1228_0.en: * But leftover TP turns into extra money at the end of battle.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1228_0.es: * But leftover TP turns into extra money at the end of battle.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1228_0.ja:
＊ でも　TPが残っている状態で
　 バトルを終えると　おカネを
　 多くもらえますよ…？/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1228_0.ko:
* 쓰고 남은 TP는 
  전투가 끝나면 돈이 돼요.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1228_0.pl: * Przecież resztki PA zmieniają się pod koniec walki w walutę.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1228_0.pt-BR: * But leftover TP turns into extra money at the end of battle.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1228_0.ru: * Но в конце сражения оставшиеся ПН конвертируются в деньги.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1228_0.zh:
* 但是多出来的TP在战斗后
会变成额外的钱.../

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1230_0.de: 1* You mean I only should have been using one square!?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1230_0.en: 1* You mean I only should have been using one square!?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1230_0.es: 1* You mean I only should have been using one square!?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1230_0.ja:
1＊ ええぇ！　だったら
　 １回に使うのは　10センチまでに
　 しとけば　よかったよーーー！！/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1230_0.ko:
1* 뭐?!
  다 쓰지 말 걸 그랬다!!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1230_0.pl: 1* Czyli w ten sposób mogłem zdobyć więcej funduszy, by poprawić życia mego smak!?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1230_0.pt-BR: 1* You mean I only should have been using one square!?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1230_0.zh:
1* 照你这么说我其实只用
一点点就好了！？/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1234_0.de:
* You get TP when you DEFEND.
* Protect yourself, then cast SPELLs, friend./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1234_0.en:
* You get TP when you DEFEND.
* Protect yourself, then cast SPELLs, friend./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1234_0.es:
* You get TP when you DEFEND.
* Protect yourself, then cast SPELLs, friend./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1234_0.ja:
＊ 「ぼうぎょ」をすると　TPたまるゥ。
＊ まず身を守れば「まほう」使えるゥ。/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1234_0.ko:
* 방어하면 TP를 얻을 수 있다구.
* 방어를 하구, 마법을 쓰라구,
  친구./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1234_0.pl:
* Aby PA zdobyć, jest OBRONA.
* Chroń się, zaklęcia rzucaj, a dołączysz do zwycięzców grona./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1234_0.pt-BR:
* You get TP when you DEFEND.
* Protect yourself, then cast SPELLs, friend./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1234_0.ru:
* Вы получаете ПН, себя ЗАЩИЩАЯ.
* Затем победите, врага ЗАКЛИНАЯ./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1234_0.zh:
* 当你【防御】时会获得TP点数。
* 保护自己，然后用点【法术】。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1235_0.de: * You also get TP by getting close to bullets./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1235_0.en: * You also get TP by getting close to bullets./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1235_0.es: * You also get TP by getting close to bullets./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1235_0.ja:
＊ 敵弾　ギリで　かわしても
　 TPたまるゥ。/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1235_0.ko:
* 적탄에 스칠 때도
  TP를 얻을 수 있지./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1235_0.pt-BR: * You also get TP by getting close to bullets./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1235_0.zh: * 如果身旁擦过子弹，就能增加TP。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1236_0.de: * Look for the heart outline when you get close to bullets./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1236_0.en: * Look for the heart outline when you get close to bullets./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1236_0.es: * Look for the heart outline when you get close to bullets./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1236_0.ja:
＊ 敵弾　近づき　ハートの外側
　 枠が見えたら　TPたまるゥ。/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1236_0.ko:
* 적탄에 스칠 때는
  하트의 윤곽에 스쳐야 하지./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1236_0.pl: * Obserwuj obwódkę serca, kiedy zbliżasz się do pocisków./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1236_0.pt-BR: * Look for the heart outline when you get close to bullets./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1236_0.ru: * Контур сердца ищите, приближаясь к снарядам./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1236_0.zh: * 出现心形线框，表示获得TP。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1238_0.ja:
＊ 「TPたまる」って
　 ２回言ったな。
　 ショボいリリックだぜ。/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1238_0.ko:
* 스친다는 말을
  몇 번을 하는 거야./

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1240_0.ja:
1＊ だ…大事なことだから
　 ２回言ったんだよぅ！/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1245_0.ja:
＊ 「TPたまる」って
　 ２回言いましたね…
　 イマイチなリリックです…/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1245_0.ko:
* 스친다는 말을
  몇 번을 하는 거야...?/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1256_0.de:
* I'm Ralsei Master.
* Ask me about RALSEI's./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1256_0.en:
* I'm Ralsei Master.
* Ask me about RALSEI's./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1256_0.es:
* I'm Ralsei Master.
* Ask me about RALSEI's./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1256_0.ja:
＊ ボクは　ラルセイ・マスター。
＊ ラルセイのことなら
　 なんでも聞いて。/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1256_0.ko:
* 나는 랄세이 마스터.
* 랄세이에 관한 거라면
  뭐든 물어봐./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1256_0.pl:
* Nauczam o Ralseiu.
* Pytaj mnie o RALSEIA./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1256_0.pt-BR:
* I'm Ralsei Master.
* Ask me about RALSEI's./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1256_0.zh:
* 我是Ralsei大师。
* 问我RALSEI的事。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1264_0.de:
* Ralsei's spell's called PACIFY.
* Use it on BABIES, before they CRY./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1264_0.en:
* Ralsei's spell's called PACIFY.
* Use it on BABIES, before they CRY./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1264_0.es:
* Ralsei's spell's called PACIFY.
* Use it on BABIES, before they CRY./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1264_0.ja:
＊ 「スリープ」。
　 それは　ラルセイの「まほう」ゥ！
　 電源おとさず　パソコン消せるゥ！/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1264_0.ko:
* 랄세이는 진정 마법을 쓸 수 있어.
* 아기의 울음을 막을 수 있어./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1264_0.pl:
* Ralseia to jest zaklęcie.
* Ucisza ono DZIECIAKI, lecz niewdzięczne to zajęcie./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1264_0.pt-BR:
* Ralsei's spell's called PACIFICAR.
* Use it on BABIES, before they CRY./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1264_0.ru:
* Ральзей УСМИРЕНИЯ магию знает.
* Используй на ДЕТЯХ, когда те РЫДАЮТ./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1264_0.zh:
* Ralsei有个法术叫【安抚】。
* 在婴儿哭之前，用它把嘴堵。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1266_0.de: * What? It safely removes a "TIRED" enemy from combat./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1266_0.en: * What? It safely removes a "TIRED" enemy from combat./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1266_0.es: * What? It safely removes a "TIRED" enemy from combat./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1266_0.ja:
＊ 違います…
　 「くたびれ」状態の敵を
　 倒さずに　逃がすんです。/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1266_0.ko:
* 아니에요!
  진정 마법은 '지친' 적을
  안전하게 보낼 때 쓰는 거예요./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1266_0.pl: * Co? Ono bezpiecznie usuwa „SENNEGO” wroga z WALKI./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1266_0.pt-BR: * What? It safely removes a "TIRED" enemy from combat./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1266_0.ru: * Что? Оно безопасно выводит «УСТАВШЕГО» врага из битвы./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1266_0.zh:
* 不对！它是用来将一个“疲惫”
的敌人安全移出战斗的。/

1＊ ボク　なんか

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1353_0.zh: 1* 我说了什么好笑的话吗！？/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1356_0.en: * Susie's gone, so no facts./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1356_0.ja:
＊ スージィいないよ。
　 マメ知識も　ないよォ。/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1356_0.pl: * Susie z wami nie ma, więc i faktów brak./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1356_0.ru: * Сьюзи исчезла, значит фактам не место./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1356_0.zh: * Susie已经离去，小知识没意义。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1357_0.de: * Will you two pick up the slackts?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1357_0.en: * Will you two pick up the slackts?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1357_0.es: * Will you two pick up the slackts?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1357_0.ja:
＊ キミたち２人が
　 すりゃいんじゃないォ？/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1357_0.pl: * I tak wiecie o niej wszystko, czyż nie jest tak?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1357_0.pt-BR: * Will you two pick up the slackts?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1357_0.ru: * Может, кто-то из вас займёт её место?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1357_0.zh: * 你们俩还能否收拾这场残局？/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1361_0.de: * SUSIE seems to have changed, just a hair./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1361_0.en: * SUSIE seems to have changed, just a hair./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1361_0.es: * SUSIE seems to have changed, just a hair./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1361_0.ja: ＊ スージィ変わった　毛ほどの変化ァ。/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1361_0.pl: * Poprawa zachowania SUSIE, to niezła zagadka./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1361_0.pt-BR: * SUSIE seems to have changed, just a hair./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1361_0.ru: * Сьюзи ныне другая, перемен лишь настрой./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1361_0.zh: * 看来SUSIE总算有了，一丝丝改变。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1362_0.de: * That kind of growth is actually rare./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1362_0.en: * That kind of growth is actually rare./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1362_0.es: * That kind of growth is actually rare./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1362_0.ja: ＊ そんな成長　かなりレアァ！/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1362_0.ko: * 이런 거 살짝 드문 것 같아./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1362_0.pl: * Taka zmiana charakteru jest dziś bardzo rzadka./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1362_0.pt-BR: * That kind of growth is actually rare./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1362_0.ru: * Как мало всех тех, кто растёт над собой./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1362_0.zh: * 这样的成长还是挺罕见。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1378_0.de:
* I'm Kris Master.
* Ask me about KRIS's./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1378_0.en:
* I'm Kris Master.
* Ask me about KRIS's./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1378_0.es:
* I'm Kris Master.
* Ask me about KRIS's./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1378_0.ja:
＊ ボクは　クリス・マスター。
＊ クリスのことなら　なんでも聞いて。/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1378_0.ko:
* 나는 크리스 마스터.
* 크리스에 관한 거라면
  뭐든 물어봐./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1378_0.pl:
* Nauczam o Kris.
* Pytaj mnie o KRIS./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1378_0.pt-BR:
* I'm Kris Master.
* Ask me about KRIS's./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1378_0.zh:
* 我是Kris大师。
* 问我关于KRIS的事。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1386_0.de: * When HP goes negative, your friends fall down/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1386_0.en: * When HP goes negative, your friends fall down/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1386_0.es: * When HP goes negative, your friends fall down/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1386_0.ja:
＊ HPゼロより下がると
　 仲間は気絶ゥ。/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1386_0.pl: * Kiedy PZ zabraknie, padną na glebę twoi przyjaciele./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1386_0.pt-BR: * When HP goes negative, your friends fall down/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1386_0.ru: * Как ОЗ упадут, так ваш друг вслед за ним./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1386_0.zh: * HP变成负数时，你的朋友会倒下。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1387_0.de: * But bringing them back, is easy-town/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1387_0.en: * But bringing them back, is easy-town/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1387_0.es: * But bringing them back, is easy-town/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1387_0.ja: ＊ でもだいじょうぶゥ。すぐに復活ゥ。/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1387_0.pl: * Ale wyleczenie ich, nie kosztuje wiele./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1387_0.pt-BR: * But bringing them back, is easy-town/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1387_0.ru: * Но верни его в строй, знай секрет лишь один./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1387_0.zh: * 要让他们站起来，方法简单又廉价。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1388_0.de: * Plain foods and spells, work like a charm -/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1388_0.en: * Plain foods and spells, work like a charm -/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1388_0.es: * Plain foods and spells, work like a charm -/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1388_0.ja:
＊ 普通の食べ物…　回復まほうゥ…
　 どちらも　バッチリ効果アリィ！/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1388_0.ko:
* 그냥 음식과 마법만 있으면
  요술같이 해결돼./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1388_0.pl: * Zwykłe jedzenie i czary, działają jak marzenie.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1388_0.pt-BR: * Plain foods and spells, work like a charm -/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1388_0.zh: * 简单的食物和法术，效果响当当-/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1389_0.de: * And with a MINT, you can cure all HARM./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1389_0.en: * And with a MINT, you can cure all HARM./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1389_0.es: * And with a MINT, you can cure all HARM./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1389_0.ja:
＊ 「ミント」を使えば　一気に復活ゥ！
　 HPだってMAXにィ！/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1389_0.ko:
* 근데 부활 민트가 있으면
  완전하게 해결돼./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1389_0.pl: * A dzięki MIĘTCE, członek drużyny przejdzie pełne leczenie./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1389_0.pt-BR: * And with a MINT, you can cure all HARM./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1389_0.ru: * А ЛЕДЕНЦОМ ты можешь с нуля воскресить./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1389_0.zh: * 要是用上了薄荷糖，治疗所有伤。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1391_0.de: * Even normal items and spells can revive people, huh?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1391_0.en: * Even normal items and spells can revive people, huh?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1391_0.es: * Even normal items and spells can revive people, huh?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1391_0.ja:
＊ つまり　普通の回復アイテムや
　 まほうでも　気絶した仲間を
　 復活させられるってこと？/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1391_0.ko:
* 그러니까 평범한 음식이랑
  마법으로도 동료들을
  살릴 수 있단 말이죠?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1391_0.pl: * Wiesz, że nawet normalne jedzenie i czary są w stanie odrodzić?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1391_0.pt-BR: * Even normal items and spells can revive people, huh?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1391_0.ru: * То есть можно исцелять даже обычными вещами, да?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1391_0.zh:
* 就连一般的物品和法术
也能使人复活，对吧？/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1393_0.en: * Yeah, that's what I'm saying!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1393_0.pl: * Tak, dokładnie to miałem na myśli!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1393_0.ru: * Да, о чём я и говорю!/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1398_0.de: * If you only ACT, you might start to think -/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1398_0.en: * If you only ACT, you might start to think -/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1398_0.es: * If you only ACT, you might start to think -/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1398_0.ja:
＊ キミはきっと　こう思うゥ。
　 「自分ばっかり『こうどう』」ゥ…/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1398_0.ko:
* 행동만 할 때는
  고민할 수 있지./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1398_0.pl: * Jeśli tylko ty możesz CZYNIĆ, to pewnie ci wpadło do głowy.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1398_0.pt-BR: * If you only ACT, you might start to think -/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1398_0.ru: * Коль ДЕЙСТВУЕШЬ, то держи при уме.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1398_0.zh: * 当你采取【行动】时，可以想想看-/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1399_0.de: * What about the guy with the scarf in pink?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1399_0.en: * What about the guy with the scarf in pink?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1399_0.es: * What about the guy with the scarf in pink?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1399_0.ja:
＊ 「ピンクのマフラーのヤツは
　 なにする」ゥ？/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1399_0.ko:
* 스카프 두른 애는
  뭘 시켜야 하지?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1399_0.pl: * Po co w drużynie ten w szaliku gość młody?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1399_0.pt-BR: * What about the guy with the scarf in pink?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1399_0.ru: * Что ты не один ведёшь бой в этой тьме./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1399_0.zh: * 让那个戴粉色围巾的怎么干？/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1401_0.de: * If you know ACTing will make the enemy friendly -/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1401_0.en: * If you know ACTing will make the enemy friendly -/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1401_0.es: * If you know ACTing will make the enemy friendly -/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1401_0.ja:
＊ クリスの「こうどう」で
　 敵と仲よくなれると
　 わかっているときは…/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1401_0.ko:
* 네 행동으로 상대가
  얌전해질 것 같으면.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1401_0.pl: * Jeśli wiesz, że twój CZYN uszczęśliwi wroga,/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1401_0.pt-BR: * If you know ACTing will make the enemy friendly -/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1401_0.ru: * Если ты знаешь, что твоё ДЕЙСТВИЕ расположит врага к нам.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1401_0.zh:
* 如果你事先知道这次
【行动】会让敌人变得友好-/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1402_0.de: * Then you can ask me to SPARE on the SAME TURN./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1402_0.en: * Then you can ask me to SPARE on the SAME TURN./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1402_0.es: * Then you can ask me to SPARE on the SAME TURN./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1402_0.ja:
＊ ボクには　敵を「にがす」
　 ように指示してくれれば
　 ターンを節約できるよ。/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1402_0.ko:
* 같은 턴에 나한테
  보내주라고 지시하면 돼./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1402_0.pl: * To możesz mnie poprosić, bym go OSZCZĘDZIŁ w TEJ SAMEJ TURZE./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1402_0.pt-BR: * Then you can ask me to SPARE on the SAME TURN./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1402_0.ru: * То ты можешь попросить меня ПОЩАДИТЬ его в тот же ход./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1402_0.zh:
* 那么你就可以让我
在同一回合里使用【饶恕】。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1403_0.de: * Or, cast PACIFY if you know they'll get TIRED./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1403_0.en: * Or, cast PACIFY if you know they'll get TIRED./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1403_0.es: * Or, cast PACIFY if you know they'll get TIRED./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1403_0.ja:
＊ 敵が「くたびれ」ると
　 わかっているときは
　 「スリープ」を使えばいい。/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1403_0.ko:
* 적이 지칠 것 같으면
  진정 마법을 쓰면 돼./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1403_0.pl: * Albo mogę rzucić zaklęcie SENNIK, gdy wiesz, że będzie SENNY./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1403_0.pt-BR: * Or, cast PACIFICAR if you know they'll get TIRED./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1403_0.ru: * Или использовать УСМИРЕНИЕ, если знаешь, что он УСТАНЕТ./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1403_0.zh:
* 或者，在你知道他们将要【疲惫】
的时候施展【安抚】。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1404_0.de: * If you plan ahead, a lot can happen in ONE TURN!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1404_0.en: * If you plan ahead, a lot can happen in ONE TURN!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1404_0.es: * If you plan ahead, a lot can happen in ONE TURN!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1404_0.ja:
＊ うまく先を読んで動けば
　 1ターンのあいだに
　 いろんなことができるよ！/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1404_0.ko:
* 계획만 잘 세우면,
  한 턴에 많은 걸
  할 수 있어!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1404_0.pl: * Jeśli zaplanujesz swoje ruchy, to możesz wiele osiągnąć w JEDNEJ TURZE!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1404_0.pt-BR: * If you plan ahead, a lot can happen in ONE TURN!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1404_0.ru: * Если планировать всё наперёд, многое можно сделать ЗА ХОД!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1404_0.zh:
* 只要你提前规划好，
就可以在一回合里解决很多事！/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1406_0.de: 1* Hey, who's the MASTER here, me or you!?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1406_0.en: 1* Hey, who's the MASTER here, me or you!?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1406_0.es: 1* Hey, who's the MASTER here, me or you!?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1406_0.ja:
1＊ ちょっと！　マスターはボクだ！
　 キミじゃない！/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1406_0.pl: 1* Ej, kto tu jest NAUCZYCIELEM, ty, czy ja!?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1406_0.pt-BR: 1* Hey, who's the MASTER here, me or you!?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1406_0.ru: 1* Эй, кто здесь МАСТЕР, я или ты?!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1406_0.zh:
1* 嘿，这儿谁才是大师，
是你还是我！？/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1410_0.de: * It's a good idea, to give us BUCKs./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1410_0.en: * It's a good idea, to give us BUCKs./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1410_0.es: * It's a good idea, to give us BUCKs./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1410_0.ja: ＊ どんどんしよう　ボクらに寄付ゥ。/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1410_0.ko:
* 너희 돈을 내게 주면,
  좋은 일 벌어지지./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1410_0.pl: * Dobrym planem jest dać nam SZMAL./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1410_0.pt-BR: * It's a good idea, to give us BUCKs./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1410_0.zh: * 若给我们钱，是个好主意。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1411_0.de: * It'll make you happy, and fill you with LUCKs./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1411_0.en: * It'll make you happy, and fill you with LUCKs./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1411_0.es: * It'll make you happy, and fill you with LUCKs./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1411_0.ja: ＊ 幸運授かり　ハッピーになるゥ。/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1411_0.pl: * Dzięki temu nie będzie cię trapił ŻAL./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1411_0.pt-BR: * It'll make you happy, and fill you with LUCKs./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1411_0.zh: * 带给你开心，还有好运气。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1412_0.de: * Over there, is our DONATION HOLE./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1412_0.en: * Over there, is our DONATION HOLE./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1412_0.es: * Over there, is our DONATION HOLE./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1412_0.ja: ＊ あそこにあるよ　「募金ホール」ゥ。/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1412_0.pl: * Oto nasza dziura DOTACJI, jakbyście nie zgadli./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1412_0.pt-BR: * Over there, is our DONATION HOLE./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1412_0.ru: * ЯМУ для денег мы здесь откопали./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1412_0.zh: * 我们的募捐洞，就在那头。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1413_0.de: * We had a BOX, but it got STOLE./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1413_0.en: * We had a BOX, but it got STOLE./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1413_0.es: * We had a BOX, but it got STOLE./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1413_0.ja:
＊ 盗まれちゃったよ
　 「募金ボックス」ゥ。/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1413_0.pl: * Mieliśmy PUDEŁKO, ale nam je ukradli./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1413_0.pt-BR: * We had a BOX, but it got STOLE./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1413_0.zh: * 我们曾有个箱子，但它早已被偷。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1423_0.de: * (If you like our tutorials, please throw your money into a hole.)/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1423_0.en: * (If you like our tutorials, please throw your money into a hole.)/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1423_0.es: * (If you like our tutorials, please throw your money into a hole.)/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1423_0.ja:
＊ (私たちの　チュートリアルに
　 ご満足いただけたなら
　 穴に　おカネを入れてください)/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1423_0.ko:
* (우리 튜토리얼이 마음에 드시면,
  돈을 구멍에 넣어 주세요.)/

　 ありがとう。スージィも

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1790_0.de: * Well, well. I am the smith Malius. I can fix anything. Weapon, armor.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1790_0.en: * Well, well. I am the smith Malius. I can fix anything. Weapon, armor.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1790_0.es: * Well, well. I am the smith Malius. I can fix anything. Weapon, armor.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1790_0.ja:
＊ わが名はマリウス。鍛冶を極めし者。
　 私に直せぬものはない。
　 武器だろうと　防具だろうと…/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1790_0.ko:
* 그래... 나는 대장장이 말리우스.
  뭐든 고칠 수 있지. 무기, 방어구.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1790_0.pl: * Witam, witam. Zwą mnie Kowalskim. Mogę naprawić wszystko. Zbroję, broń.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1790_0.pt-BR: * Well, well. I am the smith Malius. I can fix anything. Weapon, armor.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1790_0.ru: * Что ж, что ж. Я кузнец Млатий. Я могу починить что угодно. Оружие, броню.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1790_0.zh:
* 啧啧。我是铁匠Malius。
我什么都会修理。武器，防具.../

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1791_0.de: * ... I can even fix you! Well, well, what will it be?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1791_0.en: * ... I can even fix you! Well, well, what will it be?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1791_0.es: * ... I can even fix you! Well, well, what will it be?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1791_0.ja:
＊ …おぬしの体であろうとな！
　 さて　今日は　なにをお望みか？/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1791_0.ko:
* ... 그대의 몸도 말일세!
  그래..
  뭘 고치겠소?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1791_0.pl: * ...nawet WAS! Dobrze, już dobrze, w czym mogę pomóc?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1791_0.pt-BR: * ... I can even fix you! Well, well, what will it be?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1791_0.ru: * ...И даже вас самих! Что ж, что ж, чего вы хотите?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1791_0.zh:
* ...连你也能修理！
啧，啧，有何贵干？/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1796_0.en: * Hm? What is it now?/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1813_0.de: * Well, well. You have nothing to fix./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1813_0.en: * Well, well. You have nothing to fix./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1813_0.es: * Well, well. You have nothing to fix./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1813_0.ja:
＊ はて…
　 直すべき物を
　 持っておられぬようだが。/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1813_0.pl: * No dobrze, dobrze. Nie macie już niczego do naprawienia./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1813_0.pt-BR: * Well, well. You have nothing to fix./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1813_0.ru: * Что ж, что ж. У вас нечего чинить./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1813_0.zh:
* 哎呀，哎呀。
你们没有可以修理的东西。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1814_0.de: * But if you find anything BROKEN, return here./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1814_0.en: * But if you find anything BROKEN, return here./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1814_0.es: * But if you find anything BROKEN, return here./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1814_0.ja:
＊ 「こわれた」物を見つけたならば
　 再び私を訪ねてきなさい。/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1814_0.ko:
* 뭔가 망가진 걸 찾으면,
  나에게 가져와 주시오./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1814_0.pl: * Ale jak znajdziecie coś ZEPSUTEGO, to zapraszam./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1814_0.pt-BR: * But if you find anything BROKEN, return here./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1814_0.ru: * Но если вы найдёте что-то СЛОМАННОЕ, возвращайтесь./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1814_0.zh:
* 但如果你们找到什么坏掉的东西，
就来这吧。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1815_0.de: * After all, I can fix anything.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1815_0.en: * After all, I can fix anything.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1815_0.es: * After all, I can fix anything.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1815_0.ja: ＊ 私に直せぬものはない…/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1815_0.pt-BR: * After all, I can fix anything.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1815_0.ru: * В конце концов, я могу починить всё.../

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1816_0.en: * ... except for a BROKEN HEART./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1816_0.ja:
＊ …ただひとつ
　 「こわれた心」を　のぞいてはな。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1821_0.de: * Huh---! That CAKE is seething with energy! You must let me fix it!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1821_0.en: * Huh---! That CAKE is seething with energy! You must let me fix it!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1821_0.es: * Huh---! That CAKE is seething with energy! You must let me fix it!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1821_0.ja:
＊ なんと…！　そのケーキからは
　 すさまじい気が　感じられる！
　 よろこんで直させていただこう！/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1821_0.ko:
* 헛! 그 케이크에서 기운이
  끓어오르고 있군!
  내가 꼭 고쳐야겠소!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1821_0.pl: * Coo...! To CIASTO wypełnia energia! Pozwólcie mi je naprawić!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1821_0.pt-BR: * Huh---! That CAKE is seething with energy! You must let me fix it!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1821_0.ru: * А!.. Этот ТОРТ просто кипит энергией! Вы должны дать мне починить его!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1821_0.zh:
* 嗬--！那块蛋糕里翻腾着能量！
务必让我修好它！/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1822_0.de: * Hu-ha! Lasst uns meine Technik spüren!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1822_0.en: * Huh-hah! Let's feel my technique!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1822_0.ja:
＊ フッ！　ハッ！
　 わが究極の技　とくと見よ！/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1822_0.pl: * Hih-hah! Pokażę wam, na co mnie stać!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1822_0.zh: * 嗬-哈！来感受我的技术吧！/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1829_0.de: * ... actually, you will need a free space in your ITEMs first./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1829_0.en: * ... actually, you will need a free space in your ITEMs first./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1829_0.es: * ... actually, you will need a free space in your ITEMs first./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1829_0.ja:
＊ …が　まずは「アイテム」の
　 空きスペースを作るのだ。よいな？/

* ...但是，你的【物品】
也得有空位才行。/

  내가 꼭 고쳐야겠소!/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1834_0.pt-BR: * Huh---! That KEY is seething with energy! You must let me fix it!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1834_0.ru: * А!.. Этот КЛЮЧ просто кипит энергией! Вы должны дать мне починить его!/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1842_0.de: * Well, well. Good journey, my friends./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1842_0.en: * Well, well. Good journey, my friends./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1842_0.es: * Bueno, bueno. Tened buen viaje, amigos míos./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1842_0.ja:
＊ さようか。
　 では　よき旅を。/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1842_0.ko:
* 그래...
  즐거운 여행 되게나, 나의 친구들./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1842_0.pt-BR: * Well, well. Good journey, my friends./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1842_0.ru: * Что ж, что ж. Удачи вам, друзья./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1842_0.zh: * 哎呀，哎呀。一路顺风，我的友人。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1846_0.de: * Your body is a weapon, too. You must take care of it from time to time./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1846_0.en: * Your body is a weapon, too. You must take care of it from time to time./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1846_0.es: * Your body is a weapon, too. You must take care of it from time to time./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1846_0.ja:
＊ おぬしの体もまた　武器である。
　 こまめに手入れを　せねばならぬぞ。/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1846_0.ko:
* 그대의 몸 또한 무기.
  시간이 날 때마다
  몸을 정갈히 다듬으시게./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1846_0.pl: * Wasze ciała to też broń. Trzeba o nie zadbać od czasu do czasu./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1846_0.pt-BR: * Your body is a weapon, too. You must take care of it from time to time./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1846_0.ru: * Ваше тело — тоже оружие. Время от времени ему тоже нужен уход./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1846_0.zh:

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2135_0.de: 3Ah, my co-workers. Where would I be without them?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2135_0.en: 3* Ah, my co-workers. Where would I be without them?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2135_0.es: 3* Ah, my co-workers. Where would I be without them?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2135_0.ja:
3＊ ま　そんな　ゆかいな
　 なかまたちだ。こいつらが
　 いなかったら　オレは…/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2135_0.ko:
3* 아, 소중한 동료들.
  내가 얘들 없이 어떻게
  일을 할까?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2135_0.pl: 3* Ach, moi znajomi z pracy. Co ja bym bez nich zrobił?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2135_0.pt-BR: 3* Ah, my co-workers. Where would I be without them?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2135_0.ru: 3* Ах, мои коллеги. Как бы я жил без них?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2135_0.zh:
3* 啊，我的同事们。
没了他们我能去哪？/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2136_0.de: 1A happy place, little buddy. A much happier place./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2136_0.en: 1* A happy place, little buddy. A much happier place./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2136_0.es: 1* A happy place, little buddy. A much happier place./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2136_0.ja:
1＊ ここより　ずっとマシな
　 ばしょで　ずっとマシな
　 じんせい　おくってるぜ。/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2136_0.ko:
1* ... 행복하게... 지금보다 
  훨씬 더 행복하게 일하겠지./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2136_0.pl: 1* Życie bym sobie ułożył, mordeczko. Życie bym sobie ułożył./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2136_0.pt-BR: 1* A happy place, little buddy. A much happier place./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2136_0.zh:
1* 一个好地方，小家伙。
一个好得多的地方。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2141_0.de: 3It's fine, Little Buddy. You don't have to watch me suffer./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2141_0.en: 3* It's fine, Little Buddy. You don't have to watch me suffer./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2141_0.es: 3* It's fine, Little Buddy. You don't have to watch me suffer./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2141_0.ja:
3＊ かまわないぜ。オレの
　 なさけない　すがたなんて
　 みなくていい。/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2141_0.ko:
3* 괜찮아, 꼬마 친구.
  남의 고통을 굳이
  지켜보고 있을 필요는 없어./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2141_0.pl: 3* Dobrze, mordeczko. Nie musisz patrzeć jak cierpię./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2141_0.pt-BR: 3* It's fine, Little Buddy. You don't have to watch me suffer./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2141_0.ru: 3* Всё в порядке, дружище. Не стоит смотреть на мои страдания./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2141_0.zh:
3* 没事，小家伙。
你不用看着我遭受苦难。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2142_0.de: 1Just enjoy your freedom... While it lasts.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2142_0.en: 1* Just enjoy your freedom... While it lasts.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2142_0.es: 1* Just enjoy your freedom... While it lasts.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2142_0.ja:
1＊ アンタは　じゆうを
　 たのしみな。それができる
　 いまのうちにな…/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2142_0.ko:
1* 자유를 즐겨...
  즐길 수 있을 때.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2142_0.pt-BR: 1* Just enjoy your freedom... While it lasts.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2142_0.ru: 1* Просто... Наслаждайся свободой... Пока ещё можешь.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2142_0.zh:
1* 好好享受自由吧...
趁你还没失去它.../

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2147_0.ja:
ジュース
ください

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2151_0.de:
* Kris... What a pleasant surprise to see you here.
* And on a school day./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2151_0.en:
* Kris... What a pleasant surprise to see you here.
* And on a school day./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2151_0.es:
* Kris... What a pleasant surprise to see you here.
* And on a school day./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2151_0.ja:
＊ おやおや　クリス…　めずらしい。
　 でも　うれしいですね。へいじつに
　 きょうかいへ　きてくれるとは。/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2151_0.ko:
* 크리스... 혼자서도
  교회에 오다니 기쁘구나.
* 그것도 평일에 말이야./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2151_0.pl:
* Kris... Twoja dzisiejsza wizyta jest miłą niespodzianką.
* I to w dzień powszedni./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2151_0.pt-BR:
* Kris... What a pleasant surprise to see you here.
* And on a school day./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2151_0.ru:
* Крис... Как приятно видеть тебя здесь.
* Особенно в учебный день./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2151_0.zh:
* Kris... 
能在这儿遇到你还真是个惊喜。
* 况且还是上学的日子。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2152_0.de: * There must be a reason that you came here at such a time./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2152_0.en: * There must be a reason that you came here at such a time./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2152_0.es: * There must be a reason that you came here at such a time./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2152_0.ja:
＊ わざわざ　たずねてきたのには
　 なにか　わけが　あるのでしょう。/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2152_0.ko:
* 이런 시간에 찾아온 데에는
  분명 뭔가 이유가 있겠지./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2152_0.pl: * Musisz mieć jakiś bardzo ważny powód./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2152_0.pt-BR: * There must be a reason that you came here at such a time./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2152_0.ru: * Интересно, что привело тебя ко мне в такое время./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2152_0.zh:
* 你现在这个时候过来
肯定有什么原因吧。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2153_0.de:
* I, Father Alvin, implore you.
* If you have anything weighing on your mind, please, speak./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2153_0.en:
* I, Father Alvin, implore you.
* If you have anything weighing on your mind, please, speak./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2153_0.es:
* I, Father Alvin, implore you.
* If you have anything weighing on your mind, please, speak./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2153_0.ja:
＊ さあ　このアルビン師に
　 はなしてごらんなさい。
＊ なやみごとが　あるのですか？/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2153_0.ko:
* 나, 앨빈 신부가 청하니, 
* 마음속에 짐이 있다면,
  털어놓아도 좋단다./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2153_0.pl:
* Ja, ojciec Alvin, nalegam.
* Przemów, jeśli coś ci leży na sercu./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2153_0.pt-BR:
* I, Father Alvin, implore you.
* If you have anything weighing on your mind, please, speak./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2153_0.ru:
* Я, отец Элвин, прошу тебя.
* Если тебя что-то тяготит, поделись этим со мной./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2153_0.zh:
* 我，Alvin神父，殷切地希望... 
* 如果你有任何精神负担的话，
请一定要，向我倾诉。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2160_0.de: * Kris, if you want some of our "sick" Fruit Juice, you should come to our service./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2160_0.en: * Kris, if you want some of our "sick" Fruit Juice, you should come to our service./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2160_0.es: * Kris, if you want some of our "sick" Fruit Juice, you should come to our service./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2160_0.ja:
＊ クリス　きょうかいの　「ヤバい」
　 ジュースが　のみたいのなら
　 れいはいに　くることですよ。/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2160_0.ko:
* 크리스, 우리 교회의 
  과일 주스가 그렇게 좋다면
  우리와 함께하는 건 어떠니./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2160_0.pl: * Kris, jeśli chcesz napić się naszego „fajowego” soku owocowego, przyjdź na mszę./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2160_0.pt-BR: * Kris, if you want some of our "sick" Fruit Juice, you should come to our service./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2160_0.ru: * Крис, если ты хочешь нашего «крутого» сока, тебе стоит прийти на службу./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2160_0.zh:
* Kris，想喝我们“奇葩”的果汁
的话，你就应该来参加礼拜。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2161_0.de: * Our choir sounds a bit thinner since your brother went away./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2161_0.en: * Our choir sounds a bit thinner since your brother went away./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2161_0.es: * Our choir sounds a bit thinner since your brother went away./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2161_0.ja:
＊ クリスのおにいさんが　ぬけて
　 コーラスたいの　うたごえにも
　 はりが　なくなってしまいました。/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2161_0.ko:
* 아스리엘이 떠난 뒤로
  합창단의 화음이 많이
  약해졌단다./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2161_0.pl: * Nasz chór jest niekompletny, odkąd twój brat wyjechał na studia./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2161_0.pt-BR: * Our choir sounds a bit thinner since your brother went away./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2161_0.ru: * Наш хор стал звучать чуть тоньше с тех пор, как твой брат уехал./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2161_0.zh:
* 我们的唱诗班自从你哥哥离开后
音色就稍显不够丰满了。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2162_0.de: * Kris, it would be wonderful if you would sing with us./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2162_0.en: * Kris, it would be wonderful if you would sing with us./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2162_0.es: * Kris, it would be wonderful if you would sing with us./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2162_0.ja:
＊ かわりに　クリスが
　 はいってくれたら
　 だいかんげいですよ。/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2162_0.ko:
* 크리스, 네가 우리와 함께
  노래해 준다면 정말 기쁠 거야./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2162_0.pl: * Kris, byłoby cudownie, jakby twój głos zasilił nasze szeregi./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2162_0.pt-BR: * Kris, it would be wonderful if you would sing with us./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2162_0.ru: * Крис, было бы чудесно услышать твой голос в нашем хоре./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2162_0.zh:
* Kris，如果你能来和我们一起唱
就再好不过了。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2163_0.de: * Or even participated to any extent,/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2163_0.en: * Or even participated to any extent,/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2163_0.es: * Or even participated to any extent,/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2163_0.ja:
＊ せめて　きょうかいの　かつどうに
　 さんかしてくれるだけでも
　 いいのです。/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2163_0.ko:
* 노래가 아니더라도, 
  어떤 역할이든 기여해 주면
  고마울 거야./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2163_0.pl: * Lecz nie pogardzimy samą twoją obecnością,/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2163_0.pt-BR: * Or even participated to any extent,/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2163_0.ru: * Или получить хоть какую-то помощь от тебя,/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2163_0.zh: * 哪怕只是随便参与一下。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2164_0.de: * Instead of just trying to drink the Fruit Juice./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2164_0.en: * Instead of just trying to drink the Fruit Juice./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2164_0.es: * Instead of just trying to drink the Fruit Juice./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2164_0.ja:
＊ ジュースだけ　もらおうと
　 するのではなくてね。/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2164_0.ko: * 그냥 과일 주스만 마시려 하지 말고./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2164_0.pl: * Jeśli nie rzucisz się od razu na sok owocowy./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2164_0.pt-BR: * Instead of just trying to drink the Fruit Juice./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2164_0.ru: * Вместо постоянных попыток выпить нашего сока./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2164_0.zh:
* 也总比一门心思
就想喝那果汁来得好。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2168_0.de:
* I understand.
* I hope in time you may find the words you seek./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2168_0.en:
* I understand.
* I hope in time you may find the words you seek./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2168_0.es:
* I understand.
* I hope in time you may find the words you seek./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2168_0.ja:
＊ わかりました。
＊ じきに　じぶんでも　はなしたい
　 ことが　わかってくるでしょう。/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2168_0.ko:
* 이해한단다.
* 진정 원하는 것을
  찾는 날이 금방 오길 바라마./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2168_0.pl:
* Rozumiem.
* Wierzę, że niedługo objawią ci się słowa, których szukasz./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2168_0.pt-BR:
* I understand.
* I hope in time you may find the words you seek./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2168_0.ru:
* Понимаю.
* Надеюсь, ты найдёшь слова, которые ищешь./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2168_0.zh:
* 我明白了。
* 希望终有一天你能寻找到
想要倾诉的话语。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2169_0.de: * Let the Angel's power light your way./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2169_0.en: * Let the Angel's power light your way./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2169_0.es: * Let the Angel's power light your way./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2169_0.ja:
＊ てんしさまの　みちからが
　 クリスの　ゆくてを
　 てらしますよう。/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2169_0.ko:
* 너의 앞길을 천사의 힘이
  밝혀 주기를./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2169_0.pl: * Niech moc Anioła oświetli ci drogę./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2169_0.pt-BR: * Let the Angel's power light your way./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2169_0.zh: * 愿天使之力照亮你的前路。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2178_0.ja: ＊ (かおりつきの　マーカーだ)/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2185_0.de: * (You dig out the marshmallow one and start huffing it.)/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2185_0.en: * (You dig out the marshmallow one and start huffing it.)/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2185_0.es: * (You dig out the marshmallow one and start huffing it.)/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2185_0.ja:
＊ (マシュマロの　かおりの
　 マーカーを　てにとり
　 クンクン　においを　かいだ)/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2185_0.pl: * (Znajdujesz marker o zapachu pianek i zaczynasz go wdychać.)/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2185_0.pt-BR: * (Você pega o de marshmallow e dá umas cheiradas nele.)/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2185_0.ru: * (Вы достали маркер с ароматом зефира и стали обнюхивать.)/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2185_0.zh:
* （你把棉花糖味的那支挖出来
并朝着笔尖哈气。）/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2189_0.de: * (The chocolate one smells too fake anyway.)/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2189_0.en: * (The chocolate one smells too fake anyway.)/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2189_0.es: * (The chocolate one smells too fake anyway.)/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2189_0.ja:
＊ (どうせ　チョコレートの　かおりの
　 マーカーは　ニセモノしゅうが
　 ひどい)/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2189_0.pl: * (Ten czekoladowy i tak pachnie zbyt sztucznie.)/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2189_0.pt-BR: * (O de chocolate tem um cheiro falso demais, mesmo.)/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2189_0.zh: * （反正那支巧克力味的闻起来太假了。）/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2198_0.ja:
＊ (トイレだ)
＊ (みずを　ながす？)/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2219_0.ja:
＊ (みずを　むだづかい　しないのは
　 いいことだ)/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2228_0.de: * (It's an obligatory hospital piano, shrunk to fit in the corner.)/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2228_0.en: * (It's an obligatory hospital piano, shrunk to fit in the corner.)/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2228_0.es: * (It's an obligatory hospital piano, shrunk to fit in the corner.)/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2228_0.ja:
＊ (びょういんに　とってつけたように
　 おいてある　ピアノだ。スペースに
　 はまるよう　ちぢめてある)/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2228_0.ko:
* (의무상 비치된 병원 피아노,
  구석에 비집어 넣어두려고
  크기를 줄였다.)/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2228_0.pl: * (Szpitalne pianino. Pomniejszono je, by zmieściło się w kącie.)/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2228_0.pt-BR: * (É um piano hospitalar obrigatório, encolhido para caber no canto.)/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2228_0.ru: * (Стандартное больничное пианино. Чтобы уместилось в угол, пришлось его уменьшить.)/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2228_0.zh:
* （医院的公用钢琴，
为了能放在角落里而做得很小。）/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2229_0.de: * (As a result, it's missing most of the good keys.)/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2229_0.en: * (As a result, it's missing most of the good keys.)/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2229_0.es: * (As a result, it's missing most of the good keys.)/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2229_0.ja:
＊ (そのせいで
　 よい　けんばんが
　 ほとんど　なくなっている)/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2229_0.pl: * (Niestety przez to brakuje w nim większości dobrych klawiszy.)/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2229_0.pt-BR: * (Como resultado, falta a maioria das teclas boas.)/

＊ ワシは　足が速いぞよ？
　 頭もキレる。頭が回る。/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2702_0.ko:
* 하지만 난 빨라요, 빨라,
  똑똑해요, 똑똑해./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2702_0.pl: * ALE JESTEM ZWINNY, ZWINNY, SPRYTNY, SPRYTNY./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2702_0.pt-BR: * BUT I'M FAST, FAST, CLEVER, CLEVER./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2702_0.ru: * НО Я БЫСТР, БЫСТР, УМЁН, УМЁН./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2702_0.zh:
* 但我很快，很快，
很聪明，很聪明。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2703_0.de: * THEY LOST THE CHASE, AND LOCKED UP THEIR ENTIRE RACE,/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2703_0.en: * THEY LOST THE CHASE, AND LOCKED UP THEIR ENTIRE RACE,/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2703_0.es: * THEY LOST THE CHASE, AND LOCKED UP THEIR ENTIRE RACE,/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2703_0.ja:
＊ 追いかけっこは　ボクの勝ち。
　 王たちが捕えたのは　自分の民。/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2703_0.ko:
* 그들은 나를 놓쳐놓고는.
* 자기들을 전부 가뒀어요,/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2703_0.pl: * STRACILI MNIE Z OCZU I UWIĘZILI CAŁY SWÓJ LUD./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2703_0.pt-BR: * THEY LOST THE CHASE, AND LOCKED UP THEIR ENTIRE RACE,/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2703_0.ru: * ОНИ ПРОИГРАЛИ В ГОНКЕ, ТЕПЕРЬ СВЕТА НЕ УВИДЕТЬ ПОТОМКАМ,/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2703_0.zh:
* 国王们抓不到我，
便把自己的族人统统关了起来，/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2704_0.de: * BUILDING A PRISON AROUND THE WHOLE WORLD. NOW I'M THE ONLY FREE ONE./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2704_0.en: * BUILDING A PRISON AROUND THE WHOLE WORLD. NOW I'M THE ONLY FREE ONE./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2704_0.es: * BUILDING A PRISON AROUND THE WHOLE WORLD. NOW I'M THE ONLY FREE ONE./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2704_0.ja:
＊ 世界のぐるりを囲むよに
　 大きな　ろう屋を　こしらえた。
　 自由の身なのは　私だけ。/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2704_0.ko:
* 온 세상 둘러 감옥을 세웠어요.
  이젠 나만 자유로운 몸./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2704_0.pl: * OTOCZYLI KRÓLESTWO MURAMI, NICZYM WIĘZIENIE. TERAZ TYLKO JA JESTEM WOLNY./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2704_0.pt-BR: * BUILDING A PRISON AROUND THE WHOLE WORLD. NOW I'M THE ONLY FREE ONE./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2704_0.ru: * ПОСТРОИВ ТЮРЬМУ МИР ОХВАТИВ. ОСТАВИВ ЛИШЬ МЕНЯ НА СВОБОДЕ./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2704_0.zh:
* 围绕整个世界建起了监狱。
现在我是唯一自由的人。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2706_0.de: * Huh? Free? But you're clearly the one behind bars.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2706_0.en: * Huh? Free? But you're clearly the one behind bars.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2706_0.es: * Huh? Free? But you're clearly the one behind bars.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2706_0.ja:
＊ 自由…って…　でも
　 あなたは　どう見ても
　 オリの中ですよね…/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2706_0.ko:
* 자유?
  철창 안에 있는 것 같은데 .../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2706_0.pl: * Co? Wolny? Ale przecież to ty jesteś za kratami.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2706_0.pt-BR: * Huh? Free? But you're clearly the one behind bars.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2706_0.ru: * А? На свободе? Но тут только ты за решёткой, начистоту.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2706_0.zh:
* 啊？自由？可明显你才是
被关起来的那个.../

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2708_0.pt-BR: J* THINGS DON'T SEEM SUCH FROM HERE, LIGHTNERS!/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2708_0.zh:
J* 从我的角度看并非如此，
光之民！/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2710_0.de: * Well, sounds like you don't need any help, then./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2710_0.en: * Well, sounds like you don't need any help, then./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2710_0.es: * Well, sounds like you don't need any help, then./

那这么说你是不需要帮助了。/

* I GROW LONELY IN MY LITTLE FREEDOM./

* I GROW LONELY IN MY LITTLE FREEDOM./

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2714_0.de: * I'LL SHOW YOU WHAT IT MEANS TO BE FREE!/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2719_0.en: * FIND THE KEY, AND I'LL LET YOU BE FREE, FREE./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2719_0.es: * FIND THE KEY, AND I'LL LET YOU BE FREE, FREE./

　 自由にしてやる　おまえたち。/

　 知っています。ヒミツ。カギの。/

* 열쇠는 눈을 피해 숨었네.

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3046_0.de: 0When he was very little, he LOVED the green lizard from that./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3046_0.en: 0* When he was very little, he LOVED the green lizard from that./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3046_0.es: 0* When he was very little, he LOVED the green lizard from that./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3046_0.ja:
0＊ ちっちゃかったころ
　 アズリエルは　あのみどりの
　 トカゲが　おきにいりで…/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3046_0.ko:
0* 아스리엘이 어렸을 때 
  거기 나오는 녹색 도롱뇽을
  그렇게 좋아했지./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3046_0.pl: 0* Kiedy był malutki, UWIELBIAŁ zieloną jaszczurkę z tamtej gry./

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3046_0.ru: 0* Когда он был маленьким, он просто ОБОЖАЛ ту зелёную ящерку./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3046_0.zh:
0* 他很小的时候，
就喜欢里面的那只绿色蜥蜴。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3047_0.de: 9We even had a birthday party for him themed around it./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3047_0.en: 9* We even had a birthday party for him themed around it./

9＊ おたんじょうびパーティの
　 かざりつけも　ぜんぶ
　 みどりのトカゲにしてね…/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3047_0.ko:
9* 아예 그 캐릭터 테마로
  생일파티도 했었잖아./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3047_0.pl: 9* Nawet zorganizowaliśmy mu urodziny w tematyce tego gada./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3047_0.pt-BR: 9* We even had a birthday party for him themed around it./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3047_0.ru: 9* Мы даже устроили тематическую вечеринку на его день рождения./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3047_0.zh:
9* 我们甚至给他开了一个
以此为主题的生日派对。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3048_0.de: 0Your father painted all these eggs with spots as decoration.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3048_0.en: 0* Your father painted all these eggs with spots as decoration.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3048_0.es: 0* Your father painted all these eggs with spots as decoration.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3048_0.ja:
0＊ パパが　タマゴに
　 えのぐで　みどりの
　 みずたまを　かいて…/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3048_0.ko:
0* 네 아빠가 달걀에
  점박이를 그려
  장식을 했는데.../

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3048_0.ru: 0* Твой отец в качестве украшений раскрасил кучу яиц.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3048_0.zh:
0* 你爸爸把所有的蛋
都涂上了斑点作为装饰.../

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3049_0.ja:
9＊ おにいちゃんの
　 よろこんだこと…！/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3049_0.ru: 9* О, твой брат был просто СЧАСТЛИВ!../

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3050_0.de: 5Until the next day, your father cooked them all for breakfast./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3050_0.en: 5* Until the next day, your father cooked them all for breakfast./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3050_0.es: 5* Until the next day, your father cooked them all for breakfast./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3050_0.ja:
5＊ でも　つぎのあさ
　 パパが　ぜーんぶ　わって
　 オムレツにしちゃって。/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3050_0.ko:
5* 그러고는 다음 날 네 아빠가,
  아침밥 한다고
  다 깨버렸지만./

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3050_0.pt-BR: 5* Until the next day, your father cooked them all for breakfast./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3050_0.ru: 5* Пока следующим же днём твой отец не приготовил их на завтрак./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3050_0.zh:
5* 直到第二天，你爸爸
把它们全煮了当早餐吃。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3051_0.ja:
8＊ アズリエルは　おおなき。

　 きらいに　なっちゃって…/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3051_0.pl: 8* Twój brat długo nie mógł przestać płakać.../

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3052_0.de: 4Ever since, he's hated that book about eating green eggs!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3052_0.en: 4* Ever since, he's hated that book about eating green eggs!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3052_0.es: 4* Ever since, he's hated that book about eating green eggs!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3052_0.ja:
4＊ ほら　みどりの　たまごを
　 たべる　おはなしの　ほん。
　 ふふ…　なつかしいわねえ！/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3052_0.ko:
4* 그 뒤로 
  녹색 알을 먹는 내용의 
  동화책을 정말 싫어하게 됐어!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3052_0.pl: 4* Od tamtego dnia, nienawidzi tej książki o zielonych jajkach!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3052_0.pt-BR: 4* Ever since, he's hated that book about eating green eggs!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3052_0.ru: 4* С тех пор он всегда ненавидел ту книгу о готовке зелёных яиц!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3052_0.zh:
4* 从那以后，他恨透了那本
介绍吃绿色的蛋的书！/

只有我们俩住在这里了.../

0＊ でもね　そんなときは

　 パイを　わけて　たべれば…/

0* 하지만, 갓 구운
  따뜻한 파이를 나눠 먹으면.../

分享一个新做的，温暖的派，/

8* 앗, 크리스...

　 “あのひと”からね…？/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3067_0.pt-BR: 5* These are from HIM, are they not./

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3069_0.es: 0* Err, well, worry not, Kris, I will.../

　 ちゃあんと…/

  걱정하지 마, 크리스,

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3069_0.zh:

Kris，我会.../

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3070_0.ja:

　 おきますから。/

  일찍 자러 가는 게
  좋겠구나.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3078_0.pl: 1* Kris, może połóż się dziś wcześniej spać.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3078_0.pt-BR: 1* Kris, perhaps you should go to bed early tonight.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3078_0.ru: 1* Крис, наверное, тебе лучше лечь сегодня пораньше.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3078_0.zh:
1* Kris，你今晚可能应该
早点睡了.../

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3079_0.de: * You do not look quite yourself./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3079_0.en: * You do not look quite yourself./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3079_0.es: * You do not look quite yourself./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3079_0.ja:
＊ なんだか　ちょっと
　 いつもと　かおいろが
　 ちがうもの。/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3079_0.pt-BR: * You do not look quite yourself./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3079_0.zh: * 你看起来像换了个人似的。/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3088_0.en:
* (It's a door.)
* (Where will you go?)/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3104_0.ja: ＊ (しかし　なにも起こらなかった)/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3125_0.ja:
＊ (どういうわけか
　 もう　そこにいる)/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3142_0.de:
* Marga riba!
* That cake!
* It's seething with power!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3142_0.en:
* Marga riba!
* That cake!
* It's seething with power!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3142_0.es:
* Marga riba!
* That cake!
* It's seething with power!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3142_0.ja:
＊ マーマ　レード！
＊ そのケーキ！
＊ すさまじい気を　発しているヨ！/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3142_0.pl:
* Marga riba!
* To ciasto!
* Wypełnia je moc!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3142_0.pt-BR:
* Marga riba!
* Aquele bolo!
* Está fervendo com poder!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3142_0.ru:
* Марга риба!
* Этот торт!
* Он кипит силой!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3142_0.zh:
* 嘛噶里叭！
* 那个蛋糕！
* 它里面翻腾着力量！/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3143_0.de:
* It's my cake, isn't it!?
* Did you repair it!?
* Will you return it!?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3143_0.en:
* It's my cake, isn't it!?
* Did you repair it!?
* Will you return it!?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3143_0.es:
* It's my cake, isn't it!?
* Did you repair it!?
* Will you return it!?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3143_0.ja:
＊ それ　ワタシのケーキですネ？
＊ 修理したのですネ？
＊ 返してくれますネ！？/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3143_0.ko:
* 내 케이크, 맞지!?
* 자네들이 고쳤군!?
* 돌려주지 않겠나!?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3143_0.pl:
* To moje ciasto, prawda!?
* Naprawiliście je!?
* Mogę je odzyskać!?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3143_0.pt-BR:
* É meu bolo, não é?!
* Você reparou ele?!
* Você irá retornar ele a mim?!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3143_0.ru:
* Это ж мой торт, да?!
* Вы его починили?!
* Вернёте?!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3143_0.zh:
* 这是我的蛋糕，对不对！？
* 你把它修好了！？
* 你能还给我吗！？/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3152_0.de: * Edamame! My old cake! I'm so happy I could spin!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3152_0.en: * Edamame! My old cake! I'm so happy I could spin!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3152_0.es: * Edamame! My old cake! I'm so happy I could spin!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3152_0.ja:
＊ エーダマーメ！
　 ワタシの傑作ケーキ！　うれしくって
　 クルクル回っちゃいそうネ！/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3152_0.ko:
* 에다마-메! 나의 오랜 케이크!
  행복해서 돌아버리겠네!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3152_0.pl: * Edamame! Moje stare ciasto! Z radości mógłbym zacząć się kręcić!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3152_0.pt-BR: * Edamame! Meu velho bolo! Eu estou tão feliz que poderia girar!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3152_0.ru: * Эдамаме! Мой старый торт! Я так счастлив, что аж верчусь!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3152_0.zh:
* 俺哒妈咩！我的旧蛋糕！
我高兴得都快要转起来了！/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3153_0.de: * My friend, share in my riches! I have many worse cakes I do not want!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3153_0.en: * My friend, share in my riches! I have many worse cakes I do not want!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3153_0.es: * My friend, share in my riches! I have many worse cakes I do not want!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3153_0.ja:
＊ あなたたちに　お礼がしたいヨ！
　 失敗作ケーキ　たくさんあるヨ！/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3153_0.ko:
* 친구들, 보답하고 싶네!
  내겐 원치 않는
   저급 케이크가 많이 있네!!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3153_0.pl: * Moi przyjaciele, podzielę się swym bogactwem! Mam mnóstwo ciast, których nie chcę!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3153_0.pt-BR: * Meu amigo, divido as minhas riquezas! Eu tenho muitos bolos piores que não quero!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3153_0.ru: * Друзья, я поделюсь богатствами! У меня есть ненужные мне торты похуже!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3153_0.zh:
* 我的朋友们，来分享我的财富吧！
我还存着很多不那么好的蛋糕，
都不想要了！/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3154_0.de: * If you're not carrying a Cake, come here and I'll give you one! Forever!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3154_0.en: * If you're not carrying a Cake, come here and I'll give you one! Forever!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3154_0.es: * If you're not carrying a Cake, come here and I'll give you one! Forever!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3154_0.ja:
＊ ケーキ　1つも持っていないなら
　 ワタシのところへ来てヨ！
　 ケーキあげるヨ！　何度でも！/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3154_0.ko:
* 케이크가 없을 때,
  여기로 오면 하나 주지!
  영원히!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3154_0.pl: * Jeśli nie macie żadnego mojego ciasta, to wam jakieś dam! Tylko poproście!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3154_0.pt-BR: * Se não estiver carregando um bolo, venha aqui e vou te dar um! Pra sempre!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3154_0.ru: * Если у вас нет с собой торта, возвращайтесь, и я вам его дам! Навсегда!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3154_0.zh:
* 如果你身上没有蛋糕，就来我这里！
我会送你一个，多少次都行！/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3156_0.en: 0* (You traded the TopCake for the SpinCake.)/

0＊ (トップケーキを　わたして
　 スピンロールを　手に入れた)/
